In contrast, the effect of employment status on willingness to undertake informal care has been less well explored. This paper concentrates on this less-studied direction of causality using the data provided by 15 waves of the British Household Panel Survey. We find that employment participation and earnings both impact negatively on willingness to supply informal care. This evidence has implications for health and social care policy since informal care has been shown to be a significant substitute for formal long-term care.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.11.003.abstractZh: 关于非正式照顾责任对照顾者从事有偿工作的意愿和能力的影响，已有多项研究。相比之下，就业状况对提供非正式照顾意愿的影响则较少被研究。本文利用英国家庭面板调查15次调查的数据，重点探讨了这一较少被研究的因果关系方向。研究发现，就业参与率和收入都会对提供非正式照顾的意愿产生负面影响。这一发现对卫生和社会护理政策具有重要意义，因为非正式照顾已被证明是正式长期护理的重要替代方式。

abstract.text: The allocation problem in health care can be characterised as a mathematical programming problem but attempts to incorporate uncertainty in costs and effect have suffered from important limitations. A two-stage stochastic mathematical programming formulation is developed and applied to a numerical example to explore and demonstrate the implications of this more general and comprehensive approach. The solution to the allocation problem for different budgets, budgetary policies, and available actions are then demonstrated. This analysis is used to evaluate different budgetary policies and examine the adequacy of standard decision rules in cost-effectiveness analysis. The research decision is then considered alongside the allocation problem. This more general formulation demonstrates that the value of further research depends on: (i) the budgetary policy in place; (ii) the realisations revealed during the budget period; (iii) remedial actions that may be available; and (iv) variability in parameters values.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.11.005.abstractZh: 医疗保健中的分配问题可以被描述为一个数学规划问题，但试图将成本与效果的不确定性纳入其中时遇到了重要的限制。本文提出了一种两阶段随机数学规划模型，并通过一个数值示例来探讨和验证这种更通用且全面的方法的适用性。随后，针对不同的预算、预算政策以及可用的措施，对分配问题的解决方案进行了分析。这一分析用于评估不同的预算政策，并检验标准决策规则在成本效益分析中的适用性。最后，将研究决策与分配问题结合起来进行考虑。这种更通用的模型表明，进一步研究的价值取决于：(i) 现行的预算政策；(ii) 预算期间的实际执行情况；(iii) 可能采取的补救措施；以及(iv) 参数值的变动性。

abstract.text: This paper distinguishes between two scenarios for the physician-patient encounter. In the cure scenario, the patient does not know whether a loss can be recovered. In the prevention scenario, the patient faces a threat but does not know whether this threat is real enough to justify preventive action. The patient wants to induce the physician both to give an accurate diagnosis and to put appropriate effort into cure or prevention. It is shown that in the cure scenario, a contingent fee solves both these incentive problems. In the prevention scenario, however, putting up with low effort makes it easier to get an accurate diagnosis, and the use of contingent fees should be limited. These results are interpreted as providing a rationale for observed exceptions to legal and ethical restrictions on the use of contingent fees. Indeed, such exceptions are often granted for cases that fit the cure scenario.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.11.006.abstractZh: 本文区分了两种医患互动的情景。在治愈情景中，患者并不清楚是否有可能挽回损失。在预防情景中，患者面临某种威胁，但不确定这种威胁是否足够严重，值得采取预防措施。患者希望医生能够做出准确的诊断，并投入适当的努力进行治愈或预防。研究表明，在治愈情景中，约定费用可以解决这两个激励问题。然而，在预防情景中，接受低质量的医疗服务反而更容易获得准确的诊断，因此应限制约定费用的使用。这些结果被解释为对法律与伦理上对约定费用使用的限制所存在的例外情况的合理解释。事实上，这类例外通常适用于符合治愈情景的情况。

abstract.text: We develop a dynamic bio-economic model of bacterial resistance and disease transmission in which we characterize the pricing policy of a monopolist who is protected by a patent. After expiration, the monopolist behaves competitively in a generic industry having open access to the common pool of antibiotic efficacy and infection. The monopolist manages endogenously the levels of antibiotic efficacy as well as the infected population, which represent quality and market size respectively and achieves, at least temporarily, higher such levels than a hypothetically myopic monopolist who does not take into account the dynamic externalities. The pricing policy and the biological system is characterized by the turnpike property. Before the patent vanishes, the monopolist behaves more and more myopically, leading to a continuous decrease in the price of the antibiotic. Once the generic industry takes over, a discontinuous fall in price occurs. Whether a prolongation of the patent is socially desirable depends on the relative levels of antibiotic efficacy and infection.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.11.007.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个动态的生物经济模型，用于研究细菌抗性和疾病传播的关系。该模型描述了受专利保护的垄断者的定价策略。专利到期后，垄断者在具有开放访问权限的通用行业中采取竞争性行为，可以共享抗生素的疗效和感染情况。垄断者能够内生地控制抗生素的疗效水平以及感染人口的数量，从而至少暂时实现比那些不考虑动态外部性的短视垄断者更高的效益。定价策略和生物系统具有“转轨性质”——在专利失效之前，垄断者的行为越来越短视，导致抗生素价格持续下降；一旦通用行业接管，价格会突然下降。专利期限是否延长是否符合社会利益，取决于抗生素疗效和感染情况的相对水平。

abstract.text: Improving patient compliance with physicians' treatment or prescription recommendations is an important goal in medical practice. We examine the relationship between treatment progress and patient compliance. We hypothesize that patients balance expected benefits and costs during a treatment episode when deciding on compliance; a patient is more likely to comply if doing so results in an expected gain in health benefit. We use a unique data set of outpatient alcohol abuse treatment to identify a relationship between treatment progress and compliance. Treatment progress is measured by the clinician's comments after each attended visit. Compliance is measured by a client attending a scheduled appointment, and continuing with treatment. We find that a patient who is making progress is less likely to drop out of treatment. We find no evidence that treatment progress raises the likelihood of a patient attending the next scheduled visit. Our results are robust to unobserved patient heterogeneity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.11.008.abstractZh: 提高患者对医生治疗或处方建议的依从性，是医学实践中的一个重要目标。我们研究了治疗进展与患者依从性之间的关系。我们假设患者在决定依从性时，会权衡预期收益和成本；如果依从性能够带来预期的健康收益，患者就更有可能遵守治疗计划。我们使用一个独特的门诊酒精滥用治疗数据集，来识别治疗进展与依从性之间的关系。治疗进展是通过临床医生每次就诊后的评价来衡量的。依从性则通过患者是否按时参加预约并继续接受治疗来衡量。我们发现，正在取得进展的患者不太可能放弃治疗。我们没有发现治疗进展会增加患者参加下一次预约的可能性。我们的研究结果在考虑到患者个体差异的情况下仍然具有稳健性。

abstract.text: Using Danish register and survey data, we examine the effect of a national graded return-to-work program on the probability of sick-listed workers returning to regular working hours. During program participation, the sick-listed worker works fewer hours and receives the normal hourly wage for the hours worked and sickness benefit for the hours off work. When the worker's health improves, working hours are increased until the sick-listed worker is able to work regular hours. Taking account of unobserved differences between program participants and non-participants, we find that participation in the program significantly increases the probability of returning to regular working hours.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.11.009.abstractZh: 利用丹麦的登记数据和调查数据，我们研究了国家分级重返工作岗位计划对病假工人恢复正常工作时间概率的影响。在计划实施期间，病假工人工作的小时数减少，并领取正常工作时间的正常时薪以及缺勤时间的疾病津贴。当工人的健康状况改善后，工作小时数会逐步增加，直至病假工人能够恢复到正常的工时。考虑到计划参与者和非参与者之间未观察到的差异，我们发现参与该计划显著提高了恢复正常工作时间的概率。

abstract.text: In this paper, we propose a flexible "two-part" random effects model (Olsen and Schafer, 2001; Tooze et al., 2002) for correlated medical cost data. Typically, medical cost data are right-skewed, involve a substantial proportion of zero values, and may exhibit heteroscedasticity. In many cases, such data are also obtained in hierarchical form, e.g., on patients served by the same physician. The proposed model specification therefore consists of two generalized linear mixed models (GLMM), linked together by correlated random effects. Respectively, and conditionally on the random effects and covariates, we model the odds of cost being positive (Part I) using a GLMM with a logistic link and the mean cost (Part II) given that costs were actually incurred using a generalized gamma regression model with random effects and a scale parameter that is allowed to depend on covariates (cf., Manning et al., 2005). The class of generalized gamma distributions is very flexible and includes the lognormal, gamma, inverse gamma and Weibull distributions as special cases. We demonstrate how to carry out estimation using the Gaussian quadrature techniques conveniently implemented in SAS Proc NLMIXED. The proposed model is used to analyze pharmacy cost data on 56,245 adult patients clustered within 239 physicians in a mid-western U.S. managed care organization.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.11.010.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们提出了一个灵活的“两部分”随机效应模型（Olsen和Schafer，2001年；Tooze等人，2002年），用于关联医疗成本数据。通常，医疗成本数据呈右偏态分布，包含大量零值，并且可能存在异方差性。在许多情况下，这类数据也是以层次形式获得的，例如，同一位医生服务的患者数据。因此，所提出的模型由两个广义线性混合模型组成，这两个模型通过相关随机效应相互连接。分别基于随机效应和协变量，我们使用具有逻辑链接的广义线性混合模型来建模成本为正的概率（第一部分），以及实际发生的平均成本（第二部分），其中平均成本采用具有随机效应和允许依赖于协变量的尺度参数的广义伽马回归模型进行估计（参见Manning等人，2005年）。广义伽马分布类非常灵活，包括对数正态分布、伽马分布、逆伽马分布和韦伯分布作为特例。我们展示了如何使用SAS Proc NLMIXED中方便实现的高斯求积技术进行估计。所提出的模型被用于分析美国中西部一个管理式护理组织中56,245名成年患者的药房成本数据。

abstract.text: The problem introduced by grouping income data when measuring socioeconomic inequalities in health (and health care) has been highlighted in a recent study in this journal. We re-examine this issue and show there is a tendency to underestimate the concentration index at an increasing rate when lowering the number of income categories. This tendency arises due to a form of measurement error and we propose two correction methods. Firstly, the use of instrumental variables (IV) can reduce the error within income categories. Secondly, through a simple formula for correction that is based only on the number of groups. We find that the simple correction formula reduces the impact of grouping and always outperforms the IV approach. Use of this correction can substantially improve comparisons of the concentration index both across countries and across time.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.11.011.abstractZh: 在最近的一项研究中，关于在衡量健康（及医疗保健）的社会经济不平等时分组收入数据所引发的问题得到了关注。我们重新审视了这一问题，发现随着收入类别数量的减少，浓度指数的低估趋势逐渐加剧。这种趋势源于一种测量误差，我们提出了两种修正方法。首先，使用工具变量可以减少收入类别内部的误差。其次，通过一种仅基于组数的简单修正公式，我们可以有效降低分组对浓度指数的影响，并且这种修正方法始终优于使用工具变量的方法。采用这种修正方法可以显著改善不同国家之间以及不同时期之间浓度指数的比较效果。

abstract.text: The prevalence of overweight and obesity is growing rapidly in many countries. Education policies might be important for reducing this increase. This paper analyses the causal effect of education on the probability of being overweight by using longitudinal data of Australian identical twins. The data include self-reported and clinical measures of body size. Our cross-sectional estimates confirm the well-known negative association between education and the probability of being overweight. For men we find that education also reduces the probability of being overweight within pairs of identical twins. The estimated effect of education on overweight status increases with age. Remarkably, for women we find no negative effect of education on body size when fixed family effects are taken into account. Identical twin sisters who differ in educational attainment do not systematically differ in body size. Peer effects within pairs of identical twin sisters might play a role.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.11.013.abstractZh: 许多国家中，超重和肥胖的患病率正在迅速上升。教育政策可能在减少这一趋势方面发挥重要作用。本文利用澳大利亚同卵双胞胎的纵向数据，分析了教育对超重概率的因果效应。数据包括自我报告和临床测量的身体尺寸信息。我们的横断面分析证实了教育与超重概率之间的已知负相关关系。对于男性来说，教育还能降低同卵双胞胎中超重的概率。教育对超重状况的估计效应随年龄增长而增强。值得注意的是，对于女性来说，在考虑固定家庭效应后，教育对身体尺寸没有负面影响。在教育水平不同的同卵双胞胎姐妹中，身体尺寸并没有系统性差异。同卵双胞胎姐妹之间的同伴效应可能也起到了一定作用。

abstract.text: Studies on the effect of ageing on health care expenditure (HCE) have revealed the importance of controlling for time-to-death (TTD). These studies, however, are subject to possible endogeneity if HCE influences the remaining life expectancy. This paper introduces a 10-year observation period on monthly HCE, socioeconomic characteristics and survivor status to first predict TTD and then use the predicted values as an instrument in the regression for HCE. While exogeneity of TTD has to be rejected, core results concerning the role of TTD rather than age as a determinant of HCE (the 'red herring' hypothesis) are confirmed.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.11.014.abstractZh: 关于老龄化对医疗保健支出影响的研究揭示了控制至死亡时间的重要性。然而，如果这些医疗保健支出影响了剩余预期寿命，这些研究可能会受到内生性的影响。本文采用10年的月度医疗保健支出、社会经济特征和生存状态数据，首先预测至死亡时间，然后将这些预测值作为回归分析中的工具变量。尽管必须排除至死亡时间的内生性，但关于至死亡时间而非年龄作为医疗保健支出决定因素的核心结果得到了证实（“红鲱鱼假说”）。

abstract.text: Our paper is a first attempt to evaluate the long run impact of reference pricing on pharmaceutical innovation, health and expenditures. The model is based on a dynamic game involving three types of agents: pharmaceutical firms, consumers and a regulatory entity. Pharmaceutical firms choose the level of research investment and its innovative content, then negotiate introductory prices for new drugs with the regulator. Reference pricing affects negatively the intensity of research and it also modifies the types of innovations that are brought to the market, deterring small innovations. The model is calibrated with a small data on statins in France. Our results suggest that reference pricing typically generates a decline in health, whereas discounted expenditures may decrease or increase, depending on the degree of deterrence of cost reducing innovations.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.11.015.abstractZh: 我们的论文首次尝试评估参考定价对制药创新、健康及支出的长期影响。该模型基于一个动态博弈，涉及三种类型的参与者：制药公司、消费者以及监管机构。制药公司决定研究投资的规模及其创新内容，然后与监管机构协商新药的定价。参考定价会负面影响研究的强度，同时还会改变市场上推出的创新类型，从而抑制小型创新的涌现。该模型以法国他汀类药物的相关数据进行了校准。我们的研究结果表明，参考定价通常会导致健康水平的下降，而贴现后的支出则可能减少或增加，这取决于成本降低型创新的威慑力。

abstract.text: We empirically investigate the effect of tolerance for gays on the spread of HIV in the United States. Using a state-level panel dataset spanning the mid-1970s to the mid-1990s, we find that tolerance is negatively associated with the HIV rate. We then investigate the causal mechanisms potentially underlying this relationship. We find evidence consistent with the theory that tolerance for homosexuals causes low-risk men to enter the pool of homosexual partners, as well as causes sexually active men to substitute away from underground, anonymous, and risky behaviors, both of which lower the HIV rate.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.11.016.abstractZh: 我们通过实证研究了对同性恋的宽容态度对美国艾滋病病毒传播的影响。利用从20世纪70年代中期到90年代中期的州级面板数据集，我们发现宽容态度与艾滋病病毒感染率呈负相关。随后，我们探讨了这种关系背后的潜在因果机制。我们发现，与理论一致的证据表明，对同性恋的宽容态度促使低风险男性加入同性恋伴侣群体，同时促使性活跃男性放弃地下、匿名和危险的行为，而这些行为都能降低艾滋病病毒感染率。

abstract.text: Social host laws for minors aim to reduce teenage alcohol consumption by imposing liability on adults who host parties. Parents cite safety reasons as part of their motivation for hosting parties, preferring their teens and their teens' friends to drink in a supervised and safe locale. Both sides predict an effect of social host liability for minors on alcohol-related traffic accident rates for under-aged drinkers; the effects, however, work in opposite directions. This paper finds that, among 18-20 year olds, social host liability for minors reduced the drunk-driving fatality rate by 9%. I find no effect on sober traffic fatalities. Survey data on drinking and drunk driving suggest the declines resulted mostly from reductions in drunk driving and not reductions in drinking.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.12.001.abstractZh: 针对未成年人的“社会主办者责任”立法旨在通过追究举办派对的成年人的责任来减少青少年饮酒行为。家长以安全为由作为举办派对的动机，他们更愿意让青少年及其朋友在受监督且安全的环境中饮酒。双方都认为，这种针对未成年人的社会主办者责任会对与酒精相关的交通事故发生率产生积极影响；然而，这些影响的方向却相反。本文发现，在18至20岁的年轻人中，针对未成年人的社会主办者责任使酒后驾车死亡率降低了9%。而清醒状态下的交通事故死亡率则没有变化。关于饮酒和酒后驾车的调查数据显示，这种下降主要源于酒后驾车的减少，而非饮酒行为的减少。

abstract.text: A physician performs two tasks: making diagnoses and determining treatments. To reduce medical error, junior doctors are supposed to consult their supervisors when they face uncommon circumstances. However, recent research shows that junior doctors are reluctant to do so. This paper presents a model that explains (i) which junior doctors shy away from consulting; (ii) when junior doctors are reluctant; (iii) the importance of protocols in the medical sector; and (iv) when consulting is a sign of strength or a sign of weakness. Furthermore, I show that encouraging junior doctors to consult by investigating mishaps leads to another distortion: they will give too much weight to own assessments.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.12.002.abstractZh: 医生承担着两项任务：诊断疾病和制定治疗方案。为了减少医疗错误，初级医生在面临异常情况时应该向上级医生咨询。然而，最近的研究表明，初级医生并不愿意这样做。本文提出了一个模型，用以解释以下问题：(i) 哪些初级医生不愿意咨询；(ii) 他们在何时不愿意咨询；(iii) 医疗行业中的规范的重要性；(iv) 咨询究竟是力量的象征还是弱点的象征。此外，我还指出，通过调查医疗事故来鼓励初级医生咨询会导致另一个问题：他们会过分重视自己的评估。

abstract.text: Using annual, repeated cross-sections from national household surveys, we estimate how the January 1997 termination of federal disability insurance, Supplemental Security Income (SSI), for those with Drug Addiction and Alcoholism affected labor market outcomes among individuals targeted by the legislation. We also examine whether the policy change affected health insurance, health care utilization, and arrests. We employ propensity-score methods to address differences in observed characteristics between likely substance users and others, and we used a difference-in-difference-in-difference approach to mitigate potential omitted variables bias. In the short-run (1997-1998), declines in SSI receipt accompanied appreciable increases in labor force participation and current employment. There was little measurable effect of the policy change on insurance and utilization, but we have limited power to detect effects on these outcomes. In the later period after the policy change (1999-2002), the rate of SSI receipt rose, and short-run gains in labor market outcomes diminished.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.12.003.abstractZh: 我们通过使用全国家庭调查中的年度重复横截面数据，来估计1997年1月联邦残疾保险中的补充安全收入计划终止对患有药物成瘾和酒精中毒的人的劳动力市场结果产生了怎样的影响。我们还研究了这一政策变化是否影响了健康保险、医疗利用以及逮捕率。我们采用倾向得分法来消除潜在变量偏差，同时利用差异-差异-差异方法来减少这种偏差的影响。在短期内（1997-1998年），补充安全收入领取额的下降伴随着劳动力参与率和当前就业率的显著上升。政策变化对保险和医疗利用的影响较小，但我们检测这些结果的能力有限。在政策变化后的后期阶段（1999-2002年），补充安全收入领取额有所上升，而劳动力市场的短期收益则有所减少。

abstract.text: Analysis of a broad survey of Japanese adults confirms that time discounting relates to body weight, not only via impatience, but also via hyperbolic discounting, proxied by inclination toward procrastination, and the sign effect, where future negative payoffs are discounted at a lower rate than future positive payoffs. Body mass index is positively associated with survey responses indicative of impatience and hyperbolic discounting, and negatively associated with those indicative of the sign effect. A one-unit increase in the degree of procrastination is associated with a 2.81 percentage-point increase in the probability of being obese. Subjects exhibiting the sign effect show a 3.69 percentage-point lower probability of being obese and a 4.02 percentage-point higher probability of being underweight than those without the sign effect. These effects are substantial compared with the prevalence rates of the corresponding body mass status. Obesity and underweight thus result in part from the temporal decision biases.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.01.002.abstractZh: 对日本成年人进行的广泛调查表明，时间折扣与体重有关，这不仅通过急躁情绪体现，还通过双曲折扣体现，表现为拖延倾向，以及符号效应，即未来负面收益的折扣率低于未来正面收益。体质指数与表现出急躁和双曲折扣的问卷回答呈正相关，而与表现出符号效应的问卷回答呈负相关。拖延程度每增加一个单位，肥胖的概率就会增加2.81个百分点。表现出符号效应的受试者，肥胖的概率比没有这种效应的受试者低3.69个百分点，而体重过轻的概率则高出4.02个百分点。这些效应与相应体质状态的患病率相比相当显著。因此，肥胖和体重过轻在一定程度上是由时间决策偏差导致的。

abstract.text: We evaluate the effects of a reduction in sick pay from 100 to 80% of the wage. Unlike previous literature, apart from absence from work, we also consider effects on doctor/hospital visits and subjective health indicators. We also add to the literature by estimating both switch-on and switch-off effects, because the reform was repealed 2 years later. We find a 2-day reduction in the number of days of absence. Quantile regression reveals higher point estimates (both in absolute and relative terms) at higher quantiles, meaning that the reform predominantly reduced long durations of absence. In terms of health, the reform reduced the average number of days spent in hospital by almost half a day, but we cannot find robust evidence for negative effects on health outcomes or perceived liquidity constraints.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.01.003.abstractZh: 我们评估了将病假工资从工资的100%降低到80%的影响。与以往的研究不同，除了缺勤情况外，我们还考虑了其对医生/医院就诊次数以及主观健康指标的影响。此外，由于该改革在两年后被废止，我们还估算了改革带来的“开启效应”和“关闭效应”。研究发现，缺勤天数减少了2天。分位数回归显示，在较高的分位数上，点估计值（无论是绝对值还是相对值）都更高，这意味着该改革主要减少了长期缺勤的情况。在健康方面，该改革使平均住院天数减少了近半天，但我们未能找到关于健康结果或感知流动性约束的负面影响的可靠证据。

abstract.text: A new method is proposed to assess and improve the performance of risk equalization models in competitive markets for individual health insurance, where compensation is intended for variation in observed expenditures due to so-called S(ubsidy)-type risk factors but not for variation due to other, so-called N(on-subsidy)-type risk factors. Given the availability of a rich subsample of individuals for which normative expenditures, Y(NORM), can be accurately determined, we make two contributions: (a) any risk equalization scheme applied to the entire population, Y(REF), should be evaluated through its performance in the subsample, by comparing Y(REF) with Y(NORM) (not by comparing Y(REF) with observed expenditures, Y, in the entire population, as commonly done); (b) conventional risk equalization schemes can be improved by the subsample regression of Y(NORM), rather than Y, on the risk adjusters that are observable in the entire population. This new method is illustrated by an application to the 2004 Dutch risk equalization model.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.02.001.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新方法，用于评估和改进竞争市场中个人健康保险风险均衡模型的性能。该模型旨在对由于所谓的“补贴型”风险因素导致的支出变化进行补偿，而不针对其他所谓的“非补贴型”风险因素导致的支出变化。鉴于有大量的个体样本可供使用，这些样本中的规范支出可以准确确定，我们提出了两种改进方法：(a) 任何应用于整个人群的风险均衡方案，都应通过其在样本中的表现来评估，即通过比较Y(REF)与Y(NORM)；(b) 传统的风险均衡方案可以通过对Y(NORM)而非Y进行样本回归来改进，而不是像通常那样将Y与整个人群中的实际支出Y进行比较。该方法通过2004年荷兰风险均衡模型的应用进行了说明。

abstract.text: We investigate whether the removal of high-cost individuals from private insurance markets leads to greater coverage for individuals who are similar but not as high cost. Using data on insurance coverage from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics, we estimate the effect of the extension of Medicare to the disabled on the private insurance coverage of non-disabled individuals. We find that the insurance coverage of individuals who had a health condition that limited their ability to work increased significantly in states with high versus low rates of disability.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.02.002.abstractZh: 我们研究了从私人保险市场中移除高成本个体是否会导致那些相似但成本较低的个体获得更多的保险覆盖。利用《收入动态面板研究》中的保险覆盖数据，我们估计了将医疗保险扩展到残疾人士对非残疾个体私人保险覆盖的影响。研究发现，那些因健康状况而限制工作能力的个体的保险覆盖在残疾率较高的州显著增加。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of household financial indebtedness on psychological well-being using a large household survey of families with children in Britain. Existing studies that find a link between debt and depression tend to utilise small and highly selective samples of people and only self-reported measures of financial stress, responses to which are likely to correlate with subjective measures of health. From additional household data, we can construct a variety of 'objective' quantitative measures of financial stress in order to validate self-reported measures. We show that, although there is a positive association between subjective measures of financial well-being and psychological well-being, individuals differ in their psychological response to objective household financial situations. We also examine how the potential simultaneity of financial and psychological health might be handled.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.02.003.abstractZh: 我们通过一项针对英国有子女家庭的大型家庭调查，研究了家庭财务负债对心理健康的影響。现有研究发现债务与抑郁之间存在关联，但这些研究通常采用规模较小且选择性较高的样本，并且仅使用自我报告的财务压力指标，而这些指标可能与主观健康指标存在相关性。通过额外的家庭数据，我们可以构建多种“客观”的定量财务压力指标，以验证自我报告的指标。研究表明，尽管主观财务福祉指标与心理福祉之间存在正相关关系，但个体对客观家庭财务状况的心理反应存在差异。我们还探讨了如何应对财务健康与心理健康之间的潜在同时性问题。

abstract.text: To promote stockpiling of anti-viral drugs by non-government organizations such as hospitals, drug manufacturers have introduced Manufacturer Reserve Programs which, for an annual fee, provide the right to buy in the event of a severe outbreak of influenza. We show that these programs enhance drug manufacturer profits but could either increase or decrease the amount of pre-pandemic stockpiling of anti-viral drugs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.02.004.abstractZh: 为了促进非政府组织如医院和药品制造商对抗病毒药物的储备，这些机构引入了制造商储备计划。通过支付年度费用，这些计划可以在流感严重爆发时提供购买权限。研究表明，这些计划确实增加了药品制造商的利润，但也可能增加或减少疫情爆发前的抗病毒药物储备量。

abstract.text: We examine patterns in adults' willingness to pay for health-risk reductions. We allow both their marginal utilities of income and their marginal disutilities from health risks to vary systematically with the structures of their households. Demand by adults for programs which reduce their own health risks is found to be influenced by (1) their parenthood status, (2) the numbers of children in different age brackets currently in their households, (3) the ages of the adults themselves, (4) the latency period before they would fall ill, and (5) whether there will still be children in the household at that time. For younger adults, willingness to pay by parents is greater than for non-parents, and increases with each additional young child. For middle-aged adults, willingness to pay for corresponding risk reductions falls when teenagers are present and falls further with each additional teenager in the household.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.02.005.abstractZh: 我们研究了成年人愿意为降低健康风险而支付的金额 patterns。我们认为，他们的收入边际效用以及健康风险带来的边际负效用会随家庭结构而系统性地变化。研究发现，成年人对于降低自身健康风险的项目的需求受到以下因素的影响：(1) 他们的父母身份；(2) 家庭中当前不同年龄段的儿童数量；(3) 成年人自身的年龄；(4) 他们生病前的潜伏期；(5) 届时家庭中是否还有其他儿童。对于较年轻的成年人来说，父母愿意支付的金额大于非父母者，并且随着每增加一个年幼的孩子，支付意愿会增加。对于中年成年人来说，当家庭中有青少年时，他们愿意支付的金额会减少，并且随着家庭中每增加一个青少年，支付意愿进一步降低。

abstract.text: For decades, the US public and private sectors have committed substantial resources towards cancer research, but the societal payoff has not been well-understood. We quantify the value of recent gains in cancer survival, and analyze the distribution of value among various stakeholders. Between 1988 and 2000, life expectancy for cancer patients increased by roughly four years, and the average willingness-to-pay for these survival gains was roughly $322,000. Improvements in cancer survival during this period created 23 million additional life-years and roughly $1.9 trillion of additional social value, implying that the average life-year was worth approximately $82,000 to its recipient. Health care providers and pharmaceutical companies appropriated 5-19% of this total, with the rest accruing to patients. The share of value flowing to patients has been rising over time. In terms of economic rates of return, R&D investments against cancer have been a success, particularly from the patient's point of view.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.02.006.abstractZh: 几十年来，美国公共和私营部门投入了大量资源用于癌症研究，但这一举措的社会效益尚未得到充分理解。我们量化了癌症患者生存改善所带来的价值，并分析了这些价值在不同利益相关者之间的分配情况。在1988年至2000年间，癌症患者的预期寿命增加了大约四年，而人们为这些生存改善所付出的平均费用约为32.2万美元。这一时期的癌症生存改善使得患者增加了2300万年的寿命，并创造了约1.9万亿美元的社会价值，这意味着平均每年寿命的附加值约为8.2万美元。医疗保健机构和制药公司获得了总价值的5%到19%，其余部分则归患者所有。随着时间的推移，流向患者的价值份额一直在上升。从经济回报的角度来看，针对癌症的研发投资取得了成功，尤其是从患者的角度来看。

abstract.text: This study examines whether maternal employment affects the health status of low-income, elementary-school-aged children using instrumental variables estimation and experimental data from a welfare-to-work program implemented in the early 1990s. Maternal report of child health status is predicted as a function of exogenous variation in maternal employment associated with random assignment to the experimental group. IV estimates show a modest adverse effect of maternal employment on children's health. Making use of data from another welfare-to-work program we propose that any adverse effect on child health may be tempered by increased family income and access to public health insurance coverage, findings with direct relevance to a number of current policy discussions. In a secondary analysis using fixed effects techniques on longitudinal survey data collected in 1998 and 2001, we find a comparable adverse effect of maternal employment on child health that supports the external validity of our primary result.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.02.007.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了母亲就业是否会影响低收入、小学年龄段儿童的健康状况，采用了1990年代初期实施的福利转就业项目的实验数据，并通过工具变量估计方法进行分析。母亲对儿童健康状况的反馈被预测为与随机分配到实验组相关的母亲就业状况变化的函数。工具变量估计结果显示，母亲就业对儿童健康的负面影响较为轻微。通过利用另一个福利转就业项目的数据，我们提出，任何对儿童健康的负面影响都可能因家庭收入的增加以及公共健康保险覆盖率的提高而得到缓解。这些发现与当前多项政策讨论密切相关。在利用1998年和2001年收集的纵向调查数据的固定效应技术进行二次分析时，我们发现母亲就业对儿童健康的负面影响与主要研究结果具有可比性，这进一步支持了我们的主要结论的外部有效性。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of education on smoking. Our estimation strategy "differences out" the impact of unobserved characteristics correlated with education by exploiting education differences between similarly selected groups 1 year apart in their life cycle. Individuals with a given age, education, and student status in the current and previous year are compared to their counterparts born 1 year later with the same age, education, and student status in the following and current year. We find that an additional year of education does not have a causal effect on smoking. Unobserved factors correlated with education entirely explain their cross-sectional relationship.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.03.001.abstractZh: 我们估计了教育对吸烟的影响。我们的估计策略通过利用在生命周期中相隔一年且被相似方式选出的不同群体之间的教育差异，来排除与教育相关的未观测特征的影响。将当前年份和前一年具有特定年龄、教育和学生身份的个体与一年后出生的具有相同年龄、教育和学生身份的个体进行比较。我们发现，额外一年的教育并不会对吸烟行为产生因果效应。与教育相关的未观测因素完全解释了它们之间的横截面关系。

abstract.text: Malaria kills over a million people each year. The loss of chloroquine due to the spread of parasite resistance is largely responsible for the resurgence of malaria. A new class of antimalarial drugs called artemisinins are available, but are unaffordable to most people in malaria-endemic countries and may quickly face the same fate as chloroquine unless they are combined with a partner drug. Subsidies for artemisinin combination treatments may be warranted on second-best grounds as they deter use of single-ingredient drugs, for which externalities from the risk of resistance evolution are larger. Furthermore, by expanding total effective drug use, subsidies reduce infection transmission externalities among individuals. However, use of combination treatments could still lead to drug resistance and the subsidies themselves entail welfare consequences. This paper develops a conceptual and numerical framework for understanding the conditions under which subsidies for artemisinin combinations can be justified on economic efficiency grounds.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.03.002.abstractZh: 疟疾每年导致超过一百万人死亡。由于寄生虫抗药性的传播，氯喹的短缺是疟疾重新流行的主因。目前有一种新的抗疟药物——青蒿素类药物，但在疟疾流行国家，大多数人无法负担这种药物，除非将其与另一种药物联合使用，否则这类药物也可能很快面临与氯喹相同的命运。对青蒿素组合疗法的补贴可能是合理的，因为这类补贴可以阻止人们使用单一成分的药物，而单一成分药物的抗药性问题更为严重。此外，通过增加有效药物的使用量，补贴可以减少个体之间的感染传播。然而，联合疗法的使用仍可能导致药物抗性的产生，而补贴本身也会带来福利方面的后果。本文提出了一个概念性和数值框架，用于理解在何种条件下可以基于经济效率的理由对青蒿素组合疗法进行补贴。

abstract.text: We study the relationship between physician-hospital integration and its relation to monitoring IT utilization. We develop a theoretical model in which monitoring IT may complement or substitute for integration and test these relationships using a novel data source. Physician labor market heterogeneity identifies the empirical model. We find that monitoring IT utilization is increasing in integration, implying that expanded firm boundaries complement monitoring IT adoption. We argue that the relationship between monitoring IT and firm boundaries depends upon the contractibility of the monitored information.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.03.003.abstractZh: 我们研究了医生与医院整合之间的关系，以及这种整合与信息技术监控使用之间的关系。我们建立了一个理论模型，在该模型中，信息技术监控可以补充或替代整合，并通过新的数据来源来测试这些关系。医生劳动力市场的异质性为实证模型提供了依据。我们发现，随着整合程度的提高，信息技术监控的使用也在增加，这表明企业边界的扩大有助于促进信息技术监控的采用。我们认为，信息技术监控与企业边界之间的关系取决于被监控信息的可契约性。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the existence and scope of possible racial differences/disparities in the provision of emergency medical services (EMS) response capability (time from dispatch to arrival at the scene and level of training of the responding team) using data on approximately 120,000 cardiac incidents in the state of Mississippi during 1995-2004. The conceptual framework and empirical analysis focus on the likely effects of population density on the efficient production of EMS as a local public good subject to congestion, and on the need to control adequately for population density to avoid bias in testing for racial differences. Models that control for aggregate population density at the county-level indicate "reverse" disparities: faster estimated response times for African-Americans than for whites. When a refined county-level measure of population density is used that incorporates differences in African-American and white population density by Census tract, the reverse disparity in response times disappears. There also is little or no evidence of race-related differences in the certification level of EMS responders. However, there is evidence that, controlling for response time, African-Americans on average were significantly more likely to be deceased than whites upon EMS arrival at the scene. The overall results are germane to the debate over the scope of conditioning variables that should be included when testing for racial disparities in health care.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.03.004.abstractZh: 本文利用1995至2004年间密西西比州约120,000起心脏相关事件的数据，分析了紧急医疗服务响应能力（从调度到现场到达的时间以及响应团队的培训水平）中可能存在种族差异/差异的范围。概念框架和实证分析重点关注人口密度对紧急医疗服务有效供给的影响，因为紧急医疗服务是一种受拥堵影响的局部公共产品，同时强调了需要充分控制人口密度以避免在测试种族差异时出现偏差。在县级层面控制总体人口密度的模型显示出了“逆向”差异：非裔美国人的响应时间估计比白人更快。当使用更精细的县级人口密度测量方法，并考虑按人口普查区划分的非裔美国人和白人人口密度差异时，这种逆向差异就消失了。此外，几乎没有证据表明紧急医疗服务响应人员的认证水平存在种族差异。然而，有证据表明，在控制响应时间的情况下，非裔美国人在紧急医疗服务到达现场时，平均死亡的可能性显著高于白人。这些结果对于讨论在测试医疗服务的种族差异时应包含哪些条件变量具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Despite the well-known benefits of exercise, the time required for exercise is widely understood as a major reason for low levels of exercise in the US. Intensity of exercise can change the time required for a given amount of total exercise but has never been studied from an economic perspective. We present a simple model of exercise behavior which suggests that the intensity of exercise should increase relative to time spent exercising as wages increase, holding other determinants of exercise constant. Our empirical results identify an association between income and exercise intensity that is consistent with the hypothesis that people respond to increased time costs of exercise by increasing intensity. More generally, our results suggest that time costs may be an important determinant of exercise patterns and that factors that can influence the time costs of exercise, such as intensity, may be important concerns in designing interventions to promote exercise.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.03.005.abstractZh: 尽管运动具有众所周知的好处，但人们普遍认为，运动所需的时间是美国人们运动水平较低的一个重要原因。运动强度可以改变完成一定运动量所需的时间，但从未从经济角度进行过研究。我们提出了一个简单的运动行为模型，该模型表明，在其他因素保持不变的情况下，随着工资的增加，运动强度应该随着运动时间的增加而提高。我们的实证结果表明，收入与运动强度之间存在关联，这一关联与“人们通过增加运动强度来应对运动时间成本增加”的假设一致。更一般地说，我们的结果表明，时间成本可能是决定运动模式的重要因素，而能够影响运动时间成本的因素，如运动强度，可能是设计促进运动干预措施时需要考虑的重要问题。

abstract.text: Partial expected value of perfect information (EVPI) quantifies the value of removing uncertainty about unknown parameters in a decision model. EVPIs can be computed via Monte Carlo methods. An outer loop samples values of the parameters of interest, and an inner loop samples the remaining parameters from their conditional distribution. This nested Monte Carlo approach can result in biased estimates if small numbers of inner samples are used and can require a large number of model runs for accurate partial EVPI estimates. We present a simple algorithm to estimate the EVPI bias and confidence interval width for a specified number of inner and outer samples. The algorithm uses a relatively small number of model runs (we suggest approximately 600), is quick to compute, and can help determine how many outer and inner iterations are needed for a desired level of accuracy. We test our algorithm using three case studies.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.03.006.abstractZh: 完全信息下的部分期望价值（EVPI）用于量化消除决策模型中未知参数不确定性所带来的价值。可以通过蒙特卡洛方法计算EVPI。外部循环会抽样感兴趣的参数值，内部循环则从其条件分布中抽样其余参数值。这种嵌套的蒙特卡洛方法如果使用较少的内部样本，可能会导致估计偏差，并且需要大量模型运行才能获得准确的EVPI估计。我们提出了一种简单算法，用于估计给定内部和外部样本数量下的EVPI偏差和置信区间宽度。该算法使用的模型运行次数相对较少（我们建议约600次），计算速度快，并且可以帮助确定为了达到所需精度水平需要多少外部和内部迭代。我们通过三个案例研究来测试我们的算法。

abstract.text: Childhood asthma is a major chronic condition affecting millions of children in this country, yet little is known about its potential long term consequences. In this paper, we estimate the relationship between childhood asthma and several outcomes as a young adult. To overcome many of the methodological issues plaguing earlier research on this topic, we estimate sibling fixed effect models that correct for measurement error using parental reports of asthma status. In our preferred specification, we find substantial long term impacts of childhood asthma on general health status, obesity, and missed work and school days as a young adult. Broadly, our findings contribute to the growing literature in social sciences on the impacts of early life health conditions on later life health and social outcomes and suggest early treatment of asthma may have long-run benefits on young adult health and socioeconomic outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.03.007.abstractZh: 儿童哮喘是一种影响该国数百万儿童的主要慢性疾病，然而对其潜在的长期影响知之甚少。在本文中，我们估计了儿童哮喘与成年后多个结果之间的关系。为了克服早期研究中的许多方法学问题，我们采用了兄弟姐妹固定效应模型，并利用父母对哮喘状况的反馈来校正测量误差。在我们的优选模型中，我们发现儿童哮喘对成年后的整体健康状况、肥胖问题以及缺勤天数有显著的长期影响。总体而言，我们的研究结果为社会科学中关于早期生活健康状况对后期健康和社会结果影响的日益丰富的文献做出了贡献，并表明早期治疗哮喘可能对成年后的健康和社会经济结果具有长期益处。

abstract.text: This article analyses the redistributive effect caused by health financing and the distribution of healthcare utilization in Argentina before and during the severe 2001/2002 economic crisis. Both dramatically changed during this period: the redistributive effect became much more positive and utilization shifted from pro-poor to pro-rich. This clearly demonstrates that when utilization is contingent on financing, changes can occur rapidly; and that an integrated approach is required when monitoring equity. From a policy perspective, the Argentine health system appears vulnerable to economic downturns mainly due to high reliance on out-of-pocket payments and the strong link between health insurance and employment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.03.008.abstractZh: 本文分析了健康融资对阿根廷在2001/2002年严重经济危机前后再分配效应的影响，以及医疗服务的分配情况。在此期间，这两种情况都发生了显著变化：再分配效应变得更加积极，而医疗服务的使用则从有利于贫困人口转向了有利于富人。这清楚地表明，当医疗服务的使用依赖于融资时，变化可以迅速发生；在监测公平状况时，需要采用综合的方法。从政策角度来看，阿根廷的卫生系统似乎容易受到经济衰退的影响，主要是因为其高度依赖自付费用，且医疗保险与就业之间存在紧密的联系。

abstract.text: This paper seeks to create new insights when judging the impact different risk adjustment schemes may have on the incentive to select risks. It distinguishes risk types with high and low profit potential and estimates long-run profits associated with risk selection in four scenarios (no risk adjustment, demographic only, including prior hospitalization, and including prior hospitalization and Pharmaceutical Cost Groups). The database covers 180,000 Swiss individuals over 8 years, 3 of which are used for model building and 5, to estimate insurers' profits due to risk selection in the four scenarios. While these profits prove to be very high without risk adjustment and still substantial with demographic risk adjustment, they become surprisingly low when the crude morbidity indicator 'prior hospitalization' is included in the formula. These results clearly indicate the need for health status-related risk adjustment in insurance markets with community rating, taking into account insurers' planning horizon.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.03.009.abstractZh: 本文旨在探讨不同的风险调整方案对选择风险的激励作用的影响，并提出新的见解。文章将风险类型分为高利润潜力与低利润潜力两类，并针对四种情景（无风险调整、仅考虑人口统计因素、包含既往住院情况以及包含既往住院情况和药品成本组）估算风险选择带来的长期利润。研究数据涵盖了8年间180,000名瑞士个体，其中3个数据用于模型构建，5个数据用于估算四种情景下保险公司因风险选择而产生的利润。结果显示，在没有风险调整的情况下，这些利润非常高；而在考虑人口统计风险调整的情况下，利润仍然相当可观。然而，当在公式中加入既往住院这一粗死亡率指标时，这些利润却意外地降低。这些结果清楚地表明，在采用社区评级的保险市场中，需要考虑与健康状况相关的风险调整，同时还应考虑保险公司的规划期限。

abstract.text: The standard practice in cost-effectiveness analyses of health care is to assign a linear value to increasing lifetime gains. The aim of the current study was to examine the possible existence of non-linear utility for short life extensions. A representative sample of the Norwegian population, aged 40-59 years (n=2402), was asked to imagine that they had a limited remaining lifetime (1 year or 10 years) and were offered a treatment that would increase lifetime by a specified amount of time from 1 week to 1 year. In all scenarios, the price per week of life extension was held constant. The proportion of respondents that accepted the treatment increased with increasing extensions, indicating a convex utility function. The result suggests increasing marginal utility for life extensions up to 1 year.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.03.010.abstractZh: 在医疗成本效益分析中，通常的做法是将寿命延长带来的收益赋予线性价值。本研究的目的是探讨寿命短暂时是否存在非线性效用。对挪威40-59岁人群进行了代表性样本调查，共有2402名参与者。他们被要求假设自己的剩余寿命有限（1年或10年），并接受一个能够将其寿命从1周延长到1年的治疗方案。在所有情景中，每次延长寿命的每周费用保持不变。随着寿命延长时间的增加，接受治疗的受访者比例也上升，这表明存在凸效用函数。研究结果表明，对于1年以内的寿命延长，边际效用是递增的。

abstract.text: When premiums are community-rated, risk adjustment (RA) serves to mitigate competitive insurers' incentive to select favorable risks. However, unless fully prospective, it also undermines their incentives for efficiency. By capping its volume, one may try to counteract this tendency, exposing insurers to some financial risk. This in term runs counter the quest to refine the RA formula, which would increase RA volume. Specifically, the adjuster, "Hospitalization or living in a nursing home during the previous year" will be added in Switzerland starting 2012. This paper investigates how to minimize the opportunity cost of capping RA in terms of increased incentives for risk selection.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.04.001.abstractZh: 在保费采用社区评级的情况下，风险调整机制有助于减少竞争性保险公司选择有利风险对象的动机。然而，除非这种调整是全面的，否则也会削弱保险公司追求效率的积极性。通过限制风险调整的数量，可以试图抵消这种趋势，但这会使保险公司面临一定的财务风险。这与完善风险调整公式的目标背道而驰，而完善风险调整公式将有助于提高风险调整的数量。具体来说，从2012年起，瑞士将增加一项调整因素，即“过去一年是否住院或居住在护理院”。本文探讨了如何最大限度地减少风险调整数量带来的机会成本，同时又不影响保险公司选择有利风险对象的积极性。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of exposure to a set of toxic pollutants that are tracked by the Toxic Release Inventory (TRI) from manufacturing facilities on county-level infant and fetal mortality rates in the United States between 1989 and 2002. Unlike previous studies, we control for toxic pollution from both mobile sources and non-TRI reporting facilities. We find significant adverse effects of toxic air pollution concentrations on infant mortality rates. Within toxic air pollutants we find that releases of carcinogens are particularly problematic for infant health outcomes. We estimate that the average county-level decreases in various categories of TRI concentrations saved in excess of 13,800 infant lives from 1989 to 2002. Using the low end of the range for the value of a statistical life that is typically used by the EPA of $1.8M, the savings in lives would be valued at approximately $25B.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.04.002.abstractZh: 我们研究了1989年至2002年间，美国各制造设施排放的有毒污染物对县级婴儿和胎儿死亡率的影响。与以往的研究不同，我们同时考虑了来自移动污染源和非TRI报告设施的有毒污染。研究发现，有毒空气污染浓度对婴儿死亡率有显著的负面影响。在有毒空气污染物中，致癌物质的排放对婴儿健康尤为不利。我们估计，从1989年到2002年，各县级TRI浓度各项指标的下降，使得超过13,800名婴儿的生命得以挽救。如果使用美国环保署通常使用的统计生命价值下限180万美元来计算，这些生命的挽救所带来的价值约为250亿美元。

abstract.text: We examine the implications of policies to improve information about the qualities of profit-seeking duopoly hospitals which face the same regulated price and compete on quality. We show that if hospital costs of quality are similar then better information increases the quality of both hospitals. However, if the costs are sufficiently different improved information will reduce the quality of both hospitals. Moreover, even when quality increases, better information may increase or decrease patient welfare depending on whether an ex post or ex ante view of welfare is taken.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.04.003.abstractZh: 我们研究了改善关于营利性双头医院质量信息的政策影响，这些医院面临相同的监管价格，并在质量上进行竞争。研究表明，如果医院的质量成本相似，那么更好的信息会提升两家医院的质量。然而，如果成本差异足够大，更好的信息反而会降低两家医院的质量。此外，即使质量有所提升，更好的信息也可能根据是对福利的事后评估还是事前评估而有所不同，从而影响患者的福利。

abstract.text: The conventional economic wisdom is that improving consumer information will enhance welfare. Yet, some scientists speculate that the Food and Drug Administration's prominent mercury in fish advisory may have harmed public health. Lower mercury intakes reduce neurological toxicity risks. However, since seafood is the predominant dietary source of healthful omega-3 fatty acids, reduced fish consumption may have significant offsetting health impacts. We explore this risk trade-off using a rich panel of household-level seafood consumption data. To control for confounding factors, we use a non-parametric changes-in-changes approach. We find strong evidence that while the advisory reduced mercury loadings, it did so at the expense of substantial reductions in healthful omega-3s. We find this response pattern even for consumers with low fish consumption. Using advisory response patterns as inputs into a prominent risk assessment model, the central estimate is that net benefits from the advisory were negative.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.05.001.abstractZh: 传统的经济学观点认为，改善消费者的信息将会提升福利。然而，一些科学家推测，美国食品药品监督管理局关于鱼类中含汞的警告可能对公众健康造成了损害。较低的汞摄入量可以降低神经毒性风险。不过，由于海鲜是健康ω-3脂肪酸的主要来源，减少鱼类消费可能会带来其他显著的负面影响。我们利用大量家庭层面的海鲜消费数据来探讨这种风险权衡。为了控制混杂因素，我们采用了非参数变化-变化方法。我们发现，尽管该警告减少了汞的摄入量，但与此同时，健康ω-3脂肪酸的摄入量也大幅减少。即使对于鱼类消费量较低的消费者来说，这种反应模式也是显而易见的。将警告反应模式作为输入到一个重要的风险评估模型中，得出的结论是，该警告带来的净效益是负面的。

abstract.text: Court decisions in 1998 encouraged generic producers to pursue Paragraph IV patent challenges. A follow-up decision in 2000 marked the first successful challenge involving a blockbuster and brought further attention to this pathway for generic entry. We consider the impacts of these decisions on R&D-based startups, and we focus on the propensity to form alliances as a primary channel of impact. We find substantial negative impacts on alliance formation and firm value, and only the first event's impacts are restricted to small molecules. The results suggest that policy analyses in settings with R&D-based startups should consider impacts on alliance formation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.05.002.abstractZh: 1998年的法院裁决鼓励仿制药制造商提出第四款专利挑战。2000年的后续裁决标志着首次成功挑战了热门产品，进一步凸显了仿制药进入市场的这一途径。我们研究了这些裁决对基于研发的初创企业的影响，重点关注联盟形成作为主要影响渠道的情况。研究发现，这些裁决对联盟形成和企业价值产生了显著的负面影响，而仅首次裁决的影响局限于小分子药物领域。结果表明，在基于研发的初创企业环境中进行政策分析时，应考虑到对联盟形成的影响。

abstract.text: Besides patients' health and well-being, healthcare interventions may affect the well-being of significant others. Such 'spill over effects' in significant others may be distinguished in two distinct effects: (i) the caregiving effect and (ii) the family effect. The first refers to the welfare effects of providing informal care, i.e., the effects of caring for someone who is ill. The second refers to a direct influence of the health of a patient on others' well-being, i.e., the effects of caring about other people. Using a sample of Dutch informal caregivers we found that both effects exist and may be comparable in size. Our results, while explorative, indicate that economic evaluations adopting a societal perspective should include both the family and the caregiving effects measured in the relevant individuals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.05.003.abstractZh: 除了患者的健康和福祉之外，医疗干预还可能影响重要他人的福祉。这种对重要他人的“溢出效应”可以分为两种不同的类型：(i) 护理效应，即照顾病人的福利效应；(ii) 家庭效应，即患者健康对他人福祉的直接影响。通过对荷兰非正式护理者的样本研究，我们发现这两种效应都存在，并且其规模可能相当。我们的研究结果虽然属于探索性研究，但表明从社会角度进行经济评估时，应同时考虑相关个体的家庭效应和护理效应。

abstract.text: We investigate the effect of competition on quality in health care markets with regulated prices taking a differential game approach, in which quality is a stock variable. Using a Hotelling framework, we derive the open-loop solution (health care providers set the optimal investment plan at the initial period) and the feedback closed-loop solution (providers move investments in response to the dynamics of the states). Under the closed-loop solution competition is more intense in the sense that providers observe quality in each period and base their investment on this information. If the marginal provision cost is constant, the open-loop and closed-loop solutions coincide, and the results are similar to the ones obtained by static models. If the marginal provision cost is increasing, investment and quality are lower in the closed-loop solution (when competition is more intense). In this case, static models tend to exaggerate the positive effect of competition on quality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.05.004.abstractZh: 我们研究了竞争对具有管制价格的健康医疗市场质量的影响，采用差分博弈方法进行分析，其中质量被视为一个存量变量。利用霍特林框架，我们推导出了开环解（医疗提供者初始时期设定的最优投资计划）和闭环反馈解（提供者根据状态动态调整投资）。在闭环解下，竞争更为激烈，因为提供者在每个时期都会关注质量，并据此来决定投资。如果边际提供成本是恒定的，开环解和闭环解会重合，其结果与静态模型得出的结果相似。如果边际提供成本是递增的，那么在闭环解中，投资和质量都会较低（当竞争更为激烈时）。在这种情况下，静态模型往往会夸大竞争对质量的积极影响。

abstract.text: We introduce a formal definition of health equivalent to dead into a standard model to develop previously unrecognized insights. We find that the health state viewed as equivalent to dead will depend on an individual's health prognosis, probability of survival, and rate of time preference. Our work on maximum endurable time shows that using QALY scores based on long-run preferences to value health states that last for shorter periods can alter cardinal and ordinal valuations. Simulations show that errors of substantial magnitude in QALY scores can consequently result. We describe situations where biases are likely and identify possible corrections.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.05.005.abstractZh: 我们为标准模型中引入了“等同于死亡”的健康状态的定义，以揭示之前未被发现的见解。我们发现，被视为等同于死亡的健康状态取决于个人的健康预后、生存概率以及时间偏好率。关于最大可忍受时间的研究表明，使用基于长期偏好的QALY分数来评估持续时间较短的健康状态，可能会改变基数和序数的估值。模拟结果显示，QALY分数可能出现相当大的误差。我们描述了这些偏差可能发生的情况，并提出了可能的修正方法。

abstract.text: The shortage of health workers in many low-income countries poses a threat to the quality of health services. When the number of patients per health worker grows sufficiently high, there will be insufficient time to diagnose and treat all patients adequately. This paper tests the hypothesis that high caseload reduces the level of effort per patient in the diagnostic process. We observed 159 clinicians in 2095 outpatient consultations at 126 health facilities in rural Tanzania. Surprisingly, we find no association between caseload and the level of effort per patient. Clinicians appear to have ample amounts of idle time. We conclude that health workers are not overworked and that scaling up the number of health workers is unlikely to raise the quality of health services. Training has a positive effect on quality but is not in itself sufficient to raise quality to adequate levels.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.05.006.abstractZh: 许多低收入国家存在卫生工作者短缺的问题，这威胁着卫生服务的质量。当每位卫生工作者的患者数量达到一定程度时，他们将没有足够的时间来充分诊断和治疗所有患者。本文检验了高患者数量会降低每位患者诊断过程中投入的努力程度的假设。我们在坦桑尼亚农村地区的126个卫生设施中，观察了159名临床医生在2095次门诊咨询中的情况。令人惊讶的是，我们发现患者数量与每位患者的投入努力程度之间没有关联。临床医生似乎有充足的空闲时间。我们得出结论，卫生工作者并未过度工作，而且增加卫生工作者的数量不太可能提高卫生服务的质量。培训对提高服务质量有积极作用，但单凭培训本身并不足以使服务质量达到足够的水平。

abstract.text: While there is broad agreement that the way that health care providers are paid affects their performance, the empirical literature on the impacts of provider payment reforms is surprisingly thin. During the 1990s and early 2000s, many European and Central Asian (ECA) countries shifted from paying hospitals through historical budgets to fee-for-service (FFS) or patient-based payment (PBP) methods (mostly variants of diagnosis-related groups, or DRGs). Using panel data on 28 countries over the period 1990-2004, we exploit the phased shift from historical budgets to explore aggregate impacts on hospital throughput, national health spending, and mortality from causes amenable to medical care. We use a regression version of difference-in-differences (DID) and two variants that relax the DID parallel trends assumption. We find that FFS and PBP both increased national health spending, including private (i.e. out-of-pocket) spending. However, they had different effects on inpatient admissions (FFS increased them; PBP had no effect), and average length of stay (FFS had no effect; PBP reduced it). Of the two methods, only PBP appears to have had any beneficial effect on "amenable mortality", but we found significant impacts for only a couple of causes of death, and not in all model specifications.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.05.007.abstractZh: 虽然普遍认为医疗保健提供者的支付方式对其绩效有影响，但关于支付改革影响的实证研究却相对较少。在1990年代和2000年代初，许多欧洲和中亚国家从通过历史预算向按服务收费或基于患者的支付方式转变（主要是诊断相关分组的不同形式）。我们利用1990年至2004年间28个国家的面板数据，研究从历史预算向按服务收费或基于患者的支付方式转变对医院吞吐量、国家医疗支出以及可通过医疗手段治疗的疾病死亡率的综合影响。我们采用了差异中的差异回归方法，并采用了两种放宽差异平行趋势假设的变体。研究发现，按服务收费和基于患者的支付方式都增加了国家医疗支出，包括私人支出。然而，这两种支付方式对住院人数有不同的影响：按服务收费增加了住院人数，而基于患者的支付方式则没有影响；对平均住院时间的影响也不同：按服务收费没有影响，而基于患者的支付方式则减少了平均住院时间。在这两种方法中，只有基于患者的支付方式似乎对“可通过医疗手段治疗的疾病死亡率”有积极影响，但我们发现这种积极影响仅对少数几种死因有效，且并非在所有模型规格中都存在。

abstract.text: Nutritional conditions in utero and during infancy may causally affect health and mortality during childhood, adulthood, and at old ages. This paper investigates whether exposure to a nutritional shock in early life negatively affects survival at older ages, using individual data. Nutritional conditions are captured by exposure to the Potato famine in the Netherlands in 1846-1847, and by regional and temporal variation in market prices of potato and rye. The data cover the lifetimes of a random sample of Dutch individuals born between 1812 and 1902 and provide individual information on life events and demographic and socioeconomic characteristics. First we non-parametrically compare the total and residual lifetimes of individuals exposed and not exposed to the famine in utero and/or until age 1. Next, we estimate survival models in which we control for individual characteristics and additional (early life) determinants of mortality. We find strong evidence for long-run effects of exposure to the Potato famine. The results are stronger for boys than for girls. Boys and girls lose on average 4, respectively 2.5 years of life after age 50 after exposure at birth to the Potato famine. Lower social classes appear to be more affected by early life exposure to the Potato famine than higher social classes. These results confirm the mechanism linking early life (nutritional) conditions to old-age mortality. Finally, higher food prices at birth appear to reduce later life mortality of children of farmers from higher social classes. We interpret this as an income effect.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.06.001.abstractZh: 子宫内和婴儿期的营养状况可能直接影响儿童期、成年期以及老年期的健康和死亡率。本文利用个体数据，研究早期生活中的营养冲击是否会对老年期的生存产生负面影响。营养状况通过1846-1847年荷兰马铃薯饥荒的暴露情况以及马铃薯和黑麦市场价格的区域性和时间变化来反映。数据涵盖了1812年至1902年间出生的荷兰个体的生命历程，并提供了关于生活事件以及人口统计和社会经济特征的个体信息。首先，我们非参数性地比较了在子宫内或1岁前暴露于饥荒中的个体与未暴露个体的总寿命和剩余寿命。接着，我们建立了生存模型，以控制个体特征以及早期生活中的其他死亡决定因素。我们发现，暴露于马铃薯饥荒具有长期影响，且这种影响在男孩身上比女孩更为明显。在出生时就暴露于马铃薯饥荒的男孩和女孩，在50岁以后平均分别减少了4年和2.5年的寿命。较低的社会阶层似乎比较高社会阶层更容易受到早期马铃薯饥荒的影响。这些结果证实了早期营养状况与老年死亡率之间的关联机制。最后，出生时较高的食物价格似乎可以降低来自较高社会阶层的农民子女在后期生活中的死亡率，我们将此解释为收入效应。

abstract.text: Patients' choices of specialist physicians may be guided by referring physicians and report cards. I examine referral patterns to cardiac surgeons to assess whether publication of the May 2002 edition of Pennsylvania's Guide to Coronary Artery Bypass Graft Surgery added information to what referring physicians already knew. To do so, I developed a counterfactual scenario, including a simulated analogue report card, based on comparable data from Florida, a state without CABG report cards. My analysis failed to detect a significant change in referral patterns to either low-mortality or high-mortality cardiac surgeons. At the same time, referring physicians on average appear to have been knowledgeable about the relative performance of cardiac surgeons without report cards. Future report card efforts might benefit from incorporating the quality signals contained in referral patterns.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.06.002.abstractZh: 患者选择专科医生的行为可能受到转诊医生和报告卡的影响。我研究了转诊至心脏外科医生的模式，以评估2002年5月发布的宾夕法尼亚州冠状动脉旁路手术指南是否增加了转诊医生已有的信息。为此，我基于佛罗里达州没有冠状动脉旁路手术报告卡的数据，制定了一个反事实情景，并模拟了一份类似报告卡。我的分析未能发现转诊至低死亡率或高死亡率心脏外科医生的模式发生显著变化。同时，转诊医生平均而言似乎对心脏外科医生之间的相对表现有所了解。未来的报告卡工作可能会从整合转诊模式中包含的质量信息中受益。

abstract.text: This paper presents evidence that diagnoses of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) are driven largely by subjective comparisons across children in the same grade in school. Roughly 8.4 percent of children born in the month prior to their state's cutoff date for kindergarten eligibility - who typically become the youngest and most developmentally immature children within a grade - are diagnosed with ADHD, compared to 5.1 percent of children born in the month immediately afterward. A child's birth date relative to the eligibility cutoff also strongly influences teachers' assessments of whether the child exhibits ADHD symptoms but is only weakly associated with similarly measured parental assessments, suggesting that many diagnoses may be driven by teachers' perceptions of poor behavior among the youngest children in a classroom. These perceptions have long-lasting consequences: the youngest children in fifth and eighth grades are nearly twice as likely as their older classmates to regularly use stimulants prescribed to treat ADHD.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.06.003.abstractZh: 本文提供了证据，表明对注意力缺陷/多动障碍（ADHD）的诊断主要基于同龄儿童之间的主观比较。在州幼儿园入学截止日期前一个月出生的儿童中，约有8.4%的儿童被诊断出患有ADHD，这些儿童通常成为班级中年龄最小且发育最不成熟的学生；而在该日期之后一个月出生的儿童中，这一比例仅为5.1%。儿童的出生日期与幼儿园入学的截止日期之间的时间关系也强烈影响教师对儿童是否表现出ADHD症状的评估，但这一因素与家长评估的相关性较弱，这表明许多诊断可能源于教师对班级中年龄最小儿童行为不佳的感知。这种感知具有长期影响：在五年级和八年级，年龄最小的儿童使用ADHD治疗所需刺激药物的可能性几乎是年龄较大的同学的两倍。

abstract.text: I examine the role of household permanent income in determining who bribes and how much they bribe in health care in Uganda. I find that rich patients are more likely than other patients to bribe in public health care: doubling household expenditure increases the bribery probability by 1.2 percentage points compared to a bribery rate of 17%. The income elasticity of the bribe amount is about 0.37. Bribes in the Ugandan public sector appear to be fees-for-service extorted from the richer patients amongst those exempted by government policy from paying the official fees. Bribes in the private sector appear to be flat-rate fees paid by patients who do not pay official fees. I do not find evidence that the public health care sector is able to price discriminate less effectively than public institutions with less competition from the private sector.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.06.004.abstractZh: 我研究了家庭固定收入在决定谁会在乌干达的医疗保健领域行贿以及行贿金额方面的作用。我发现，与其他患者相比，富裕患者在公共医疗保健领域更有可能行贿：家庭支出增加一倍时，行贿的概率会上升1.2个百分点，而行贿率仅为17%。行贿金额的收入弹性约为0.37。在乌干达的公共部门，行贿行为似乎是对那些被政府政策豁免支付官方费用的高收入患者征收的服务费。而在私营部门，行贿行为则可能是由那些不支付官方费用的患者支付的固定费用。我没有发现任何证据表明，公共医疗保健部门在价格歧视方面不如那些在私营部门竞争较少的公立机构有效。

abstract.text: Are demand-side interventions effective at curbing drug use? To the extent demand-side programs are successful, their cost effectiveness can be appealing from a policy perspective. Established in 2005, the Montana Meth Project (MMP) employs a graphic advertising campaign to deter meth use among teens. Due to the MMP's apparent success, seven other states have adopted Meth Project campaigns. Using data from the Youth Risk Behavior Surveys (YRBS), this paper investigates whether the MMP reduced methamphetamine use among Montana's youth. When accounting for a preexisting downward trend in meth use, effects on meth use are statistically indistinguishable from zero. These results are robust to using related changes of meth use among individuals without exposure to the campaign as controls in a difference-in-difference framework. A complementary analysis of treatment admissions data from the Treatment Episode Data Set (TEDS) confirms the MMP has had no discernable impact on meth use.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.06.005.abstractZh: 需求侧干预措施在遏制药物使用方面是否有效？如果需求侧项目取得成功，其成本效益从政策角度来看具有吸引力。成立于2005年的蒙大拿州甲基苯丙胺项目通过图形广告活动来阻止青少年使用甲基苯丙胺。由于该项目的明显成效，其他七个州也采用了类似的甲基苯丙胺项目活动。本文利用青少年风险行为调查的数据，研究蒙大拿州的青少年甲基苯丙胺使用情况是否有所减少。在考虑甲基苯丙胺使用量已存在的下降趋势后，甲基苯丙胺使用量的变化在统计上与零无显著差异。这些结果在采用未接触过该活动的个体作为对照组进行差异-差异框架分析时依然成立。对治疗事件数据集中的治疗入院数据进行的补充分析也证实，该项目对甲基苯丙胺使用量没有显著影响。

abstract.text: We elicit measures of individual discount rates from a representative sample of the Danish population and test two substantive hypotheses. The first hypothesis is that smokers have higher individual discount rates than non-smokers. The second hypothesis is that smokers are more likely to have time inconsistent preferences than non-smokers, where time inconsistency is indicated by a hyperbolic discounting function. We control for the concavity of the utility function in our estimates of individual discount rates and find that male smokers have significantly higher discount rates than male non-smokers. However, smoking has no significant association with discount rates among women. This result is robust across exponential and hyperbolic discounting functions. We consider the sensitivity of our conclusions to a statistical specification that allows each observation to potentially be generated by more than one latent data-generating process.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.06.006.abstractZh: 我们从丹麦人口的代表性样本中收集个体折扣率的测量数据，并检验两个主要假设。第一个假设是，吸烟者的个体折扣率高于非吸烟者。第二个假设是，吸烟者比非吸烟者更可能具有时间不一致偏好，其中时间不一致性通过双曲折扣函数来表示。我们在估计个体折扣率时控制了效用函数的凹性，发现男性吸烟者的折扣率显著高于男性非吸烟者。然而，吸烟与女性个体的折扣率之间没有显著关联。这一结果在指数折扣函数和双曲折扣函数下都是稳健的。我们还考虑了我们的结论对一种统计假设的敏感性，即允许每个观测值可能由多个潜在的数据生成过程产生。

abstract.text: Whether newer pharmaceuticals justify their higher costs by reducing other health expenditures has generated significant debate. We replicate a frequently cited paper by Lichtenberg on drug "offsets" and find the results disappear using a more appropriate model or updated dataset. Further, we test the suitability of similar methods using newer hypertension drugs. We find our observational results run counter to well-established clinical evidence on comparative efficacy and conclude that our model, as well as other studies that do not adequately control for unobserved characteristics that jointly determine drug choice and health expenditures, are likely subject to significant bias.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.06.007.abstractZh: 关于新型药物是否能够通过降低其他健康支出来证明其高昂的成本，这一话题引发了广泛的讨论。我们重新验证了Lichtenberg一篇关于药物“抵消效应”的论文，发现使用更合适的模型或更新后的数据集后，研究结果不再成立。此外，我们还测试了使用新型高血压药物时类似方法的适用性。我们发现，我们的观察结果与关于药物疗效的比较性临床证据相冲突，因此得出结论：我们的模型以及其他未能充分控制那些共同决定药物选择和健康支出的未观测特征的研究，可能存在显著的偏差。

abstract.text: We investigate the long-term effect of childhood socio-economic conditions on the health of the elderly in Mexico. We utilize a panel of individuals aged 50 and above from the Mexican Health and Aging Survey and find that the conditions under which the individual lived at the age of 10 affect health in old age, even accounting for education and income. This paper contributes to the literature of the long-term effects of childhood socio-economic status by being the first, to our knowledge, to consider exclusively the case of the elderly in a developing country.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.07.001.abstractZh: 我们研究了墨西哥儿童时期社会经济状况对老年人健康影响的长期效应。我们利用了墨西哥健康与老龄化调查中的50岁及以上人群的数据，发现个体在10岁时所处的社会经济环境会影响其老年时的健康状况，即使考虑到教育和收入因素也是如此。本文通过首次专注于发展中国家老年人的情况，为研究儿童时期社会经济地位对健康的长期影响提供了依据。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effect of ambulatory surgical centers (ASCs) on hospital surgical volume using hospital and year fixed effects models with several robustness checks. We show that ASC entry only appears to influence a hospital's outpatient surgical volume if the facilities are within a few miles of each other. Even then, the average reduction in hospital volume is only 2-4%, which is not nearly large enough to offset the new procedures performed by an entering ASC. The effect is, however, stronger for large ASCs and the first ASCs to enter a market. Additionally, we find no evidence that entering ASCs reduce a hospital's inpatient surgical volume.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.07.003.abstractZh: 本文通过医院和年份固定效应模型，估计了门诊手术中心对医院手术量的影响，并进行了多项稳健性检验。我们发现，只有当门诊手术中心位于彼此几英里范围内时，其设立才会对医院的门诊手术量产生影响。即便如此，医院手术量的平均减少幅度也仅为2-4%，这一数值远远不足以抵消新设立的门诊手术中心所开展的手术业务。此外，对于规模较大的门诊手术中心以及首次进入市场的门诊手术中心来说，其影响更为显著。另外，我们没有发现设立门诊手术中心会减少医院住院手术量的证据。

abstract.text: Income motivation among general practitioners (GPs) is frequently discussed in the health economics literature. The question addressed in the present study on reimbursement drugs and addictive drugs is whether increased competition among GPs, which is part of a declared health policy to improve efficiency, contributes to more prescriptions for the elderly. The dataset comprises registered data of all prescribed drugs dispensed at pharmacies from the Norwegian Prescription Database merged with data on GPs. In choosing a method, particular attention is given to the fact that patients tend to be attracted to GPs who fit their preferences. Hence, we treat the composition of the patient list as endogenous. The results indicate that the stronger competition a GP faces, the more drugs are prescribed, which implies that GPs' prescription style may conflict with their role as gatekeepers, and even worse, it may be a hazard to patients' health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.07.004.abstractZh: 在健康经济学文献中，全科医生收入动机的问题经常被讨论。本研究探讨的是报销药品和成瘾性药品的问题，即作为提高效率政策的一部分，全科医生之间的竞争是否会导致更多老年人被开药。研究数据来源于挪威处方数据库，包含了在药店处方的所有药品记录，并与全科医生的数据进行了合并。在选择研究方法时，我们特别注意了患者倾向于选择符合自己偏好的全科医生这一事实。因此，我们将患者名单的构成视为内生变量。研究结果表明，全科医生面临的竞争越激烈，被开出的药品就越多，这意味着全科医生的处方行为可能与他们作为“守门人”的角色相冲突，甚至可能对患者的健康造成危害。

abstract.text: We exploit the discontinuity in age when children start kindergarten generated by state eligibility laws to examine whether relative age is a significant determinant of ADHD diagnosis and treatment. Using a regression discontinuity model and exact dates of birth, we find that children born just after the cutoff, who are relatively old-for-grade, have a significantly lower incidence of ADHD diagnosis and treatment compared with similar children born just before the cutoff date, who are relatively young-for-grade. Since ADHD is an underlying neurological problem where incidence rates should not change dramatically from one birth date to the next, these results suggest that age relative to peers in class, and the resulting differences in behavior, directly affects a child's probability of being diagnosed with and treated for ADHD.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.07.005.abstractZh: 我们利用州资格法律所设定的儿童开始上幼儿园的年龄不连续性，来研究相对年龄是否是ADHD诊断和治疗的重要决定因素。通过回归不连续模型和精确的出生日期数据，我们发现，在截止日期之后出生的儿童，相对于同年级的其他儿童来说年龄较大，其ADHD的诊断和治疗发生率明显较低。相反，在截止日期之前出生的儿童，相对于同年级的其他儿童来说年龄较小，其ADHD的诊断和治疗发生率则较高。由于ADHD是一种潜在的神经性问题，其发病率从一个出生日期到另一个出生日期之间不应有显著变化，因此这些结果表明，儿童相对于同班同学的年龄，以及由此导致的行为差异，直接影响了儿童被诊断出ADHD并接受治疗的概率。

abstract.text: In this paper, we examine the effect of changes in population density-urban sprawl-between 1970 and 2000 on BMI and obesity of residents in metropolitan areas in the U.S. We address the possible endogeneity of population density by using a two-step instrumental variables approach. We exploit the plausibly exogenous variation in population density caused by the expansion of the U.S. Interstate Highway System, which largely followed the original 1947 plan for the Interstate Highway System. We find a negative association between population density and obesity, and estimates are robust across a wide range of specifications. Estimates indicate that if the average metropolitan area had not experienced the decline in the proportion of population living in dense areas over the last 30 years, the rate of obesity would have been reduced by approximately 13%.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.07.006.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了1970年至2000年间人口密度和城市扩张变化对美国大都市地区居民BMI和肥胖状况的影响。我们通过两步工具变量方法探讨了人口密度可能的内生性。我们利用美国州际公路系统扩展所导致的合理外生人口密度变化，这一系统在很大程度上遵循了1947年最初的州际公路系统规划。我们发现人口密度与肥胖状况之间存在负相关关系，且研究结果在不同模型设定下均具有稳健性。估计结果显示，如果过去30年间大都市地区居住在密集区域的人口比例没有下降，肥胖率将减少约13%。

abstract.text: This paper expands the standard model of utility maximization to endogenize the ubiquitous phenomenon of adaptation. We assume that total utility is an aggregate function of the utility associated with different domains of life, with relative weights that are optimized according to the effort that the individual expends on producing utility in each domain. Comparative statics from the general maximization problem demonstrate that the traditional Slutsky equation should incorporate an additional response term to account for adaptation processes. Our adaptive global utility maximization model can be used to explain responses to changes in health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.07.007.abstractZh: 本文将效用最大化标准模型扩展为内生化普遍存在的适应现象。我们假设总效用是不同生活领域相关效用的综合函数，这些效用的相对权重是根据个体在每个领域产生效用的努力程度进行优化的。从一般最大化问题的比较静态分析来看，传统的Slutsky方程应该包含一个额外的响应项，以解释适应过程。我们的适应性全球效用最大化模型可以用来解释对健康变化的响应。

abstract.text: This paper empirically evaluates whether government ideology and electoral motives influenced the growth of public health expenditures in 18 OECD countries over the 1971-2004 period. The results suggest that incumbents behaved opportunistically and increased the growth of public health expenditures in election years. Government ideology did not have an influence. These findings indicate (1) the importance of public health in policy debates before elections and (2) the political pressure towards re-organizing public health policy platforms especially in times of demographic change.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.07.008.abstractZh: 本文通过实证研究，评估了1971年至2004年间18个经合组织国家的政府意识形态和选举动机是否影响了公共卫生支出的增长。研究结果表明，现任政府出于机会主义动机，在选举年增加了公共卫生支出的增长。而政府意识形态并未对此产生影响。这些发现表明：（1）在选举前的政策讨论中，公共卫生的重要性；（2）特别是在人口结构发生变化时，重新调整公共卫生政策框架所面临的政治压力。

abstract.text: This study assesses the factors influencing the movement of people across health plans. We distinguish three types of cost-related transitions: adverse selection, the movement of the less healthy to more generous plans; adverse retention, the tendency for people to stay where they are when they get sick; and aging in place, enrollees' inertia in plan choice, leading plans with older enrollees to increase in relative cost over time. Using data from the Group Insurance Commission in Massachusetts, we show that adverse selection and aging in place are both quantitatively important. Either can materially impact equilibrium enrollments, especially when premiums to enrollees reflect these costs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.08.001.abstractZh: 本研究评估了影响人们在不同健康保险计划间转移的因素。我们将这些转移分为三类与成本相关的现象：逆向选择，即健康状况较差的人转向更优厚的保险计划；逆向保留，即人们在生病时倾向于留在当前的保险计划中；以及“就地养老”，即参保者在选择保险计划时的惰性，导致拥有较年长参保者的保险计划随时间推移相对成本增加。通过马萨诸塞州团体保险委员会的数据分析，我们发现逆向选择和“就地养老”这两种现象都具有重要的定量影响。无论哪种情况，都可能实质性地影响保险计划的均衡参保人数，尤其是当参保者的保费能够反映这些成本时。

abstract.text: Casinos have been introduced throughout the U.S. to spur economic development and generate tax revenues. Yet, casinos may also be associated with a variety of social ills. One issue that has not been empirically tested in the literature is whether there is a link between casino expansion and alcohol-related fatal traffic accidents. We suspect a link may exist since casinos often serve alcohol to their patrons and, by their dispersed nature, could impact driving distances after drinking. Using the variation in the timing and location of casino openings over a 10-year period, we isolate the impact of casino introduction on alcohol-related fatal accidents. Results indicate that there is a strong link between the presence of a casino in a county and the number of alcohol-related fatal traffic accidents. However, this relationship is negatively related to the local-area (county) population. Results prove durable, as we subject them to robustness checks.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.08.002.abstractZh: 赌场在美国各地被引入，旨在促进经济发展并增加税收收入。然而，赌场也可能与多种社会问题相关联。文献中尚未有实证研究探讨赌场扩张与酒精相关致命交通事故之间是否存在关联。我们认为可能存在这种关联，因为赌场通常会为顾客提供酒精饮料，而其分散的布局可能会影响到饮酒后的驾驶距离。通过分析10年间赌场开业的时间和地点变化，我们研究了赌场引入对酒精相关致命事故的影响。结果表明，一个县内存在赌场与酒精相关致命交通事故的数量之间存在强烈关联。不过，这种关联与当地人口数量呈负相关。我们的研究结果具有稳定性，因为我们进行了稳健性检验。

abstract.text: The price effects of the Swedish pharmaceutical substitution reform are analyzed using data for a panel of all pharmaceutical product sold in Sweden in 1997-2007. The price reduction due to the reform was estimated to average 10% and was found to be significantly larger for brand-name pharmaceuticals than for generics. The results also imply that the reform amplified the effect that generic entry has on brand-name prices by a factor of 10. Results of a demand estimation imply that the price reductions increased total pharmaceutical consumption by 8% and consumer welfare by SEK 2.7 billion annually.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.08.003.abstractZh: 本文利用1997至2007年间瑞典所有药品销售数据的分析，探讨了瑞典药品替代改革对价格的影响。改革导致的价格下降平均幅度为10%，且品牌药品的价格降幅明显大于仿制药。研究还表明，该改革使仿制药进入市场对品牌药品价格的影响增强了10倍。需求估计结果显示，价格下降使药品总消费增加了8%，每年为消费者带来27亿瑞典克朗的福利提升。

abstract.text: Physicians play a major role in determining the cost and quality of healthcare, yet estimates of these effects can be confounded by patient sorting. This paper considers a natural experiment where nearly 30,000 patients were randomly assigned to clinical teams from one of two academic institutions. One institution is among the top medical schools in the U.S., while the other institution is ranked lower in the distribution. Patients treated by the two programs have similar observable characteristics and have access to a single set of facilities and ancillary staff. Those treated by physicians from the higher ranked institution have 10-25% less expensive stays than patients assigned to the lower ranked institution. Health outcomes are not related to the physician team assignment. Cost differences are most pronounced for serious conditions, and they largely stem from diagnostic-testing rates: the lower ranked program tends to order more tests and takes longer to order them.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.08.004.abstractZh: 医生在决定医疗保健的成本和质量方面起着重要作用，然而，这些影响的估计可能会受到患者分配方式的影响。本文研究了一个自然实验，其中近30,000名患者被随机分配到两个学术机构中的临床团队。其中一个机构是美国顶尖的医学院之一，而另一个机构的排名较低。两个项目治疗的患者具有相似的可观察特征，并且可以使用相同的设施和辅助人员。由排名较高的机构医生治疗的患者，其住院费用比那些被分配到排名较低的机构的患者低10-25%。健康结果与医生团队的分配无关。成本差异在严重疾病中最为明显，这些差异主要源于诊断测试的频率：排名较低的机构倾向于进行更多的测试，并且测试所需的时间也更长。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of coverage on demand for health insurance in the Medicare Advantage (MA) insurance market. Estimating the effects of coverage on demand poses a challenge for researchers who must consider both the hundreds of benefits that affect out-of-pocket costs (OOPC) to consumers, but also the endogeneity of coverage. These problems are addressed in a discrete choice demand model by employing a unique measure of OOPC that considers a consumer's expected payments for a fixed bundle of health services and applying instrumental variable techniques to address potential endogeneity bias. The results of the demand model show that OOPC have a significant effect on consumer surplus and that not instrumenting for OOPC results in a significant underestimate of the value of coverage.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.08.005.abstractZh: 本文探讨了保险覆盖对医疗保险优势市场保险需求的影响。评估保险覆盖对需求的影响对研究人员来说是一个挑战，因为他们不仅要考虑影响消费者自付费用的数百种福利，还要考虑保险覆盖的内生性问题。这些问题通过离散选择需求模型得到解决，该模型采用了一种独特的自付费用衡量方法，该方法考虑了消费者对固定健康服务组合的预期支付，并运用工具变量技术来消除潜在的内生性偏差。需求模型的结果表明，自付费用对消费者剩余有显著影响，如果不对自付费用进行工具变量处理，则会对保险覆盖价值的评估产生显著低估。

abstract.text: Increasingly, health economists are required to work across sectors when evaluating options for improving health, health care and well-being. Social care is a key sector which is both influenced by and influences the use and outcomes of health services. This paper reports on a developing approach to measuring social care outcome, designed to reflect outcomes across client groups. In this process it is important that we reflect the relative importance or value of these domains of outcome. This paper reports on a pilot study that investigated the feasibility of using discrete choice experiments to identify a financial "willingness to accept" valuation of a large number of domains and investigated factors associated with variations in respondents' preferences. We conclude that, while the domains themselves need further work, the approach provides a helpful starting point in the difficult issue of reflecting population preferences for a large number of social care outcome domains.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.08.006.abstractZh: 越来越多的健康经济学家在评估改善健康、医疗保健和福祉的方案时需要跨领域合作。社会护理是一个关键领域，它既受到健康服务使用方式的影响，也影响着服务的效果。本文介绍了一种用于衡量社会护理效果的新方法，该方法旨在反映不同客户群体的效果。在这个过程中，重要的是要体现这些效果领域的相对重要性或价值。本文还报告了一项试点研究，该研究探讨了使用离散选择实验来识别大量领域中的财务“接受意愿”评估的可行性，并研究了影响受访者偏好差异的因素。我们得出结论，虽然这些领域本身还需要进一步研究，但这种方法为在反映大量社会护理效果领域的群体偏好这一难题上提供了一个有用的起点。

abstract.text: The recent growth of the home care sector combined with societal and demographic changes have given rise to concerns about the adequacy of the supply of family and friend caregivers. Potential caregivers face competing time pressures that pull them in the direction of the labour market on one hand, and towards unpaid caregiving duties on the other. This paper examines the influence of unpaid caregiving on the labour supply of a cohort of working-aged caregivers in Canada, with particular emphasis on caregiving intensity. Results suggest that caregivers are heterogeneous in both their caregiving inputs and associated labour market responses, thereby underscoring the importance of controlling for caregiving intensity when measuring labour supply. The negative influence of primary caregiving on labour supply appears to be at the level of labour force participation, rather than on hours of work or wages.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.08.007.abstractZh: 近期家庭护理领域的增长，加上社会与人口结构的变化，引发了对家庭和亲友护理人员供应是否足够性的担忧。潜在的护理人员面临着时间压力，一方面被劳动力市场所吸引，另一方面则倾向于从事无偿护理工作。本文研究了无偿护理对加拿大工作年龄护理人员劳动力供应的影响，特别关注护理强度因素。研究结果表明，护理人员在护理投入及其与劳动力市场反应方面存在差异，这进一步强调了在衡量劳动力供应时控制护理强度的重要性。主要护理对劳动力供应的负面影响似乎体现在劳动力参与率上，而非工作时间或工资水平。

abstract.text: Are All Readmissions Bad Readmissions?To The Editor: The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) view readmission for any reason after an index hospitalization for heart failure as a sign of poor quality of care."From the patient perspective, readmission from any cause is an adverse event." 1 Little consideration has been given, however, to a potential association between readmissions and mortality, an outcome that is of primary interest to medical professionals and the general public.We examined the association between riskadjusted readmission and risk-adjusted death within 30 days after hospitalization for heart failure among 3857 hospitals included in the CMS Hospital Compare public reporting database (www .hospitalcompare.hhs.gov) that had no missing data.We used linear regression analysis with restricted cubic splines 2 (piecewise smoothing polynomials) (Fig. 1).Analysis was performed with the use of R, version 2.10.1 (www.r-project.org), and Harrell's Hmisc library.A higher occurrence of readmissions after index admissions for heart failure was associated with lower risk-adjusted 30-day mortality.Our findings suggest that readmissions could be "adversely" affected by a competing risk 3 of death -a patient who dies during the index episode of care can never be readmitted.Hence, if a hospital has a lower mortality rate, then a greater proportion of its discharged patients are eligible for readmission.As such, to some extent, a higher readmission rate may be a consequence of successful care.Furthermore, planned readmissions for procedures or surgery may represent appropriate care that decreases the risk of death, but this is not accounted for in Hospital Compare.These observations are consistent with a recent study of 3999 Medicare beneficiaries in California who were hospitalized at various hospitals with a principal diagnosis of heart failure.Hospitals that used more resources had lower mortality rates.4 It is unclear why the relation between 30-day readmissions and 30-day mortality was flat among hospitals with the lowest readmission rates (Fig. 1).We speculate that this has to do with variations in hospital characteristics between hospitals with low readmission rates versus those with high readmission rates or in hospitals' approaches to the journal's web and e-mail addresses
