We use microdata on sales and prices to uncover the role of markup adjustment, local costs, and barriers to price adjustment in determining incomplete pass-through using a structural oligopoly model that nests all three potential factors. The implied pricing model explains the main dynamic features of short and long-run pass-through. Local costs reduce long-run pass-through by a factor of 59% relative to a CES benchmark. Markup adjustment reduces pass-through by an additional factor of 33%, where the extent of markup adjustment depends on the estimated \\super-elasticity" of demand. The estimated menu costs are small (0:23% of revenue) and have a negligible eect on long-run pass-through, but are quantitatively successful in explaining the delayed response of prices to costs. We nd that delayed passthrough in the coee industry occurs almost entirely at the wholesale rather than the retail level.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2009.589.x.abstractZh: 近期理论研究表明，导致汇率对价格传递不完全的诸多潜在因素包括加价调整、本地成本以及价格调整障碍。我们实证分析了共同经济体内汇率传递不完全的决定因素。该行业中观察到的传递现象与总体数据中记录的传递特征一致：价格对成本变化的反应迟缓且不完全。我们利用销售和价格微观数据，通过结构性寡头模型来探讨加价调整、本地成本以及价格调整障碍在导致汇率传递不完全中的作用。该模型解释了短期和长期传递的主要动态特征。与CES基准相比，本地成本使长期传递减少了59%的幅度。加价调整进一步减少了传递的幅度，额外减少了33%，而加价调整的程度取决于需求的“超弹性”估计值。估计的菜单成本很小（占收入的0.23%），对长期传递的影响微乎其微，但能够成功解释价格对成本变化的延迟反应。我们发现，共同经济体内的汇率传递延迟几乎完全发生在批发层面，而非零售层面。

abstract.text: We consider situations in which every agent would like to take an action that is coordinated with those of others, as well as close to a common state of nature, with the ideal proximity to that state varying across agents. Before this coordination game is played, agents decide to whom they reveal their private information about the state. The information transmission occurring in the cheap-talk communication stage is characterized by a strategic communication network whose links represent truthful information transmission. In equilibrium, whether communication takes place between two agents depends not only on the conflict of interest between these agents, but also on the number and preferences of the other agents with whom they communicate. In particular, communication to a large group of recipients may be feasible even though communication to a small subset of that group may not be. We show that agents who are more central in terms of preference tend to communicate more and to have a greater impact on decisions.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2009.591.x.abstractZh: 我们考虑这样一种情况：每个代理人都希望采取一种与其他代理人协调一致的行动，并尽可能接近一个共同的自然状态。在协调游戏开始之前，代理人决定向谁透露关于状态的私人信息。在“廉价交流”阶段发生的信息传递，由一个战略性的通信网络来表征，该网络的节点代表真实信息的传递。在均衡状态下，是否进行通信不仅取决于这些代理人之间的利益冲突，还取决于他们与其他代理人进行通信的数量和偏好。特别地，即使向一小部分接收者进行通信可能不可行，但向大量接收者进行通信却是可行的。我们表明，在偏好方面处于中心位置的代理人更倾向于进行更多的交流，并对决策产生更大的影响。

abstract.text: We study a two-country, two-sector model of international trade in which one sector produces homogeneous products and the other produces differentiated products. Both sectors are subjected to search and matching frictions in the labour market and wage bargaining. As a result, some of the workers searching for jobs end up being unemployed. Countries are similar except for frictions in their labour markets, such as efficiency of matching and costs of posting vacancies, which can vary across the sectors. The differentiated-product industry has firm heterogeneity and monopolistic competition. We study the interaction of labour market rigidities and trade impediments in shaping welfare, trade flows, productivity, and unemployment. We show that both countries gain from trade. A country with relatively lower frictions in the differentiated-product industry exports differentiated products on net. A country benefits from lowering frictions in its differentiated sector's labour market, but this harms the country's trade partner. Alternatively, a simultaneous, proportional lowering of labour market frictions in the differentiated sectors of both countries benefits both of them. The opening to trade raises a country's rate of unemployment if its relative labour market frictions in the differentiated sector are low, and it reduces the rate of unemployment if its relative labour market frictions in the differentiated sector are high. Cross-country differences in rates of unemployment exhibit rich patterns. In particular, lower labour market frictions do not ensure lower unemployment, and unemployment and welfare can both rise in response to falling labour market frictions and falling trade costs.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2010.00600.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个双国、双部门的国际贸易模型，其中一个部门生产同质产品，另一个部门生产差异化产品。这两个部门都受到劳动力市场的搜寻与匹配摩擦以及工资谈判的影响。因此，一些寻找工作的工人最终会失业。这些国家在劳动力市场摩擦方面存在差异，例如匹配效率以及发布职位空缺的成本，这些差异可能在不同部门之间有所不同。差异化产品行业存在企业异质性和垄断竞争现象。我们研究了劳动力市场刚性与贸易障碍对福利、贸易流量、生产效率和失业率的相互作用。研究表明，两国都能从贸易中获益。在差异化产品行业存在较低摩擦的国家，其出口的差异化产品具有净收益；而在差异化部门劳动力市场摩擦较低的国家，虽然该国的福利有所提升，但这一变化会对贸易伙伴造成负面影响。相反，如果两国在差异化部门的劳动力市场摩擦同时得到适度降低，那么两国都能从中受益。如果某个国家在差异化部门的劳动力市场摩擦较低，那么贸易开放会导致该国的失业率上升；反之，如果摩擦较高，则失业率会下降。不同国家之间的失业率差异呈现出丰富的模式。具体而言，较低的劳动力市场摩擦并不一定能降低失业率，相反，随着劳动力市场摩擦和贸易成本的降低，失业率和福利都可能上升。

abstract.text: Prices are typically used as proxies for countries' export quality. I relax this strong assumption by exploiting both price and quantity information to estimate the quality of products exported to the United States. Higher quality is assigned to products with higher market shares conditional on price. The estimated qualities reveal substantial heterogeneity in product markets' scope for quality differentiation, or their “quality ladders”. I use this variation to explain the heterogeneous impact of low-wage competition on US manufacturing employment and output. Markets characterized by relatively short quality ladders are associated with larger employment and output declines resulting from low-wage competition.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2010.00602.x.abstractZh: 价格通常被用作衡量国家出口质量的指标。我通过利用价格和数量信息来估算出口到美国的产品的质量，从而放宽了这一假设。在价格相同的条件下，市场份额较高的产品被赋予更高的质量等级。估算出的质量等级显示出产品市场在质量差异化方面的显著异质性，即所谓的“质量阶梯”。我利用这种差异来解释低工资竞争对美国制造业就业和产出影响的异质性。那些质量阶梯相对较短的市场，由于低工资竞争的影响，其就业和产出下降幅度更大。

abstract.text: The paper investigates inference in non-linear and non-Gaussian models with moderately time-varying parameters. We show that for many decision problems, the sample information about the parameter path can be summarized by an artificial linear and Gaussian model, at least asymptotically. The approximation allows for computationally convenient path estimators and parameter stability tests. Also, in contrast to standard Bayesian techniques, the artificial model can be robustified so that in misspecified models, decisions about the path of the (pseudo-true) parameter remain as good as in a corresponding correctly specified model.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2010.00603.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了在具有中等时间变化参数的非线性和非高斯模型中的推断问题。我们表明，对于许多决策问题，关于参数路径的样本信息至少可以渐近地通过一个人工的线性和高斯模型来概括。这种近似方法使得参数估计器和参数稳定性测试在计算上更加方便。此外，与标准贝叶斯技术不同，人工模型可以被增强，使得在模型设定错误的情况下，关于（伪真实）参数路径的决策仍然与正确设定模型时一样有效。

abstract.text: This paper sets out necessary and sufficient empirical conditions for rational intrinsic habits models in the revealed preference tradition of Samuelson (1948), Houthakker (1950), Afriat (1967), and Browning (1989). The conditions in the paper are shown to be computationally straightforward and to yield set identification for certain features of the model. The ideas outlined are applied to a microeconomic panel dataset. The addition of habit formation to the discounted utility model is shown to improve the rationalizability of the microdata considerably. Even if habit formation is rejected, it is shown that modest and plausible allowance for heterogeneity in prices and interest rates is sufficient to bring consumption behaviour into line with the theory.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2010.00604.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了在Samuelson（1948）、Houthakker（1950）、Afriat（1967）和Browning（1989）提出的显性偏好理论框架中，理性内在习惯模型所需的必要且充分的经验条件。文中指出，这些条件在计算上较为简单，并且能够为模型的某些特征提供有效的识别方法。所提出的观点被应用于一个微观经济面板数据集上。将习惯形成因素纳入折现效用模型后，显著提升了微观数据的合理性。即使不考虑习惯形成因素，只要适度且合理地考虑价格和利率的异质性，也能使消费行为符合理论预测。

abstract.text: Precautionary saving has been linked to the property of prudence, and the property of temperance has been used to show how the presence of an unavoidable risk affects one's behaviour towards a second risk. These two higher order risk effects also play key roles in aversion to negative skewness and to kurtosis, respectively. This article presents a laboratory experiment to determine whether subjects are prudent and/or temperate. The experiment is based upon preferences over lottery pairs in simple 50–50 gambles. Subjects are asked in which of two states of nature they would prefer to receive a zero-mean gamble. For prudence, the choices are between a lower and higher wealth outcome. For temperance, the choices are between a state with no other risk and a state with a second (independent) risk. The results show behavioural evidence for prudence, but they also show evidence of intemperate behaviour. Implications of these results for both expected-utility and non-expected-utility models are examined.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2010.00605.x.abstractZh: 预防性储蓄与谨慎的属性相关联，而节制属性则用于说明不可避免的风险如何影响人们对第二种风险的行为。这两种高级风险效应在厌恶负偏度和负峰度方面也起着关键作用。本文通过一项实验室实验来探讨受试者是否具有谨慎和/或节制的特性。实验基于在简单50-50赌博中对彩票组合的偏好选择。受试者需要选择在两种自然状态下，他们更倾向于接受哪种结果。对于谨慎属性，选择是在较低和较高的财富结果之间；对于节制属性，选择是在没有其他风险的状态与存在第二种（独立）风险的状态之间。实验结果显示了谨慎行为的证据，但也发现了不节制的表现。这些结果对预期效用模型和非预期效用模型的影响也进行了分析。

abstract.text: This paper develops a simple model to analyse how a lack of political competition may lead to policies that hinder economic growth. We test the predictions of the model on panel data for the US states. In these data, we find robust evidence that lack of political competition in a state is associated with anti-growth policies: higher taxes, lower capital spending, and a reduced likelihood of using rightto- work laws. We also document a strong link between low political competition and low income growth.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2010.00606.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个简单的模型，用于分析政治竞争不足如何可能导致阻碍经济增长的政策。我们运用美国各州的面板数据来验证该模型的预测结果。研究发现，州内政治竞争不足与反增长政策之间存在显著关联：税收增加、资本支出减少，以及使用劳动权益法的可能性降低。此外，我们还发现政治竞争不足与收入增长缓慢之间存在密切的联系。

abstract.text: We present a novel structural estimation procedure for models of intertemporal allocation. This is based on modelling expectations errors directly; we refer to it as synthetic residual estimation (SRE). The flexibility of SRE allows us to account for measurement error in consumption and for heterogeneity in intertemporal allocation parameters. An investigation of the small sample properties of the SRE estimator indicates that it dominates generalized method of moments (GMM) estimation of both exact and approximate Euler equations in the case when we have short panels and noisy consumption data. We apply SRE to two panels drawn from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) and estimate the joint distribution of the discount factor and the elasticity of intertemporal substitution. We reject strongly homogeneity of the discount factor and the elasticity of intertemporal substitution. We find that, on average, the more educated are more patient and less willing to substitute intertemporally than the less educated. Within education strata, patience and willingness to substitute are positively correlated.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2010.00607.x.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种用于跨时期分配模型的新结构估计方法。该方法基于直接建模预期误差，我们将其称为合成残差估计（SRE）。SRE的灵活性使我们能够考虑消费中的测量误差以及跨时期分配参数的异质性。对SRE估计量在小样本情况下的研究表明，在拥有短面板数据和噪声消费数据的情况下，SRE在精确和近似欧拉方程的估计中优于广义矩估计（GMM）。我们应用SRE对收入动态面板研究（PSID）中的两个面板数据进行了分析，并估计了折现因子和跨时期替代弹性的联合分布。我们强烈拒绝折现因子和跨时期替代弹性的完全同质性假设。研究发现，平均而言，受教育程度较高的人比受教育程度较低的人更耐心，也更不愿意进行跨时期的替代。在受教育程度不同的群体内部，耐心和替代意愿呈正相关。

abstract.text: We analyse an experimental public goods game in which group members can endogenously determine whether they want to supplement a standard voluntary contribution mechanism with the possibility of rewarding or punishing other group members. We find a significantly positive effect of endogenous institutional choice on the level of cooperation in comparison to the same exogenously implemented institutions. This suggests that participation rights enhance cooperation in groups. With endogenous choice, groups typically vote for the reward option, although punishment is even more effective in sustaining high levels of cooperation. Our results are evaluated against the predictions of social preference models.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2010.00608.x.abstractZh: 我们分析了一个实验性公共物品游戏，在该游戏中，小组成员可以自主决定是否要在标准自愿贡献机制的基础上，增加奖励或惩罚其他成员的可能性。研究发现，与同样由外部实施的制度相比，自主性的制度选择对合作程度有显著的积极影响。这表明，参与权能够增强小组内的合作。在自主性选择下，小组通常会投票支持奖励选项，而惩罚则更能维持高水平的合作。我们的研究结果与社会偏好模型的预测进行了对比分析。

abstract.text: Relative to developed countries and some parts of the developing world, most notably sub-Saharan Africa, there are far fewer women than men in India and China. It has been argued that as many as a 100 million women could be missing. The possibility of gender bias at birth and the mistreatment of young girls are widely regarded as key explanations. We provide a decomposition of these missing women by age and cause of death. While we do not dispute the existence of severe gender bias at young ages, our computations yield some striking new findings: (1) the vast majority of missing women in India and a significant proportion of those in China are of adult age; (2) as a proportion of the total female population, the number of missing women is largest in sub-Saharan Africa, and the absolute numbers are comparable to those for India and China; (3) almost all the missing women stem from disease-by-disease comparisons and not from the changing composition of disease, as described by the epidemiological transition. Finally, using historical data, we argue that a comparable proportion of women was missing at the start of the 20th century in the United States, just as they are in India, China, and sub-Saharan Africa today.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2010.00609.x.abstractZh: 与发达国家以及部分发展中国家相比，尤其是撒哈拉以南非洲地区，印度和中国的女性数量远远少于男性。有观点认为，可能有多达1亿女性缺失。出生时的性别偏见以及对年轻女孩的虐待被广泛认为是主要原因。我们对这些缺失女性的年龄和死因进行了分解分析。虽然我们并不否认在幼年时期存在严重的性别偏见，但我们的计算结果显示了一些令人惊讶的新发现：(1) 印度绝大多数缺失女性以及中国相当一部分缺失女性已经成年；(2) 从女性总人口的比例来看，撒哈拉以南非洲地区的缺失女性数量最多，其绝对数量与印度和中国的相当；(3) 几乎所有缺失女性都是由于疾病导致的，而非像流行病学转变所描述的那样由于疾病构成的变化。最后，通过历史数据，我们认为20世纪初美国的女性缺失比例与今天印度、中国和撒哈拉以南非洲地区的缺失比例相当。

abstract.text: We build a model of heterogeneous individuals—who make investments in schooling quantity and quality—to quantify the importance of differences in human capital vs. total factor productivity (TFP) in explaining the variation in per capita income across countries. The production of human capital requires expenditures and time inputs; the relative importance of these inputs determines the predictions of the theory for inequality both within and across countries. We discipline our quantitative assessment with a calibration firmly grounded on US micro evidence. Since in our calibrated model economy human capital production requires a significant amount of expenditures, TFP changes affect disproportionately the benefits and costs of human capital accumulation. Our main finding is that human capital accumulation strongly amplifies TFP differences across countries: to explain a 20-fold difference in the output per worker, the model requires a 5-fold difference in the TFP of the tradable sector, vs. an 18-fold difference if human capital is fixed across countries.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2010.00610.x.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个异质个体的模型，这些个体在教育的数量和质量上进行投资，以此来量化人力资本差异与全要素生产率差异在解释各国人均收入差异中的重要性。人力资本的生产需要支出和时间投入；这些投入的相对重要性决定了理论对于国内和国与之间不平等现象的预测结果。我们的定量评估基于美国微观数据的校准进行限制。因为在我们的校准模型中，人力资本的生产需要大量的支出，全要素生产率的变化会不成比例地影响人力资本积累的利益和成本。我们的主要发现是，人力资本积累会显著放大各国之间的全要素生产率差异：要解释工人产出相差20倍的情况，模型需要可贸易部门的全要素生产率相差5倍，而如果人力资本在各国之间保持不变，则需要相差18倍。

abstract.text: We set up and solve a spatial, dynamic equilibrium model of the housing market based on two main assumptions: households with heterogenous abilities flow in and out metropolitan areas in response to local wage shocks, and the housing supply cannot adjust instantly because of regulatory constraints. In our equilibrium, house prices compensate for cross-sectional productivity differences. We increase productivity dispersion in the calibrated model in order to match the 30-year increase in cross-sectional wage dispersion that we document based on metropolitan-level data. We show that the model quantitatively matches the observed 30-year increase in dispersion of house prices across US metropolitan areas. It is consistent with several other features of the cross-sectional distribution of house prices and wages.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2010.00611.x.abstractZh: 我们建立并求解了一个基于两个主要假设的住房市场空间动态均衡模型：具有不同能力的家庭会根据当地工资变动在都市区域之间流动，而住房供应由于监管限制无法立即调整。在均衡状态下，房价能够弥补横截面生产力差异。我们在校准模型中增加了生产力的分散性，以匹配我们根据都市级数据记录的30年间房价横截面分散性的增加。结果表明，该模型在定量上符合美国都市地区房价横截面分散性30年的增加情况，这与房价和工资横截面分布的几个其他特征是一致的。

abstract.text: We model earnings processes allowing for lots of heterogeneity across agents. We also introduce an extension to the linear ARMA model which allows the initial convergence in the long run to be different from that implied by the conventional ARMA model. This is particularly important for unit root tests, which are actually tests of a composite of two independent hypotheses. We fit to a variety of statistics including most of those considered by previous investigators. We use a sample drawn from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID), and focus on white males with a high-school degree. Despite this observable homogeneity, we find more latent heterogeneity than previous investigators. We show that allowance for heterogeneity makes substantial differences to estimates of model parameters and to outcomes of interest. Additionally, we find strong evidence against the hypothesis that any worker has a unit root.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2010.00612.x.abstractZh: 我们建立了能够体现不同主体之间大量异质性的收益过程模型。我们还对线性ARMA模型进行了扩展，使得长期内的初始收敛情况与传统ARMA模型所暗示的情况有所不同。这一点对于单位根检验尤为重要，因为单位根检验实际上是对两个独立假设的综合检验。我们采用了来自收入动态面板研究（PSID）的多种统计数据，并重点关注拥有高中学历的白人男性。尽管存在这种可观察到的同质性，我们发现实际的潜在异质性比之前的研究者发现的要多。我们表明，考虑异质性会对模型参数的估计以及感兴趣的结果产生显著影响。此外，我们还发现了强有力的证据，支持“任何工人都具有单位根”的假设是错误的。

abstract.text: We analyse a Bewley-Huggett-Aiyagari incomplete-markets model with labour-market frictions. Consumers are subject to idiosyncratic employment shocks against which they cannot insure directly. The labour market has a Diamond-Mortensen-Pissarides structure: firms enter by posting vacancies and match with workers bilaterally, with match probabilities given by an aggregate matching function. Wages are determined through Nash bargaining. We also consider aggregate productivity shocks and a complete set of contingent claims conditional on this risk. We use the model to evaluate a tax-financed unemployment insurance scheme. Higher insurance is beneficial for consumption smoothing, but because it raises workers' outside option value, it discourages firm entry. We find that the latter effect is more potent for welfare outcomes; we tabulate the effects quantitatively for different kinds of consumers. We also demonstrate that productivity changes in the model—in steady state as well as stochastic ones—generate rather limited unemployment effects, unless workers are close to indifferent between working and not working; thus, recent findings are corroborated in our more general setting.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2010.00700.x.abstractZh: 我们分析了一个包含劳动力市场摩擦的Bewley-Huggett-Aiyagari不完全市场模型。消费者面临无法直接保险的特有就业冲击。劳动力市场的结构类似于Diamond-Mortensen-Pissarides模型：企业通过发布职位空缺进入市场，并与工人进行双边匹配，匹配概率由综合匹配函数决定。工资通过纳什谈判确定。我们还考虑了总体生产率冲击以及基于这种风险的一系列条件性索赔。我们利用该模型评估了一项由税收资助的失业保险计划。较高的保险对消费平滑有益，但由于它提高了工人的外部选择价值，反而抑制了企业的进入。我们发现，这种抑制作用对福利结果的影响更为显著；我们为不同类型的消费者量化了这些效应。此外，我们还证明了模型中的生产率变化——无论是稳态还是随机状态——产生的失业效应相当有限，除非工人在工作与不工作之间几乎无差别；因此，最近的研究结果在我们更一般的框架下得到了验证。

abstract.text: In this paper, we expand on the seminal work of Altonji and Shakotko (1987) and Topel (1991) and reinvestigate the returns to seniority in the United States. We begin with the same wage equation as in previous studies. We extend the model of Hyslop (1999) and explicitly model the participation/employment and inter-firm mobility decisions, which, in turn, define the individual's experience and seniority. We introduce into the wage equation a summary of the workers' entire career path. The three-equation system is estimated simultaneously using data from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID). We find that for each of the three education groups studied the returns to seniority are larger than those previously found in the literature.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2010.598.x.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们扩展了Altonji和Shakotko（1987年）以及Topel（1991年）的开创性研究，重新探讨了美国中资历的回报情况。我们采用与以往研究相同的工资方程模型。我们扩展了Hyslop（1999年）的模型，并明确考虑了参与/就业以及企业间流动决策，这些决策反过来又决定了个人的经验和资历。我们在工资方程中引入了工人整个职业路径的概要信息。该三方程系统通过面板收入动态研究（PSID）的数据进行同时估计。我们发现，对于所研究的三个教育群体而言，资历的回报比文献中先前发现的要高。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVE: We ask whether Medicare's Hospital Compare random effects model correctly assesses acute myocardial infarction (AMI) hospital mortality rates when there is a volume-outcome relationship. DATA SOURCES/STUDY SETTING: Medicare claims on 208,157 AMI patients admitted in 3,629 acute care hospitals throughout the United States. STUDY DESIGN: We compared average-adjusted mortality using logistic regression with average adjusted mortality based on the Hospital Compare random effects model. We then fit random effects models with the same patient variables as in Medicare's Hospital Compare mortality model but also included terms for hospital Medicare AMI volume and another model that additionally included other hospital characteristics. PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: Hospital Compare's average adjusted mortality significantly underestimates average observed death rates in small volume hospitals. Placing hospital volume in the Hospital Compare model significantly improved predictions. CONCLUSIONS: The Hospital Compare random effects model underestimates the typically poorer performance of low-volume hospitals. Placing hospital volume in the Hospital Compare model, and possibly other important hospital characteristics, appears indicated when using a random effects model to predict outcomes. Care must be taken to insure the proper method of reporting such models, especially if hospital characteristics are included in the random effects model.

10.1111/j.1475-6773.2010.01130.x.abstractZh:
目的：我们旨在探讨在存在数量-结果关系的情况下，Medicare的Hospital Compare随机效应模型是否能够准确评估急性心肌梗死（AMI）患者的医院死亡率。  
数据来源/研究环境：选取了美国全国3,629家急性护理医院中收治的208,157名AMI患者的Medicare索赔数据。  
研究设计：我们通过逻辑回归比较了平均调整死亡率，并与Hospital Compare随机效应模型得出的平均调整死亡率进行了对比。随后，我们使用与Medicare的Hospital Compare死亡率模型相同的患者变量，同时加入了医院AMI病例数量的相关项，以及其他医院特征的相关项，构建了随机效应模型。  
主要发现：Hospital Compare的平均调整死亡率显著低估了小型医院的平均死亡率。在Hospital Compare模型中引入医院病例数量这一变量后，预测效果显著改善。  
结论：Hospital Compare随机效应模型低估了低容量医院通常较差的绩效表现。在利用随机效应模型预测结果时，将医院病例数量及其他重要医院特征纳入模型是有必要的。在纳入随机效应模型时，必须注意报告方法的正确性，尤其是当医院特征被纳入模型时。

abstract.text: We describe recent advances in the empirical analysis of insurance markets. This new research proposes ways to estimate individual demand for insurance and the relationship between prices and insurer costs in the presence of adverse and advantageous selection. We discuss how these models permit the measurement of welfare distortions arising from asymmetric information and the welfare consequences of potential government policy responses. We also discuss some challenges in modeling imperfect competition between insurers and outline a series of open research questions.

10.1146/annurev.economics.050708.143254.abstractZh: 我们描述了保险市场实证分析领域的最新进展。这些新研究提出了估算个人对保险需求的方法，以及在不对称选择和有利选择情况下，价格与保险公司成本之间关系的分析方法。我们讨论了这些模型如何能够衡量由信息不对称引起的福利扭曲，以及潜在政府政策响应的福利后果。我们还讨论了一些在模拟保险公司之间不完全竞争时的挑战，并概述了一系列尚未解决的研究问题。

abstract.text: Does competition spur productivity? And if so, how does it accomplish this? These have long been regarded as central questions in economics. This article reviews the literature that makes progress toward answering both questions.

10.1146/annurev.economics.102308.124407.abstractZh: 竞争能否促进生产力提升？如果可以，又是如何实现的？这些问题长期以来一直被视为经济学中的核心问题。本文回顾了那些在解答这两个问题方面取得进展的文献。

abstract.text: It is widely believed that cost-sharing - charging a subsidized, positive price - for a health product is necessary to avoid wasting resources on those who will not use or do not need the product. We explore this argument in the context of a field experiment in Kenya, in which we randomized the price at which pregnant women could buy long lasting anti-malarial insecticide-treated nets (ITNs) at prenatal clinics. We find no evidence that cost-sharing reduces wastage on those that will not use the product: women who received free ITNs are not less likely to use them than those who paid subsidized positive prices. We also find no evidence that cost-sharing induces selection of women who need the net more: those who pay higher prices appear no sicker than the prenatal clients in the control group in terms of measured anemia (an important indicator of malaria). Cost-sharing does, however, considerably dampen demand. We find that uptake drops by 75 percent when the price of ITNs increases from 0 to $0.75, the price at which ITNs are currently sold to pregnant women in Kenya. We combine our estimates in a cost-effectiveness analysis of ITN prices on infant mortality that incorporates both private and social returns to ITN usage. Overall, given the large positive externality associated with widespread usage of insecticide-treated nets, our results suggest that free distribution to pregnant women is both more effective and more cost-effective than cost-sharing.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.1.1.abstractZh: 人们普遍认为，对卫生产品收取补贴性价格以进行费用分摊是必要的，这样可以避免资源被浪费在那些不会使用或不需要的产品上。我们在肯尼亚的一项实地实验中探讨了这一论点。在该实验中，我们随机改变了孕妇在产前诊所购买长效抗疟疾杀虫剂处理蚊帐的价格。我们发现，费用分摊并没有减少那些不会使用产品的人的资源浪费：获得免费蚊帐的妇女使用蚊帐的可能性并不低于那些支付补贴性价格的人。此外，我们也没有发现费用分摊会促使那些更需要蚊帐的妇女选择使用蚊帐：支付较高价格的人在贫血指标方面并不比对照组孕妇更不健康。然而，费用分摊确实显著降低了需求。我们发现，当蚊帐的价格从0美元增加到0.75美元时，使用率下降了75%。这一价格正是肯尼亚目前向孕妇出售蚊帐的价格。我们将这些估计结果结合到一项关于蚊帐价格对婴儿死亡率影响的成本效益分析中，该分析同时考虑了蚊帐使用的私人和社会回报。总体而言，鉴于广泛使用杀虫剂处理蚊帐所带来的巨大正外部性，我们的结果表明，向孕妇免费分发蚊帐比费用分摊更为有效且更具成本效益。

abstract.text: We investigate the role of sectoral labor productivity in explaining the process of structural transformation—the secular reallocation of labor across sectors—and the time path of aggregate productivity across countries. We measure sectoral labor productivity across countries using a model of the structural transformation. Productivity differences across countries are large in agriculture and services and smaller in manufacturing. Over time, productivity gaps have been substantially reduced in agriculture and industry but not nearly as much in services. These sectoral productivity patterns generate implications in the model that are broadly consistent with the cross-country data. We find that productivity catch-up in industry explains about 50% of the gains in aggregate productivity across countries, whereas low productivity in services and the lack of catch-up explain all the experiences of slowdown, stagnation, and decline observed across countries.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.1.129.abstractZh: 我们研究了部门劳动生产率在解释结构转型过程中的作用——即劳动力在不同部门之间的长期重新分配——以及各国总体生产率的时间变化。我们通过一个结构转型模型来衡量各国部门的劳动生产率。在农业和服务业领域，各国之间的生产率差异较大，而在制造业领域则相对较小。随着时间的推移，农业和产业领域的生产率差距显著缩小，而服务业领域的差距则几乎没有缩小。这些部门生产率模式在模型中的表现与跨国数据大体一致。我们发现，工业领域生产率的提升解释了各国总体生产率提升的约50%，而服务业的低生产率以及缺乏生产率提升则解释了各国观察到的所有放缓、停滞和下降现象。

abstract.text: Growing concerns over the inadequate achievement of U.S. students have led to proposals to reward good teachers and penalize (or fire) bad ones. The leading method for assessing teacher quality is “value added” modeling (YAM), which decomposes students' test scores into components attributed to student heterogeneity and to teacher quality. Implicit in the VAM approach are strong assumptions about the nature of the educational production function and the assignment of students to classrooms. In this paper, I develop falsification tests for three widely used VAM specifications, based on the idea that future teachers cannot influence students' past achievement. In data from North Carolina, each of the VAMs' exclusion restrictions is dramatically violated. In particular, these models indicate large “effects” of fifth grade teachers on fourth grade test score gains. I also find that conventional measures of individual teachers' value added fade out very quickly and are at best weakly related to long-run effects. I discuss implications for the use of VAMs as personnel tools.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.1.175.abstractZh: 对于美国学生成绩未能达到预期水平的担忧日益加剧，这促使人们提出奖励优秀教师、惩罚或解雇不合格教师的方案。评估教师质量的主要方法是“增值模型”（Value Added Model，简称VAM），该模型将学生的测试成绩分解为由学生异质性和教师质量共同导致的成分。增值模型隐含着关于教育生产函数性质以及学生分配至不同教室的假设。在本文中，我基于未来教师无法影响学生过去成绩的观点，为三种广泛使用的增值模型提出了验证性测试。来自北卡罗来纳州的数据表明，这些增值模型的排除限制被严重违反。具体而言，这些模型显示五年级教师对四年级测试成绩提升有显著的影响。我还发现，传统上用来衡量个别教师增值的指标很快会消失，且最多只能与长期效果形成弱关联。最后，我讨论了将增值模型作为人事管理工具的应用前景。

abstract.text: Despite extensive public infrastructure spending, surprisingly little is known about its economic return. In this paper, we estimate the value of school facility investments using housing markets: standard models of local public goods imply that school districts should spend up to the point where marginal increases would have zero effect on local housing prices. Our research design isolates exogenous variation in investments by comparing school districts where referenda on bond issues targeted to fund capital expenditures passed and failed by narrow margins. We extend this traditional regression discontinuity approach to identify the dynamic treatment effects of bond authorization on local housing prices, student achievement, and district composition. Our results indicate that California school districts underinvest in school facilities: passing a referendum causes immediate, sizable increases in home prices, implying a willingness to pay on the part of marginal homebuyers of $1.50 or more for each $1 of capital spending. These effects do not appear to be driven by changes in the income or racial composition of homeowners, and the impact on test scores appears to explain only a small portion of the total housing price effect.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.1.215.abstractZh: 尽管公共基础设施投资规模庞大，但关于其经济回报的信息却相对较少。在本文中，我们采用住房市场的方法来估算学校设施投资的价值：传统的本地公共物品模型表明，学区应投资于边际增加对当地房价影响为零的点。我们的研究设计通过对比那些关于债券问题的公投以资助资本支出的学区，这些公投以微弱差距通过或失败，从而分离出投资中的外生变异。我们扩展了这种传统的回归不连续方法，以识别债券授权对当地房价、学生成绩和学区构成的影响。我们的结果表明，加利福尼亚州的学区在学校设施投资上投入不足：通过公投会导致房价立即出现显著上涨，这意味着边际购房者愿意为每1美元的资本支出支付1.50美元或更多。这些效应似乎并不由房主的收入或种族构成的变化所驱动，而对考试成绩的影响似乎只能解释总房价效应的一小部分。

abstract.text: Firms spend billions of dollars developing advertising content, yet there is little field evidence on how much or how it affects demand. We analyze a direct mail field experiment in South Africa implemented by a consumer lender that randomized advertising content, loan price, and loan offer deadlines simultaneously. We find that advertising content significantly affects demand. Although it was difficult to predict ex ante which specific advertising features would matter most in this context, the features that do matter have large effects. Showing fewer example loans, not suggesting a particular use for the loan, or including a photo of an attractive woman increases loan demand by about as much as a 25% reduction in the interest rate. The evidence also suggests that advertising content persuades by appealing “peripherally” to intuition rather than reason. Although the advertising content effects point to an important role for persuasion and related psychology, our deadline results do not support the psychological prediction that shorter deadlines may help overcome time-management problems; instead, demand strongly increases with longer deadlines.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.1.263.abstractZh: 企业花费数十亿美元用于开发广告内容，但关于这些广告内容对需求的影响程度以及具体影响方式，目前缺乏实证数据。我们分析了南非一家消费贷款机构实施的一项直接邮件实地实验。该实验同时随机分配了广告内容、贷款价格和贷款提交截止日期。研究发现，广告内容对需求有显著影响。尽管在事前很难预测哪些具体广告元素最为重要，但那些确实起作用的元素会产生较大的影响。展示较少的示例贷款、不推荐特定的贷款用途，或者包含一张性感的女性照片，都能使贷款需求增加约25%，而利率的降低则对需求的影响较小。这些证据还表明，广告内容通过“外围”方式影响消费者的直觉，而非理性思维。虽然广告内容的效果表明说服技巧及相关心理学理论具有重要意义，但我们的实验结果并不支持“较短的截止日期有助于解决时间管理问题”这一心理学预测；相反，较长的截止日期反而能显著增加需求。

abstract.text: A central question surrounding the current subprime crisis is whether the securitization process reduced the incentives of financial intermediaries to carefully screen borrowers. We examine this issue empirically using data on securitized subprime mortgage loan contracts in the United States. We exploit a specific rule of thumb in the lending market to generate exogenous variation in the ease of securitization and compare the composition and performance of lenders' portfolios around the ad hoc threshold. Conditional on being securitized, the portfolio with greater ease of securitization defaults by around 10%–25% more than a similar risk profile group with a lesser ease of securitization. We conduct additional analyses to rule out differential selection by market participants around the threshold and lenders employing an optimal screening cutoff unrelated to securitization as alternative explanations. The results are confined to loans where intermediaries' screening effort may be relevant and soft information about borrowers determines their creditworthiness. Our findings suggest that existing securitization practices did adversely affect the screening incentives of subprime lenders.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.1.307.abstractZh: 当前次贷危机的核心问题是，证券化过程是否降低了金融中介机构仔细筛选借款人的积极性。我们通过美国证券化次贷抵押贷款合同的数据来实证研究这一问题。我们利用贷款市场中的一个特定经验法则，生成证券化难易程度的外生变化，并比较在临时设定的阈值附近各贷款机构投资组合的构成和表现。在已经进行证券化的条件下，证券化难度较高的投资组合的违约率比风险状况相似但证券化难度较低的组别高出10%至25%。我们还进行了额外分析，以排除市场参与者在阈值附近的差异选择，以及贷款机构使用与证券化无关的最优筛选标准作为替代解释。研究结果仅适用于那些中介机构的筛选努力可能相关的贷款，且借款人的信用状况由软信息决定。我们的研究结果表明，现有的证券化做法确实对次贷贷款机构的筛选积极性产生了不利影响。

abstract.text: This paper studies the theoretical and empirical implications of monetary policy making by committee under four different voting protocols. The protocols are a consensus model, where a supermajority is required for a policy change; an agenda-setting model, where the chairman controls the agenda; a dictator model, where the chairman has absolute power over the committee; and a simple majority model, where policy is determined by the median member. These protocols give preeminence to different aspects of the actual decision-making process and capture the observed heterogeneity in formal procedures across central banks. The models are estimated by maximum likelihood using interest rate decisions by the committees of five central banks, namely the Bank of Canada, the Bank of England, the European Central Bank, the Swedish Riksbank, and the U.S. Federal Reserve. For all central banks, results indicate that the consensus model fits actual policy decisions better than the alternative models. This suggests that despite institutional differences, committees share unwritten rules and informal procedures that deliver observationally equivalent policy decisions.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.1.363.abstractZh: 本文研究了委员会制定货币政策在四种不同投票协议下的理论和实证意义。这些协议包括共识模型，其中政策变更需要超多数同意；议程设定模型，其中主席控制议程；独裁模型，其中主席对委员会拥有绝对权力；以及简单多数模型，其中政策由中位成员决定。这些协议分别突出了实际决策过程中的不同方面，并反映了不同中央银行在正式程序上的差异。模型通过最大似然法对五家中央银行——加拿大银行、英格兰银行、欧洲中央银行、瑞典央行和美国联邦储备系统的利率决策进行了估计。对于所有中央银行而言，结果表明共识模型比其他模型更能拟合实际政策决策。这表明，尽管存在制度上的差异，委员会之间存在着不成文的规定和非正式程序，这些机制能够产生与观察结果相当的政策决策。

abstract.text: Residential segregation by jurisdiction generates disparities in public services and education. The distinctive American pattern—in which blacks live in cities and whites in suburbs—was enhanced by a large black migration from the rural South. I show that whites responded to this black influx by leaving cities and rule out an indirect effect on housing prices as a sole cause. I instrument for changes in black population by using local economic conditions to predict black migration from southern states and assigning predicted flows to northern cities according to established settlement patterns. The best causal estimates imply that each black arrival led to 2.7 white departures.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.1.417.abstractZh: 按司法管辖区划分的住宅隔离导致了公共服务和教育的差异。美国特有的模式——黑人居住在城市，白人居住在郊区——因大量黑人从南方农村迁移而更加明显。我发现，白人为了应对这种黑人人口流入，选择离开城市，因此不能将房价上涨视为唯一的直接原因。我通过利用当地经济状况来预测黑人的迁移，并根据既定的居住模式将预测的迁移流向北方城市，以此来研究黑人群体变化的影响。最精确的因果估计表明，每有1名黑人到来，就会导致2.7名白人离开城市。

abstract.text: This paper examines how a large conditional grants program influenced school desegregation in the American South. Exploiting newly collected archival data and quasi-experimental variation in potential per-pupil federal grants, we show that school districts with more at risk in 1966 were more likely to desegregate just enough to receive their funds. Although the program did not raise the exposure of blacks to whites like later court orders, districts with larger grants at risk in 1966 were less likely to be under court order through 1970, suggesting that tying federal funds to nondiscrimination reduced the burden of desegregation on federal courts.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.1.445.abstractZh: 本文探讨了大型条件性拨款计划如何影响了美国南部的学校废除种族隔离进程。通过利用新收集的档案数据以及潜在每生联邦拨款的准实验性变化，我们发现1966年面临更大风险的教育区更有可能进行足以获得拨款的废除种族隔离行动。尽管该计划并未像后来的法院命令那样提高黑人与白人的接触机会，但1966年面临更大拨款风险的学区在1970年受到法院命令的可能性较低，这表明将联邦资金与反歧视措施挂钩减轻了联邦法院在废除种族隔离方面的负担。

abstract.text: In standard monetary policy approaches, interest-rate rules often produce indeterminacy. A sophisticated policy approach does not. Sophisticated policies depend on the history of private actions, government policies, and exogenous events and can differ on and off the equilibrium path. They can uniquely implement any desired competitive equilibrium. When interest rates are used along the equilibrium path, implementation requires regime-switching. These results are robust to imperfect information. Our results imply that the Taylor principle is neither necessary nor sufficient for unique implementation. They also provide a direction for empirical work on monetary policy rules and determinacy.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.1.47.abstractZh: 在标准的货币政策方法中，利率规则往往会导致不确定性。而复杂的货币政策方法则不会。复杂的货币政策依赖于私人行为、政府政策以及外部事件的历史，并且可以在均衡路径上有所不同。它们能够唯一地实现任何期望的竞争均衡。当在均衡路径上使用利率时，实施这些政策需要制度转换。这些结果在不完美信息的情况下仍然成立。我们的研究结果表明，泰勒原则既不是实现唯一均衡的必要条件，也不是充分条件。这些结果也为关于货币政策规则和不确定性的实证研究提供了方向。

abstract.text: This paper uses Social Security Administration longitudinal earnings micro data since 1937 to analyze the evolution of inequality and mobility in the United States. Annual earnings inequality is U-shaped, decreasing sharply up to 1953 and increasing steadily afterward. Short-term earnings mobility measures are stable over the full period except for a temporary surge during World War II. Virtually all of the increase in the variance in annual (log) earnings since 1970 is due to increase in the variance of permanent earnings (as opposed to transitory earnings). Mobility at the top of the earnings distribution is stable and has not mitigated the dramatic increase in annual earnings concentration since the 1970s. Long-term mobility among all workers has increased since the 1950s but has slightly declined among men. The decrease in the gender earnings gap and the resulting substantial increase in upward mobility over a lifetime for women are the driving force behind the increase in long-term mobility among all workers.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.1.91.abstractZh: 本文利用自1937年以来的美国社会保障管理局纵向收入微观数据，分析美国不平等与收入流动性的演变趋势。年度收入不平等呈现U形曲线，在1953年前急剧下降，之后则稳步上升。短期收入流动性在整个研究期间保持稳定，仅在第二次世界大战期间出现过短暂上升。自1970年以来，年度收入（对数）方差的增加几乎全部源于永久收入方差的增加（而非暂时性收入）。收入分布顶端的流动性保持稳定，并未缓解自1970年代以来年度收入集中度的急剧上升。自1950年代以来，所有工人的长期流动性有所提高，但男性工人的流动性略有下降。性别收入差距的缩小以及女性一生中向上流动性的显著增加，是提升所有工人长期流动性的主要因素。

abstract.text: The formal literature on firm boundaries has assumed that ex post conflicts are resolved through bargaining. In reality, parties often simply exercise their decision rights. We develop a model, based on shading, in which the use of authority has a central role. We consider two firms deciding whether to adopt a common standard. Nonintegrated firms may fail to coordinate if one firm loses. An integrated firm can internalize the externality, but puts insufficient weight on employee benefits. We use our approach to understand why Cisco acquired StrataCom, a provider of new transmission technology. We also analyze delegation.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.2.483.abstractZh: 关于企业边界的正式文献通常假设事后冲突是通过谈判解决的。实际上，各方往往只是行使自己的决策权。我们基于“阴影效应”理论构建了一个模型，其中权威的使用起着核心作用。我们研究了两家企业是否采用共同标准的问题。如果一家企业失去优势，未整合的企业可能无法进行协调。而整合的企业可以内部化外部性，但员工福利的权重不足。我们利用这一模型来理解为什么思科收购了StrataCom——一家提供新型传输技术的公司。我们还分析了委托代理问题。

abstract.text: Economists emphasize the link between market returns to education and investments in schooling. Though many studies estimate these returns with earnings data, it is the perceived returns that affect schooling decisions, and these perceptions may be inaccurate. Using survey data for eighth-grade boys in the Dominican Republic, we find that the perceived returns to secondary school are extremely low, despite high measured returns. Students at randomly selected schools given information on the higher measured returns completed on average 0.20–0.35 more years of school over the next four years than those who were not.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.2.515.abstractZh: 经济学家强调市场回报与教育投资之间的联系。尽管许多研究使用收益数据来估算这些回报，但影响教育决策的是人们感知到的回报，而这些感知可能并不准确。通过对多米尼加共和国八年级男生的调查数据进行分析，我们发现尽管中学教育的实际回报很高，但人们感知到的回报却极低。在随机选取的学校中，那些了解到较高实际回报的学生，在接下来的四年里平均多完成0.20至0.35年的学业。

abstract.text: We estimate the magnitude of spillovers generated by 112 academic "superstars" who died prematurely and unexpectedly, thus providing an exogenous source of variation in the structure of their collaborators' coauthorship networks. Following the death of a superstar, we find that collaborators experience, on average, a lasting 5% to 8% decline in their quality-adjusted publication rates. By exploring interactions of the treatment effect with a variety of star, coauthor, and star/coauthor dyad characteristics, we seek to adjudicate between plausible mechanisms that might explain this finding. Taken together, our results suggest that spillovers are circumscribed in idea space, but less so in physical or social space. In particular, superstar extinction reveals the boundaries of the scientific field to which the star contributes-the "invisible college." (c) 2010 by the President and Fellows of Harvard College and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology..

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.2.549.abstractZh: 我们估计了112位过早且意外去世的学术“超级明星”所产生的溢出效应的大小，这为研究他们合作者共同作者网络结构的变化提供了外部变量来源。在超级明星去世后，我们发现合作者的质量调整出版率平均下降了5%到8%。通过探讨治疗效果与各种明星、合作者以及明星/合作者组合特征之间的相互作用，我们试图确定可能解释这一发现的合理机制。综合来看，我们的结果表明，溢出效应在思想领域是有限度的，但在物理或社会领域则较为明显。特别是，超级明星的消失揭示了该明星所贡献的科学领域的边界——即“隐形学院”。© 2010 由哈佛学院和麻省理工学院的会长们发布。

abstract.text: A key policy question is whether the benefits of additional medical expenditures exceed their costs. We propose a new approach for estimating marginal returns to medical spending based on variation in medical inputs generated by diagnostic thresholds. Specifically, we combine regression discontinuity estimates that compare health outcomes and medical treatment provision for newborns on either side of the very low birth weight threshold at 1500 grams. First, using data on the census of US births in available years from 1983-2002, we find that newborns with birth weights just below 1500 grams have lower one-year mortality rates than do newborns with birth weights just above this cutoff, even though mortality risk tends to decrease with birth weight. One-year mortality falls by approximately one percentage point as birth weight crosses 1500 grams from above, which is large relative to mean infant mortality of 5.5% just above 1500 grams. Second, using hospital discharge records for births in five states in available years from 1991-2006, we find that newborns with birth weights just below 1500 grams have discontinuously higher charges and frequencies of specific medical inputs. Hospital costs increase by approximately $4,000 as birth weight crosses 1500 grams from above, relative to mean hospital costs of $40,000 just above 1500 grams. Under an assumption that observed medical spending fully captures the impact of the "very low birth weight" designation on mortality, our estimates suggest that the cost of saving a statistical life of a newborn with birth weight near 1500 grams is on the order of $550,000 in 2006 dollars.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.2.591.abstractZh: 一个关键的政策问题是，额外的医疗支出所带来的收益是否超过了其成本。我们提出了一种新的方法来估算医疗支出的边际回报，该方法基于诊断阈值导致的医疗投入的变化。具体来说，我们结合了回归不连续估计，比较了1500克以下极低出生体重新生儿的健康结果和医疗治疗情况。首先，利用1983年至2002年可用年份的美国出生人口普查数据，我们发现出生体重略低于1500克的新生儿一年的死亡率低于出生体重略高于此阈值的新生儿，尽管死亡率通常随着出生体重的增加而降低。当出生体重超过1500克时，一年的死亡率大约下降一个百分点，这一数值相对于1500克以上婴儿的平均死亡率5.5%来说相当大。其次，利用1991年至2006年五个州可用的出生出院记录，我们发现出生体重略低于1500克的新生儿在特定医疗投入的收费和频率上呈现出不连续的升高。当出生体重超过1500克时，医院费用大约增加了4000美元，而1500克以上婴儿的平均医院费用仅为40000美元。在假设观察到的医疗支出完全反映了“极低出生体重”这一标签对死亡率的影响的情况下，我们的估计表明，在2006年的货币价值下，为出生体重接近1500克的新生儿挽救一个统计生命所需的成本约为550,000美元。

abstract.text: We present a model with altruistic parents and heterogeneous productivity. We derive two key properties for optimal estate taxation. First, the estate tax should be progressive, so that parents leaving a higher bequest face a lower net return on bequests. Second, marginal estate taxes should be negative, so that all parents face a marginal subsidy on bequests. Both properties can be implemented with a simple nonlinear tax on bequests, levied separately from the income tax. These results apply to other intergenerational transfers, such as educational investments, and are robust to endogenous fertility choices. Both estate or inheritance taxes can implement the optimal allocation, but we show that the inheritance tax has some advantages. Finally, when we impose an ad hoc constraint requiring marginal estate taxes to be nonnegative, the optimum features a zero tax up to an exemption level, and a progressive tax thereafter.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.2.635.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个包含利他型父母和异质生产率的模型。我们推导出最优遗产税的两个关键特性。首先，遗产税应该实行累进制，这样留给后人的遗产越多，获得的净收益就越低。其次，边际遗产税应该为负值，这样所有父母在遗产继承上都会获得边际补贴。这两个特性可以通过一个简单的非线性遗产税来实现，该税与所得税分开征收。这些结果适用于其他代际转移，如教育投资，并且对于内生性生育选择具有鲁棒性。无论是遗产税还是继承税都可以实现最优分配，但我们发现继承税有一些优势。最后，当我们施加一个临时约束，要求边际遗产税为非负值时，最优方案表现为零税直至某个免税额，之后则实行累进税。

abstract.text: We empirically document, using U.S. import prices, that on average goods with a high frequency of price adjustment have a long-run pass-through that is at least twice as high as that of low-frequency adjusters. We show theoretically that this relationship should follow because variable mark-ups that reduce longrun pass-through also reduce the curvature of the profit function when expressed as a function of cost shocks, making the firm less willing to adjust its price. We quantitatively evaluate a dynamic menu-cost model and show that the variable mark-up channel can generate significant variation in frequency, equivalent to 37% of the observed variation in the data. On the other hand, the standard workhorse model with constant elasticity of demand and Calvo or state-dependent pricing has difficulty matching the facts.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.2.675.abstractZh: 我们通过使用美国进口价格进行实证分析，发现平均而言，价格调整频率较高的商品在长期中的传递效应至少是频率较低的商品的两倍。我们从理论上证明了这种关系之所以成立，是因为降低长期传递效应的可变加价也会降低利润函数的曲率，当利润函数表示为成本冲击的函数时，企业就不太愿意调整价格。我们定量评估了一个动态菜单成本模型，并发现可变加价渠道能够产生显著的频率变化，相当于数据中观察到的变化的37%。另一方面，以需求恒定弹性以及Calvo定价或状态依赖定价为特点的标准模型则难以符合实际情况。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact on agricultural development of the introduction of barbed wire fencing to the American Plains in the late nineteenth century. Without a fence, farmers risked uncompensated damage by others' livestock. From 1880 to 1900, the introduction and near-universal adoption of barbed wire greatly reduced the cost of fences, relative to the predominant wooden fences, especially in counties with the least woodland. Over that period, counties with the least woodland experienced substantial relative increases in settlement, land improvement, land values, and the productivity and production share of crops most in need of protection. This increase in agricultural development appears partly to reflect farmers' increased ability to protect their land from encroachment. States' inability to protect this full bundle of property rights on the frontier, beyond providing formal land titles, might have otherwise restricted agricultural development.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.2.767.abstractZh: 本文探讨了19世纪末在美国大平原地区引入带刺铁丝网对农业发展所产生的影响。如果没有铁丝网，农民面临着牲畜受到他人无补偿损害的风险。从1880年到1900年，带刺铁丝网的引入及其近乎普遍的采用，大大降低了围栏的成本，相对于当时占主导地位的木制围栏而言，这一点在林地最少的县份尤为明显。在这段时间里，林地最少的县份经历了定居点数量、土地改良、土地价值以及最需要保护的农作物生产效率和生产份额的显著增长。这种农业发展的提升，部分反映了农民在保护土地免受侵占方面的能力增强。各州在边疆地区未能完全保障这些财产权利，除了提供正式的土地所有权证书外，可能会限制农业的发展。

abstract.text: Why is private investment so low in Gulf compared to Western countries? We investigate cross-regional differences in trust and reference points for trustworthiness as possible factors. Experiments controlling for cross-regional differences in institutions and beliefs about trustworthiness reveal that Gulf citizens pay much more than Westerners to avoid trusting, and hardly respond when returns to trusting change. These differences can be explained by subjects' gain/loss utility relative to their region's reference point for trustworthiness. The relation-based production of trust in the Gulf induces higher levels of trustworthiness, albeit within groups, than the rule-based interactions prevalent in the West.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.2.811.abstractZh: 为什么海湾地区的私人投资比西方国家低？我们研究了跨地区在信任和信任基准方面的差异，认为这些是可能的因素。通过控制跨地区在制度和信任观念上的差异进行的实验表明，海湾地区的公民愿意支付更高的代价来避免信任，并且当信任回报发生变化时，他们的反应几乎不变。这些差异可以通过受试者相对于其所在地区信任基准的收益/损失效用来解释。海湾地区基于关系的信任建立方式，虽然仅限于特定群体，但比西方普遍存在的基于规则的互动方式更能促进更高水平的信任。

abstract.text: We study a world with national external economies of scale at the industry level. In contrast to the standard treatment with perfect competition and two industries, we assume Bertrand competition in a continuum of industries. With Bertrand competition, each firm can internalize the externalities from production by setting a price below those set by others. This out-of-equilibrium threat eliminates many of the “pathologies” of the standard treatment. There typically exists a unique equilibrium with trade guided by “natural” comparative advantage. And, when a country has CES preferences and any finite elasticity of substitution between goods, gains from trade are ensured.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.2.829.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个具有行业层面国家外部规模经济的世界。与采用完全竞争和两种行业的标准处理方法不同，我们假设在连续的行业中存在伯特兰竞争。在伯特兰竞争下，每家企业可以通过设定低于其他企业设定的价格来内部化生产带来的外部性。这种非均衡威胁消除了标准处理方法中的许多“病理现象”。通常存在一个由“自然”比较优势引导的独特均衡。此外，当一个国家具有CES偏好，并且商品之间的替代弹性有限时，贸易带来的收益是得到保障的。

abstract.text: We use field and natural experiments in online auctions to study the revenue effect of varying the level and disclosure of shipping charges. Our main findings are (1) disclosure affects revenues—for low shipping charges, a seller is better off disclosing; and (2) increasing shipping charges boosts revenues when these charges are hidden. These results are not explained by changes in the number of bidders.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.2.859.abstractZh: 我们通过在线拍卖中的实地和自然实验来研究不同运输费用水平和披露程度对收入的影响。我们的主要发现包括：(1) 披露运输费用会影响收入——对于较低的运输费用，卖方通过披露运输费用会获得更好的收益；(2) 当运输费用被隐藏时，增加运输费用会提升收入。这些结果并不能通过投标者数量的变化来解释。

abstract.text: We document that, in a cross section of countries, government regulation is strongly negatively correlated with measures of trust. In a simple model explaining this correlation, distrust creates public demand for regulation, whereas regulation in turn discourages formation of trust, leading to multiple equilibria. A key implication of the model is that individuals in low-trust countries want more government intervention even though they know the government is corrupt. We test this and other implications of the model using country- and individual-level data on trust and beliefs about the role of government, as well as on changes in beliefs during the transition from socialism.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.3.1015.abstractZh: 我们发现在不同国家中，政府监管与信任程度之间存在强烈的负相关关系。在一个简单的模型中，不信任会引发公众对监管的需求，而监管则反过来抑制信任的形成，从而导致多重均衡状态。该模型的一个关键结论是，在信任度较低的国家中，尽管人们知道政府存在腐败问题，但他们仍然希望政府有更多的干预。我们利用关于国家和个人层面上的信任与对政府角色的认知数据，以及从社会主义向市场经济转型过程中信念变化的数据，来检验这一结论以及其他模型中的推论。

abstract.text: Market size matters for innovation and hence for productivity. Improved access to foreign markets will thus encourage firms to simultaneously export and invest in raising productivity. We examine this insight using the responses of Canadian plants to the elimination of U.S. tariffs. Unique “plant-specific” tariff cuts serve as an instrument for changes in exporting. We find that Canadian plants that were induced by the tariff cuts to start exporting or to export more (a) increased their labor productivity, (b) engaged in more product innovation, and (c) had higher adoption rates for advanced manufacturing technologies. Further, these responses were heterogeneous.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.3.1051.abstractZh: 市场规模对创新以及生产力提升至关重要。改善对外市场的准入将促使企业同时开展出口业务和投资，从而提高生产力。我们通过加拿大工厂对美国关税取消后的反应来检验这一观点。独特的“工厂特定”关税减免成为衡量出口变化的一个指标。我们发现，因关税减免而开始出口或增加出口量的加拿大工厂：(a) 提高了劳动生产率；(b) 进行了更多的产品创新；(c) 对先进制造技术的采用率更高。此外，这些反应存在差异。

abstract.text: Why aren't there more women in science? This paper begins to shed light on this question by exploiting data from the U.S. Air Force Academy, where students are randomly assigned to professors for a wide variety of mandatory standardized courses.We focus on the role of professor gender. Our results suggest that although professor gender has little impact on male students, it has a powerful effect on female students' performance in math and science classes, and high-performing female students' likelihood of taking future math and science courses, and graduating with a STEM degree. The estimates are largest for students whose SAT math scores are in the top 5% of the national distribution. The gender gap in course grades and STEM majors is eradicated when high-performing female students are assigned to female professors in mandatory introductory math and science coursework.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.3.1101.abstractZh: 为什么科学领域的女性比例不高？本文通过利用美国空军学院的数据来探讨这一问题。该学院的学生被随机分配到不同的教授手中，学习各种必修的标准化课程。我们重点关注教授性别对女性学生的影响。研究结果表明，尽管教授性别对男性学生的表现影响较小，但对女性学生在数学和科学课程中的表现有着显著的影响，同时，表现优异的女性学生未来选择学习数学和科学课程以及获得STEM学位的可能性也更高。当表现优异的女性学生被分配到女性教授手中学习必修的数学和科学基础课程时，性别在课程成绩和STEM专业选择上的差距就会消失。

abstract.text: We show that “commodity currency” exchange rates have surprisingly robust power in predicting global commodity prices, both in-sample and out-of-sample, and against a variety of alternative benchmarks. This result is of particular interest to policy makers, given the lack of deep forward markets in many individual commodities, and broad aggregate commodity indices in particular. We also explore the reverse relationship (commodity prices forecasting exchange rates) but find it to be notably less robust. We offer a theoretical resolution, based on the fact that exchange rates are strongly forward-looking, whereas commodity price fluctuations are typically more sensitive to short-term demand imbalances.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.3.1145.abstractZh: 我们指出，“商品货币”汇率在预测全球商品价格方面具有出人意料的强大能力，无论是在样本内还是样本外，也适用于多种替代基准。这一结果对于政策制定者来说尤其重要，因为许多单一商品缺乏深度远期市场，而综合商品指数更是如此。我们还探讨了反向关系（即汇率预测商品价格），但发现这种关系明显不够稳健。我们提出了一种理论解释，即汇率具有强烈的远期预测能力，而商品价格波动则通常对短期需求失衡更为敏感。

abstract.text: We analyze the effect of counterparty risk on financial insurance contracts, using the case of credit risk transfer in banking. This paper posits a new moral hazard problem on the insurer side of the market, which causes the insured party to be exposed to excessive counterparty risk. We find that this counterparty risk can create an incentive for the insured party to reveal superior information about the likelihood of a claim. In particular, a unique separating equilibrium may exist, even in the absence of any costly signaling device.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.3.1195.abstractZh: 我们分析了交易对手风险对金融保险合同的影响，以银行中的信用风险转移为例。本文提出了市场上保险公司一方的新道德风险问题，即被保险人面临过高的交易对手风险。我们发现，这种交易对手风险可能会促使被保险人透露有关索赔可能性的更多信息。特别是，即使在没有昂贵的信号传递机制的情况下，也可能存在独特的分离均衡。

abstract.text: I process satellite-generated data on terrain elevation and presence of water bodies to precisely estimate the amount of developable land in U.S. metropolitan areas. The data show that residential development is effectively curtailed by the presence of steep-sloped terrain. I also find that most areas in which housing supply is regarded as inelastic are severely land-constrained by their geography. Econometrically, supply elasticities can be well characterized as functions of both physical and regulatory constraints, which in turn are endogenous to prices and demographic growth. Geography is a key factor in the contemporaneous urban development of the United States.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.3.1253.abstractZh: 我处理由卫星生成的关于地形高程和水体存在的数据，以精确估算美国大都市地区的可开发土地面积。数据显示，陡峭的地形实际上限制了住宅开发。我还发现，那些被认为住房供应缺乏弹性的地区，其土地资源受到地理条件的严重限制。从经济计量学的角度来看，供应弹性可以很好地用物理和监管限制的函数来描述，而这些限制又受到价格和人口增长的动态影响。地理因素是美国当代城市发展的关键因素。

abstract.text: An increasingly popular practice for student assignment to public schools in the United States is the use of school choice systems. The celebrated Gale. Shapley student-optimal stable mechanism (SOSM) has recently replaced two deficient student assignment mechanisms that were in use in New York City and Boston. We provide theoretical evidence that the SOSM outcome may produce large welfare losses. Then we propose an efficiency-adjusted deferred acceptance mechanism (EADAM) that allows a student to consent to waive a certain priority that has no effect on his or her assignment. Under EADAM, consenting students cause themselves no harm, but may help many others benefit as a consequence. We show that EADAM can recover any welfare losses due to SOSM while also preserving immunity against strategic behavior in a particular way. It is also possible to use EADAM to eliminate welfare losses due to randomly breaking ties in student priorities.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.3.1297.abstractZh: 在美国，将学生分配到公立学校的一种越来越受欢迎的做法是采用学校选择制度。著名的Gale-Shapley学生最优稳定机制（SOSM）最近取代了纽约市和波士顿正在使用的两种有缺陷的学生分配机制。我们提供了理论依据，表明SOSM的结果可能会导致巨大的福利损失。随后，我们提出了一种效率调整后的延迟接受机制（EADAM），该机制允许学生同意放弃某种对其分配无影响的优先权。在EADAM下，同意的学生不会给自己带来任何损失，但可能会帮助许多人受益。我们证明，EADAM可以弥补由于SOSM造成的任何福利损失，同时以特定方式保持对策略行为的免疫性。此外，EADAM还可以用来消除由于随机打破学生优先顺序而导致的福利损失。

abstract.text: We explain trends in dowry levels in Bangladesh by drawing attention to an institutional feature of marriage contracts previously ignored in the literature: mehr or traditional Islamic bride-price. We develop a model of marriage contracts in which mehr serves as a barrier to husbands exiting marriage and a component of dowry as an amount that ex ante compensates the groom for the cost of mehr. We investigate how mehr and dowry respond to exogenous changes in the costs of polygamy and divorce, and show that our model gives a different set of predictions than traditional models. We show that major changes in dowry levels took place precisely after the legal changes, corresponding to simultaneous changes in levels of mehr.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.3.1349.abstractZh: 我们通过关注婚姻合同中一个先前被忽视的制度特征——即“mehr”或传统的伊斯兰新娘嫁妆，来解释孟加拉国嫁妆水平的趋势。我们构建了一个婚姻合同模型，其中“mehr”作为丈夫退出婚姻的障碍，而嫁妆则作为对新娘因支付“mehr”而产生的成本进行预先补偿的组成部分。我们研究了“mehr”和嫁妆如何对一夫多妻制和离婚成本的外生变化作出反应，并发现我们的模型给出了与传统模型不同的预测结果。我们发现，嫁妆水平的重大变化恰恰发生在法律变更之后，这与“mehr”水平的同时变化相对应。

abstract.text: We provide a graphical illustration of how standard consumer and producer theory can be used to quantify the welfare loss associated with inefficient pricing in insurance markets with selection. We then show how this welfare loss can be estimated empirically using identifying variation in the price of insurance. Such variation, together with quantity data, allows us to estimate the demand for insurance. The same variation, together with cost data, allows us to estimate how insurer's costs vary as market participants endogenously respond to price. The slope of this estimated cost curve provides a direct test for both the existence and nature of selection, and the combination of demand and cost curves can be used to estimate welfare. We illustrate our approach by applying it to data on employer-provided health insurance from one specific company. We detect adverse selection but estimate that the quantitative welfare implications associated with inefficient pricing in our particular application are small, in both absolute and relative terms.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.3.877.abstractZh: 我们提供了一个图形示例，说明如何利用标准消费者理论和生产者理论来量化保险市场中因选择效应导致的定价低效所带来的福利损失。接着，我们展示了如何通过识别保险价格的变化来实证估计这种福利损失。这种变化与数量数据相结合，使我们能够估算保险需求。同样的变化与成本数据相结合，则使我们能够估算出随着市场参与者对价格的反应，保险公司的成本如何变化。所估算的成本曲线的斜率直接检验了选择效应的存在及其性质，而需求曲线和成本曲线的结合则可用于估算福利。我们通过将这种方法应用于某家特定公司的雇主提供健康保险数据来说明我们的方法。我们发现存在逆向选择现象，但估计表明，在我们特定的应用中，由于定价低效所带来的福利损失在绝对和相对意义上都是较小的。

abstract.text: The neurotransmitter dopamine is central to the emerging discipline of neuroeconomics; it is hypothesized to encode the difference between expected and realized rewards and thereby to mediate belief formation and choice. We develop the first formal test of this theory of dopaminergic function, based on a recent axiomatization by Caplin and Dean [2008A]. These tests are satisfied by neural activity in the nucleus accumbens, an area rich in dopamine receptors. We find evidence for separate positive and negative reward prediction error signals, suggesting that behavioral asymmetries in response to losses and gains may parallel asymmetries in nucleus accumbens activity.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.3.923.abstractZh: 神经递质多巴胺是新兴的神经经济学领域的核心研究对象；有假设认为，多巴胺能够编码预期奖励与实际奖励之间的差异，从而介导信念的形成和决策过程。我们基于Caplin和Dean在2008年提出的公理体系，首次对多巴胺功能理论进行了形式化检验。这些检验的结果表明，神经活动在伏隔核区域得到了验证，而伏隔核区域富含多巴胺受体。我们发现，存在独立的积极和消极的奖励预测误差信号，这表明对损失和收益的反应行为的不对称性可能与伏隔核活动的不对称性相平行。

abstract.text: Empirical evidence suggests that as much as one-third of the U.S. business cycle is due to nominal shocks. We calibrate a multisector menu cost model using new evidence on the cross-sectional distribution of the frequency and size of price changes in the U.S. economy. We augment the model to incorporate intermediate inputs. We show that the introduction of heterogeneity in the frequency of price change triples the degree of monetary non-neutrality generated by the model. We furthermore show that the introduction of intermediate inputs raises the degree of monetary non-neutrality by another factor of three, without adversely affecting the model's ability to match the large average size of price changes. A single-sector model with a frequency of price change equal to the median, rather than the mean, generates monetary non-neutrality similar to that in our multisector model. Our multisector model with intermediate inputs generates variation in real output in response to calibrated aggregate nominal shocks that can account for roughly 23% of the U.S. business cycle.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.3.961.abstractZh: 实证证据表明，美国商业周期中多达三分之一的波动是由名义冲击引起的。我们基于关于美国经济中价格变动频率和规模分布的新数据，对多部门菜单成本模型进行了校准。我们进一步扩展了模型以包含中间投入要素。研究表明，引入价格变动频率的异质性后，模型产生的货币非中性程度增加了三倍。此外，引入中间投入要素后，货币非中性程度又增加了三倍，而并未影响模型对大规模价格变动的匹配能力。一个以价格变动频率等于中位数而非平均值的单部门模型，也能产生与多部门模型相似的货币非中性效应。我们的多部门模型在包含中间投入要素的情况下，能够产生对校准后的总体名义冲击的响应，这种响应可以解释美国商业周期中约23%的波动。

abstract.text: We present a model of intuitive inference, called “local thinking,” in which an agent combines data received from the external world with information retrieved from memory to evaluate a hypothesis. In this model, selected and limited recall of information follows a version of the representativeness heuristic. The model can account for some of the evidence on judgment biases, including conjunction and disjunction fallacies, but also for several anomalies related to demand for insurance.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.4.1399.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个名为“局部思维”的直观推理模型，其中代理将来自外部世界的数据与从记忆中检索到的信息结合起来，以评估一个假设。在该模型中，信息的选择和有限性遵循代表性启发式的规则。该模型能够解释一些关于判断偏差的证据，包括合取和析取谬误，同时也能解释与保险需求相关的几种异常情况。

abstract.text: We show that it is very difficult to devise performance-based compensation contracts that reward portfolio managers who generate excess returns while screening out managers who cannot generate such returns. Theoretical bounds are derived on the amount of fee manipulation that is possible under various performance contracts.We show that recent proposals to reform compensation practices, such as postponing bonuses and instituting clawback provisions, will not eliminate opportunities to game the system unless accompanied by transparency in managers' positions and strategies. Indeed, there exists no compensation mechanism that separates skilled from unskilled managers solely on the basis of their returns histories.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.4.1435.abstractZh: 我们表明，设计基于绩效的补偿合同以奖励能够产生超额回报的投资经理，同时剔除无法产生此类回报的经理，是非常困难的。我们推导出了在各种绩效合同下可能的费用操纵程度的理论界限。我们指出，最近提出的改革薪酬制度的建议，如推迟奖金发放和实施回收条款，除非伴随对经理人的持仓和策略的透明度，否则无法消除操纵系统的机会。事实上，不存在一种仅基于经理人的历史回报来区分熟练与不熟练的薪酬机制。

abstract.text: This paper examines whether terrorism is an effective tool for achieving political goals. By exploiting geographic variation in terror attacks in Israel from 1988 to 2006, we show that local terror attacks cause Israelis to be more willing to grant territorial concessions to the Palestinians. These effects are stronger for demographic groups that are traditionally right-wing in their political views. However, terror attacks beyond a certain threshold cause Israelis to adopt a less accommodating position. In addition, terror induces Israelis to vote increasingly for right-wing parties, as the right-wing parties move to the left in response to terror. Hence, terrorism appears to be an effective strategy in terms of shifting the entire political landscape to the left, although we do not assess whether it is more effective than non-violent means.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.4.1459.abstractZh: 本文探讨了恐怖主义是否是一种实现政治目标的有效手段。通过分析1988至2006年间以色列境内恐怖袭击的地理分布，我们发现局部恐怖袭击使得以色列人更愿意向巴勒斯坦人作出领土让步。这种效应在那些传统上持右翼政治观点的群体中更为明显。然而，当恐怖袭击达到一定规模时，以色列人就会采取更为保守的立场。此外，恐怖主义还促使以色列人越来越多地投票给右翼政党，因为右翼政党在应对恐怖主义时往往会向左转。因此，从改变整个政治格局的角度来看，恐怖主义似乎是一种有效的策略，尽管我们并未评估其是否比非暴力手段更为有效。

abstract.text: We study the dynamic selection of governments. A government consists of a subset of the individuals in the society. The competence level of the government in o ce determines collective utilities (e.g., by determining the amount and quality of public goods), and each individual derives additional utility from being part of the government (e.g., corruption or rents from holding o ce). We characterize the dynamic evolution of governments and determine structure of stable governments, which arise and persist in equilibrium. Our main focus is on the impact of di erent political institutions on the selection of governments. Perfect democracy, where current members of the government do not have an incumbency advantage or special powers, always leads to the emergence of the most competent government. However, any deviation from perfect democracy destroys this result. There is always at least one other, less competent government that is also stable and can persist forever. In addition, even the least competent government can persist forever in o ce. When there are stochastic shocks to the competence levels of di erent governments or to the rules determining the election of new governments, political institutions with a greater degree of democracy (less power for incumbents) are shown to perform better, because they can adapt to changes more successfully. This suggests that a particular advantage of democratic regimes is their relative exibility. We also show that, in the presence of stochastic shocks, \\royalty-like" dictatorships may be more successful than \\junta-like " dictatorships, because they might also be more adaptable to change.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.4.1511.abstractZh: 我们研究了政府的动态选择。政府由社会中的一部分个体组成。政府的能力水平决定了集体效用（例如，通过决定公共产品的数量和质量），而每个个体从成为政府的一部分中获得额外的效用（例如，腐败或从持有权力中获得的租金）。我们描述了政府的动态演变，并确定了稳定政府的构成，这些政府能够在均衡状态下出现并持续存在。我们的主要关注点是不同政治制度对政府选择的影响。在完美的民主制度下，现任政府成员没有任期优势或特殊权力，这总是会导致最有能力政府的出现。然而，任何偏离完美民主制度的做法都会破坏这一结果。总是至少存在一个能力较低但同样稳定的政府，它可以永远持续存在。此外，即使是最无能的政府也可以在权力下永远存在。当不同政府的能力水平或决定新政府选举的规则受到随机冲击时，具有更高程度民主制度的政治制度（现任政府权力较小）表现得更好，因为它们能够更成功地适应变化。这表明，民主制度的一个特殊优势是其相对灵活性。我们还表明，在随机冲击存在的情况下，类似“租金”的独裁制度可能比类似“政府”的独裁制度更成功，因为它们可能更能适应变化。

abstract.text: A new data set on national poverty lines is combined with new price data and almost 700 household surveys to estimate absolute poverty measures for the developing world. We find that 25% of the population lived in poverty in 2005, as judged by what “poverty” typically means in the world's poorest countries. This is higher than past estimates. Substantial overall progress is still indicated—the corresponding poverty rate was 52% in 1981—but progress was very uneven across regions. The trends over time and regional profile are robust to various changes in methodology, though precise counts are more sensitive.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.4.1577.abstractZh: 一项关于国家贫困线的新数据集与新的价格数据以及近700份家庭调查相结合，用于估算发展中国家绝对贫困状况。根据世界上最贫困国家中“贫困”的通常定义，我们发现2005年有25%的人口生活在贫困中。这一比例高于以往的估计值。尽管整体而言仍显示出显著进展——1981年的相应贫困率为52%——但各地区的进展非常不均衡。随着时间的推移和地区差异的变化，这些趋势仍然具有稳定性，不过精确的数据统计更为敏感。

abstract.text: We construct a matrix showing the share of the year 2000 population in every country that is descended from people in different source countries in the year 1500. Using the matrix to adjust indicators of early development so they reflect the history of a population's ancestors rather than the history of the place they live today greatly improves the ability of those indicators to predict current GDP. The variance of early development history of a country's inhabitants is a good predictor for current inequality, with ethnic groups originating in regions having longer histories of organized states tending to be at the upper end of a country's income distribution.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.4.1627.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个矩阵，显示2000年人口中来自1500年时不同来源国家的人的比例。利用该矩阵调整早期发展指标，使其反映一个群体祖先的历史而非他们当前居住地的历史，这极大地提升了这些指标预测当前GDP的能力。一个国家居民早期发展历史的差异是预测当前不平等状况的良好指标，那些起源于具有更悠久组织化国家历史的地区的族群，往往处于该国收入分配的较高端。

abstract.text: We attempt to measure the effect of competition on bias in the context of analyst earnings forecasts, which are known to be excessively optimistic because of conflicts of interest. Our natural experiment for competition is mergers of brokerage houses, which result in the firing of analysts because of redundancy (e.g., one of the two oil stock analysts is let go) and other reasons such as culture clash. We use this decrease in analyst coverage for stocks covered by both merging houses before the merger (the treatment sample) to measure the causal effect of competition on bias. We find that the treatment sample simultaneously experiences a decrease in analyst coverage and an increase in optimism bias the year after the merger relative to a control group of stocks, consistent with competition reducing bias. The implied economic effect from our natural experiment is significantly larger than estimates from OLS regressions that do not correct for the endogeneity of coverage. This effect is much more significant for stocks with little initial analyst coverage or competition.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.4.1683.abstractZh: 我们试图衡量竞争对分析师盈利预测偏差的影响。众所周知，分析师的盈利预测往往过于乐观，这是由于利益冲突导致的。我们的自然实验选择的是经纪公司之间的合并事件，这种合并会导致分析师被解雇，原因包括冗余问题（例如，两家石油股票分析师中的一名被解雇）以及文化冲突等其他原因。我们利用合并前两家经纪公司共同覆盖的股票数量减少这一现象，来衡量竞争对偏差的因果效应。研究发现，与对照组股票相比，合并后的那一年，处理组股票的数量减少，而乐观偏差却有所增加，这与竞争减少偏差的观点一致。我们的自然实验所揭示的经济效应，比那些未考虑覆盖范围内生性问题的OLS回归估计值要大得多。对于初始分析师覆盖较少或竞争较弱的股票来说，这种效应更为显著。

abstract.text: New goods play a central role in many trade and growth models. We use detailed trade and firm-level data from India to investigate the relationship between declines in trade costs, imports of intermediate inputs, and domestic firm product scope. We estimate substantial gains from trade through access to new imported inputs. Moreover, we find that lower input tariffs account on average for 31% of the new products introduced by domestic firms. This effect is driven to a large extent by increased firm access to new input varieties that were unavailable prior to the trade liberalization.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.4.1727.abstractZh: 新商品在许多贸易和增长模型中扮演着核心角色。我们利用来自印度的详细贸易和企业级数据，研究贸易成本下降、中间投入品的进口以及国内企业产品范围之间的关系。我们估计，通过获取新的进口投入品，企业可以获得显著的贸易收益。此外，我们发现较低的投入关税平均占国内企业引入的新产品的31%。这一效应在很大程度上是由企业能够获取在贸易自由化之前无法获得的新型投入品所驱动的。

abstract.text: The use of stock-based compensation as a solution to agency problems between shareholders and managers has increased dramatically since the early 1990s. We show that in a dynamic rational expectations model with asymmetric information, stock-based compensation not only induces managers to exert costly effort, but also induces them to conceal bad news about future growth options and to choose suboptimal investment policies to support the pretense. This leads to a severe overvaluation and a subsequent crash in the stock price. Our model produces many predictions that are consistent with the empirical evidence and are relevant to understanding the current crisis.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.4.1769.abstractZh: 自20世纪90年代初以来，使用股票型薪酬作为解决股东与管理者之间代理问题的手段已经显著增加。我们的研究表明，在一个具有不对称信息的动态理性预期模型中，股票型薪酬不仅促使管理者付出高昂的努力，还促使他们隐瞒关于未来增长前景的负面信息，并选择次优的投资策略来支持这些虚假信息。这导致了股票的严重高估，随后股价出现暴跌。我们的模型提出了许多与实证证据一致的预测，这些预测对于理解当前的经济危机具有重要意义。

abstract.text: We examine the determinants of cooperation and the effectiveness of deterrence when fear is a motive for conflict.We contrast results obtained in a complete information setting with those obtained in a setting with strategic risk, where players have different information about their environment. These two strategic settings allow us to identify and distinguish the role of predatory and preemptive incentives as determinants of cooperation and conflict. In our model, weapons unambiguously facilitate peace under complete information. In contrast, under strategic risk, we show that increases in weapon stocks can have a nonmonotonic effect on the sustainability of cooperation. We also show that under strategic risk, asymmetry in military strength can facilitate peace, and that anticipated peacekeeping interventions may improve incentives for peaceful behavior.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.4.1821.abstractZh: 我们研究了在恐惧成为冲突动机时，合作的决定因素以及威慑效果的影响因素。我们将在完全信息环境下的研究结果与在具有战略风险的环境下的研究结果进行了对比，后者中参与者对环境的了解程度不同。这两种战略环境使我们能够识别并区分掠夺性激励与预防性激励在促进合作与引发冲突中的作用。在我们的模型中，在完全信息环境下，武器明确有助于促进和平。相比之下，在战略风险环境下，我们指出武器库存的增加对合作的可持续性会产生非单调效应。我们还发现，在战略风险环境下，军事力量不对称可能有助于促进和平，而预期的维和干预措施也可能改善和平行为的激励因素。

abstract.text: The NBA provides an intriguing place to assess discrimination: referees and players are involved in repeated interactions in a high-pressure setting, with referees making split-second decisions that might allow implicit racial biases to become evident. We find that more personal fouls are awarded against players when they are officiated by an opposite-race officiating crew than when they are officiated by an own-race refereeing crew. These biases are sufficiently large so that they affect the outcome of an appreciable number of games. Our results do not distinguish whether the bias stems from the actions of white or black referees.

10.1162/qjec.2010.125.4.1859.abstractZh: NBA为评估歧视现象提供了一个有趣的研究对象：裁判和球员在高压环境下频繁互动，裁判需要做出瞬间决策，这可能会让隐性种族偏见显现出来。我们发现，当球员由不同种族的裁判执法时，他们受到更多个人犯规的处罚。这些偏见的影响足以改变大量比赛的结果。我们的研究结果并未区分这种偏见是由白人还是黑人裁判所引发的。

abstract.text: Using data on user attributes and interactions from an online dating site, we estimate mate preferences, and use the Gale-Shapley algorithm to predict stable matches. The predicted matches are similar to the actual matches achieved by the dating site, and the actual matches are approximately efficient. Out-of-sample predictions of offline matches, i.e., marriages, exhibit assortative mating patterns similar to those observed in actual marriages. Thus, mate preferences, without resort to search frictions, can generate sorting in marriages. However, we underpredict some of the correlation patterns; search frictions may play a role in explaining the discrepancy. (JEL C78, J12)

10.1257/aer.100.1.130.abstractZh: 我们利用一个在线约会网站上的用户属性和互动数据，来估计伴侣偏好，并使用Gale-Shapley算法来预测稳定的匹配结果。预测出的匹配结果与该网站实际达成的匹配相似，且这些匹配大致是有效的。对线下匹配结果的样本外预测，即婚姻，显示出与实际婚姻中观察到的类似的同质匹配模式。因此，无需借助搜索摩擦，伴侣偏好就能在婚姻中产生排序效应。然而，我们对某些相关模式的预测有所低估；搜索摩擦可能在解释这种差异中起到作用。（JEL C78, J12）

abstract.text: Using European data, this paper finds that (i) industry entry and exit rates are positively related to industry rates of investment-specific technical change (ISTC); and (ii) the sensitivity of industry entry and exit rates to cross-country differences in entry costs depends on industry rates of ISTC. The paper constructs a general equilibrium model in which the rate of ISTC varies across industries and new investment-specific technologies can be introduced by entrants or by incumbents. In the calibrated model, equilibrium behavior is consistent with stylized facts (i) and (ii), provided the cost of technology adoption is increasing in the rate of ISTC. (JEL G31, L11, O31, O33)

10.1257/aer.100.1.164.abstractZh: 本文利用欧洲数据发现：(i)行业进入和退出率与行业投资技术变革率呈正相关；(ii)行业进入和退出率对跨国进入成本的敏感性取决于行业投资技术变革率。本文构建了一个一般均衡模型，在该模型中，投资技术变革率在不同行业之间存在差异，新的投资技术可以由新进入者或现有企业引入。在校准后的模型中，均衡行为与以下两个典型事实一致：(i)和(ii)，前提是技术采纳的成本随投资技术变革率的增加而上升。(JEL G31, L11, O31, O33)

abstract.text: In the Medicare program, increases in cost sharing by a supplemental insurer can exert financial externalities. We study a policy change that raised patient cost sharing for the supplemental insurer for retired public employees in California. We find that physician visits and prescription drug usage have elasticities that are similar to those of the RAND Health Insurance Experiment (HIE). Unlike the HIE, however, we find substantial "offset" effects in terms of increased hospital utilization. The savings from increased cost sharing accrue mostly to the supplemental insurer, while the costs of increased hospitalization accrue mostly to Medicare.

10.1257/aer.100.1.193.abstractZh: 在Medicare计划中，补充保险公司的费用分担增加可能会产生财务外部性。我们研究了一项政策变化，该变化提高了加州退休公共员工在补充保险公司的费用分担比例。我们发现，医生就诊次数和处方药使用量具有与RAND健康保险实验相似的弹性。然而，与RAND实验不同的是，我们发现医院使用率有所增加，从而产生了显著的“抵消”效应。增加费用分担所带来的节省主要归补充保险公司所有，而增加的住院费用则主要由Medicare承担。

abstract.text: We analyze how contractibility affects contract design. A major concern when designing research agreements is that researchers use their funding to subsidize other projects. We show that, when research activities are not contractible, an option contract is optimal. The financing firm obtains the option to terminate the agreement and, in case of termination, broad property rights. The threat of termination deters researchers from cross-subsidization, and the cost of exercising the termination option deters the financing firm from opportunistic termination. We test this prediction using 580 biotechnology research agreements. Contracts with termination options are more common when research is non-contractible. (JEL D86, L65, O31, O34)

10.1257/aer.100.1.214.abstractZh: 我们分析了契约性对合同设计的影响。在设计研究协议时，一个主要的问题是研究人员可能会利用资金来补贴其他项目。我们发现，当研究活动不具备契约性时，选择合同是最优的。融资方获得了终止协议的权利，而在终止的情况下，融资方拥有广泛的财产权利。终止的威胁可以阻止研究人员进行交叉补贴，而行使终止权利的成本则使得融资方不会采取机会主义的终止行为。我们通过580份生物技术研究协议来验证这一预测。在研究不具备契约性时，带有终止选项的合同更为常见。（JEL D86, L65, O31, O34）

abstract.text: During the 1990s, anti-sweatshop activists campaigned to improve conditions for workers in developing countries. This paper analyzes the impact of anti-sweatshop campaigns in Indonesia on wages and employment. Identification is based on comparing the wage growth of workers in foreign-owned and exporting firms in targeted regions or sectors before and after the initiation of anti-sweatshop campaigns. We find the campaigns led to large real wage increases for targeted enterprises. There were some costs in terms of reduced investment, falling profits, and increased probability of closure for smaller plants, but we fail to find significant effects on employment. (JEL F23, J31, J81, L67, O14, O15)

10.1257/aer.100.1.247.abstractZh: 在20世纪90年代，反童工活动家们致力于改善发展中国家工人的工作条件。本文分析了印度尼西亚反童工运动对工资和就业的影响。研究通过对比目标地区或行业中外资企业和出口企业工人工资在反童工运动启动前后的变化情况来进行分析。研究发现，这些运动确实导致了目标企业的实际工资大幅上升。不过，这种运动也带来了一些负面影响，如投资减少、利润下降以及小型工厂倒闭概率增加，但我们并未发现其对就业产生显著影响。（JEL F23, J31, J81, L67, O14, O15）

abstract.text: The paper considers optimal monetary stabilization policy in a forward-looking model, when the central bank recognizes that private sector expectations need not be precisely model-consistent, and wishes to choose a policy that will be as good as possible in the case of any beliefs that are close enough to model-consistency. It is found that commitment continues to be important for optimal policy, that the optimal long-run inflation target is unaffected by the degree of potential distortion of beliefs, and that optimal policy is even more history-dependent than if rational expectations are assumed. (JEL C62, D84, E13, E31, E32, E52)
