10.1257/aer.100.1.274.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在前瞻性模型中最优的货币稳定政策问题，其中中央银行认识到私人部门的预期不必完全符合模型，并希望选择一种在任何接近模型一致性的信念情况下都能取得最佳效果的政策。研究发现，承诺对最优政策仍然非常重要，最优的长期通胀目标不受信念潜在扭曲程度的影响，而且最优政策甚至比假设理性预期时更加依赖于历史背景。（JEL C62, D84, E13, E31, E32, E52）

abstract.text: We show, using novel data on currency and prices for US imports, that even conditional on a price change, there is a large difference in the exchange rate pass-through of the average good priced in dollars (25 percent) versus nondollars (95 percent). We document this to be the case across countries and within disaggregated sectors. This finding contradicts the assumption in an important class of models that the currency of pricing is exogenous. We present a model of endogenous currency choice in a dynamic price setting environment and show that the predictions of the model are strongly supported by the data. (JEL E31, F14, F31)

10.1257/aer.100.1.304.abstractZh: 我们通过使用关于美国进口商品货币和价格的新数据表明，即使是在价格变动的条件下，以美元计价的平均商品的汇率传导效果也存在显著差异：以美元计价的商品其汇率传导效果为25%，而以非美元计价的商品则高达95%。我们在不同国家和不同行业中都发现了这一现象。这一发现与一类重要模型中的假设相矛盾，即定价所使用的货币是外生的。我们提出了一个动态价格设定环境下货币选择的内生模型，并证明该模型的预测结果得到了数据的有力支持。（JEL E31, F14, F31）

abstract.text: This article studies the effects of demographics on the mix of tax rates on labor and capital. It uses a quantitative general-equilibrium, overlapping-generations model where tax rates are voted without past commitments in every period and characterized as a Markov equilibrium. In the United States, the younger voting-age population in 1990 compared to 1965 accounts for the observed decline in the relative capital tax rate between those two years. A younger population raises the net return to capital, leads voters to increase their savings, and results in a preference for lower taxes on capital. Conversely, aging might increase capital taxation. (JEL E13, H24, H25, J11)

10.1257/aer.100.1.337.abstractZh: 本文研究了人口结构对劳动力和资本税收组合的影响。模型采用定量的一般均衡、重叠世代模型，其中税收的投票过程不受过去承诺的影响，并被视为马尔可夫均衡。在美国，1990年与1965年相比，年轻投票年龄人口的比例下降，这解释了这两年间资本相对税收率的下降。年轻人口提高了资本的净回报，促使选民增加储蓄，并导致人们更倾向于降低资本的税收。相反，人口老龄化可能会增加资本税收。（JEL E13, H24, H25, J11）

abstract.text: This paper investigates the role of social learning in the diffusion of a new agricultural technology in Ghana. We use unique data on farmers' communication patterns to define each individual's information neighborhood. Conditional on many potentially confounding variables, we find evidence that farmers adjust their inputs to align with those of their information neighbors who were surprisingly successful in previous periods. The relationship of these input adjustments to experience further indicates the presence of social learning. In addition, applying the same method to input choices for another crop, of known technology, correctly indicates an absence of social learning effects. (JEL D83, O13, O33, Q16)

10.1257/aer.100.1.35.abstractZh: 本文探讨了社会学习在加纳一项新农业技术传播中的作用。我们利用关于农民交流模式的独特数据来定义每个个体的信息邻域。在考虑了许多潜在的混杂变量后，我们发现农民会调整自己的投入，以使其与那些在以往时期表现出色的信息邻居的投入保持一致。这些投入调整与经验之间的关系进一步表明存在社会学习现象。此外，将同样的方法应用于另一种已知技术的作物的投入选择时，结果显示不存在社会学习效应。（JEL D83, O13, O33, Q16）

abstract.text: A large empirical literature finds that there is too little international trade and too much intranational trade to be rationalized by observed international trade costs, such as tariffs and transport costs. This paper investigates whether a model in which the nature of production can change in response to trade costs—a framework with multistage production—can better explain the home bias in trade. The calibrated model can explain about two-fifths of the Canada border effect, about two-and-one-half times that of a model with one production stage. The model also explains a significant fraction of Canada-US “back-and-forth,” or vertical specialization, trade. (JEL F11, F13, F14)

10.1257/aer.100.1.364.abstractZh: 大量实证研究表明，国际贸易过少而国内贸易过多，无法用观察到的国际贸易成本（如关税和运输成本）来解释。本文探讨了一种生产性质可以随贸易成本变化模型——一种具有多阶段生产的框架——是否能更好地解释贸易中的本土偏好现象。经过校准的模型能够解释大约五分之二的加拿大边境效应，这一比例是一阶段生产模型的两倍半。该模型还能解释加拿大与美国之间大量垂直专业化贸易现象。（JEL F11, F13, F14）

abstract.text: We propose a model of trade agreements in which contracting is costly, and as a consequence the optimal agreement may be incomplete. In spite of its simplicity, the model yields rich predictions on the structure of the optimal trade agreement and how this depends on the fundamentals of the contracting environment. We argue that taking contracting costs explicitly into account can help explain a number of key features of real trade agreements. (JEL D86, F13)

10.1257/aer.100.1.394.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个贸易协议模型，其中签约成本较高，因此最优协议可能并不完整。尽管该模型较为简单，但它对最优贸易协议的结构以及这种结构如何依赖于签约环境的基本因素提供了丰富的预测。我们认为，明确考虑签约成本有助于解释现实贸易协议中的许多关键特征。（JEL D86, F13）

abstract.text: We study how conflict in contest games is influenced by rival parties being groups and by group members being able to punish each other. Our motivation stems from the analysis of sociopolitical conflict. The theoretical prediction is that conflict expenditures are independent of group size and of whether punishment is available. We find, first, that conflict expenditures of groups are substantially larger than those of individuals, and both are above equilibrium. Second, allowing group members to punish each other leads to even larger conflict expenditures. These results contrast with those from public goods experiments where punishment enhances efficiency. (JEL C72, D74, H41)

10.1257/aer.100.1.420.abstractZh: 我们研究了竞争游戏中的冲突如何受到敌对团体以及团体成员之间能够互相惩罚的影响。我们的研究动机源于对社会政治冲突的分析。理论预测表明，冲突支出与团体规模以及是否存在惩罚机制无关。我们发现，首先，团体的冲突支出明显大于个体，且两者均高于均衡水平。其次，允许团体成员互相惩罚会导致更大的冲突支出。这些结果与公共物品实验的结果相反，在公共物品实验中，惩罚机制反而能提升效率。（JEL C72, D74, H41）

abstract.text: This paper studies how agents with conflicting interests learn to cooperate when the details of cooperation are not common knowledge. It considers a repeated game in which one player has incomplete information about when and how her partner can provide benefits. Initially, monitoring is imperfect and cooperation requires inefficient punishment. As the players' common history grows, the uninformed player can learn to monitor her partner's actions, which allows players to establish more efficient cooperative routines. Because revealing information is costly, it may be optimal not to reveal all the existing information, and efficient equilibria can be path-dependent. (JEL C73, D82, D83, D86)

10.1257/aer.100.1.448.abstractZh: 本文研究的是，当合作的细节并非常识时，具有冲突利益的参与者如何学会合作。研究中的一个重复博弈中，一个玩家对合作伙伴何时以及如何提供利益的信息并不完整。最初，监控机制并不完善，合作需要低效的惩罚手段。随着玩家共同历史的发展，信息不足的玩家能够学会监控合作伙伴的行为，这使得玩家能够建立更高效的合作机制。由于揭示信息成本较高，不揭示所有现有信息可能是最优选择，而有效的均衡可能是路径依赖的。（JEL C73, D82, D83, D86）

abstract.text: This paper develops a theory of the firm in which a firm's centralized asset ownership and low-powered incentives give the manager, as an equilibrium outcome, interpersonal authority over employees (in a world with open disagreement). The paper thus provides micro-foundations for the idea that bringing a project inside the firm gives the manager control over that project, while explaining concentrated asset ownership, low-powered incentives, and centralized authority as typical characteristics of firms. The paper also leads to new perspectives on the firm as a legal entity and on the relationship between the Knightian and Coasian views of the firm. (JEL D23, L20)

10.1257/aer.100.1.466.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种企业理论，其中企业的集中式资产所有权和低强度激励使得管理者在均衡状态下能够对个人员工拥有权威（在存在公开分歧的世界中）。因此，本文为“将项目纳入企业内部可使管理者对该项目拥有控制权”这一观点提供了微观基础，同时解释了集中式资产所有权、低强度激励和集中式权威是企业的典型特征。本文还为企业作为法律实体的性质以及Knight理论和Coase理论对企业看法之间的关系提供了新的视角。（JEL D23, L20）

abstract.text: I revisit the question of indeterminacy in US monetary policy using limited-information identification-robust methods. I find that the conclusions of Clarida, Galí, and Gernter (2000) that policy was inactive before 1979 are robust, but the evidence over the Volcker-Greenspan periods is inconclusive. I show that this is in fact consistent with policy being active over that period. Problems of identification also arise because policy reaction has been more gradual recently. At a methodological level, the paper demonstrates that identification issues should be taken seriously, and that identification-robust methods can be informative even when they produce wide confidence sets. (E31, E32, E52, E65,)

10.1257/aer.100.1.491.abstractZh: 我重新审视了美国货币政策中不确定性问题，采用了有限信息识别稳健性方法。我发现Clarida、Galí和Gernter（2000年）关于1979年前货币政策不活跃的结论是稳健的，但关于Volcker-Greenspan时期的证据并不明确。实际上，这一结论与该时期货币政策较为活跃的情况是一致的。由于政策反应近年来更为渐进，识别问题也出现了。从方法论层面来看，本文表明识别问题应当被认真对待，即使识别稳健性方法能够产生广泛的置信区间，它们仍然具有信息价值。（E31, E32, E52, E65）

abstract.text: I discuss the measurement of world poverty and inequality, with particular attention to the role of purchasing power parity (PPP) price indexes from the International Comparison Project. Global inequality increased with the latest revision of the ICP, and this reduced the global poverty line relative to the US dollar. The recent large increase of nearly half a billion poor people came from an inappropriate updating of the global poverty line, not from the ICP revisions. Even so, PPP comparisons between widely different countries rest on weak theoretical and empirical foundations. I argue for wider use of self-reports from international monitoring surveys, and for a global poverty line that is truly denominated in US dollars. (JEL C43, D31, I31, I32, F31)

10.1257/aer.100.1.5.abstractZh: 我讨论了世界贫困和不平等的衡量问题，特别关注国际比较项目中的购买力平价（PPP）指数所起的作用。随着国际比较项目的最新修订，全球不平等程度有所上升，这导致以美元计价的全球贫困线相对降低。近期贫困人口增加了近五亿，这一增长并非由于国际比较项目的修订，而是由于全球贫困线的不合理更新。即便如此，不同国家之间的PPP比较仍然建立在薄弱的理论和实证基础上。我主张更广泛地使用国际监测调查中的自我报告数据，并采用以美元计价的全球贫困线。（JEL C43, D31, I31, I32, F31）

abstract.text: Tournaments can elicit more effort but sabotage may attenuate the effect of competition. Because it is hard to separate effort and ability, the evidence on tournaments is thin. There is even less evidence on sabotage because these acts often consist of subjective peer evaluation or “office politics.” We discuss real effort experiments in which quality adjusted output and office politics are compared under piece rates and tournaments and find that tournaments increase effort only in the absence of office politics. Competitors subvert each other more in tournaments, and as a result, workers produce less because they expect to be sabotaged. (D82, M54)

10.1257/aer.100.1.504.abstractZh: 比赛可能会激发更多的努力，但破坏行为可能会削弱竞争的效果。由于很难将努力与能力区分开来，关于比赛的研究证据较为有限。关于破坏行为的证据则更少，因为这些行为往往涉及主观的同伴评价或“办公室政治”。我们研究了真实努力的实验，在这些实验中，我们比较了按件计酬和比赛环境下的质量调整后的产出以及办公室政治的影响，发现只有在没有办公室政治的情况下，比赛才会增加努力。在比赛中，竞争者之间更容易互相破坏，因此，工人因为预期会受到破坏行为的影响而减少努力。（D82, M54）

abstract.text: In order to gain a better empirical understanding of the international financial implications of currency movements, we construct a database of international currency exposures for a large panel of countries over 1990-2004. We show that trade-weighted exchange rate indices are insufficient to understand the financial impact of currency movements and that our currency measures have high explanatory power for the valuation term in net foreign asset dynamics. Exchange rate valuation shocks are sizable, not quickly reversed, and may entail substantial wealth redistributions. Further, we show that many developing countries have substantially reduced their negative foreign currency positions over the last decade. (F31, F32, G15)

10.1257/aer.100.1.518.abstractZh: 为了更深刻地了解货币变动对国际金融的影响，我们构建了一个包含1990至2004年间多个国家的国际货币敞口数据库。我们发现，以贸易加权汇率指数无法充分反映货币变动的金融影响，而我们的货币指标在解释净外国资产动态中的估值因素方面具有较高的解释力。汇率估值波动幅度较大，且不会迅速逆转，可能会导致大量的财富重新分配。此外，我们还发现，许多发展中国家在过去十年中大幅减少了其负面的外币头寸。（F31, F32, G15）

abstract.text: One lingering puzzle is why voluntary contributions to public goods decline over time in experimental and real-world settings. We show that the decline of cooperation is driven by individual preferences for imperfect conditional cooperation. Many people's desire to contribute less than others, rather than changing beliefs of what others will contribute over time or people's heterogeneity in preferences makes voluntary cooperation fragile. Universal free riding thus eventually emerges, despite the fact that most people are not selfish. (D12, D 83, H41, Z13)

10.1257/aer.100.1.541.abstractZh: 一个悬而未决的谜题是，在实验和现实环境中，自愿为公共物品做出贡献的行为为何会随时间减少。我们发现，合作行为的减少是由个体对不完全条件合作的偏好所驱动的。许多人希望贡献的额度低于其他人，而不是改变人们对他人贡献行为的预期，或者考虑人们的偏好差异，这些因素使得自愿合作变得脆弱。因此，尽管大多数人并非自私，但普遍的搭便车行为最终还是会出现。（D12, D 83, H41, Z13）

abstract.text: We conducted experiments in Vietnamese villages to determine the predictors of risk and time preferences. In villages with higher mean income, people are less loss-averse and more patient. Household income is correlated with patience but not with risk. We expand measurements of risk and time preferences beyond expected utility and exponential discounting, replacing those models with prospect theory and a three-parameter hyperbolic discounting model. Comparable risk parameter estimates have been found for Chinese farmers, using our method. (C83, D12, O12, P38)

10.1257/aer.100.1.557.abstractZh: 我们在越南的村庄进行了实验，以确定风险和时间偏好的预测因素。在平均收入较高的村庄中，人们更不厌恶损失，且更有耐心。家庭收入与耐心相关，但与风险无关。我们将风险和时间偏好的测量范围扩展到预期效用和指数贴现之外，用前景理论和三参数双曲贴现模型来替代这些模型。使用我们的方法，我们为中国农民找到了相似的风险参数估计值。（C83, D12, O12, P38）

abstract.text: Earnings losses of Connecticut workers affected by mass layoff are calculated using administrative data. Estimated reductions are initially more than 30 percent and six years later, as much as 15 percent. The Connecticut estimates are smaller than comparable ones from Pennsylvania administrative data but similar to those from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) and Department of Workforce Services (DWS). Earnings reductions in Connecticut and Pennsylvania are concentrated among Unemployment Insurance recipients. An unusually high proportion of Unemployment Insurance beneficiaries in Pennsylvania explains the larger estimated losses relative to other studies. Fixed-effects, random growth, and matching estimators produced similar earnings loss estimates suggesting each is relatively unbiased in this context.

10.1257/aer.100.1.572.abstractZh: 受大规模裁员影响的康涅狄格州工人的收入损失是通过行政数据计算得出的。初步估计，收入减少幅度超过30%，六年后则降至15%。康涅狄格州的估计值低于宾夕法尼亚州类似行政数据得出的结果，但与收入动态调查小组研究和劳动力服务部的研究结果相似。康涅狄格州和宾夕法尼亚州的收入减少主要集中在失业保险领取者身上。宾夕法尼亚州失业保险领取者比例异常高，这解释了与其他研究相比，该州估计的损失幅度更大。固定效应、随机增长和匹配估计方法得出的收入损失估计值相似，表明这些方法在此背景下都具有相对无偏性。

abstract.text: Medicare Part D began coverage of prescription drugs in 2006. Rather than setting pharmaceutical prices, the government contracted with private insurers to provide drug coverage. Theory suggests that additional insured consumers will raise the optimal price of a branded drug, while the insurer's ability to move demand to substitute treatments may lower prices. We estimate the program's effect on the price and utilization of pharmaceutical treatments. We find that Part D enrollees paid substantially lower prices than while uninsured, and increased their utilization of prescription drugs. We find relative price declines only for drugs with significant therapeutic competition.

10.1257/aer.100.1.590.abstractZh: Medicare Part D于2006年开始覆盖处方药。政府并非直接设定药品价格，而是与私人保险公司合作提供药品保险。理论表明，增加参保人数会提高品牌药品的最优价格，而保险公司将需求转向替代疗法的能力则可能降低价格。我们评估了该计划对药品价格和使用率的影响。研究发现，Part D参保人的药品价格比未参保者低得多，且处方药的使用率也有所增加。我们仅发现那些存在显著治疗竞争的药物价格有所下降。

abstract.text: This paper examines the frequency, pervasiveness, and determinants of product switching by US manufacturing firms. We find that one-half of firms alter their mix of five-digit SIC products every five years, that product switching is correlated with both firm- and firm-product attributes, and that product adding and dropping induce large changes in firm scope. The behavior we observe is consistent with a natural generalization of existing theories of industry dynamics that incorporates endogenous product selection within firms. Our findings suggest that product switching contributes to a reallocation of resources within firms toward their most efficient use. (JEL L11, L21, L25, L60)

10.1257/aer.100.1.70.abstractZh: 本文研究了美国制造企业产品转换的频率、普遍性和决定因素。我们发现，有一半的企业每五年会更换一次其五种数字SIC产品的组合，产品转换与企业和产品属性都有关联，而产品的增加和减少会导致企业经营范围发生较大变化。我们观察到的行为与现有行业动态理论的自然延伸相一致，这些理论将企业内部的内生产品选择纳入了分析框架。我们的研究结果表明，产品转换有助于企业将资源重新分配到最高效的用途上。（JEL L11, L21, L25, L60）

abstract.text: The 1960s ushered in a new era in US demographic history characterized by significantly lower fertility rates and smaller family sizes. What catalyzed these changes remains a matter of considerable debate. This paper exploits idiosyncratic variation in the language of "Comstock" statutes, enacted in the late 1800s, to quantify the role of the birth control pill in this transition. Almost 50 years after the contraceptive pill appeared on the US market, this analysis provides new evidence that it accelerated the post-1960 decline in marital fertility.

10.1257/aer.100.1.98.abstractZh: 20世纪60年代，美国人口历史迎来了一个新时代，其特征是生育率显著下降和家庭规模缩小。究竟是什么推动了这些变化，至今仍是一个备受争议的问题。本文利用19世纪末颁布的“科姆斯托克法案”中特有的语言差异，来量化避孕药在促成这一转变中的作用。在避孕药在美国市场上出现近50年后，这项分析提供了新的证据，表明避孕药加速了1960年后婚姻生育率的下降。

abstract.text: The welfare effects of trade shocks turn on the nature and magnitude of the costs workers face in moving between sectors. Using an Euler-type equilibrium condition derived from a rational expectations model of dynamic labor adjustment, we estimate the mean and variance of workers' switching costs from the US CPS. We estimate high values of both parameters, implying slow adjustment of the economy and sharp movements in wages in response to trade shocks. However, import-competing workers can still benefit from tariff removal; liberalization lowers their wages in the short and long run but raises their option value. (JEL E24, F13, F16)

10.1257/aer.100.3.1008.abstractZh: 贸易冲击对福利的影响取决于劳动者在不同行业之间流动所面临的成本性质和大小。我们基于理性预期模型推导出的欧拉型均衡条件，从美国人口普查数据中估算出劳动者转移成本的均值和方差。估算结果显示这两个参数的值都较高，这意味着经济调整速度较慢，且工资在贸易冲击下会出现剧烈波动。然而，从事进口竞争的劳动者仍可以从关税取消中受益；虽然自由化会在短期和长期内降低他们的工资，但会提升他们的选择价值。（JEL E24, F13, F16）

abstract.text: The success of new technologies depends on both the firms' investment and consumers' usage decisions. We study this problem in a shared ATM network. Inefficiencies may arise because banks coordinate investment, and consumers may not make proper use of the network. Based on an empirical model of ATM investment and demand, we find that banks substantially underinvested in ATMs, in contrast with earlier findings of strategic overinvestment in the United States. Furthermore, ATM usage was too low, because regulation prohibited fees for cash withdrawals. A direct promotion of investment improves welfare, but fees for branch cash withdrawals would be more effective. (JEL G21, G31, O33)

10.1257/aer.100.3.1046.abstractZh: 新技术的成功取决于企业的投资以及消费者的使用决策。我们在共享自动取款机网络中对这一问题进行了研究。由于银行需要协调投资，可能会出现效率低下的情况，而消费者也可能未能充分利用该网络。基于自动取款机投资和需求的实证模型，我们发现与之前美国关于战略性过度投资的研究结果不同，银行在自动取款机上的投资明显不足。此外，由于法规禁止收取取款手续费，自动取款机的使用率也较低。直接促进投资可以提高福利，但收取分支机构取款手续费可能会更为有效。（JEL G21, G31, O33）

abstract.text: There is continuing controversy over the importance of credit constraints. This paper investigates whether total household expenditure and debt is affected by an exogenous increase in access to credit provided by a credit market reform that enabled Danish house owners to use housing equity as collateral for consumption loans. We find that the magnitude of the response is correlated with the amount of equity released by the reform and that the effect is strongest for younger households. Even for this group, the response was moderate. The aggregate effect of the reform was significant but small. (JEL D14, D91, E21)

10.1257/aer.100.3.1080.abstractZh: 关于信贷约束的重要性一直存在争议。本文研究的是，通过信贷市场改革，丹麦房主能够使用住房权益作为消费贷款的抵押品，这种改革是否会影响家庭总支出和债务。我们发现，这种影响的程度与改革所释放的权益数量相关，且这种效应在年轻家庭中最明显。即使对于这一群体，这种影响也是中等的。改革的总体效应是显著的，但幅度较小。（JEL D14, D91, E21）

abstract.text: An incentives based theory of policing is developed which can explain the phenomenon of random “crackdowns,” i.e., intermittent periods of high interdiction/surveillance. For a variety of police objective functions, random crackdowns can be part of the optimal monitoring strategy. We demonstrate support for implications of the crackdown theory using traffic data gathered by the Belgian Police Department and use the model to estimate the deterrence effect of additional resources spent on speeding interdiction. (JEL K42, R41)

10.1257/aer.100.3.1104.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种基于激励的警务理论，该理论能够解释所谓的“随机打击”现象，即间歇性的高拦截/监控频率。对于多种警务目标函数而言，随机打击可以成为最优监控策略的一部分。我们通过比利时警察部门收集的交通数据来支持这一理论，并利用该模型估算在超速拦截上投入更多资源所带来的威慑效果。（JEL K42, R41）

abstract.text: A sender may communicate with a decision maker through intermediaries. In this model, an objective sender and intermediary pass on information truthfully, while biased ones favor a particular agenda but also have reputational concerns. I show that the biased sender and the biased intermediary's reporting truthfulness are strategic complements. The biased sender is less likely to use an intermediary than an objective sender if his reputational concerns are low, but more likely to do so if his reputational concerns are moderate. Moreover, the biased sender may be more likely to use an intermediary perceived to be more biased. (JEL D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.100.3.1136.abstractZh: 发送者可以通过中间人来与决策者进行沟通。在这个模型中，诚实的发送者和中间人传递信息，而存在偏见的中间人则倾向于支持特定议程，但同时也存在声誉方面的顾虑。研究表明，存在偏见的发送者和存在偏见的中间人在报告真实性方面是战略上的互补关系。如果发送者的声誉顾虑较低，他使用中间人的可能性就会降低；但如果声誉顾虑处于中等水平，则更有可能使用中间人。此外，存在偏见的发送者可能更倾向于使用那些被认为更有偏见的中间人。（JEL D82, D83）

abstract.text: Entrepreneurship is risky. We study the risk facing a well-documented and important class of entrepreneurs, those backed by venture capital. Using a dynamic program, we calculate the certainty-equivalent of the difference between the cash rewards that entrepreneurs actually received over the past 20 years and the cash that entrepreneurs would have received from a risk-free salaried job. The payoff to a venture-backed entrepreneur comprises a below-market salary and a share of the equity value of the company when it goes public or is acquired. We find that the typical venture-backed entrepreneur received an average of $5.8 million in exit cash. Almost three-quarters of entrepreneurs receive nothing at exit and a few receive over a billion dollars. Because of the extreme dispersion of payoffs, an entrepreneur with a coefficient of relative risk aversion of two places a certainty equivalent value only slightly greater than zero on the distribution of outcomes she faces at the time of her company's launch. (JEL G24, G32, L26, M13)

10.1257/aer.100.3.1163.abstractZh: 创业是充满风险的。我们研究了一类被风险资本支持的、备受关注的创业者的风险状况。通过动态模型计算，我们得出了过去20年间创业者实际获得的现金回报与无风险薪资之间的差额的确定性等价值。风险资本支持的创业者获得的回报包括低于市场的薪资以及公司上市或被收购时股权价值的份额。我们发现，典型的风险资本支持的创业者平均获得的退出现金为580万美元。几乎四分之三的创业者在退出时没有任何收益，只有少数人的收益超过十亿美元。由于收益的极端差异，一个具有2倍相对风险厌恶系数的创业者，在其公司成立时面临的结果分布中，其确定性等价值仅略高于零。（JEL G24, G32, L26, M13）

abstract.text: Why do firms cluster near one another? We test Marshall's theories of industrial agglomeration by examining which industries locate near one another, or coagglomerate. We construct pairwise coagglomeration indices for US manufacturing industries from the Economic Census. We then relate coagglomeration levels to the degree to which industry pairs share goods, labor, or ideas. To reduce reverse causality, where collocation drives input-output linkages or hiring patterns, we use data from UK industries and from US areas where the two industries are not collocated. All three of Marshall's theories of agglomeration are supported, with input-output linkages particularly important. (JEL L14, L60, O33, R23, R32)

10.1257/aer.100.3.1195.abstractZh: 为什么企业会聚集在彼此附近？我们通过研究哪些行业会彼此靠近或形成产业集群，来检验马歇尔的工业聚集理论。我们依据经济普查数据，为美国制造业行业构建了成对聚集指数。然后，我们将聚集程度与行业对共享商品、劳动力或信息的程度联系起来。为了减少逆向因果关系的影响，即聚集地驱动投入产出联系或招聘模式，我们使用了英国行业的数据，以及那些两个行业并不聚集的美国地区的数据。马歇尔关于聚集的所有三个理论都得到了支持，其中投入产出联系尤为重要。（JEL L14, L60, O33, R23, R32）

abstract.text: In a reasonably calibrated Mortensen and Pissarides matching model, shocks to average labor productivity can account for a small portion of the fluctuations in unemployment and vacancies (Shimer (2005)). I add heterogeneity in jobs (matches) with respect to the time the job is created in the form of different embodied technology levels. I also introduce specific capital that, once adapted for a match, has less value in another match. I show that the augmented model can account for fluctuations in unemployment and vacancies, and that specific capital is important to decreasing the volatility of the destruction rate of existing matches.

10.1257/aer.100.3.1214.abstractZh: 在Mortensen和Pissarides的校准模型框架下，平均劳动生产率的变化可以解释失业率和职位空缺波动中的一小部分原因（Shimer, 2005）。我引入了职位（匹配）的异质性，这种异质性与职位创建的时间有关，表现为不同的技术水平。我还引入了特定资本，这种资本在适应某一匹配后，在其他匹配中的价值会降低。我证明，改进后的模型能够解释失业率和职位空缺的波动，并且特定资本对于降低现有匹配被破坏的波动性具有重要意义。

abstract.text: This paper investigates whether there is a link between cognitive ability, risk aversion, and impatience, using a representative sample of roughly 1,000 German adults. Subjects participate in choice experiments with monetary incentives measuring risk aversion, and impatience over an annual horizon, and conduct two different, widely used, tests of cognitive ability. We find that lower cognitive ability is associated with greater risk aversion, and more pronounced impatience. These relationships are significant, and robust to controlling for personal characteristics, education, income, and measures of credit constraints. We perform a series of additional robustness checks, which help rule out other possible confounds.

10.1257/aer.100.3.1238.abstractZh: 本文研究了认知能力、风险厌恶和急躁情绪之间是否存在关联，研究样本为约1000名德国成年人。参与者参与了带有货币激励的选择实验，这些实验用于衡量风险厌恶和一年时间范围内的急躁情绪，同时进行了两项广泛使用的认知能力测试。研究发现，较低的认知能力与更高风险厌恶和更明显的急躁情绪相关。这些关系具有显著性，并且即使在控制个人特征、教育水平、收入以及信贷约束因素后，这些关系依然成立。我们还进行了一系列额外的稳健性检验，以排除其他可能的混淆因素。

abstract.text: We analyze the existence of policy reversal, the phenomenon sometimes observed that a certain policy (say extreme left-wing) is implemented by the “unlikely” (right-wing) party. We formulate a Downsian signaling model where the incumbent government, through its choice of policy, reveals information both regarding own preferences and external circumstances that may call for a particular policy. We show that policy reversal may indeed exist as an equilibrium phenomenon. This is partly because the incumbent party has superior opportunities to reveal information, and partly because its reputation protects a left-wing incumbent when advertising a right-wing policy.

10.1257/aer.100.3.1261.abstractZh: 我们分析了政策逆转的存在性，这种现象有时会出现，即某个极端左翼的政策被“不太可能”出现的右翼政党所实施。我们构建了一个唐斯式的信号模型，其中执政党通过政策选择，揭示了自身偏好以及可能要求特定政策的外部环境信息。我们表明，政策逆转确实可能作为一种均衡现象存在。这部分是因为执政党有更好的机会来揭示信息，另一部分则是因为其声誉在宣传右翼政策时保护了左翼执政党。

abstract.text: Oliver E. Williamson delivered his Prize Lecture on 8 December 2009 at Aula Magna, Stockholm University. He was introduced by Professor Bertil Holmlund, Chairman of the Economic Sciences Prize Committee.

10.1257/aer.100.3.673.abstractZh: 奥利弗·E·威廉姆森于2009年12月8日在斯德哥尔摩大学的大礼堂发表了他的获奖演讲。他的演讲由经济科学奖委员会主席贝尔蒂尔·霍尔姆伦教授主持。

abstract.text: This paper describes the extent of product creation and destruction in a large sector of the US economy. We find four times more entry and exit in product markets than is found in labor markets because most product turnover happens within firms. Net product creation is strongly procyclical and primarily driven by creation rather than destruction. We find that a cost-of-living index that takes product turnover into account is 0.8 percentage points per year lower than a “fixed goods” price index like the CPI. The procyclicality of the bias implies that business cycles are more volatile than indicated by official statistics. (JEL E31, E32, L11, O31)

10.1257/aer.100.3.691.abstractZh: 本文描述了美国经济中一个较大领域的产品创造与破坏的规模。我们发现，产品市场的进入和退出频率是劳动力市场的四倍，因为大部分产品流转发生在企业内部。净产品创造具有强烈的顺周期性，主要由创造而非破坏驱动。我们发现，一个考虑到产品流转的生活成本指数，其每年比“固定商品”价格指数（如CPI）低0.8个百分点。这种顺周期性意味着商业周期的波动比官方统计数据所显示的更为剧烈。（JEL E31, E32, L11, O31）

abstract.text: This paper examines bidding in over 1,700 knockout auctions used by a bidding cartel (or ring) of stamp dealers in the 1990s. The knockout was conducted using a variant of the model studied by Daniel Graham, Robert Marshall, and Jean-Francois Richard (1990). Following a reduced form examination of these data, damages, induced inefficiency, and the ring's benefit from colluding are estimated using a structural model in the spirit of Emmanuel Guerre, Isabelle Perrigne, and Quang Vuong (2000). A notable finding is that nonring bidders suffered damages that were of the same order of magnitude as those of the sellers. (JEL D43, D44, L12)

10.1257/aer.100.3.724.abstractZh: 本文研究了20世纪90年代由邮票经销商组成的竞标联盟在1,700多次淘汰式拍卖中的竞标行为。这些淘汰式拍卖采用了Daniel Graham、Robert Marshall和Jean-Francois Richard在1990年研究的模型的一种变体。通过对这些数据的简化分析，使用Emmanuel Guerre、Isabelle Perrigne和Quang Vuong在2000年提出的结构模型，估算了损害程度、由此产生的效率损失以及竞标联盟从中获得的利益。一个显著的发现是，非联盟竞标者的损失与卖家的损失处于同一数量级。（JEL D43, D44, L12）

abstract.text: This paper investigates the impact of tax changes on economic activity. We use the narrative record, such as presidential speeches and Congressional reports, to identify the size, timing, and principal motivation for all major postwar tax policy actions. This analysis allows us to separate legislated changes into those taken for reasons related to prospective economic conditions and those taken for more exogenous reasons. The behavior of output following these more exogenous changes indicates that tax increases are highly contractionary. The effects are strongly significant, highly robust, and much larger than those obtained using broader measures of tax changes. (JEL E32, E62, H20, N12)

10.1257/aer.100.3.763.abstractZh: 本文研究了税收变化对经济活动的影响。我们通过分析总统演讲和国会报告等官方记录，来识别战后所有主要税收政策的规模、实施时机以及主要动机。这一分析使我们能够将立法上的变化分为两类：一类是出于对未来经济状况的考虑而采取的，另一类则是出于更外部因素而做出的调整。这些外部因素导致的税收变化对产出的影响表明，税收增加具有强烈的紧缩效应。其影响非常显著，且比使用更广泛的税收变化指标所得到的结论更为有力。（JEL E32, E62, H20, N12）

abstract.text: We study dynamic bargaining with asymmetric information and arrival of exogenous events, which represent arrival of traders or information. We characterize the unique limit of stationary equilibria with frequent offers. The possibility of arrivals changes equilibrium dynamics. There is delay in equilibrium, and the seller slowly screens out buyers with higher valuations. The seller payoff equals what he can achieve by simply awaiting an arrival. In applications, when buyer valuations fall, average prices drop and delay increases. Surplus division depends on relative arrival rates of buyers/sellers and expected time to trade is a nonmonotonic function of the arrival rate. (JEL C78, D82)

10.1257/aer.100.3.802.abstractZh: 我们研究了具有不对称信息以及外部事件发生的动态讨价还价行为，这些外部事件代表了交易者的到来或信息的出现。我们描述了在频繁报价情况下静态均衡的独特极限情况。外部事件的到来会改变均衡动态，导致均衡出现延迟，卖方会逐步排除那些估值较高的买家。卖方的收益等于他单纯等待交易者到来的收益。在实际应用中，当买家的估值下降时，平均价格也会下降，均衡延迟也会增加。剩余财富的分配取决于买家和卖家的相对到达率，而预期交易时间则是到达率的非单调函数。（JEL C78, D82）

abstract.text: This paper analyzes an emissions trading program that was introduced to reduce smog-causing pollution from large stationary sources. Using variation in state level electricity industry restructuring activity, I identify the effect of economic regulation on pollution permit market outcomes. There are two main findings. First, deregulated plants in restructured electricity markets were less likely to adopt more capital intensive environmental compliance options as compared to regulated or publicly owned plants. Second, as a consequence of heterogeneity in electricity market regulations, a larger share of the permitted pollution is being emitted in states where air quality problems tend to be more severe. (JEL L51, L94, L98, Q53, Q58)

10.1257/aer.100.3.837.abstractZh: 本文分析了一项旨在减少大型固定污染源造成的烟雾污染的排放交易计划。通过研究各州电力行业重组活动的差异，本文探讨了经济监管对污染许可市场结果的影响。主要发现有两个：首先，在重组后的电力市场中，未受监管的电厂相比受监管或公共所有的电厂，更不愿意采用资本密集型的环境合规措施。其次，由于电力市场监管的差异性，更多被允许的污染排放发生在空气质量问题较为严重的州。（JEL L51, L94, L98, Q53, Q58）

abstract.text: A major puzzle in international finance is that high interest rate currencies tend to appreciate (forward discount puzzle). Motivated by the fact that only a small fraction of foreign currency holdings is actively managed, we calibrate a two-country model in which agents make infrequent portfolio decisions. We show that the model can account for the forward discount puzzle. It can also account for several related empirical phenomena, including that of “delayed overshooting.” We also show that making infrequent portfolio decisions is optimal as the welfare gain from active currency management is smaller than the corresponding fees. (JEL F31, G11, G15)

10.1257/aer.100.3.870.abstractZh: 国际金融中的一个主要难题是，高利率货币往往会出现升值现象（即远期折价难题）。由于只有一小部分外币持有量被积极管理，我们构建了一个双国模型，模型中代理人进行不频繁的投资组合决策。我们证明该模型能够解释远期折价难题，并且还能解释一些相关的实证现象，包括“延迟超调”现象。我们还表明，不频繁进行投资组合决策是最优的，因为积极管理货币所带来的福利收益小于相应的管理费用。（JEL F31, G11, G15）

abstract.text: Dating to the classic works of Alonso, Mills, and Muth, the production function for housing has played a central role in urban economics and local public finance. This paper provides a new flexible approach for estimating the housing production function which treats housing quantities and prices as latent variables. The empirical analysis is based on a comprehensive database of recently built properties in Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. We find that the new method proposed in this paper works well in the application and provides reasonable estimates for the underlying production function. (JEL C51, D24, R11, R31)

10.1257/aer.100.3.905.abstractZh: 从阿隆索、米尔斯和穆斯的经典著作开始，住房生产函数在城市经济学和地方公共财政中一直扮演着核心角色。本文提出了一种新的灵活方法，用于估算住房生产函数，该方法将住房数量和价格视为潜在变量。实证分析基于宾夕法尼亚州阿勒格尼县最近新建房产的综合性数据库。我们发现，本文提出的新方法在应用中表现良好，并为潜在生产函数提供了合理的估算结果。（JEL C51, D24, R11, R31）

abstract.text: This paper focuses on the importance of equity markets in facilitating the exit of entrepreneurs investing in technology. Entrepreneurs' willingness to invest and aggregate output is affected in two opposite ways. First, uncertainty about equity price or lack of market liquidity discourages technology adoption. This can explain slow technology adoption and limited participation by venture capitalists in underdeveloped equity markets. Second, fast adoption is a positive signal to imperfectly informed equity market participants. This provides a rational explanation for overpricing technology stocks and overinvestment in developed markets. Fast adoption is most probable at an intermediate quality of information. (JEL D82, E23, G12, G31, G32, O33)

10.1257/aer.100.3.925.abstractZh: 本文重点探讨了股权市场在促进投资于技术的企业家退出过程中的重要性。企业家投资意愿和总产出受到两种相反因素的影响。首先，股权价格的不确定性或市场流动性不足会抑制技术的采用。这可以解释技术采用速度缓慢以及风险资本家在欠发达的股权市场中的参与有限现象。其次，快速的技术采用对信息不完全的股权市场参与者来说是一个积极的信号。这为技术股票的过度定价以及在发达市场中的过度投资提供了合理的解释。在信息质量处于中等水平时，快速采用技术是最有可能的。（JEL D82, E23, G12, G31, G32, O33）

abstract.text: This study examines why people initially give to charities, why they remain committed to the cause, and what factors attenuate these influences. Using an experimental design that links donations across distinct treatments separated in time, we present several results. For example, previous donors are more likely to give, and contribute more, than other donor types. Yet, how previous donors were acquired is critical: agents initially attracted by an economic mechanism are more likely to continue giving than agents attracted by a nonmechanism factor. From a methodological viewpoint, our study showcases the benefit of moving beyond an experimental design that focuses on short-run substitution effects. (JEL C93, D64, D82, H41, L31, Z12)

10.1257/aer.100.3.958.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了人们为何最初会向慈善机构捐款，为何会持续致力于这一事业，以及哪些因素能够减弱这些影响。我们采用了一种实验设计，将不同时间段的捐款行为联系起来，并得出了一些结果。例如，之前的捐赠者比其他类型的捐赠者更有可能进行捐款，并且捐款金额也更高。然而，如何吸引之前的捐赠者至关重要：最初被经济机制吸引的捐赠者比被非机制因素吸引的捐赠者更有可能继续捐款。从方法论的角度来看，我们的研究展示了超越仅关注短期替代效应的实验设计的重要性。（JEL C93, D64, D82, H41, L31, Z12）

abstract.text: We report experiments on sender-receiver games with an incentive for senders to exaggerate. Subjects “overcommunicate”—messages are more informative of the true state than they should be, in equilibrium. Eyetracking shows that senders look at payoffs in a way that is consistent with a level-k model. A combination of sender messages and lookup patterns predicts the true state about twice as often as predicted by equilibrium. Using these measures to infer the state would enable receiver subjects to hypothetically earn 16–21 percent more than they actually do, an economic value of 60 percent of the maximum increment. (JEL C72, C91, D82, Z13)

10.1257/aer.100.3.984.abstractZh: 我们报道了关于发送者-接收者游戏的实验，其中发送者有动机夸大信息。实验对象“过度沟通”——在均衡状态下，发送的信息比实际情况更具信息量。眼动追踪结果显示，发送者查看收益的方式与level-k模型一致。发送者的信息内容与查找模式相结合，预测的真实状态出现频率是均衡预测频率的两倍。利用这些指标推断状态，可以使接收者假设获得的收益比实际多16-21%，其经济价值相当于最大增量的60%。（JEL C72, C91, D82, Z13）

abstract.text: Self-regulation is the private provision of public goods and private redistribution. This paper examines the scope of self-regulation motivated by altruistic moral preferences that are reciprocal and stronger the closer are citizens in a socioeconomic distance. The focus is on the role of organizations in increasing self-regulation by mitigating free-rider problems. Social label and certification organizations can expand the scope of self-regulation but not beyond that with unconditional altruism. Enforcement organizations expand the scope of self-regulation farther, and for-profit enforcement is more aggressive than non-profit enforcement. Enforcement through social pressure imposed by NGOs also expands the scope of self-regulation. (JEL D64, H41, L51)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1299.abstractZh: 自我调节是指私人提供公共物品和私人再分配行为。本文探讨了由利他主义道德偏好驱动的自我调节的范围，这种偏好是互惠的，且公民之间的社会经济距离越近，这种偏好就越强。研究的重点是组织在缓解搭便车问题方面对自我调节的促进作用。社会标签和认证组织可以扩大自我调节的范围，但无条件利他主义无法超越这一范围。执法组织则能进一步扩展自我调节的范围，营利性执法比非营利性执法更为积极。非政府组织施加的社会压力也能扩大自我调节的范围。（JEL D64, H41, L51）

abstract.text: The capital-labor substitution elasticity and technical biases in production are critical parameters. The received wisdom claims their joint identification is infeasible. We challenge that interpretation. Putting the new approach of “normalized” production functions at the heart of a Monte Carlo analysis we identify the conditions under which identification is feasible and robust. The key result is that jointly modeling the production function and first-order conditions is superior to single-equation approaches especially when merged with “normalization.” Our results will have fundamental implications for production-function estimation under non-neutral technical change, for understanding the empirical relevance of normalization and variability underlying past empirical studies. (JEL E22, O33, O41)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1330.abstractZh: 资本与劳动力的替代弹性以及生产中的技术偏差是至关重要的参数。现有的观点认为，这些参数联合识别是不可行的。我们对此解释提出质疑。通过将“标准化”生产函数的新方法作为蒙特卡洛分析的核心，我们确定了识别可行的条件。关键结论是，联合建模生产函数和一阶条件优于单一方程的方法，尤其是当与“标准化”措施结合使用时。我们的研究结果对于在非中性技术变革下估计生产函数具有重要意义，也有助于理解标准化措施及其变化对过去实证研究的影响。（JEL E22, O33, O41）

abstract.text: We design a field experiment to explore the use of social comparison to increase contributions to an online community. We find that, after receiving behavioral information about the median user's total number of movie ratings, users below the median demonstrate a 530 percent increase in the number of monthly movie ratings, while those above the median decrease their ratings by 62 percent. When given outcome information about the average user's net benefit score, above-average users mainly engage in activities that help others. Our findings suggest that effective personalized social information can increase the level of public goods provision. (JEL C93, H41, L82)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1358.abstractZh: 我们设计了一项实地实验，以探索利用社会比较来增加对在线社区的贡献。研究发现，在收到关于中位用户电影评分总数的行为信息后，中位数以下用户的每月电影评分数量增加了530%，而中位数以上的用户则减少了62%。当获得关于平均用户净收益分数的结果信息时，高于平均水平的用户主要参与帮助他人的活动。我们的研究结果表明，有效的个性化社会信息可以提高公共产品提供的水平。（JEL C93, H41, L82）

abstract.text: To gauge the competitiveness of the group health insurance industry, I investigate whether health insurers charge higher premiums, ceteris paribus, to more profitable firms. Such "direct price discrimination" is feasible only in imperfectly competitive settings. Using a proprietary national database of health plans offered by a sample of large, multisite firms from 1998–2005, I find firms with positive profit shocks subsequently face higher premium growth, even for the same health plans. Moreover, within a given firm, those sites located in concentrated insurance markets experience the greatest premium increases. The findings suggest health care insurers are exercising market power in an increasing number of geographic markets.

10.1257/aer.100.4.1399.abstractZh: 为了评估团体健康保险行业的竞争状况，我研究了健康保险公司是否会在其他条件相同的情况下，向更盈利的公司收取更高的保费。这种“直接价格歧视”只有在不完全竞争的环境中才可行。利用一个由1998年至2005年间部分大型多站点公司提供的健康计划的国家专有数据库，我发现那些在随后出现盈利冲击的公司，即使使用相同的健康计划，其保费增长也更高。此外，在同一家公司内部，那些位于保险市场集中的地区的站点，其保费增长最为显著。这些发现表明，健康保险公司在越来越多的地理市场中行使市场力量。

abstract.text: We specify a life-cycle model of consumption, labor supply and job mobility in an economy with search frictions. We distinguish different sources of risk, including shocks to productivity, job arrival, and job destruction. Allowing for job mobility has a large effect on the estimate of productivity risk. Increases in the latter impose a considerable welfare loss. Increases in employment risk have large effects on output and, primarily through this channel, affect welfare. The welfare value of programs such as Food Stamps, partially insuring productivity risk, is greater than the value of unemployment insurance which provides (partial) insurance against employment risk. (JEL D91, J22, J31, J61, J64, J65)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1432.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个包含搜寻摩擦的经济体系中的消费、劳动力供给和就业流动的生命周期模型。我们区分了不同的风险来源，包括生产力冲击、就业获得和就业丧失。允许就业流动对生产力风险的估计有显著影响。生产力风险的增加会导致相当大的福利损失。就业风险的增加对产出有重大影响，并且主要通过这一渠道影响福利。诸如食品券这样的福利计划，通过部分保险生产力风险，其价值大于提供（部分）就业风险保险失业保险的价值。（JEL D91, J22, J31, J61, J64, J65）

abstract.text: Empirical work shows that a large majority of individuals get most of their information from a very small subset of the group, viz., the influencers; moreover, there exist only minor differences between the observable characteristics of the influencers and the others. We refer to these empirical findings as the Law of the Few. This paper develops a model where players personally acquire information and form connections with others to access their information. Every (robust) equilibrium of this model exhibits the law of the few. (JEL D83, D85, Z13)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1468.abstractZh: 实证研究表明，绝大多数个体获取信息的主要来源是极少数群体，即那些具有影响力的人物；此外，这些具有影响力的人物与其他人的可观测特征之间仅存在细微差异。我们将这些实证发现称为“少数法则”。本文提出了一个模型，其中参与者通过个人获取信息并与他人建立联系来获取信息。该模型的每一个（稳健的）均衡都体现了“少数法则”的特征。（JEL D83, D85, Z13）

abstract.text: The US Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) estimates that the return on investments of foreign subsidiaries of US multinational companies over the period 1982–2006 averaged 9.4 percent annually after taxes; US subsidiaries of foreign multinationals averaged only 3.2 percent. BEA returns on foreign direct investment (FDI) are distorted because most intangible investments made by multinationals are expensed. We develop a multicountry general equilibrium model with an essential role for FDI and apply the BEA's methodology to construct economic statistics for the model economy. We estimate that mismeasurement of intangible investments accounts for over 60 percent of the difference in BEA returns. (JEL F23, F32)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1493.abstractZh: 美国经济分析局（BEA）估计，1982年至2006年间，美国跨国公司的外国子公司投资回报率年均达到9.4%，而外国跨国公司的美国子公司则仅达到3.2%。BEA对外国直接投资的回报率评估存在偏差，因为跨国公司进行的大多数无形资产投资都被计入了费用。我们建立了一个多国通用均衡模型，该模型将外国直接投资视为重要因素，并采用BEA的方法论来构建该模型经济体的经济统计数据。我们的估计表明，无形资产投资的误测因素占BEA回报率差异的60%以上。（JEL F23, F32）

abstract.text: Conventional wisdom says that, in the absence of default penalties, sovereign risk destroys all foreign asset trade. We show that this conventional wisdom rests on one implicit assumption: that assets cannot be retraded in secondary markets. Without this assumption, foreign asset trade is possible even in the absence of default penalties. This result suggests a broader perspective regarding the origins of sovereign risk and its remedies. Sovereign risk affects foreign asset trade only if default penalties are insufficient and secondary markets work imperfectly. To reduce its effects, one can either increase default penalties or improve the working of secondary markets. (JEL F34, G12, G15)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1523.abstractZh: 传统观点认为，在没有违约惩罚的情况下，主权风险会破坏所有外国资产交易。我们发现，这一传统观点基于一个隐含的假设：资产无法在二级市场上重新交易。如果没有这一假设，即使在没有违约惩罚的情况下，外国资产交易仍然是可能的。这一结果为我们理解主权风险的起源及其解决方法提供了更广阔的视角。只有当违约惩罚不足且二级市场运作不当时，主权风险才会影响外国资产交易。为了减轻其影响，可以增加违约惩罚或改善二级市场的运作机制。（JEL F34, G12, G15）

abstract.text: This paper describes a series of laboratory experiments studying whether the form in which items are displayed at the time of decision affects the dollar value that subjects place on them. Using a Becker-DeGroot auction under three different conditions—(i) text displays, (ii) image displays, and (iii) displays of the actual items—we find that subjects' willingness-to-pay is 40–61 percent larger in the real than in the image and text displays. Furthermore, follow-up experiments suggest the presence of the real item triggers preprogrammed consummatory Pavlovian processes that promote behaviors that lead to contact with appetitive items whenever they are available. (JEL C91, D03, D12, D87)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1556.abstractZh: 本文描述了一系列实验室实验，研究在决策时物品展示的形式是否会影响受试者对其的货币价值评价。通过在不同条件下使用Becker-DeGroot拍卖模型进行实验——包括(i)文字展示、(ii)图像展示，以及(iii)实际物品的展示——我们发现，受试者在实物展示中的支付意愿比在图像和文字展示中的支付意愿高出40%至61%。此外，后续实验表明，实际物品的存在会触发预先编程的消费行为，促使受试者在有机会接触吸引人的物品时采取行动。(JEL C91, D03, D12, D87)

abstract.text: We investigate political determinants of land reform implementation in the Indian state of West Bengal. Using a village panel spanning 1974–1998, we do not find evidence supporting the hypothesis that land reforms were positively and monotonically related to control of local governments by a Left Front coalition vis-à-vis the right-centrist Congress party, combined with lack of commitment to policy platforms. Instead, the evidence is consistent with a quasi-Downsian theory stressing the role of opportunism (reelection concerns) and electoral competition.(JEL D72, O13, O17, Q15)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1572.abstractZh: 我们研究了印度西孟加拉邦土地改革实施的政治因素。通过1974至1998年的村庄面板数据研究，我们没有发现任何证据支持这样的假设：土地改革与地方政府由左翼联盟控制之间存在正相关关系，且这种关系呈单调递增趋势，同时缺乏对政策纲领的承诺。相反，研究结果与准戴尔森理论一致，该理论强调机会主义（连任顾虑）和选举竞争的作用。(JEL D72, O13, O17, Q15)

abstract.text: This paper presents a general analysis of the effects of monopolistic third-degree price discrimination on welfare and output when all markets are served. Sufficient conditions—involving straightforward comparisons of the curvatures of the direct and inverse demand functions in the different markets—are presented for discrimination to have negative or positive effects on social welfare and output. (JEL D42)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1601.abstractZh: 本文对垄断性第三级价格歧视对所有市场服务时对社会福利和产出的影响进行了总体分析。文中提出了充分条件——涉及不同市场中直接需求函数和反向需求函数的曲率直接比较——以判断价格歧视对社会福利和产出的影响是负面还是正面。（JEL D42）

abstract.text: Two parties choose redistricting plans to maximize their probability of winning a majority in the House of Representatives. In the unique equilibrium, parties maximally segregate their opponents' supporters but pool their own supporters into uniform districts. Ceteris paribus, the stronger party segregates more than the weaker one, and the election outcome is biased in the stronger party's favor and against the party whose supporters are easier to identify. We incorporate policy choice into our redistricting game and find that when one party controls redistricting, the equilibrium policy is biased towards the preferences of the redistricting party's supporters. (JEL C72, D72)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1616.abstractZh: 两政党选择重新划分选区以最大化其在众议院获得多数席位的概率。在独特的均衡状态下，各政党会最大限度地将对手的支持者分隔开来，同时将自己的支持者集中到统一的选区中。在其他条件不变的情况下，较强的政党会比较弱的政党进行更多的分隔，选举结果会偏向较强的政党，而不利于那些支持者更容易被识别的政党。我们将政策选择纳入重新划分选区的游戏中，发现当某一政党控制重新划分选区时，均衡政策会偏向该政党支持者的偏好。（JEL C72, D72）

abstract.text: I develop a general theory of monopoly pricing of networks. Platforms use insulating tariffs to avoid coordination failure, implementing any desired allocation. Profit maximization distorts in the spirit of A. Michael Spence (1975) by internalizing only network externalities to marginal users. Thus the empirical and prescriptive content of the popular Jean-Charles Rochet and Jean Tirole (2006) model of two-sided markets turns on the nature of user heterogeneity. I propose a more plausible, yet equally tractable, model of heterogeneity in which users differ in their income or scale. My approach provides a general measure of market power and helps predict the effects of price regulation and mergers. (JEL D42, D85, L14)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1642.abstractZh: 我提出了一种关于网络垄断定价的一般理论。平台通过采用隔离性定价来避免协调失败，从而实现任何期望的分配。利润最大化行为违背了A. Michael Spence（1975年）的理论，因为它只将网络外部性内部化到边际用户身上。因此，Jean-Charles Rochet和Jean Tirole（2006年）提出的双边市场模型的实证和规范性内容，实际上取决于用户异质性的性质。我提出了一个更为合理且同样可行的异质性模型，在该模型中，用户在收入或规模上存在差异。我的方法提供了一种衡量市场力量的一般性指标，并有助于预测价格监管和合并的影响。（JEL D42, D85, L14）

abstract.text: This study considers replacing the current US tax system with only a flat tax consumption tax, showing, in contrast to the literature, that such a reform leads to a decline in inequality and increase in welfare for the welfare-poor. The results are obtained from a simple model that identifies the main channels through which the reform affects the economy. It is shown also that these novel results depend on the distribution of wealth and earnings, and that they hold for the relevant empirical distributions. (JEL D31, H23, H25)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1673.abstractZh: 本研究探讨用单一的消费税取代当前的美国税收体系，与现有文献不同，研究表明这样的改革能够降低不平等程度，并提高福利水平，尤其是针对福利水平较低的群体。研究结果基于一个简单模型得出，该模型明确了改革对经济的主要影响途径。此外，研究还表明这些新结果取决于财富和收入的分配情况，并且这些结论适用于相关的实证数据分布。（JEL D31, H23, H25）

abstract.text: We study costless pre-play communication of intentions among inexperienced players. Using the level-k model of strategic thinking to describe players' beliefs, we fully characterize the effects of preplay communication in symmetric 2×2 games. One-way communication weakly increases coordination on Nash equilibrium outcomes, although average payoffs sometimes decrease. Two-way communication further improves payoffs in some games but is detrimental in others. Moving beyond the class of symmetric 2 × 2 games, we find that communication facilitates coordination in common interest games with positive spillovers and strategic complementarities, but there are also games in which any type of communication hampers coordination. (JEL C72, D83)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1695.abstractZh: 我们研究了无成本、在游戏开始前就传达意图的行为。利用策略思维的水平-k模型来描述玩家的信念，我们全面分析了在对称2×2博弈中预沟通的效果。单向沟通在一定程度上增强了纳什均衡结果的协调性，尽管平均收益有时会下降。双向沟通在某些游戏中进一步提升了收益，但在其他游戏中则会产生负面影响。超越对称2×2博弈的范畴，我们发现，在具有正溢出效应和战略互补性的共同利益游戏中，沟通有助于协调，但在某些游戏中，任何形式的沟通都会阻碍协调。 (JEL C72, D83)

abstract.text: We analyze how family ties affect incentives, with focus on the strategic interaction between two mutually altruistic siblings. The siblings exert effort to produce output under uncertainty, and they may transfer output to each other. With equally altruistic siblings, their equilibrium effort is nonmonotonic in the common degree of altruism, and it depends on the harshness of the environment. We define a notion of local evolutionary stability of degrees of sibling altruism and show that this degree is lower than the kinship-relatedness factor. Numerical simulations show how family ties vary with the environment, and how this affects economic outcomes. (JEL D13, D64, J12, Z13)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1725.abstractZh: 我们分析了家庭关系如何影响激励，重点关注两个相互利他的兄弟姐妹之间的策略互动。这些兄弟姐妹在不确定性条件下努力生产产出，并且可能会将产出相互转移。对于同样利他的兄弟姐妹来说，他们的均衡努力与共同的利他程度呈非单调关系，并且取决于环境的严酷程度。我们定义了兄弟姐妹利他程度的地方性进化稳定性概念，并表明这一程度低于亲属关系因素。数值模拟展示了家庭关系如何随环境变化，以及这如何影响经济结果。（JEL D13, D64, J12, Z13）

abstract.text: We study an open economy where a pro-labor and a pro-business candidate compete in an election. The winner chooses taxes, which affect investment returns. Electoral outcomes depend on the size of the foreign debt, but the debt itself reflects expectations about the election. The resulting interaction is novel and has several implications. Elections are associated with increased volatility. Politico-economic crises can occur. Inefficiencies vanish if the candidates commit to an appropriate tax policy, but such commitments have predictable effects on the election. Empirical evidence supporting the theory is discussed. (JEL D72, F34, O17, O19)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1759.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个开放经济体，在这个经济体中，一位支持劳工的政策候选人和一位支持商业的政策候选人在选举中竞争。获胜者会决定税收，而税收会影响投资回报。选举结果取决于外债的规模，但债务本身反映了人们对选举的预期。这种互动是新颖的，并带来一些重要启示。选举与市场波动性的增加有关。政治经济危机也可能发生。如果候选人承诺实施适当的税收政策，这些低效现象就会消失，但这种承诺对选举结果有着可预测的影响。本文还讨论了支持该理论的实证证据。（JEL D72, F34, O17, O19）

abstract.text: Several impatient investors with private costs C i face an indivisible irreversible investment opportunity whose value V is governed by geometric Brownian motion. The first investor i to seize the opportunity receives the entire payoff, V-C i . We characterize the symmetric Bayesian Nash equilibrium for this game. A laboratory experiment confirms the model's main qualitative predictions: competition drastically lowers the value at which investment occurs; usually the lowest-cost investor preempts the other investors; observed investment patterns in competition (unlike monopoly) are quite insensitive to changes in the Brownian parameters. Support is more qualified for the prediction that markups decline with cost. (JEL C73, D44, D82, G31)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1778.abstractZh: 一些缺乏耐心的投资者，其私人成本为C_i，面临一个不可分割、不可逆转的投资机会，该机会的价值V遵循几何布朗运动规律。第一个抓住机会的投资者i将获得全部收益V-C_i。我们描述了该游戏的对称贝叶斯纳什均衡。一项实验室实验证实了模型的主要定性预测：竞争会显著降低投资发生的价值；通常，成本最低的投资者会优先选择其他投资者；与垄断情况不同，竞争中的投资模式对布朗运动参数的变化几乎不敏感。对于“加价随着成本下降”这一预测，我们得到了更有力的支持。（JEL C73, D44, D82, G31）

abstract.text: Can marriage institutions limit marital inefficiency? We study the pervasive custom of watta satta in rural Pakistan, a bride exchange between families coupled with a mutual threat of retaliation. Watta satta can be seen as a mechanism for coordinating the actions of two sets of parents, each wishing to restrain their son-in-law. We find that marital discord, as measured by estrangement, domestic abuse, and wife's mental health, is indeed significantly lower in watta satta versus “conventional” marriage, but only after accounting for selection bias. These benefits cannot be explained by endogamy, a marriage pattern associated with watta satta. (JEL J12, J16, O15, O18, Z13)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1804.abstractZh: 婚姻制度能否限制婚姻的低效率？我们研究了巴基斯坦农村普遍存在的“瓦塔·萨塔”习俗，这是一种由家庭之间进行的新娘交换行为，同时伴随着相互的报复威胁。 “瓦塔·萨塔”可以被视为一种协调双方父母行为的机制，双方都希望约束自己的女婿。我们发现，通过衡量夫妻疏远程度、家庭暴力以及妻子的心理健康状况来衡量的婚姻不和谐程度，在“瓦塔·萨塔”婚姻中确实明显低于“传统”婚姻，但这一差异只有在考虑选择偏差后才会显现。这些好处并不能通过内婚制来解释，内婚制是一种与“瓦塔·萨塔”习俗相关的婚姻模式。（JEL J12, J16, O15, O18, Z13）

abstract.text: Principal-agent relationships are typically assumed to be motivated by efficiency gains from comparative advantage. However, principals may also delegate tasks to avoid taking direct responsibility for selfish or unethical behavior. We report three laboratory experiments in which principals repeatedly either decide how much money to share with a recipient or hire agents to make sharing decisions on their behalf. Across several experimental treatments, recipients receive significantly less, and in many cases close to nothing, when allocation decisions are made by agents. (JEL D82)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1826.abstractZh: 委托-代理关系通常被认为是由比较优势带来的效率收益所驱动的。然而，委托人也可能将任务委托给他人，以避免直接承担自私或不道德行为的责任。我们报告了三项实验室实验，在这些实验中，委托人反复决定与接收者分享多少资金，或者雇佣代理人来代为做出分配决策。在多个实验处理中，当分配决策由代理人做出时，接收者获得的资金显著减少，在许多情况下几乎为零。（JEL D82）

abstract.text: Three quarters of all violence against women is perpetrated by domestic partners. This study exploits exogenous changes in the demand for labor in female-dominated industries to estimate the impact of the male-female wage gap on domestic violence. Decreases in the wage gap reduce violence against women, consistent with a household bargaining model. These findings shed new light on the health production process as well as observed income gradients in health and suggest that in addition to addressing concerns of equity and efficiency, pay parity can also improve the health of American women via reductions in violence.

10.1257/aer.100.4.1847.abstractZh: 四分之三针对女性的暴力行为是由家庭伴侣实施的。本研究利用女性主导行业劳动力需求的外生变化，来估算男女工资差距对家庭暴力的影响。工资差距的缩小有助于减少针对女性的暴力行为，这与家庭议价模型的观点一致。这些发现为健康生产过程以及观察到的健康收入梯度提供了新的见解，并表明除了解决公平和效率问题外，薪酬平等还可以通过减少暴力行为来改善美国女性的健康状况。

abstract.text: The literature on school choice assumes that families can submit a preference list over all the schools they want to be assigned to. However, in many real-life instances families are only allowed to submit a list containing a limited number of schools. Subjects' incentives are drastically affected, as more individuals manipulate their preferences. Including a safety school in the constrained list explains most manipulations. Competitiveness across schools plays an important role. Constraining choices increases segregation and affects the stability and efficiency of the final allocation. Remarkably, the constraint reduces significantly the proportion of subjects playing a dominated strategy (JEL D82, I21)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1860.abstractZh: 关于学校选择的文献通常假设家庭可以提交一份包含所有他们希望被分配到学校的偏好列表。然而，在许多实际情况下，家庭只能提交一份包含有限数量学校的列表。由于更多个体会调整自己的偏好，个体的激励因素会受到极大影响。在受限的列表中包含一所安全学校可以解释大多数选择行为。学校之间的竞争关系也起着重要作用。限制选择会增加学校之间的隔离现象，并影响最终分配方案的稳定性和效率。值得注意的是，这种限制显著降低了采用支配策略的受试者比例（JEL D82, I21）。

abstract.text: To address how technological progress in financial intermediation affects the economy, a costly-state verification framework is embedded into the standard growth model. The framework has two novel ingredients. First, firms differ in the risk/return combinations that they offer. Second, the efficacy of monitoring depends upon the amount of resources invested in the activity. A financial theory of firm size results. Undeserving firms are over-financed, deserving ones under-funded. Technological advance in intermediation leads to more capital accumulation and a redirection of funds away from unproductive firms toward productive ones. With continued progress, the economy approaches its first-best equilibrium. (JEL G21, G31, O16, O33, O41)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1875.abstractZh: 本文探讨了金融中介技术的进步如何影响经济。在标准的增长模型中，引入了一个成本状态验证框架。该框架包含两个创新要素：首先，不同企业提供的风险/回报组合存在差异；其次，监控的有效性取决于投入到该活动中的资源数量。由此产生了关于企业规模的理论。不值得投资的企业会获得过多的资金，而值得投资的企业则会资金不足。金融中介技术的进步促进了资本积累，并使资金从非生产性企业转向生产性企业。随着技术的持续进步，经济将趋近于其最优状态。（JEL G21, G31, O16, O33, O41）

abstract.text: The need for efficient coordination is ubiquitous in organizations and industries. The literature on the determinants of efficient coordination has focused on individual decision making so far. In reality, however, teams often have to coordinate with other teams. We present a series of coordination experiments with a total of 1,101 participants. We find that teams of three subjects each coordinate much more efficiently than individuals. This finding adds one important cornerstone to the recent literature on the conditions for successful coordination. We explain the differences between individuals and teams using the experience weighted attraction learning model. (JEL C71, C91, D23, D83, M54)

10.1257/aer.100.4.1892.abstractZh: 在组织和行业中，高效协调的需求无处不在。迄今为止，关于高效协调决定因素的文献主要集中在个体决策上。然而，实际上，团队往往需要与其他团队进行协调。我们开展了一系列协调实验，共有1,101名参与者参与。我们发现，由三名成员组成的团队比个体团队能够更有效地进行协调。这一发现为最近关于成功协调条件的文献增添了一个重要依据。我们使用经验加权吸引学习模型来解释个体与团队之间的差异。（JEL C71, C91, D23, D83, M54）

abstract.text: Social identities prescribe behaviors for people. We identify the marginal behavioral effect of these norms on discount rates and risk aversion by measuring how laboratory subjects' choices change when an aspect of social identity is made salient. When we make ethnic identity salient to Asian-American subjects, they make more patient choices. When we make racial identity salient to black subjects, non-immigrant blacks (but not immigrant blacks) make more patient choices. Making gender identity salient has no effect on intertemporal or risk choices.

10.1257/aer.100.4.1913.abstractZh: 社会身份为人们的行为设定了规范。我们通过测量当某种社会身份特征被凸显时，实验对象的选择会发生怎样的变化，来研究这些规范对折扣率和风险厌恶的边际影响。当我们将种族身份特征凸显给亚裔美国人实验对象时，他们做出的选择更加耐心。而当我们将种族身份特征凸显给黑人实验对象时，非移民黑人（而非移民黑人）会做出更耐心的选择。而将性别身份特征凸显出来，则对跨时间选择或风险选择没有影响。

abstract.text: Financial crashes were followed by deep recessions in the Sudden Stops of emerging economies. An equilibrium business cycle model with a collateral constraint explains this phenomenon as a result of the amplification and asymmetry that the constraint induces in the responses of macro-aggregates to shocks. Leverage rises during expansions, and when it rises enough it triggers the constraint, causing a Fisherian deflation that reduces credit and the price and quantity of collateral assets. Output and factor allocations fall because access to working capital financing is also reduced. Precautionary saving makes Sudden Stops low probability events nested within normal cycles, as observed in the data. (JEL E21, E23, E32, E44, G01, O11, O16)

10.1257/aer.100.5.1941.abstractZh: 在新兴经济体的“突然停止”过程中，金融危机之后往往伴随着严重的经济衰退。一个带有抵押约束的均衡商业周期模型可以解释这一现象，因为该约束在宏观总量对冲击的响应中引发了放大效应和不对称性。在扩张期间，杠杆率会上升，当杠杆率上升到一定程度时，就会触发这一约束，导致类似费雪式的通缩，从而降低信贷以及抵押资产的价格和数量。由于获得营运资金融资的机会减少，产出和要素分配也会下降。预防性储蓄使得“突然停止”成为正常周期内的低概率事件，这一点在数据中得到了验证。（JEL E21, E23, E32, E44, G01, O11, O16）

abstract.text: We examine the effects of constituents, special interests, and ideology on congressional voting on two of the most significant pieces of legislation in US economic history. Representatives whose constituents experience a sharp increase in mortgage defaults are more likely to support the Foreclosure Prevention Act, especially in competitive districts. Interestingly, representatives are more sensitive to defaults of their own-party constituents. Special interests in the form of higher campaign contributions from the financial industry increase the likelihood of supporting the Emergency Economic Stabilization Act. However, ideologically conservative representatives are less responsive to both constituent and special interests. (JEL D72, G21, G28)

10.1257/aer.100.5.1967.abstractZh: 我们研究了选民、特殊利益团体和意识形态对国会投票的影响，这些投票涉及美国经济史上最重要的两项立法。那些其选民的抵押贷款违约率急剧上升的议员，更有可能支持《止赎预防法案》，尤其是在竞争激烈的选区。有趣的是，议员们对自己政党选民的违约情况更为敏感。以金融行业提供的更多竞选资金为代表的特殊利益团体，增加了他们支持《紧急经济稳定法案》的可能性。然而，意识形态上较为保守的议员对选民和特殊利益团体的影响反应较小。（JEL D72, G21, G28）

abstract.text: Employment at a multinational enterprise (MNE) responds to wages at the extensive margin, when an MNE enters a foreign location, and at the intensive margin, when an MNE operates existing affiliates. We present an MNE model and conditions for parametric and nonparametric identification. Prior studies rarely found wages to affect MNE employment. Our integrated approach documents salient labor substitution for German manufacturing MNEs and removes bias. In Central and Eastern Europe, most employment responds at the extensive margin, while in Western Europe the extensive margin accounts for around two-thirds of employment shifts. At distant locations, MNEs respond to wages only at the extensive margin. (JEL F23, J23, J31, R32)

10.1257/aer.100.5.1999.abstractZh: 跨国企业在进入外国市场时，其雇佣情况会受广泛边际工资的影响；而在运营现有子公司时，则受密集边际工资的影响。我们提出了一个跨国企业模型，并探讨了参数化与非参数化识别的条件。以往的研究很少发现工资会影响跨国企业的雇佣情况。我们的综合研究方法揭示了德国制造跨国企业显著的劳动力替代现象，并消除了偏见。在中欧和东欧，大多数雇佣情况受广泛边际的影响；而在西欧，广泛边际占雇佣变动的约三分之二。在偏远地区，跨国企业仅受广泛边际的工资影响。（JEL F23, J23, J31, R32）

abstract.text: We develop a model that, at the aggregate level, is similar to the one-sector neoclassical growth model; at the disaggregate level, it has implications for the path of observable measures of technology adoption. We estimate it using data on the diffusion of 15 technologies in 166 countries over the last two centuries. Our results reveal that, on average, countries have adopted technologies 45 years after their invention. There is substantial variation across technologies and countries. Newer technologies have been adopted faster than old ones. The cross-country variation in the adoption of technologies accounts for at least 25 percent of per capita income differences. (JEL O33, O41, O47)

10.1257/aer.100.5.2031.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个模型，该模型在总体层面上与单部门新古典增长模型类似；在细分层面上，它对可观测的技术采纳指标的路径产生了影响。我们基于过去两个世纪中166个国家15项技术扩散的数据对该模型进行了估计。我们的研究结果表明，平均而言，各国在发明技术后45年才采纳该技术。不同技术和不同国家之间的采纳速度存在显著差异。较新的技术比旧的技术被采纳得更快。各国在技术采纳上的差异至少可以解释人均收入差异的25%。（JEL O33, O41, O47）

abstract.text: This paper develops a new method to uncover the causal effect of trust on economic growth by focusing on the inherited component of trust and its time variation. We show that inherited trust of descendants of US immigrants is significantly influenced by the country of origin and the timing of arrival of their forebears. We thus use the inherited trust of descendants of US immigrants as a time-varying measure of inherited trust in their country of origin. This strategy allows to identify the sizeable causal impact of inherited trust on worldwide growth during the twentieth century by controlling for country fixed effects. (JEL N11, N12, N31, N32, O47, Z13)

10.1257/aer.100.5.2060.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新方法，通过关注信任的继承成分及其时间变化，来揭示信任对经济增长的因果效应。我们发现，美国移民后代的继承信任显著受到其原籍国以及祖先到达时间的影响。因此，我们将美国移民后代的继承信任作为他们原籍国继承信任的时间变化指标。这一策略有助于在控制国家固定效应的前提下，识别继承信任在二十世纪全球经济增长中的显著因果影响。（JEL N11, N12, N31, N32, O47, Z13）

abstract.text: I develop a novel view of the trade frictions between rich and poor countries by arguing that to reconcile bilateral trade volumes and price data within a standard gravity model, the trade frictions between rich and poor countries must be systematically asymmetric, with poor countries facing higher costs to export relative to rich countries. I provide a method to model these asymmetries and demonstrate the merits of my approach relative to alternatives in the trade literature. I then argue that these trade frictions are quantitatively important to understanding the large differences in standards of living and total factor productivity across countries. (JEL F11, F13, F14, O19)

10.1257/aer.100.5.2093.abstractZh: 我提出了一种关于贫富国家之间贸易摩擦的新观点，认为要在标准重力模型中调和双边贸易量和价格数据，贫富国家之间的贸易摩擦必须具有系统性不对称，即贫穷国家在出口方面面临更高的成本。我提供了一种建模这些不对称性的方法，并证明了我的方法相对于贸易文献中的其他方法的优势。接着，我指出这些贸易摩擦在理解各国生活水平和全要素生产率之间的巨大差异方面具有定量上的重要性。（JEL F11, F13, F14, O19）

abstract.text: Early admissions are widely used by selective colleges and universities. We identify some basic facts about early admissions policies, including the admissions advantage enjoyed by early applicants and patterns in application behavior, and propose a game-theoretic model that matches these facts. The key feature of the model is that colleges want to admit students who are enthusiastic about attending, and early admissions programs give students an opportunity to signal this enthusiasm. (JEL C78, I23)

10.1257/aer.100.5.2125.abstractZh: 选择性学院和大学广泛采用提前录取政策。我们确定了关于提前录取政策的一些基本事实，包括提前申请者所享有的录取优势以及申请行为模式，并提出了一种符合这些事实的博弈论模型。该模型的核心特点是，学院希望录取那些对就读该校充满热情的学生，而提前录取计划则为学生提供了表达这种热情的机会。（JEL C78, I23）

abstract.text: The incidence of bilateral trade costs is calculated here using neglected properties of the structural gravity model, disaggregated by commodity and region, and re-aggregated into forms useful for economic geography. For Canada's provinces, 1992–2003, sellers' incidence is on average some five times higher than buyers' incidence. Sellers' incidence falls over time due to specialization, despite constant gravity coefficients. This previously unrecognized globalizing force drives big reductions in “constructed home bias,” the disproportionate predicted share of local trade; and large but varying gains in real GDP. (JEL F11, F14, R12)

10.1257/aer.100.5.2157.abstractZh: 本文利用结构引力模型中被忽视的特性，按商品和地区进行分解，并将结果重新整合为对经济地理学有用的形式，从而计算出双边贸易成本的发生率。对于加拿大的各省，在1992年至2003年期间，卖方的成本发生率平均是买方的约五倍。尽管引力系数保持不变，但卖方的成本发生率随时间下降，这是由于专业化导致的。这种先前未被认识到的全球化力量，显著降低了“构建性本土偏见”，即本地贸易所占的不成比例的比例；同时，实际GDP也获得了较大但不同的增长。（JEL F11, F14, R12）

abstract.text: We investigate the impact of reputation in a laboratory experiment. We do so by varying whether the past choices of a long-run player are observable by the short-run players. Our framework allows for reputation to have either a beneficial or a harmful effect on the long-run player. We find that reputation is seldom harmful and its beneficial effects are not as strong as theory suggests. When reputational concerns are at odds with other-regarding preferences, we find the latter overwhelm the former. (JEL C91, D12, D82, D83, Z13)

10.1257/aer.100.5.2187.abstractZh: 我们在一个实验室实验中研究了声誉的影响。我们通过改变长期玩家的过去选择是否能被短期玩家观察到这一因素来进行研究。我们的框架允许声誉对长期玩家产生有益或有害的影响。我们发现，声誉很少产生有害影响，其有益效果也不如理论所预测的那么显著。当声誉问题与其他关系偏好相冲突时，我们发现后者会占据主导地位。（JEL C91, D12, D82, D83, Z13）

abstract.text: A novel experiment is used to show that the effect of a policy on the level of cooperation is greater when it is chosen democratically by the subjects than when it is exogenously imposed. In contrast to the previous literature, our experimental design allows us to control for selection effects (e.g. those who choose the policy may be affected differently by it). Our finding implies that democratic institutions may affect behavior directly in addition to having effects through the choice of policies. Our findings have implications for the generalizability of the results of randomized policy interventions.

10.1257/aer.100.5.2205.abstractZh: 一项新颖的实验表明，当政策由受试者通过民主方式选择时，其对合作水平的影响比由外部强加时更为显著。与以往的研究不同，我们的实验设计能够控制选择效应（例如，选择政策的受试者可能会受到不同的影响）。我们的研究发现表明，除了通过政策选择产生影响外，民主制度还可能直接作用于行为。这些发现对于随机政策干预结果的普遍性具有重要意义。

abstract.text: This paper studies equilibrium behavior in a class of games that models asymmetric competitions with unconditional and conditional investments. Such competitions include lobbying settings, labor-market tournaments, and R&D races, among others. I provide an algorithm that constructs the unique equilibrium in these games and apply it to study competitions in which a fraction of each competitor's investment is sunk and the rest is paid only by the winners. Complete-information all-pay auctions are a special case. (JEL D44, D72, D82)

10.1257/aer.100.5.2230.abstractZh: 本文研究了一类博弈中的均衡行为，这些博弈模拟了具有无条件条件和条件性投资的不对称竞争场景。此类竞争包括游说场景、劳动力市场锦标赛以及研发竞赛等。我们提出了一种算法，用于构建这些博弈中的唯一均衡，并应用该算法研究其中一部分竞争者的投资会被浪费，而其余部分仅由胜者获得的情况。完全信息全额拍卖是这类竞争的一个特例。（JEL D44, D72, D82）

abstract.text: This paper reports a three-phase experiment on a stylized labor market. In the first two phases, agents face simple games, which we use to estimate subjects' social and reciprocity concerns. In the last phase, four principals compete by offering agents a contract from a fixed menu. Then, agents “choose to work” for a principal by selecting one of the available contracts. We find that (i) (heterogeneous) social preferences are significant determinants of choices, (ii) for both principals and agents, strategic uncertainty aversion is a stronger determinant of choices than fairness, and (iii) agents display a marked propensity to work for principals with similar distributional concerns. (JEL D82, D86, J41)

10.1257/aer.100.5.2261.abstractZh: 本文报道了一项关于典型劳动力市场的三阶段实验。在前两个阶段中，参与者面临简单的博弈，我们利用这些博弈来估计参与者的社会性和互惠性偏好。在最后一个阶段中，四位负责人通过提供固定菜单中的合同来竞争，参与者则通过选择其中一个合同来决定是否为该负责人“工作”。我们发现：(i) 异质性的社会偏好是选择行为的重要决定因素；(ii) 对于负责人和参与者而言，策略性不确定性厌恶比公平性更能决定选择行为；(iii) 参与者表现出明显的倾向，会选择为具有相似分配关切的负责人工作。(JEL D82, D86, J41)

abstract.text: We analyze contract choices, loan-repayment behavior, and welfare in a model of a competitive credit market when borrowers have a taste for immediate gratification. Consistent with many credit cards and subprime mortgages, for most types of nonsophisticated borrowers the baseline repayment terms are cheap, but they are also inefficiently front loaded and delays require paying large penalties. Although credit is for future consumption, nonsophisticated consumers overborrow, pay the penalties, and back load repayment, suffering large welfare losses. Prohibiting large penalties for deferring small amounts of repayment—akin to recent regulations in the US credit-card and mortgage markets—can raise welfare. (JEL D14, D18, D49, D86)

10.1257/aer.100.5.2279.abstractZh: 我们在一个竞争性信贷市场的模型中分析了合同选择、贷款偿还行为以及福利状况。当借款人倾向于即时满足需求时，与许多信用卡和次级抵押贷款类似，大多数非复杂类型的借款人的基准偿还条款虽然便宜，但偿还期限前置且效率低下，延迟还款则需要支付高额罚款。尽管信贷是用于未来消费，但非复杂的消费者会过度借贷、支付罚款，并推迟还款，从而导致巨大的福利损失。禁止对少量延期还款收取高额罚款——类似于美国信用卡和抵押贷款市场最近实施的监管措施——可以提高福利水平。（JEL D14, D18, D49, D86）

abstract.text: We document that delivery lags and transaction-level economics of scale matter for international trade, leading importers to import infrequently and hold additional inventory. In a model with these frictions calibrated to empirical measures of inventory and trade lumpiness, these frictions have a large (20 percent) tariff equivalent, mostly due to inventory carrying costs. These frictions also alter the dynamics of imports and prices. Consistent with evidence from large devaluation episodes in six developing economies, following terms-of-trade and interest rate shocks, the model generates a short-term implosion of imports and a gradual increase in the retail price of imports. (JEL D92, F14, G31, L81, M11)

10.1257/aer.100.5.2304.abstractZh: 我们证明，交付延迟和交易层面的规模经济效应对国际贸易至关重要，导致进口商较少进行进口交易，并持有更多库存。在一个考虑了这些摩擦因素的模型中，这些摩擦因素对关税的替代效应较大，约为20%，主要归因于库存持有成本。这些摩擦因素还会改变进口行为和价格动态。与六个发展中国家在大规模贬值事件中的证据一致，在贸易条件和利率出现冲击后，该模型预测进口量会出现短期下降，而进口商品的零售价格则会逐渐上升。（JEL D92, F14, G31, L81, M11）

abstract.text: The paper presents a meta dataset covering 13 experiments on social learning games. It is found that in situations where it is empirically optimal to follow others and contradict one's own information, the players err in the majority of cases, forgoing substantial parts of earnings. The average player contradicts her own signal only if the empirical odds ratio of the own signal being wrong, conditional on all available information, is larger than 2:1, rather than 1:1 as would be implied by rational expectations. A regression analysis formulates a straightforward test of rational expectations which strongly rejects the null. (JEL D82, D83, D84)

10.1257/aer.100.5.2340.abstractZh: 该论文提出了一个包含13项关于社交学习游戏的实验的元数据集。研究发现，在那些从经验上最优选择跟随他人并反驳自身信息的情境中，玩家在大多数情况下都会犯错，从而损失大量收益。玩家只有在自身信号的错误概率条件于所有可用信息的情况下大于2:1时才会反驳自己的信号，而不是理性预期所暗示的1:1。通过回归分析，可以对一个理性预期假设进行直接的检验，结果强烈拒绝了原假设。（JEL D82, D83, D84）

abstract.text: We consider the credibility, persuasiveness, and informativeness of multidimensional cheap talk by an expert to a decision maker. We find that an expert with state-independent preferences can always make credible comparative statements that trade off the expert's incentive to exaggerate on each dimension. Such communication benefits the expert—cheap talk is “persuasive”—if her preferences are quasiconvex. Communication benefits a decision maker by allowing for a more informed decision, but strategic interactions between multiple decision makers can reverse this gain. We apply these results to topics including product recommendations, voting, auction disclosure, and advertising. (JEL D44, D72, D82, D83, M37)

10.1257/aer.100.5.2361.abstractZh: 我们研究了专家向决策者进行多维廉价谈话的可信度、说服力以及信息含量。研究发现，具有状态独立偏好的专家总能做出可信的比较性陈述，同时能够平衡专家在每个维度上夸大事实的动机。如果专家的偏好具有准凸性，那么这种沟通方式对专家是有益的——廉价谈话具有“说服力”。这种沟通方式也能使决策者获得更多信息，从而做出更明智的决策。然而，多个决策者之间的策略性互动可能会逆转这种收益。我们将这些结果应用于产品推荐、投票、拍卖信息披露和广告等主题。（JEL D44, D72, D82, D83, M37）

abstract.text: The controversy over how much to charge for health products in the developing world rests, in part, on whether higher prices can increase use, either by targeting distribution to high-use households (a screening effect), or by stimulating use psychologically through a sunk-cost effect. We develop a methodology for separating these two effects. We implement the methodology in a field experiment in Zambia using door-to-door marketing of a home water purification solution. We find evidence of economically important screening effects. By contrast, we find no consistent evidence of sunk-cost effects. (JEL C93, D12, I11, M31, O12)

10.1257/aer.100.5.2383.abstractZh: 关于在发展中国家对健康产品收取多少费用的争议，部分原因在于更高的价格是否能够增加使用量，这可以通过将产品定向提供给高使用量的家庭（筛选效应）来实现，或者通过沉没成本效应在心理上刺激使用行为。我们开发了一种方法来区分这两种效应。我们在赞比亚进行了一项实地实验，采用挨家挨户推销家庭净水解决方案的方式。我们发现存在具有经济意义的筛选效应。相比之下，我们没有发现沉没成本效应的一致证据。（JEL C93, D12, I11, M31, O12）

abstract.text: Entrepreneurs may be legally bound to bequeath a minimal stake to noncontrolling heirs. The size of this stake can reduce investment in family firms, by reducing the future income they can pledge to external financiers. Using a purpose-built indicator of the permissiveness of inheritance law and data for 10,004 firms from 38 countries in 1990–2006, we find that stricter inheritance law is associated with lower investment in family firms but does not affect investment in nonfamily firms. Moreover, as the model predicts, inheritance law affects investment only in family firms that experience a succession. (JEL G31, G32, K22, L26, O17).

10.1257/aer.100.5.2414.abstractZh: 企业家在法律上可能被要求将一定比例的股份留给非控股继承人。这一比例的大小可能会减少对家族企业的投资，因为这将降低这些企业未来能够向外部融资机构提供的收入。通过构建一个专门用于衡量继承法律允许性的指标，并结合1990至2006年间来自38个国家的10,004家企业的数据，我们发现更严格的继承法律与家族企业的投资减少有关，但并不会影响非家族企业的投资。此外，正如模型所预测的那样，继承法律仅对经历继承的家族企业产生影响。（JEL G31, G32, K22, L26, O17）

abstract.text: We modify the principal-agent model with moral hazard by assuming that the agent is expectation-based loss averse according to Kőoszegi and Rabin (2006, 2007). The optimal contract is a binary payment scheme even for a rich performance measure, where standard preferences predict a fully contingent contract. The logic is that, due to the stochastic reference point, increasing the number of different wages reduces the agent's expected utility without providing strong additional incentives. Moreover, for diminutive occurrence probabilities for all signals the agent is rewarded with the fixed bonus if his performance exceeds a certain threshold. (JEL D82, D86, J41, M52, M12)

10.1257/aer.100.5.2451.abstractZh: 我们通过假设代理人根据Kőoszegi和Rabin（2006年，2007年）的研究是基于期望损失的厌恶者，来修改主代理模型中的道德风险问题。即使对于丰富的绩效度量标准，最优合同也是一种二元支付方案，而标准偏好则预测会出现完全依赖绩效的契约。其逻辑在于，由于随机参考点的存在，增加不同工资的数量会降低代理人的期望效用，而不会提供额外的强烈激励。此外，对于所有信号发生概率较低的情况，如果代理人的绩效超过一定阈值，他将获得固定的奖励。（JEL D82, D86, J41, M52, M12）

abstract.text: This paper investigates experimentally how a group's structure affects its ethical behavior towards a passive outsider. We analyze one vertical and two horizontal structures (one requiring consensus, one implementing a compromise by averaging proposals). We also control for internal communication. The data support our main predictions: (1) horizontal, averaging structures are more ethical than vertical structures (where subordinates do not feel responsible) and than consensual structures (where responsibility is dynamically diffused); (2) communication makes vertical structures more ethical (subordinates with voice feel responsible); (3) with communication, vertical structures are more ethical than consensual structures (where in-group bias hurts the outsider). (JEL C92, D23, L21, M14)

10.1257/aer.100.5.2478.abstractZh: 本文通过实验研究，探讨了群体结构对其对待被动外来者的伦理行为的影响。我们分析了一种垂直结构和两种水平结构（一种需要达成共识，另一种通过平均提案来实施妥协）。同时，我们也控制了内部沟通的影响。数据支持了我们的主要预测：（1）水平结构比垂直结构更具有伦理性（在垂直结构中，下属不会感到有责任感），也比共识结构更具有伦理性（在共识结构中，责任会动态分散）；（2）沟通使得垂直结构更具伦理性（有发言权的下属会感到有责任感）；（3）在沟通的情况下，垂直结构比共识结构更具有伦理性（在共识结构中，内群体偏见会对外来者造成伤害）。（JEL C92, D23, L21, M14）

abstract.text: This paper provides the first credible evidence on the economic value of “green buildings” derived from impersonal market transactions rather than engineering estimates. We analyze clusters of certified green and nearby buildings, establishing that “rated” buildings command substantially higher rents and selling prices than otherwise identical buildings. Variations in premiums are systematically related to energy-saving characteristics. Increased energy efficiency is associated with increased selling prices -- beyond the premiums paid for a labeled building. Evidence suggests that the intangible effects of the label itself may also play a role in determining the values of green buildings in the marketplace. (JEL G31,M14,Q52,R33)

10.1257/aer.100.5.2492.abstractZh: 本文首次提供了关于“绿色建筑”经济价值的可靠证据，这些价值来源于非个人市场交易，而非工程估算。我们分析了获得认证的绿色建筑及其附近建筑群，发现“认证”建筑所要求的租金和售价远高于其他相同建筑。溢价与节能特性之间存在系统性关联。能源效率的提高与售价的上升相关——这超出了为标注建筑所支付的溢价。证据表明，标签本身带来的无形效应也可能在决定绿色建筑的市场价值中发挥作用。（JEL G31,M14,Q52,R33）

abstract.text: We use more than a century of Argentine and Mexican data to estimate the structural parameters of a small-open-economy real-business-cycle model driven by nonstationary productivity shocks. We find that the RBC model does a poor job of explaining business cycles in emerging countries. We then estimate an augmented model that incorporates shocks to the country premium and financial frictions.
