We find that the estimated financial-friction model provides a remarkably good account of business cycles in emerging markets and, importantly, assigns a negligible role to nonstationary productivity shocks. (JEL E13, E32, E44, F43, O11, O16)

10.1257/aer.100.5.2510.abstractZh: 我们利用超过一个世纪的阿根廷和墨西哥数据，来估计一个由非平稳生产率冲击驱动的小型开放经济实际商业周期模型的结构参数。我们发现，RBC模型在解释新兴国家的商业周期方面表现不佳。随后，我们估计了一个包含国家溢价冲击和金融摩擦的扩展模型。研究发现，所估计的金融摩擦模型能够很好地解释新兴市场的商业周期，并且重要的是，它认为非平稳生产率冲击的作用微乎其微。（JEL E13, E32, E44, F43, O11, O16）

abstract.text: Heterogeneity is an important determinant of the shape of optimal tax schemes. This is shown here in a model à la Mirrlees. The agents differ in their productivities and opportunity costs of work, but their labor supplies depend only on a given unidimensional combination of these two characteristics. Conditions are provided under which marginal tax rates are everywhere nonnegative. This is the case when work opportunity costs are distributed independently of income. But one can also get negative marginal tax rates, in particular at the bottom of the income distribution. A numerical illustration is given, based on UK data. (JEL H21, H24, H31, J22)

10.1257/aer.100.5.2532.abstractZh: 异质性是确定最优税收方案形式的重要因素。本文采用Mirrlees模型对此进行了说明。各代理人的生产效率和工作机会成本存在差异，但他们的劳动力供给仅取决于这两个特征的一个单一组合。文中提出了一种条件，使得边际税率在任何情况下都是非负的。这种情况发生在工作机会成本与收入无关的情况下。不过，在收入分布的最低端，边际税率也可能为负。文中还基于英国数据给出了数值示例。（JEL H21, H24, H31, J22）

abstract.text: Emotions can have important effects on performance and socioeconomic outcomes. We study a natural experiment where two teams of professionals compete in a tournament taking turns in a sequence. As the sequential order is determined by the random outcome of a coin flip, the treatment and control groups are determined via explicit randomization. Hence, absent any psychological effects, both teams should have the same probability of winning. Yet, we find a systematic first-mover advantage. Further, professionals are self-aware of their own psychological effects and, when given the chance, they rationally react by systematically taking advantage of these effects. (JEL C93, D03, D82, L83)

10.1257/aer.100.5.2548.abstractZh: 情绪对表现和社会经济结果有着重要的影响。我们研究了一个自然实验，其中两支专业团队轮流参加一场锦标赛。由于顺序是由硬币投掷的随机结果决定的，因此实验组和对照组是通过明确的随机化方法确定的。因此，如果没有任何心理效应的影响，两支队伍获胜的概率应该是相同的。然而，我们发现两支队伍之间存在系统性的先发优势。此外，专业人士能够意识到自己的心理效应，并且当有机会时，他们会理性地利用这些效应来获得优势。（JEL C93, D03, D82, L83）

abstract.text: As rapid U.S. health care spending growth continues, the question of whether additional dollars purchase better health or unnecessary care remains in sharp focus for policy makers, large employers, and other stakeholders. To investigate this question, we measured changes in mortality and cost for seven common diagnoses at 122 U.S. hospitals from 2000 to 2004. After adjusting for inflation, we found little correlation between reduced mortality for certain conditions and increased spending on patients with those conditions. The message to be underscored once again for policy makers is that health care dollars provide inconsistent value, and future spending increases should be targeted to care that improves outcomes.

10.1377/hlthaff.2009.0287.abstractZh: 随着美国医疗保健支出的持续快速增长，关于额外的资金是否能够带来更好的健康效果或不必要的护理问题，成为政策制定者、大型雇主及其他利益相关者关注的焦点。为了研究这一问题，我们测量了2000年至2004年间122家美国医院中七种常见疾病的死亡率和成本变化。经过通货膨胀调整后，我们发现某些疾病的死亡率降低与对这些疾病患者的支出增加之间几乎没有相关性。对于政策制定者来说，需要再次强调的是，医疗保健资金的效果并不一致，未来的支出增加应集中在能够改善治疗效果的护理上。

abstract.text: The traditional approaches to improving the quality of care at U.S. nursing homes--regulation, inspection, and accountability through public reporting--have produced modest results. Greater progress could be made by focusing incentives on broader processes related to improving quality. This could foster a culture of upstream identification and solving of problems that would supplement existing downstream requirements to meet specific safety and care standards.

10.1377/hlthaff.2009.0555.abstractZh: 传统上，提高美国养老院护理质量的方法——通过监管、检查和公开报告来加强问责制——取得的成效有限。如果能将激励措施集中在与提升质量相关的更广泛流程上，就能取得更大的进展。这将有助于培养一种能够提前识别并解决问题文化，从而补充现有的下游要求，以达成特定的安全和护理标准。

abstract.text: Per capita Medicare spending is more than twice as high in New York City and Miami than in places like Salem, Oregon. How much of these differences can be explained by Medicare's paying more to compensate for the higher cost of goods and services in such areas? To answer this question, we analyzed Medicare spending after adjusting for local price differences in 306 Hospital Referral Regions. The price-adjustment analysis resulted in less variation in what Medicare pays regionally, but not much. The findings suggest that utilization-not local price differences-drives Medicare regional payment variations, along with special payments for medical education and care for the poor.

10.1377/hlthaff.2009.0609.abstractZh: 纽约市和迈阿密的人均医疗保险支出是俄勒冈州塞勒姆等地区的两倍多。这些差异中，有多少可以通过医疗保险为这些地区更高的商品和服务成本支付更多费用来解释？为了回答这个问题，我们分析了在调整了306个医院转诊地区的当地价格差异后的医疗保险支出。价格调整分析结果显示，医疗保险在地区间的支付差异较小。研究结果表明，导致医疗保险地区间支付差异的是使用率，而非当地价格差异，此外还有针对医学教育和贫困人群护理的特殊支付。

abstract.text: Medicare spending for the elderly is much higher in McAllen, Texas, than in El Paso, Texas, as reported in a 2009 New Yorker article by Atul Gawande. To investigate whether this disparity was present in the non-Medicare populations of those two cities, we obtained medical use and expense data for patients privately insured by Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Texas. In contrast to the Medicare population, the use of and spending per capita for medical services by privately insured populations in McAllen and El Paso was much less divergent, with some exceptions. For example, although spending per Medicare member per year was 86 percent higher in McAllen than in El Paso, total spending per member per year in McAllen was 7 percent lower than in El Paso for the population insured by Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Texas. We consider possible explanations but conclude that health care providers respond quite differently to incentives in Medicare compared to those in private insurance programs.

10.1377/hlthaff.2010.0492.abstractZh: 根据Atul Gawande在2009年《纽约客》杂志上的报道，德克萨斯州麦卡伦市老年人的医疗保险支出远高于埃尔帕索市。为了研究这两个城市非医疗保险人群是否存在类似的差异，我们获取了德克萨斯州蓝十字和蓝盾保险公司为私人保险客户提供的医疗使用及费用数据。与医疗保险人群相比，麦卡伦和埃尔帕索私人保险人群在医疗服务的使用及人均支出方面差异较小，但也有一些例外。例如，尽管麦卡伦的每位医疗保险会员每年的支出比埃尔帕索高出86%，但由蓝十字和蓝盾保险公司承保的麦卡伦人口，每位会员每年的总支出却比埃尔帕索低7%。我们探讨了可能的解释，但得出结论：与医疗保险相比，医疗服务提供者对私人保险计划中的激励措施的反应差异很大。

abstract.text: This work has as objective to analyze the implementation process of the Health Social Organizations (OSS), in the State of São Paulo, focusing the role played by factors as administrative and financial autonomy, direction proposed by the Management Contract and the use of instruments and innovative management practices, as factors that give condition to the gain of efficiency of these OSS facing the Direct Administration units (AD). The adopted approach was the Comparative Study, which proposes the establishment of possibilities, from the confrontation between two units (HOSS and HAD), to identify the elements capable of explaining this difference of performance between the two models of management. The research points to the positive influence of the administrative and financial autonomy, to the direction given to the work processes by goals setting in the Management Contract and innovative management technologies with the intensive use of the information as base for taking decisions. This result, far from indicating the complete conversion of AD to the publicizing by the OSS model, points to the possibilities and limits of development of AD, by the incorporation of management technologies in the OSS environment.

10.1590/s1413-81232010000500023.abstractZh: 本研究旨在分析圣保罗州健康社会组织（OSS）的实施过程，重点关注行政和财务自主权、管理合同所提出的指导方针以及工具和创新管理实践等因素在提高这些组织相对于直接行政单位（AD）效率方面的作用。研究采用了比较研究的方法，通过对比两种管理模式（HOSS与AD），试图找出能够解释两者绩效差异的因素。研究发现，行政和财务自主权对提升效率具有积极影响，管理合同中的目标设定以及以信息为基础的创新管理技术也有助于优化工作流程。这一研究结果虽然并未表明将直接行政模式完全转变为健康社会组织模式，但指出了在健康社会组织环境中引入管理技术对直接行政模式发展的可能性与限制。

abstract.text: Public technology assessments in general and Comparative Effectiveness Research (CER) in particular have been justified by offsetting benefits of improving patient health and reducing health care spending. However, little conceptual and empirical understanding exists concerning the quantitative impact of public technology assessments such as CER. This is needed to assess whether CER has benefits that outweighs its investment costs. This paper provides a systematic framework to analyze the impact of CER on health outcomes and medical care spending. We interpret CER to infuse evidence on product quality into the market place declaring product winners and losers. This shifts demand by patients and doctors as well as coverage by third party payers towards the winners of CER studies and away from losers. We trace out the spending and health implications of such responses to evidence on product quality in privately and publicly financed health care markets. We simulate these effects for antipsychotics that are among the largest drug classes of the US Medicaid program and for which CER has been conducted by means of the CATIE trial in 1999. Our main conclusion, from both the conceptual and empirical analysis, is that investments into CER may not always have the intended benefits of lowering spending and improving health outcomes. Because CER may result in higher spending and worse health, it is important to have methods to evaluate quantitatively the impacts of CER investments.

10.3386/w15633.abstractZh: 公共技术评估，尤其是比较有效性研究，通常被认为能够通过改善患者健康和减少医疗支出来带来抵消性收益。然而，对于公共技术评估（如比较有效性研究）在数量上的影响，目前缺乏概念性和实证性的理解。这种理解对于评估比较有效性研究是否其收益能够抵消其投资成本至关重要。本文提供了一个系统性的框架，用于分析比较有效性研究对健康结果和医疗支出的影响。我们认为，比较有效性研究能够将关于产品质量的证据引入市场，从而明确产品的胜者与败者。这将促使患者和医生以及第三方支付机构将需求转向比较有效性研究中的胜者，而远离败者。我们进一步探讨了这些反应对私人及公共融资医疗市场的支出和健康影响。我们模拟了抗精神病药物这一美国医疗补助计划中最主要的药物类别的效应，该药物类别的比较有效性研究已于1999年通过CATIE试验进行。从概念性和实证性的分析来看，我们的主要结论是：对比较有效性研究的投资并不总是能够带来降低支出和改善健康结果的预期收益。由于比较有效性研究可能导致更高的支出和更差的健康状况，因此拥有定量评估比较有效性研究投资影响的方法非常重要。

abstract.text: We use data from the Whitehall II study to examine the potential role played by early-life health and circumstances in determining health and employment status in middle and older ages. The population from which the Whitehall II cohort was drawn consisted almost exclusively of white collar civil servants. We demonstrate that estimates of the impact of early-life conditions based on the Whitehall II cohort provide a lower bound on the effect of early-life circumstances on adult health and economic status for the population as a whole. That said, using the Whitehall II cohort data, we find early life circumstances are all predictive of entry grade and promotion to higher grade in Whitehall. Even with controls for entry grade or current grade, we find that childhood circumstances predict cohort members' current health status. Using fixed effect and first-difference models of self-assessed health status and civil service employment grade, we find no evidence of civil service grade affecting future self-assessed health. However, we find self-assessed health has a significant effect on future civil service grade.

10.3386/w15640.abstractZh: 我们利用Whitehall II研究的数据，来探讨早年健康状况和境遇在决定中年及老年时期的健康状况和就业状况方面所起的作用。Whitehall II队列的样本几乎完全由白领公务员组成。我们的研究表明，基于Whitehall II队列得出的早年状况影响估计值，为整体人口早年境遇对成年健康和经济状况的影响提供了一个下限。尽管如此，利用Whitehall II队列的数据，我们发现早年境遇能够预测进入特定职位以及晋升到更高职位的机会。即使控制了进入职位或当前职位的情况，我们仍然发现童年境遇能够预测队列成员当前的健康状况。通过固定效应和首次差分模型分析自我评估的健康状况以及公务员的职位等级，我们发现公务员的职位等级并不会影响未来的自我评估健康状况。然而，我们发现自我评估的健康状况对未来的公务员职位等级有显著影响。

abstract.text: We study the impact of mandatory calorie posting on consumers' purchase decisions, using detailed data from Starbucks. We find that average calories per transaction falls by 6%. The effect is almost entirely related to changes in consumers' food choices--there is almost no change in purchases of beverage calories. There is no impact on Starbucks profit on average, and for the subset of stores located close to their competitor Dunkin Donuts, the effect of calorie posting is actually to increase Starbucks revenue. Survey evidence and analysis of commuters suggest the mechanism for the effect is a combination of learning and salience.

10.3386/w15648.abstractZh: 我们研究了强制公布卡路里信息对消费者购买决策的影响，使用了星巴克的详细数据。研究发现，每次交易的平均卡路里摄入量减少了6%。这一影响几乎完全与消费者食物选择的变化有关——饮料的卡路里摄入量几乎没有变化。总体而言，这并未对星巴克的利润产生显著影响；对于位于竞争对手唐恩都乐附近的门店来说，卡路里信息公布反而增加了星巴克的收入。调查数据和通勤者分析表明，这种影响机制是学习与显著性因素的结合。

abstract.text: Medical care at the end of life, estimated to contribute up to a quarter of US health care spending, often encounters skepticism from payers and policy makers who question its high cost and often minimal health benefits. However, though many observers have claimed that such spending is often irrational and wasteful, little explicit analysis exists on the incentives that determine end of life health care spending. This paper attempts to provide the first rational and systematic analysis of the incentives behind end of life care. The main argument we make is that existing theoretical and empirical analysis of the value of life do not apply, and often under-values, the value of life near its end and terminal care. We argue that several factors drive up the value of life near its end including the low opportunity cost of medical spending near ones death, the value of hope including living into new innovations, and the potential positive effect of on the value of life from being frail. We calibrate the ex-post value of hope associated with treatments for HIV patients to be as much as four times as high as standard per-capita estimates of treatment effects and as many as two and a half times as high as aggregate values across all cohorts.

10.3386/w15649.abstractZh: 临终医疗服务的支出估计占美国医疗保健总支出的四分之一，这一领域经常遭到支付方和政策制定者的质疑，他们质疑其高昂的成本以及通常微不足道的健康效益。然而，尽管许多观察家认为这种支出往往是不理智且浪费的，但关于决定临终医疗支出动机的明确分析却很少。本文试图首次对临终医疗服务的动机进行理性且系统的分析。我们的主要观点是，现有的关于生命价值的理论和实证分析并不适用于临终阶段，并且往往低估了临终阶段的生命价值。我们认为，有几个因素提升了临终阶段的生命价值：一是临终时医疗支出的低机会成本；二是希望的价值，包括能够参与新的创新；三是身体虚弱可能对生命价值产生的积极影响。我们对HIV患者治疗相关希望的价值进行了估算，其数值是标准人均治疗效果估计值的四倍，是所有人群综合价值的两倍半。

abstract.text: Over 20 states have adopted laws requiring youths to wear a helmet when riding a bicycle. We confirm previous research indicating that these laws reduced fatalities and increased helmet use, but we also show that the laws significantly reduced youth bicycling. We find this result in standard two-way fixed effects models of parental reports of youth bicycling, as well as in triple difference models of self-reported bicycling among high school youths that explicitly account for bicycling by youths just above the helmet law age threshold. Our results highlight important intended and unintended consequences of a well-intentioned public policy.

10.3386/w15658.abstractZh: 已有20多个州通过了要求青少年骑自行车时必须佩戴头盔的法律。我们证实了先前的研究结果，这些法律确实减少了死亡人数并提高了头盔的使用率，但我们也发现，这些法律显著减少了青少年的骑自行车行为。我们在标准的双向固定效应模型中发现了这一结果，这些模型基于家长对青少年骑自行车行为的报告，同时，在针对高中学生的三重差异模型中，我们也发现了这一结果，这些模型明确考虑了那些年龄略高于头盔法律年龄门槛的青少年的骑自行车行为。我们的研究结果凸显了这项出于善意的公共政策的某些有意和无意的后果。

abstract.text: In a paper presented to the Royal Meteorological Society, Brodie (1905) presented a data series that presaged the modern Environmental Kuznets Curve: in the decades leading up to 1890, the number of foggy days in London rose steadily, but after 1891, the fogs began to subside. Brodie attributed the rise and fall of the London fog to variation in emissions of coal smoke, arguing that before 1890 Londoners burned excessive amounts of soft coal, while in the years following, a series of legal, demographic, and technological changes mitigated the production of coal smoke. This paper asks two questions. First, are Brodie's underlying data trustworthy? Do other, independent sources of evidence same patterns Brodie identified? Was London's atmosphere becoming more polluted and foggy for most of the nineteenth century, only to improve around 1890? Second, if so, is Brodie's interpretation of the data correct? Can the changes in London's atmosphere be attributed to changes in the production of coal smoke, or were they the result of some broader meteorological phenomenon. The evidence we present here is consistent Brodie's data and interpretation.

10.3386/w15669.abstractZh: 在提交给皇家气象学会的一篇论文中，Brodie（1905年）提出了一个数据系列，预示了现代环境库兹涅茨曲线：在1890年之前的几十年里，伦敦的雾天数量稳步增加，但自1891年后，雾气开始减少。Brodie将伦敦雾气的增减归因于煤炭烟雾排放的变化，他认为在1890年之前，伦敦人燃烧了过量的软煤，而在之后的几年里，一系列法律、人口和技术变化减少了煤炭烟雾的产生。这篇论文提出了两个问题。首先，Brodie提供的数据是否可靠？其他独立来源是否也发现了与Brodie相同的模式？整个19世纪，伦敦的大气是否一直受到污染和雾气的困扰，直到1890年左右才有所改善？其次，如果确实如此，Brodie对数据的解释是否正确？伦敦大气的变化是否可以归因于煤炭烟雾产量的变化，还是由某种更广泛的气象现象所导致？我们在这里提供的证据与Brodie的数据和解释是一致的。

abstract.text: Societies socialize children about sex. This is done in the presence of peer-group effects, which may encourage undesirable behavior. Parents want the best for their children. Still, they weigh the marginal gains from socializing their children against its costs. Churches and states may stigmatize sex, both because of a concern about the welfare of their flocks and the need to control the cost of charity associated with out-of-wedlock births. Modern contraceptives have profoundly affected the calculus for instilling sexual mores. As contraception has improved there is less need for parents, churches and states to inculcate sexual mores. Technology affects culture.

10.3386/w15677.abstractZh: 社会在教导儿童关于性的知识时，会考虑到同伴群体的影响，这些因素可能会促使儿童表现出不希望的行为。父母希望自己的孩子能够拥有最好的生活，但他们也会权衡将性知识传授给孩子的边际收益与成本。教会和国家可能会因为对民众福祉的担忧，以及控制非婚生育相关慈善支出的需求，而对性行为进行限制。现代避孕措施的出现，极大地改变了人们灌输性道德观念的方式。随着避孕技术的改进，父母、教会和国家在传授性道德方面的需求已经减少。技术影响着文化。

abstract.text: The long-standing inverse relationship between education and mortality strengthened substantially later in the 20th century. This paper examines the reasons for this increase. We show that behavioral risk factors are not of primary importance. Smoking has declined more for the better educated, but not enough to explain the trend. Obesity has risen at similar rates across education groups, and control of blood pressure and cholesterol has increased fairly uniformly as well. Rather, our results show that the mortality returns to risk factors, and conditional on risk factors, the return to education, have grown over time.

10.3386/w15678.abstractZh: 教育水平与死亡率之间长期存在的负相关关系在20世纪后期得到了显著加强。本文探讨了这一趋势加剧的原因。我们发现，行为性风险因素并非主要影响因素。受过更好教育的群体的吸烟率下降幅度更大，但这一变化不足以解释整体趋势。肥胖率在不同教育群体中的上升幅度相似，血压和胆固醇的控制情况也呈现出相当一致的上升趋势。相反，我们的研究结果表明，死亡率与风险因素之间存在正相关关系，而在风险因素既定的情况下，教育水平对死亡率的改善作用则随着时间而增强。

abstract.text: We examine the extent to which an individual's actual insurance and investment choices display a stable ranking in willingness to bear risk, relative to his peers, across different contexts. We do so by examining the same individuals' decisions regarding their 401(k) asset allocations and their choices in five different employer-provided insurance domains, including health and disability insurance. We reject the null that there is no domain-general component of preferences. Among the five insurance domains, the magnitude of the domain-general component of preferences appears substantial; we find for example that one's choices in other insurance domains are substantially more predictive of one's choice in a given insurance domain than either one's detailed demographic characteristics or one's claims experience in that domain. However, we find considerably less predictive power between one's insurance choices and the riskiness of one's 401(k) asset allocations, suggesting that the common element of an individual's preferences may be stronger among domains that are "closer" in context. We also find that the relationship between insurance and investment choices appears considerably larger for employees who may be associated with better "financial sophistication." Overall, we view our findings as largely consistent with an important domain-general component of risk preferences.

10.3386/w15686.abstractZh: 我们研究了个体在面临不同情境时，其实际保险和投资选择在风险承受能力上的排名是否保持稳定，这一排名是相对于其同龄人而言的。我们通过考察同一个体在401(k)资产配置方面的决策，以及他们在五个不同的雇主提供的保险领域中的选择来进行研究，这些保险领域包括健康和残疾保险。我们拒绝了没有领域通用偏好成分这一假设。在五个保险领域中，领域通用偏好成分的重要性似乎相当显著；例如，我们发现一个人在其他保险领域的选择对于其在某一特定保险领域的选择来说，比其详细的人口特征或在该领域的理赔经验更具预测性。然而，我们发现保险选择与401(k)资产配置的风险性之间的预测能力要弱得多，这表明个体偏好中的共同元素在“更接近”情境的领域中可能更为明显。我们还发现，对于那些可能具有更高“财务成熟度”的员工来说，保险与投资选择之间的关系更为紧密。总体而言，我们认为我们的发现与风险偏好中一个重要的领域通用成分是一致的。

abstract.text: Most non-elderly Americans purchase insurance through their employers, which sponsor a limited number of plans. We estimate how much employees would be willing to pay for the right to apply their employer subsidy to the plan of their choosing. We make use of a proprietary dataset containing information on plan offerings and enrollment for 800+ large employers between 1998 and 2006; the dataset represents over 10 million Americans annually. We estimate a model of employee preferences using the set of plans they are offered. Using the estimated parameters from this model, we predict employees' choices in a hypothetical world in which additional plans in a market are available to them on the same terms, i.e. tax-free and subsidized by their employers. Holding employer outlays constant, we estimate that the median welfare gain from expanding choice amounts to roughly 20 percent of premiums. For the vast majority of employee groups and alternative model specifications, the gains from choice are likely to outweigh potential premium increases associated with a transition from large group to individual pricing.

10.3386/w15687.abstractZh: 大多数非老年美国人通过雇主购买保险，而雇主通常只提供有限数量的保险计划。我们估算了员工愿意支付多少费用，以便将雇主提供的补贴用于他们选择的保险计划。我们使用了包含1998年至2006年间800多家大型雇主的保险计划信息和注册数据的专有数据集，该数据集代表了每年超过1000万美国人的信息。我们利用这些计划数据来估算员工偏好模型。利用该模型估算出的参数，我们预测了在假设条件下，如果市场上提供更多相同条件的保险计划（即免税且由雇主补贴），员工的选择将会如何。在雇主支出保持不变的情况下，我们估计，选择范围的扩大所带来的福利增益大约相当于保费金额的20%。对于绝大多数员工群体和不同的模型设定，选择带来的收益很可能超过从大型团体定价转向个人定价可能导致的保费增加。

abstract.text: Several past studies have found health risk to be negatively correlated with the probability of voluntary health insurance. This is contrary to what one would expect from standard textbook models of adverse selection and moral hazard. The two most common explanations to the counter-intuitive result are either (1) that risk-aversion is correlated with health -- i.e. that healthier individuals are also more risk-averse -- or (2) that insurers are able to discriminate among customers based on observable health-risk characteristics. We revisited these arguments, using data from the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe (SHARE). Self-assessed health served as an indicator of risk: better health, lower risk. We did, indeed, observe a negative correlation between risk and insurance but found no evidence of heterogeneous risk-preferences as an explanation to our finding.

10.3386/w15689.abstractZh: 多项先前的研究发现，健康风险与自愿购买健康保险的概率呈负相关。这与标准教科书中对逆向选择和道德风险的模型预期相悖。对于这一反直觉的结果，最常见的两种解释是：(1)风险厌恶与健康状况相关——即健康状况较好的个体也更厌恶风险；(2)保险公司能够根据可观察到的健康风险特征对顾客进行区分。我们重新审视了这些论点，使用了欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查的数据。自我评估的健康状况被用作风险指标：健康状况越好，风险越低。我们确实观察到风险与保险之间存在负相关关系，但并未发现风险偏好存在异质性的证据作为解释这一发现的原因。

abstract.text: We estimate the impact of diabetic drug adherence on hospitalizations, ER visits, and hospital costs, using insurance claims from MarketScan® employer data. However, it is often difficult to measure the impact of drug adherence on hospitalizations since both adherence and hospitalizations may be correlated with unobservable patient severity. We control for such unobservables using propensity score methods and instrumental variables for adherence such as drug coinsurance levels and direct-to- consumer-advertising. We find a significant bias due to unobservable severity in that patients with more severe health are more apt to comply with medications. Thus, the relationship between adherence and hospitalization will be underestimated if one does not control for unobservable severity. Overall, we find that increasing diabetic drug adherence from 50% to 100% reduced the hospitalization rate by 23.3% (p=0.02) from 15% to 11.5%. ER visits are reduces by 46.2% (p=.04) from 17.3% to 9.3%. While such an increase in adherence increases diabetic drug spending by $776 a year per diabetic, the annual cost savings for averted hospitalizations are $886 per diabetic, a cost offset of $110 (p=0.02), or $1.14 per $1 spent on drugs.

10.3386/w15691.abstractZh: 我们通过使用MarketScan®的雇主数据中的保险索赔，估计了糖尿病药物依从性对住院、急诊就诊和医院费用的影响。然而，由于药物依从性和住院情况可能都与不可观测的患者病情严重程度相关，因此往往难以衡量药物依从性对住院的影响。我们使用倾向得分方法和药物共付水平等工具变量来控制这些不可观测因素。我们发现，由于不可观测的病情严重程度，病情较重的患者更有可能遵守用药规定。因此，如果不控制不可观测的病情严重程度，药物依从性与住院之间的关系将被低估。总体而言，我们发现，将糖尿病药物依从性从50%提高到100%，住院率降低了23.3%（p=0.02），从15%降低到11.5%。急诊就诊次数减少了46.2%（p=0.04），从17.3%降低到9.3%。虽然这种依从性的提高使每位糖尿病患者的药物支出增加了776美元，但避免因住院而节省的年度费用达到了886美元，成本抵消了110美元（p=0.02），即每花费1美元购买药物，就能节省1.14美元。

abstract.text: In this paper we estimate the impacts of climate change on the allocation of time using econometric models that exploit plausibly exogenous variation in daily temperature over time within counties. We find large reductions in U.S. labor supply in industries with high exposure to climate and similarly large decreases in time allocated to outdoor leisure. We also find suggestive evidence of short-run adaptation through temporal substitutions and acclimatization. Given the industrial composition of the US, the net impacts on total employment are likely to be small, but significant changes in leisure time as well as large scale redistributions of income may be consequential. In developing countries, where the industrial base is more typically concentrated in climate-exposed industries and baseline temperatures are already warmer, employment impacts may be considerably larger.

10.3386/w15717.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们运用计量经济模型来估算气候变化对时间分配的影响，这些模型利用了各县域内每日温度随时间变化的合理外生变异。我们发现，美国在受气候影响较大的行业中，劳动力供应大幅减少，用于户外休闲的时间也相应减少。我们还发现了通过时间替代和适应实现的短期适应现象。考虑到美国的产业结构，对总就业的影响可能较小，但休闲时间的显著变化以及大规模的收入重新分配可能是重要的结果。在发展中国家，由于产业基础通常集中在受气候影响的行业，且基准温度已经较高，就业影响可能会更大。

abstract.text: This paper explores the effects of relative food prices on body weight and body fat over time in China. We study a cohort of 15,000 adults from over 200 communities in China, using the longitudinal China Health and Nutrition Survey (1991-2006). While we find that decreases in the price of energy-dense foods have consistently led to elevated body fat, this price effect does not always hold for body weight. These findings suggest that changes in food consumption patterns induced by varying food prices can increase percentage body fat to risky levels even without substantial weight gain. In addition, food prices and subsidies could be used to encourage healthier food consumption patterns and to curb obesity.

10.3386/w15720.abstractZh: 本文探讨了相对食品价格随时间对中国体重和体脂的影响。我们研究了中国200多个社区的15,000名成年人的数据，使用了1991至2006年的中国健康与营养调查数据。研究发现，能量密集型食品价格的下降会持续导致体脂增加，但这种价格效应并不总是适用于体重变化。这些发现表明，由于食品价格变化引发的消费模式改变，即使没有显著的体重增加，也可能导致体脂百分比达到危险水平。此外，食品价格和补贴可以被用来鼓励更健康的消费模式，并遏制肥胖问题。

abstract.text: Generic utilization rates have risen substantially since the enactment of The Drug Price Competition and Patent Term Restoration Act (Hatch-Waxman) in 1984. In the year Hatch-Waxman was enacted, generic utilization rates were 19 percent; in contrast, today, the generic utilization rate is approximately 70 percent. Striking a balance between access to existing medicines and access to yet-to-be-discovered (and developed) drugs, through research incentives, was the principal objective of this landmark legislation. However, given the current rate of generic utilization, it seems plausible, if not likely, that any balance achieved by the 1984 Act has since shifted away from research incentives and towards improved access, ceteris paribus. Among other factors, recent mandatory substitution laws in most states have driven up generic utilization rates. In the current paper, we employ semi-annual data from 1992 to 2008 to examine the link between generic utilization rates and real U.S. prescription drug prices. This link is important because previous research has identified a causal relationship between real drug prices in the U.S. and industry-level R&D investment intensity. We identify a statistically significant, positive relationship between generic utilization rates in the U.S. and real U.S. prescription drug prices. Specifically, we estimate an elasticity of real drug prices to generic utilization rates of -0.15. This finding, when coupled with previous empirical work on the determinants of pharmaceutical R&D intensity, suggests an elasticity of R&D to generic utilization rates of about 0.090. While the magnitude of this elasticity is modest, as theory would predict--the effect of greater generic erosion of brand sales at patent expiration is heavily discounted due to the long time horizon to generic erosion when an R&D project is in clinical development. However, because there has been a very substantial increase in generic utilization rates since 1984, the impact on R&D is nevertheless quite large. We explore this and other issues in the current paper.

10.3386/w15723.abstractZh: 自1984年《药品价格竞争与专利期限恢复法》（Hatch-Waxman法案）颁布以来，仿制药的利用率显著上升。在Hatch-Waxman法案颁布的那一年，仿制药的利用率为19%；而如今，仿制药的利用率约为70%。这项具有里程碑意义的立法的主要目标是通过研究激励措施，在获取现有药物和获取尚未发现（或开发）的药物之间实现平衡。然而，鉴于当前的仿制药利用率，似乎可以认为，1984年法案所实现的平衡已经从研究激励转向了在其它条件不变的情况下改善获取能力。此外，大多数州最近实施的强制替代法律也推动了仿制药利用率的提高。在本文中，我们使用了1992年至2008年的半年数据，来研究仿制药利用率与美国实际处方药价格之间的关系。这种关系非常重要，因为先前的研究已经发现了美国实际药品价格与行业研发投资强度之间的因果关系。我们发现，美国仿制药利用率与实际美国处方药价格之间存在显著的正相关关系。具体来说，我们估计实际药品价格对仿制药利用率的弹性为-0.15。这一发现，结合之前关于药品研发强度决定因素的实证研究，表明研发对仿制药利用率的弹性约为0.090。虽然这种弹性的大小并不显著，正如理论所预测的那样——由于专利到期时仿制药对品牌销售的侵蚀时间跨度很长，因此这一影响被大大低估了。然而，由于自1984年以来仿制药的使用率有了显著增长，对研发活动的影响仍然相当大。我们在本文中探讨了这一问题以及其他相关议题。

abstract.text: In this paper, we take a structural approach to investigate the effects of wages and working hours on health behaviors of low-educated persons using variation in wages and hours caused by changes in economic activity. We find that increases in hours are associated with an increase in cigarette smoking, a reduction in physical activity, and fewer visits to physicians. More importantly, we find that most of the effects associated with changes in hours can be attributed to the changes in the extensive margin of employment. Increases in wages are associated with greater consumption of cigarettes.

10.3386/w15737.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们采用结构主义方法，研究工资和工作时长的变化对低教育水平人群健康行为的影响，这些变化是由经济活动的变化引起的。我们发现，工作时长的增加与吸烟次数的增加、体力活动的减少以及就医次数的减少有关。更重要的是，我们发现，与工作时长变化相关的大部分影响都可以归因于就业范围的变动。工资的增加则与香烟消费量的增加有关。

abstract.text: In June 2009, the World Health Organization declared that novel influenza A (nH1N1) had reached pandemic status worldwide. The response to the spread of this virus by the public and by the public health community was immediate and widespread. Among the responses included voluntary avoidance of public spaces, closure of schools, the ubiquitous placement of hand sanitizer, and the use of face masks in public places. Existing forecasting models of the epidemic spread of nH1N1, used by public health officials to aid in making many decisions including vaccination policy, ignore avoidance responses in the formal modeling. In this paper, we build a forecasting model of the nH1N1 epidemic that explicitly accounts for avoidance behavior. We use data from the U.S. summer and the Australian winter nH1N1 epidemic of 2009 to estimate the parameters of our model and forecast the course of the epidemic in the U.S. in 2010. We find that accounting for avoidance responses results in a better fitting forecasting model. We also find that in models with avoidance, the marginal return in terms of saved lives and reduced infection rates of an early vaccination campaign are higher.

10.3386/w15752.abstractZh: 2009年6月，世界卫生组织宣布新型甲型流感（nH1N1）已在全球范围内引发大流行。公众和公共卫生界对这种病毒传播的应对措施迅速且广泛。这些措施包括自愿避免进入公共场所、关闭学校、在公共场所普遍放置洗手液以及使用口罩。现有的nH1N1疫情传播预测模型由公共卫生官员使用，以协助制定包括疫苗接种政策在内的许多决策，但这些模型并未考虑人们的回避行为。在本文中，我们构建了一个能够明确考虑回避行为的nH1N1疫情预测模型。我们利用了2009年美国夏季和澳大利亚冬季nH1N1疫情的数据来估计模型的参数，并预测2010年美国疫情的发展态势。研究发现，考虑回避行为后，预测模型更为准确。此外，我们还发现，在包含回避行为的模型中，早期疫苗接种活动在挽救生命和减少感染率方面的边际效益更高。

abstract.text: This paper reviews the issues around and impacts of the tax exclusion for employer-sponsored insurance. After reviewing the arguments for and against this policy, I present micro-simulation evidence on the federal revenue, insurance coverage, and distributional impacts of various reforms to the exclusion.

10.3386/w15766.abstractZh: 本文回顾了雇主赞助保险税收豁免政策的相关问题及其影响。在分析了支持与反对该政策的论点后，本文通过微观模拟分析，探讨了该政策对联邦财政收入、保险覆盖范围以及分配影响的各种改革方案。

abstract.text: There is a large and robust correlation between adult health and education, part of which likely reflects causality running from education into health. Less clear is whether education obtained later in life is as valuable for health as are earlier years of schooling, or whether education raises health directly or through income or wealth. In this paper, I examine how the timing of educational attainment is important for adult health outcomes, income, and wealth, in order to illuminate these issues. Among military retirees, a subpopulation with large variation in the final level and timing of educational attainment, the health returns to a year of education are diminishing in age at acquisition, a pattern that is less pronounced for income and wealth. In the full sample, the marginal effects on the probability of fair or poor health at age 55 of a year of schooling acquired before, during, and after a roughly 25-year military career are -0.025, -0.016, and -0.006, revealing a decline of about half a percentage point each decade. These results suggest that education improves health outcomes more through fostering a lifelong accumulation of healthy behaviors and habits, and less through augmenting the flow of income or the stock of physical wealth.

10.3386/w15778.abstractZh: 成年人的健康与教育之间存在密切且显著的相关性，其中部分因果关系可能从教育传递到健康。不过，尚不清楚在生命后期获得的教育是否像早期教育那样对健康有同等价值，或者教育是否直接通过收入或财富来提升健康。本文旨在研究教育获得时机对成年人健康结果、收入和财富的影响，以阐明这些问题。在军队退休人员中，有一部分人群在教育获得的最终水平和时间上存在较大差异，他们每增加一年的教育，55岁时的健康回报会随着年龄的增长而减少，而这一趋势在收入和财富方面则不太明显。在全体样本中，对于在大约25年的军事生涯之前、期间和之后接受一年教育，55岁时健康状况为良好或较差的概率，其边际效应分别为-0.025、-0.016和-0.006，表明每十年健康状况的改善幅度约为0.5个百分点。这些结果表明，教育通过培养终身的健康行为和习惯来改善健康结果，而通过增加收入或物质财富来提升健康的效果则相对较弱。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the impact of cigarette prices on youth smoking in lower-income countries using data from the Global Youth Tobacco Survey (GYTS). Country-level heterogeneity is addressed with fixed effects and by directly controlling for confounding environmental factors such as local anti-smoking sentiment, cigarette advertising, anti-smoking media messages, and compliance with youth access restrictions. We find that cigarette price is an important determinant of both smoking participation and conditional demand. The estimated price elasticity of participation is -0.63. The likelihood of participation decreases with anti-smoking sentiment and increases with exposure to cigarette advertising. The estimated price elasticity of conditional cigarette demand is approximately -1.2. Neither anti-smoking sentiment, cigarette advertising, nor access restrictions have an impact on the intensity of smoking among current smokers, but exposure to anti-smoking media may reduce the number of cigarettes smoked.

10.3386/w15781.abstractZh: 本文利用全球青少年烟草调查的数据，估计了香烟价格对低收入国家青少年吸烟行为的影响。通过固定效应模型以及直接控制混杂的环境因素，如当地的反吸烟情绪、香烟广告、反吸烟媒体宣传以及青少年吸烟限制措施，来应对国家层面的异质性问题。研究发现，香烟价格是决定青少年吸烟参与率和条件需求的重要因素。参与率的估计价格弹性为-0.63，反吸烟情绪越强，参与率越低；而接触香烟广告则会增加参与率。条件性香烟需求的估计价格弹性约为-1.2。反吸烟情绪、香烟广告以及吸烟限制措施对当前吸烟者的吸烟强度没有影响，但反吸烟媒体宣传可能会减少吸烟数量。

abstract.text: The field of Industrial Organization has made dramatic advances over the last few decades in developing empirical methods for analyzing imperfect competition and the organization of markets. We describe the motivation for these developments and some of the successes. We also discuss the relative emphasis that applied work in the field has placed on economic theory relative to statistical research design, and the possibility that a focus on methodological innovation has crowded out applications. We offer some suggestions about how the field may progress in coming years.

10.3386/w15786.abstractZh: 工业组织领域在过去几十年中取得了显著进展，开发了用于分析不完全竞争和市场组织结构的实证方法。我们阐述了这些发展的动机以及一些取得的成果。同时，我们也讨论了该领域在应用研究方面对经济理论与统计研究设计的重视程度，以及方法创新可能导致的应用研究的忽视问题。最后，我们对该领域未来几年的发展提出了一些建议。

abstract.text: This essay reviews progress in empirical economics since Leamer's (1983) critique. Leamer highlighted the benefits of sensitivity analysis, a procedure in which researchers show how their results change with changes in specification or functional form. Sensitivity analysis has had a salutary but not a revolutionary effect on econometric practice. As we see it, the credibility revolution in empirical work can be traced to the rise of a design-based approach that emphasizes the identification of causal effects. Design-based studies typically feature either real or natural experiments and are distinguished by their prima facie credibility and by the attention investigators devote to making the case for a causal interpretation of the findings their designs generate. Design-based studies are most often found in the microeconomic fields of Development, Education, Environment, Labor, Health, and Public Finance, but are still rare in Industrial Organization and Macroeconomics. We explain why IO and Macro would do well to embrace a design-based approach. Finally, we respond to the charge that the design-based revolution has overreached.

10.3386/w15794.abstractZh: 本文回顾了自Leamer（1983年）的批评以来，实证经济学领域的进展。Leamer强调了敏感性分析的重要性，这是一种让研究者展示其研究结果如何随着模型设定或函数形式的变化而变化的程序。敏感性分析对计量经济学实践产生了有益的影响，但并未带来革命性的变革。我们认为，实证研究中的可信度革命可以追溯到一种以设计为基础的方法的兴起，这种方法强调对因果效应的识别。设计基础的研究通常采用真实或自然实验，其特点在于具有初步的可信度，以及研究者对如何解释其设计产生的研究结果所付出的努力。设计基础的研究最常见于发展、教育、环境、劳动、健康和公共财政等微观经济领域，但在产业组织和宏观经济学领域仍然较为罕见。我们解释了为什么产业组织和宏观经济学领域应该采纳这种设计基础的方法。最后，我们回应了关于这种设计基础的方法可能过度扩张的批评。

abstract.text: The seasonal influenza virus afflicts millions of people in the U.S. population each year, imposing significant costs on those who fall ill, their families, employers, and the health care system. The flu is transmitted via droplet spread or close contact, and certain environments, such as schools or offices, promote transmission. In this paper, we examine whether increases in employment are associated with increased incidence of the flu. We use state-level data on the prevalence of the flu from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. In our preferred specification, we find that a one percentage point increase in the employment rate increases the number of influenza related doctor visits by about 16 percent, and these effects are highly pronounced in the retail sector and healthcare sector, the sectors with the highest levels of interpersonal contact.

10.3386/w15796.abstractZh: 季节性流感病毒每年影响美国数百万人口，给患病者、他们的家人、雇主以及医疗保健系统带来巨大负担。流感通过飞沫传播或近距离接触传播，某些环境，如学校或办公室，会促进病毒的传播。在本文中，我们探讨了就业增加是否与流感发病率上升有关。我们使用了美国疾病控制与预防中心提供的州级流感流行数据。在我们的模型设定中，我们发现就业率每提高一个百分点，与流感相关的医生就诊次数就会增加约16%。这些效应在零售行业和医疗保健行业尤为明显，这两个行业的人际接触最为频繁。

abstract.text: This paper explores the consequences of the expiration of charity care requirements imposed on private hospitals by the Hill-Burton Act. We examine delivery care and the health of newborns using the universe of Florida births from 1989-2003 combined with hospital data from the American Hospital Association. We find that charity care requirements were binding on hospitals, but that private hospitals under obligation "cream skimmed" the least risky maternity patients. Conditional on patient characteristics, they provided less intensive maternity services but without compromising patient health. When obligations expired, private hospitals quickly reduced their charity caseloads, shifting maternity patients to public hospitals. There they received more intensive services, but did not experience improvements in health. These results suggest that public hospitals provided services less efficiently than private hospitals constrained to provide charity care.

10.3386/w15798.abstractZh: 本文探讨了《希尔-伯顿法案》对私立医院实施的慈善护理要求到期后的影响。我们通过1989年至2003年间佛罗里达州的出生数据以及美国医院协会提供的医院数据，来研究护理服务的提供情况以及新生儿的健康状况。研究发现，慈善护理要求确实对医院产生了约束力，但受此要求的私立医院在分配产妇患者时，最不倾向于选择风险较低的产妇。根据患者特征，这些私立医院提供了较为低强度的产妇服务，但并未危及患者的健康。当这些要求到期时，私立医院迅速减少了慈善护理的承担量，将产妇患者转至公立医院。在公立医院，产妇患者获得了更为密集的服务，但健康状况并未得到改善。这些结果表明，与那些被要求提供慈善护理的私立医院相比，公立医院的服务效率较低。

abstract.text: A substantial part of the inequality literature in the United States has focused on yearly levels and trends in income and its distribution over time. Recent findings in that literature show that median income appears to be stagnating with income growth primarily coming at higher income levels. But the value of health insurance is an important and growing source of economic well being for American households that is missed by focusing solely on income. In this paper we take estimates of the value of different types of health insurance received by households and add them to usual pre tax post transfer measures of income from the Current Population Survey's March Annual Demographic Supplement for income years 1995-2008 to investigate their impact on levels and trends in measured inequality. We show that ignoring the value of health insurance coverage will substantially understate the level of economic well being of Americans and its upward trend and overstate the level of inequality and its upward trend. As an application of our fuller measure of income, we consider how two provisions of current health reform proposals to expand health insurance affect the level and distribution of economic well being.

10.3386/w15811.abstractZh: 在美国的不平等研究文献中，相当一部分内容集中在收入的年度水平和随时间的变化趋势上。最近的研究发现，中位数收入似乎处于停滞状态，收入增长主要出现在较高收入水平。然而，健康保险的价值是美国家庭经济福祉的重要且不断增长的来源，仅关注收入而忽视这一点是不全面的。在本文中，我们采用了关于家庭所接受的不同类型健康保险价值的估计数据，并将其与《当前人口调查》1995-2008年年度人口统计补充资料中的税前收入数据相结合，以研究其对衡量不平等的水平和趋势的影响。我们发现，忽略健康保险的价值会严重低估美国人的经济福祉水平及其上升趋势，同时高估不平等的水平及其上升趋势。作为我们对收入更全面衡量方法的应用，我们探讨了当前健康改革提案中两项扩大健康保险覆盖范围的条款对经济福祉水平和分布的影响。

abstract.text: This paper revisits the relationship between health and growth in light of modern endogenous growth theory. We propose a unified framework that encompasses the growth effects of both the rate of improvement of health and the level of health. Based on cross-country regressions over the period 1960-2000, where we instrument for both variables, we find that a higher initial level and a higher rate of improvement in life expectancy both have a significantly positive impact on per capita GDP growth. Then, restricting attention to OECD countries, we find supportive evidence that only the reduction in mortality below age forty generates productivity gains, which in turn may explain why the positive correlation between health and growth in cross-OECD country regressions appears to have weakened since 1960.

10.3386/w15813.abstractZh: 本文重新审视了健康与增长之间的关系，基于现代内生增长理论进行了分析。我们提出了一个统一的框架，涵盖了健康改善速度和健康水平对经济增长的影响。通过对1960至2000年期间跨国数据的回归分析，我们发现，较高的初始健康水平和较高的预期寿命改善速度都对人均GDP增长有显著的积极影响。进一步将注意力集中在OECD国家上，我们发现只有降低40岁以下的死亡率才能带来生产率的提升，这或许可以解释为什么在跨OECD国家的回归分析中，健康与增长之间的正相关关系自1960年以来有所减弱。

abstract.text: This paper uses a regression discontinuity design to estimate the effect of home computers on child and adolescent outcomes. We collected survey data from households who participated in a unique government program in Romania which allocated vouchers for the purchase of a home computer to low-income children based on a simple ranking of family income. We show that children in households who received a voucher were substantially more likely to own and use a computer than their counterparts who did not receive a voucher. Our main results indicate that that home computer use has both positive and negative effects on the development of human capital. Children who won a voucher had significantly lower school grades in Math, English and Romanian but significantly higher scores in a test of computer skills and in self-reported measures of computer fluency. There is also evidence that winning a voucher increased cognitive ability, as measured by Raven's Progressive Matrices. We do not find much evidence for an effect on non-cognitive outcomes. Finally, the presence of parental rules regarding computer use and homework appear to mitigate the effects of computer ownership, suggesting that parental monitoring and supervision may be important mediating factors.

10.3386/w15814.abstractZh: 本文采用回归不连续设计来估计家用电脑对儿童及青少年成长的影响。我们收集了来自罗马尼亚一项独特政府计划的家庭调查数据，该计划根据家庭收入简单排名，为低收入儿童提供购买家用电脑的代金券。研究发现，获得代金券的家庭中的儿童比未获得代金券的儿童更有可能拥有并使用电脑。主要结果表明，家用电脑的使用对人类资本的发展既有正面影响，也有负面影响。获得代金券的儿童在数学、英语和罗马尼亚语方面的学业成绩明显较低，但在计算机技能测试以及自我报告的计算机使用能力方面则表现较好。此外，获得代金券的儿童在认知能力方面也有提升，这一提升通过拉文渐进矩阵测试得以体现。我们没有发现对非认知成果有显著影响的证据。最后，关于电脑使用和家庭作业的家长规定似乎能够缓解电脑拥有所带来的影响，这表明家长的监督和指导可能是重要的中介因素。

abstract.text: Substantial uncertainty exists regarding the causal effect of health insurance on the utilization of care. Most studies cannot determine whether the large differences in healthcare utilization between the insured and the uninsured are due to insurance status or to other unobserved differences between the two groups. In this paper, we exploit a sharp change in insurance coverage rates that results from young adults "aging out" of their parents' insurance plans to estimate the effect of insurance coverage on the utilization of emergency department (ED) and inpatient services. Using the National Health Interview Survey (NHIS) and a census of emergency department records and hospital discharge records from seven states, we find that aging out results in an abrupt 5 to 8 percentage point reduction in the probability of having health insurance. We find that not having insurance leads to a 40 percent reduction in ED visits and a 61 percent reduction in inpatient hospital admissions. The drop in ED visits and inpatient admissions is due entirely to reductions in the care provided by privately owned hospitals, with particularly large reductions at for profit hospitals. The results imply that expanding health insurance coverage would result in a substantial increase in care provided to currently uninsured individuals.

10.3386/w15823.abstractZh: 关于健康保险对医疗使用的影响，存在相当大的不确定性。大多数研究无法确定，有保险与无保险之间在医疗使用上的巨大差异是由于保险状态还是其他未观察到的差异造成的。在本文中，我们利用年轻人“脱离父母保险计划”导致保险覆盖率发生显著变化这一事实，来估算保险覆盖率对急诊科和住院服务使用的影响。通过美国国家健康访谈调查以及七个州的急诊科记录和医院出院记录，我们发现，脱离父母保险计划会导致拥有健康保险的概率突然下降5到8个百分点。研究发现，没有保险会导致急诊科就诊次数减少40%，住院次数减少61%。急诊科就诊次数和住院次数的减少完全是由于私人医院提供的医疗服务减少所致，尤其是营利性医院的减少更为明显。这些结果表明，扩大健康保险覆盖范围将显著增加目前无保险人群获得的医疗服务。

abstract.text: The state of Texas began enforcement of the Woman's Right to Know (WRTK) Act on January 1, 2004. The law requires that all abortions at 16 weeks gestation or later be performed in an ambulatory surgical center (ASC). In the month the law went into effect, not one of Texas's 54 non-hospital abortion providers met the requirements of a surgical center. The effect was immediate and dramatic. The number of abortions performed in Texas at 16 weeks gestation or later dropped 88 %, from 3642 in 2003 to 446 in 2004, while the number of residents who left the state for a late abortion almost quadrupled. By 2006, an ASC had opened in 4 major cities down from 9 in 2003 but the abortion rate 16 weeks or more gestation remained 50 percent below its pre-Act level. Regulations of abortion providers that require new facilities or costly renovations could have profound effects on the market for second trimester abortions.

10.3386/w15825.abstractZh: 德克萨斯州于2004年1月1日开始实施《妇女知情权法案》。该法律要求所有在妊娠16周或之后的堕胎手术必须在门诊手术中心进行。在该法律生效的当月，德克萨斯州54家非医院堕胎机构中，没有一家符合手术中心的要求。这一影响是立即且显著的：德克萨斯州在妊娠16周或之后的堕胎数量下降了88%，从2003年的3642例降至2004年的446例；而前往其他州进行晚期堕胎的堕胎机构数量则几乎增加了四倍。到2006年，主要城市中有4家门诊手术中心开业，而2003年时有9家。不过，妊娠16周或以上的堕胎率仍比法案实施前低50%。对堕胎机构的新设要求或昂贵的改造措施，可能会对第二孕期堕胎市场产生深远影响。

abstract.text: This chapter seeks to set out what Economists have learned about the effects of early childhood influences on later life outcomes, and about ameliorating the effects of negative influences. We begin with a brief overview of the theory which illustrates that evidence of a causal relationship between a shock in early childhood and a future outcome says little about whether the relationship in question biological or immutable. We then survey recent work which shows that events before five years old can have large long term impacts on adult outcomes. Child and family characteristics measured at school entry do as much to explain future outcomes as factors that labor economists have more traditionally focused on, such as years of education. Yet while children can be permanently damaged at this age, an important message is that the damage can often be remediated. We provide a brief overview of evidence regarding the effectiveness of different types of policies to provide remediation. We conclude with a list of some of (the many) outstanding questions for future research. Hard-copy subscribers may access the tables for this paper here .

10.3386/w15827.abstractZh: 本章旨在梳理经济学家关于早期童年经历对后期生活结果的影响的研究成果，以及如何减轻负面影响的措施。我们首先简要概述相关理论，指出早期童年经历与未来结果之间的因果关系，并不能说明这种关系是生物学上的还是不可改变的。随后，我们回顾了近期的研究，这些研究表明，五岁之前的经历可能对成年后的结果产生长期影响。在入学时测量的儿童和家庭特征，与劳动经济学家更传统关注的受教育年限等因素一样，对未来的结果有重要的解释作用。尽管儿童在这个年龄可能会受到永久性损害，但一个重要的信息是，这种损害往往是可以弥补的。我们简要介绍了不同类型政策在弥补损害方面的有效性证据。最后，我们列出了一些未来研究需要解决的悬而未决的问题。纸质版订阅者可以在此处访问本文的表格。

abstract.text: We provide a critical review of research in economics that has examined causal relationships between alcohol use and crime. We lay out several causal pathways through which alcohol regulation and alcohol consumption may affect crime, including: direct pharmacological effects on aggression, reaction time, and motor impairment; excuse motivations; venues and social interactions; and victimization risk. We focus our review on four main types of alcohol regulations: price/tax restrictions, age-based availability restrictions, spatial availability restrictions, and temporal availability restrictions. We conclude that there is strong evidence that tax- and age-based restrictions on alcohol availability reduce crime, and we discuss implications for policy and practice.

10.3386/w15828.abstractZh: 我们对研究酒精使用与犯罪之间因果关系的经济学文献进行了批判性综述。我们列出了几种酒精监管和酒精消费可能影响犯罪的途径，包括：对攻击性、反应时间和运动能力的直接药理作用；借酒消遣的动机；饮酒场所和社会互动；以及受害风险。我们的综述重点关注四种主要类型的酒精监管措施：价格/税收限制、基于年龄的供应限制、空间供应限制以及时间供应限制。我们得出结论，有强有力的证据表明，对酒精供应的税收和年龄限制能够降低犯罪率，并讨论了这些发现对政策和实践的影响。

abstract.text: We study how advances in scientific knowledge affect the evolution of disparities in health. Our focus is the 1964 Surgeon General Report on Smoking and Health - the first widely publicized report of the negative effects of smoking on health. Using an historical dataset that includes the smoking habits of pregnant women 1959-1966, we find that immediately after the 1964 Report, more educated mothers immediately reduced their smoking as measured by both self-reports and serum cotinine levels, while the less educated did not, and that the relative health of their newborns likewise increased. We also find strong peer effects in the response to information: after the 1964 report, educated women surrounded by other educated women were more likely to reduce smoking relative to those surrounded by less educated women. Over time, the education gradient in both smoking and newborn health continued to increase, peaking in the 1980s and then shrinking, eventually returning to initial levels. These results can explain why in an era of great advancements in medical knowledge, health disparities may actually increase, at least initially.

10.3386/w15840.abstractZh: 我们研究了科学知识的发展如何影响健康差异的演变。我们的研究重点是1964年《外科医生关于吸烟与健康的报告》——这是第一份广泛宣传的关于吸烟对健康负面影响的报告。通过包含1959-1966年孕妇吸烟习惯的历史数据集，我们发现1964年报告发布后，受教育程度较高的母亲立即减少了吸烟行为，这一变化通过自我报告和血清可替宁水平得以体现；而受教育程度较低的母亲则没有采取类似措施，她们新生儿的相对健康状况也有所改善。我们还发现，对信息的响应中存在强烈的同伴效应：在1964年报告发布后，被其他受教育程度较高的女性包围的受过教育的女性更有可能减少吸烟行为，相比之下，被受教育程度较低的女性包围的女性的这一比例则较低。随着时间的推移，吸烟和新生儿健康方面的教育梯度持续上升，在20世纪80年代达到顶峰，随后逐渐缩小，最终恢复到初始水平。这些结果可以解释为什么在医学知识取得巨大进步的時代，健康差异实际上可能会增加，至少最初是如此。

abstract.text: Using data from a 2003 survey of 1,476 obstetrician-gynecologists, the effects of malpractice pressure on the specialty are investigated. Physicians report having made substantial changes to their practice in response to the general environment and to liability pressures. Regression analysis finds that liability pressure increases reports of income and practice reductions, but direct effects on actual income and productivity are less clear. Liability pressures may lead to a specialization effect, with some physicians concentrating more in obstetrics and others in gynecological surgery. Overall, the evidence suggests that liability pressure has moderate but significant effects on the specialty.

10.3386/w15841.abstractZh: 通过对2003年对1,476名妇产科医生的调查数据进行分析，研究了医疗事故压力对该专业的影响。医生们表示，为了应对整体环境的变化和法律责任压力，他们已经对自己的执业方式进行了重大调整。回归分析发现，法律责任压力增加了关于收入减少和执业范围缩减的报告，但对其实际收入和生产力的影响则不太明显。法律责任压力可能导致专业化的现象，一些医生更专注于妇产科领域，而另一些则专注于妇科手术领域。总体而言，证据表明法律责任压力对该专业有中等程度但显著的影响。

abstract.text: Public-place smoking restrictions are the most important non-price tobacco control measures worldwide, yet surprisingly little is known about their effects on exposure to environmental tobacco smoke (ETS). We study these laws in Canada using data with questions about respondents' ETS exposure in public and private places. In fixed-effects models we find these laws had no effects on smoking but induced large and statistically significant reductions in public-place ETS exposure, especially in bars and restaurants. We do not find significant evidence of ETS displacement to private homes. Our results indicate wide latitude for health improvements from banning smoking in public places.

10.3386/w15849.abstractZh: 公共场所吸烟限制是全球最重要的非价格烟草控制措施，然而，关于这些限制对环境烟草烟雾暴露的影响，我们知之甚少。我们利用包含有关受访者在公共和私人场所暴露于环境烟草烟雾数据的数据，对加拿大的这些法律进行了研究。在固定效应模型中，我们发现这些法律对吸烟行为没有影响，但显著减少了公共场合的环境烟草烟雾暴露，尤其是在酒吧和餐馆中。我们没有发现环境烟草烟雾转向私人住宅的显著证据。我们的研究结果表明，禁止在公共场所吸烟可以在很大程度上改善健康状况。

abstract.text: Concerns over the impacts of hospital strikes on patient welfare led to substantial delay in the ability of hospitals to unionize. Once allowed, hospitals unionized rapidly and now represent one of the largest union sectors of the U.S. economy. Were the original fears of harmful hospital strikes realized as a result? In this paper we analyze the effects of nurses' strikes in hospitals on patient outcomes. We utilize a unique dataset collected on nurses' strikes over the 1984 to 2004 period in New York State, and match these strikes to a restricted use hospital discharge database which provides information on treatment intensity, patient mortality and hospital readmission. Controlling for hospital specific heterogeneity, patient demographics and disease severity, the results show that nurses' strikes increase in-hospital mortality by 19.4% and 30-day readmission by 6.5% for patients admitted during a strike, with little change in patient demographics, disease severity or treatment intensity. This study provides some of the first analytical evidence on the effects of health care strikes on patients, and suggests that hospitals functioning during nurses' strikes are doing so at a lower quality of patient care.

10.3386/w15855.abstractZh: 关于医院罢工对患者福利影响的担忧导致医院组建工会的进程出现了重大延误。一旦被允许，医院工会迅速成立，如今已成为美国经济中最大的工会群体之一。最初的担忧——即医院罢工会带来负面影响——是否真的实现了呢？本文分析了护士罢工对病人治疗效果的影响。我们利用了1984年至2004年间纽约州发生的护士罢工的独特数据集，并将这些罢工事件与医院出院数据库进行匹配，该数据库提供了治疗强度、患者死亡率和医院再入院率的信息。在控制医院特异性、患者人口统计学特征和疾病严重程度等因素后，研究结果显示，护士罢工期间，住院死亡率增加了19.4%，30天再入院率增加了6.5%。而患者人口统计学特征、疾病严重程度和治疗强度几乎没有变化。这项研究提供了关于医疗罢工对患者影响的首批分析证据，并表明在护士罢工期间运营的医院，其患者护理质量较低。

abstract.text: Are many prisoners in jail or prison because of their mental illness? And if so, is mental health treatment a cost-effective way to reduce crime and lower criminal justice costs? This paper reviews and evaluates the evidence assessing the potential of expansion of mental health services for reducing crime. Mental illness and symptoms of mental illness are highly prevalent among adult and child criminal justice populations. The association between serious mental illness and violence and arrest is particularly strong among individuals who are psychotic and do not adhere to medication. Two empirical studies augment the empirical research base relating mental illness to crime. In a recent community sample of adults, we find higher rates of arrest for those with serious mental illness and with substance abuse. Among youth, even with family fixed effects, antisocial personality scores predict future school problems and arrests. A large body of research tracks mental health and criminal justice outcomes associated with treatments and social policies. Reviews of the cost-effectiveness of treatments for children with behavioral problems, mental health courts, and mandatory outpatient treatment are inconclusive.

10.3386/w15858.abstractZh: 许多囚犯是因为精神疾病而被关押在监狱中吗？如果是这样，那么心理健康治疗是否是一种降低犯罪和降低刑事司法成本的有效方式？本文回顾并评估了有关扩大心理健康服务以减少犯罪的潜在效果的文献。精神疾病及其症状在成年和儿童刑事司法人群中非常普遍。在患有严重精神疾病且不遵守药物治疗的人群中，严重精神疾病与暴力行为和逮捕之间的关联尤为明显。两项实证研究进一步丰富了关于精神疾病与犯罪关系的实证研究基础。在一项针对成年人的社区样本中，我们发现患有严重精神疾病和药物滥用行为的人的逮捕率更高。在青少年中，即使考虑到家庭因素的影响，反社会人格评分也能预测未来的学校问题和逮捕情况。大量研究探讨了与治疗和社会政策相关的心理健康和刑事司法结果。关于针对行为问题儿童的治疗、心理健康法庭以及强制性的门诊治疗的成本效益评估结果并不一致。

abstract.text: The trend in the BMI values of the US population has not been estimated accurately because time series data are unavailable and because the focus has been on calculating period effects. In contrast to the prevailing strategies, we estimate the trend and rate of change of BMI values by birth cohorts stratified by gender and ethnicity born 1882-1986. We use loess additive regression models to estimate age and trend effects of BMI values of US-born black and white adults measured between 1959 and 2006. We use all the NHES and NHANES survey data and find that the increase in BMI was already underway among the birth cohorts of the early 20th century. The rate of increase was fastest among black females; for the three other groups under consideration, the rates of increase were similar. The generally persistent upward trend was punctuated by upsurges, particularly after each of the two World Wars. That the estimated rate of change of BMI values increased by 71% among black females between the birth cohorts 1955 and those of 1965 is indicative of the rapid increases in their weight. We infer that transition to post-industrial weights was a gradual process and began considerably earlier than hitherto supposed.

10.3386/w15862.abstractZh: 由于时间序列数据无法获取，且研究重点主要集中在计算时期效应上，因此美国人口BMI值的趋势难以准确估计。与现有研究策略不同，我们通过对1882-1986年间出生的不同性别和种族人群进行分层分析，来估算BMI值的趋势和变化率。我们使用Loess加法回归模型，对1959年至2006年间美国出生的黑人和白人成年人的BMI值随年龄的变化进行了分析。我们利用所有NHES和NHANES调查数据发现，20世纪初出生的群体BMI值增长已经开始。其中，黑人女性的增长速度最快；其他三个群体的增长速度则较为相似。BMI值持续上升的趋势在两次世界大战期间出现了明显的增长高峰。1955年至1965年间，黑人女性的BMI值变化率增加了71%，这表明她们的体重增长速度非常快。我们推断，向后工业时代体重模式的转变是一个渐进的过程，其开始时间比目前认为的要早得多。

abstract.text: The ongoing debate about the economic causes of obesity has focused on the changing relative prices of diet and exercise. This paper uses a model that explicitly includes time and spatially varying community-level urbanicity and price measures as instruments to obtain statistically correct measures for the endogenous effects of diet, physical activity, drinking, and smoking on weight. We apply a dynamic panel system GMM estimation model to longitudinal (1991-2006) data from China to model weight and find that among adult men in China, about 6.1% of weight gain was due to declines in physical activity and 2.9-3.8% was due to dietary changes over this period. In the long run, physical activity can account for around 6.9% of weight gain, while diet can account for 3.2-4.2% of weight gain.

10.3386/w15864.abstractZh: 关于肥胖的经济原因的持续讨论主要集中在饮食与运动相对价格的变化上。本文采用了一个模型，该模型明确包含了时间上的变化以及空间上的城市化程度与价格指标，以此来获得饮食、体力活动、饮酒和吸烟对体重影响的统计上正确的度量。我们应用动态面板系统GMM估计模型，对中国1991-2006年的纵向数据进行了分析，发现在中国成年男性中，约6.1%的体重增加是由于体力活动的减少，而2.9-3.8%的增加则是由于饮食变化所致。从长期来看，体力活动可以解释约6.9%的体重增加，而饮食则可以解释3.2-4.2%的体重增加。

abstract.text: We exploit arguably exogenous train schedule changes in Washington DC to investigate the relationship between public transportation provision, the risky decision to consume alcohol, and the criminal decision to engage in alcohol-impaired driving. Using a triple differences strategy, we provide evidence that overall there was little effect on DUI arrests, alcohol related fatal traffic and alcohol related arrests. However, we find that these overall effects mask considerable heterogeneity across geographic areas and spatial shifting. Specifically, we find that areas close to bars that are within walking distance to Metro stations experience increases in alcohol related arrests and decreases in DUI arrests.

10.3386/w15872.abstractZh: 我们利用华盛顿特区火车时刻表的改变这一可能由外部因素引起的现象，来研究公共交通供给、饮酒的冒险决策以及因酒精影响而引发的犯罪决策之间的关系。通过三重差异策略的分析，我们发现总体上对酒驾逮捕、与酒精相关的致命交通事故以及与酒精相关的逮捕数量几乎没有影响。然而，我们发现这些总体效应掩盖了不同地理区域和空间上的显著差异。具体来说，我们发现靠近酒吧且步行距离内能到达地铁站的区域，与酒精相关的逮捕数量增加，而酒驾逮捕数量则减少。

abstract.text: I analyze the effects of four types of medical innovation and cancer incidence on U.S. cancer mortality rates during the period 2000-2009, by estimating difference-in-differences models using longitudinal (annual) data on about 60 cancer sites (breast, colon, etc.). The outcome measure used is not subject to lead-time bias. I control for mean age at diagnosis, the stage distribution of patients at time of diagnosis, and the sex and race of diagnosed patients. Under the assumption that there were no pre‐dated factors that drove both innovation and mortality and that there would have been parallel trends in mortality in the absence of innovation, the estimates indicate that there were three major sources of the 13.8% decline of the age-adjusted cancer mortality rate during 2000-2009. Drug innovation and imaging innovation are estimated to have reduced the cancer mortality rate by 8.0% and 4.0%, respectively. The decline in incidence is estimated to have reduced the cancer mortality rate by 1.2%. The social value of the reductions in cancer mortality attributable to medical innovations has been enormous, and much greater than the cost of these innovations.

10.3386/w15880.abstractZh: 我通过使用关于60种癌症类型的纵向（年度）数据，估计了四种医疗创新类型对2000-2009年期间美国癌症死亡率的影响，采用了差异-差异模型。所使用的结果指标不受先行偏差的影响。我控制了诊断时的平均年龄、患者诊断时的分期分布，以及被诊断患者的性别和种族。在假设没有先前的因素同时驱动创新和死亡率，并且如果没有创新，死亡率也会呈现类似的趋势的情况下，估计结果显示，2000-2009年间年龄调整后的癌症死亡率下降13.8%的主要来源有三个。药物创新和影像技术的创新分别使癌症死亡率降低了8.0%和4.0%。发病率的下降估计使癌症死亡率降低了1.2%。医疗创新所带来的癌症死亡率降低所带来的社会价值巨大，远远超过了这些创新的成本。

abstract.text: In addition to traditional forms of private and public medical insurance, two other large programs help pay for costs associated with ill health. In 2007, Workers Compensation (WC) insurance provided $55.4 billion in medical care and cash benefits to employees who are injured at work or contract a work-related illness, and Social Security Disability Insurance (DI) provided $99 billion to individuals who suffer from permanent disabilities and are unable to engage in substantial gainful activity. During the 1990s, real DI outlays increased nearly 70 percent, whereas real WC cash benefit spending fell by 12 percent. There has been concern that part of this relationship between two of the nation's largest social insurance programs may be due to individuals substituting towards DI as state WC policies tightened. We test this hypothesis using a number of different WC and DI program parameters. We first show that this negative correlation between the national series does not hold over time within states, the level at which a causal relationship should operate. We then test how regulatory changes in state WC program parameters impact WC outcomes (intended effect) and DI outcomes (unintended effect). We find no compelling evidence of WC tightening causing DI rolls to increase, and conclude it is unlikely that state WC changes were a meaningful factor in explaining the rise in DI.

10.3386/w15895.abstractZh: 除了传统的私人和公共医疗保险形式之外，还有另外两个大型计划帮助支付与健康状况相关费用。2007年，工伤赔偿保险为在工作中受伤或患上与工作相关的疾病的员工提供了554亿美元的医疗护理和现金补助，而社会保障残疾保险则为患有永久性残疾且无法从事实质性有偿活动的个人提供了990亿美元的资金。在1990年代，社会保障残疾保险的实际支出增加了近70%，而工伤赔偿保险的现金补助支出则下降了12%。人们担心，这两个国家最大的社会保障计划之间的这种关系部分可能是由于在州级工伤赔偿政策收紧的情况下，人们转向使用社会保障残疾保险。我们使用多种不同的工伤赔偿和残疾保险计划参数来测试这一假设。我们首先证明，这种全国范围内的负相关关系在州级范围内并不持续，即因果关系应该在州级范围内才成立。然后，我们测试了州级工伤赔偿计划参数的监管变化对工伤赔偿结果（预期效应）和残疾保险结果（非预期效应）的影响。我们没有发现任何令人信服的证据表明工伤赔偿政策的收紧会导致残疾保险参保人数的增加，因此认为州级工伤赔偿政策的改变不太可能是解释残疾保险增加的一个重要因素。

abstract.text: This paper presents new evidence linking trust and subjective well-being, based primarily on data from the Gallup World Poll and cycle 17 of the Canadian General Social Survey (GSS17). Because several of the general explanations for subjective well-being examined here show large and significant linkages to both household income and various measures of trust, it is possible to estimate income-equivalent compensating differentials for different types of trust. Measures of trust studied include general social trust, trust in co-workers, trust in neighbours, and trust in police. In addition, some Canadian surveys and the Gallup World Poll ask respondents to estimate the chances that a lost wallet would be returned to them if found by different individuals, including neighbours, police and strangers. Our results reveal sufficiently strong linkages between trust and well-being to support much more study of how trust can be built and maintained, or repaired where it has been damaged. We therefore use data from the Canadian GSS17 to analyze personal and neighbourhood characteristics, including education, migration history, and mobility, that help explain differences in trust levels among individuals. New experimental data from Canada show that wallets are far more likely to be returned, even by strangers in large cities, than people expect.

10.3386/w15911.abstractZh: 本文提出了新的证据，将信任与主观幸福感联系起来，这些证据主要基于盖洛普世界民意调查和加拿大综合社会调查第17轮的数据。由于这里探讨的几种关于主观幸福感的一般解释与家庭收入以及各种信任指标之间存在显著关联，因此可以估算出不同类型信任所对应的收入补偿差异。所研究的信任指标包括社会整体信任、对同事的信任、对邻居的信任以及对警察的信任。此外，一些加拿大调查和盖洛普世界民意调查还要求受访者估计丢失的钱包如果被不同人找回，包括邻居、警察和陌生人，找回的概率。我们的研究结果揭示了信任与幸福感之间相当强的关联，这支持了对如何建立、维持或修复受损信任进行更深入的研究。因此，我们利用加拿大综合社会调查第17轮的数据来分析个人和社区特征，包括教育水平、迁移历史以及流动性等，这些因素有助于解释个体之间信任水平的差异。来自加拿大的新实验数据表明，即使在大型城市中，陌生人找回丢失的钱包的可能性也远高于人们的预期。

abstract.text: In this paper we contribute new empirical results about consumers' decisions to avoid cigarette excise taxes, and a new applied welfare economic analysis of optimal excise taxation with tax avoidance. We examine direct measures of consumer excise tax avoidance in novel individual-level data from the 2003 and 2006 - 2007 Tobacco Use Supplements to the U.S. Current Population Survey. We estimate reduced-form models and a structural endogenous switching regression model. In the structural border-crossing equation, the decision to cross the border depends on the difference between the endogenous home- and border-state prices. The reduced-form and structural results show that the probability of cross-border cigarette purchases responds in predictable ways to the economic incentives created by the distance to the border and state tax differentials. To our knowledge, we are also the first study to extend the formula for optimal Pigouvian corrective taxation to incorporate excise tax avoidance. Taking into account tax avoidance implies the optimal tax is substantially below the simple Pigouvian tax that internalizes external costs. In illustrative calculations for 2003, we find that in 20 states the optimal tax that accounts for tax avoidance is at least 20 percent smaller than the simple Pigouvian tax.

10.3386/w15941.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们提出了关于消费者如何规避香烟消费税的新实证结果，并对最优消费税征收与税收规避相结合的情况进行了新的应用福利经济分析。我们采用了2003年和2006-2007年《美国当前人口调查》中关于烟草使用的补充数据，通过直接测量方法来研究消费者的消费税规避行为。我们建立了简化形式模型和结构内生转换回归模型。在结构性的边界跨越方程中，跨越边界的决策取决于内生家庭状态与边界状态之间的价格差异。简化形式和结构分析的结果表明，跨境购买香烟的概率会按照预期的方式受到距离边界和州内税收差异所创造的经济激励的影响。据我们所知，这是第一项将最优皮古维修正税公式扩展到包含消费税规避的研究。考虑到税收规避因素，最优税收水平明显低于单纯的内生化外部成本的皮古维税。通过2003年的示例计算，我们发现有20个州的考虑到税收规避的最优税收水平，至少比单纯皮古维税低20%。

abstract.text: We conduct an empirical study of the impact of consumer price-search on the shifting of cigarette excise taxes to consumer prices. We use novel data on the prices smokers report actually paying for cigarettes. We document substantial price dispersion. We find that cigarette taxes are shifted at lower rates to the prices paid by consumers who undertake more price search - carton buyers, and especially, smokers who buy cartons of cigarettes in a state other than their state of residence. We also find suggestive evidence that taxes are shifted at slightly higher rates to the prices paid by non-daily smokers, less addicted smokers, and smokers of light cigarettes.

10.3386/w15942.abstractZh: 我们进行了一项实证研究，探讨消费者价格搜索对香烟消费税向消费者价格转移的影响。我们使用了关于吸烟者实际支付香烟价格的新数据。我们发现价格存在显著的差异。研究发现，对于那些进行更多价格搜索的消费者——如购买整箱香烟的消费者，尤其是那些在居住地以外的州购买整箱香烟的吸烟者——香烟消费税的转移率较低。我们还发现，对于非日常吸烟者、成瘾程度较低的吸烟者以及购买轻型香烟的吸烟者来说，消费税的转移率略高一些。

abstract.text: This study examines the relationship between binge drinking and sexual behavior in nationally representative data on age 18-24 four-year college students. For having sex, overall or without condoms, large and significant positive associations are eliminated upon holding constant proxies for time-invariant sexual activity and drinking preferences. However, strong relationships persist for sex with multiple recent partners, overall and without condoms, even controlling for substance use, risk aversion, mental health, sports participation, and sexual activity frequency. Promiscuity is unrelated with non-binge drinking but even more strongly related with binge drinking on multiple occasions. Results from a rudimentary instrumental variables strategy and accounting for whether sex is immediately preceded by alcohol use suggest that binge drinking directly leads to risky sex. Some binge drinking-induced promiscuity seems to occur among students, especially males, involved in long-term relationships. Effects are concentrated among non-Hispanic whites and are not apparent for students in two-year schools.

10.3386/w15953.abstractZh: 本研究通过18至24岁四年制大学学生的全国代表性数据，探讨了酗酒与性行为之间的关系。总体而言，无论是否使用避孕套，在控制其他变量（如性行为频率、饮酒偏好等）后，酗酒与性行为之间的正相关关系被消除。然而，即使控制物质使用、风险规避、心理健康、体育参与以及性行为频率等因素，与多个近期伴侣发生性行为的关系仍然显著。多性伴侣行为与非酗酒行为无关，但与多次酗酒行为有更强的关联。初步的 instrumental variables 分析结果表明，酗酒直接导致风险性行为。一些由酗酒引发的滥交现象似乎发生在处于长期恋爱关系中的学生中，尤其是男性。这种影响主要集中在非西班牙裔白人学生中，而在两年制学校的学生中则不明显。

abstract.text: Expenditures on prescription drugs are one of the fastest growing components of national health care spending, rising by almost three-fold between 1995 and 2007. Coinciding with this growth in prescription drug expenditures has been a rapid rise in direct-to-consumer advertising (DTCA), made feasible by the Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) clarification and relaxation of the rules governing broadcast advertising in 1997 and 1999. This study investigates the separate effects of broadcast and non-broadcast DTCA on price and demand, utilizing an extended time series of monthly records for all advertised and non-advertised drugs in four major therapeutic classes spanning 1994-2005, a period which enveloped the shifts in FDA guidelines and the large expansions in DTCA. Controlling for promotion aimed at physicians, results from fixed effects models suggest that broadcast DTCA positively impacts own-sales and price, with an estimated elasticity of 0.10 and 0.04 respectively. Relative to broadcast DTCA, non-broadcast DTCA has a smaller impact on sales (elasticity of 0.05) and price (elasticity of 0.02). Simulations suggest that the expansion in broadcast DTCA may be responsible for about 19 percent of the overall growth in prescription drug expenditures over the sample period, with over two-thirds of this impact being driven by an increase in demand as a result of the DTCA expansion and the remainder due to higher prices.

10.3386/w15969.abstractZh: 处方药支出是国家医疗保健支出中增长最快的组成部分之一，在1995年至2007年间增长了近三倍。与处方药支出增长同步的是直接面向消费者广告的迅速增加，这一变化得益于美国食品药品监督管理局在1997年和1999年对广播广告规则的放宽和明确。本研究探讨了广播广告与非广播广告对价格和需求的单独影响，使用了1994年至2005年间所有广告和未广告药物在四个主要治疗类别中的月度记录数据，这一时间段涵盖了FDA指南的变化以及直接面向消费者广告的显著增长。通过控制针对医生的推广活动，固定效应模型的结果表明，广播广告对自售量和价格有积极影响，其估计弹性分别为0.10和0.04。与广播广告相比，非广播广告对销售的影响较小（弹性为0.05），对价格的影响也较小（弹性为0.02）。模拟结果显示，广播广告的扩展可能解释了样本期间处方药支出总体增长的约19%，其中超过三分之二的增长是由直接面向消费者广告的扩展导致的需求增加，其余部分则是由价格上涨引起的。

abstract.text: Using micro data on more than 130,000 individuals from 69 countries, we analyze the extent to which joblessness of the individuals and the prevailing unemployment rate in the country impact perceptions of the effectiveness of democracy. We find that personal joblessness experience translates into negative opinions about the effectiveness of democracy and it increases the desire for a rogue leader. Evidence from people who live in European countries suggests that being jobless for more than a year is the source of discontent. We also find that well-educated and wealthier individuals are less likely to indicate that democracies are ineffective, regardless of joblessness. People's beliefs about the effectiveness of democracy as system of governance are also shaped by the unemployment rate in countries with low levels of democracy. The results suggest that periods of high unemployment and joblessness could hinder the development of democracy or threaten its existence.

10.3386/w15994.abstractZh: 我们基于来自69个国家的超过130,000名个体的微观数据，分析了个人失业状况以及该国普遍存在的失业率对人们对民主有效性的看法的影响。研究发现，个人失业经历会导致对民主有效性的负面看法，并增加人们对无政府领导者的渴望。来自欧洲国家的人的证据表明，失业超过一年是引发不满的根源。我们还发现，无论是否失业，受过良好教育且经济条件较好的个体，不太可能认为民主制度无效。人们对民主作为治理体系的有效性的看法，也受到民主程度较低国家的失业率的影响。研究结果表明，高失业率时期可能会阻碍民主的发展，甚至威胁到民主的存在。

abstract.text: The interaction between offenders and potential victims has so far received relatively little attention in the literature on the economics of crime. The main objective of this paper is twofold: to extend the "market for offenses model" to deal with both "product" and "factor" markets, and to apply it to the case where guns are used for crime commission by offenders and for self-protection by potential victims. Our analysis offers new insights about the association between crime and guns and the limits it imposes on the efficacy of law enforcement and regulatory policies aimed to control both crime and guns.

10.3386/w16009.abstractZh: 在犯罪经济学文献中，犯罪者与潜在受害者之间的互动至今尚未受到足够关注。本文的主要目标有两个：一是将“犯罪市场模型”扩展为同时涵盖“产品市场”和“要素市场”；二是将其应用于犯罪者使用枪支实施犯罪以及潜在受害者出于自卫使用枪支的情况。我们的分析为犯罪与枪支之间的关联提供了新的见解，并揭示了这种关联对执法和监管政策的有效性所带来的限制。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of gaining prescription drug insurance as a result of Medicare Part D on use of prescription drugs, use of other medical services, and health for a nationally representative sample of Medicare beneficiaries. Given the heightened importance of prescription drugs for those with chronic illness, we provide separate estimates for those in poorer health. We find that gaining prescription drug insurance through Medicare Part D was associated with a 70% increase in the number of annual prescriptions, but that obtaining prescription drug insurance is not significantly related to use of other health care services or health, as measured by functional status and self-reported health. Among those in poorer health, we find that gaining prescription drug insurance was associated with a 60% increase in the number of annual prescriptions, and is not significantly related to use of other services or health.

10.3386/w16011.abstractZh: 我们研究了通过Medicare Part D获得处方药保险对处方药使用、其他医疗服务使用以及健康状况的影响，样本来自全国代表性的Medicare受益人。鉴于处方药对于慢性病患者的重要性日益凸显，我们为健康状况较差的人群提供了单独的估计结果。研究发现，通过Medicare Part D获得处方药保险与年度处方数量增加了70%有关，但获得处方药保险与医疗服务使用或健康状况并无显著关联，后者通过功能状态和自我报告的健康状况来衡量。在健康状况较差的人群中，我们发现获得处方药保险与年度处方数量增加了60%有关，但与其他服务的使用或健康状况并无显著关联。

abstract.text: In April 2006, the state of Massachusetts passed legislation aimed at achieving near universal health insurance coverage. A key provision of this legislation, and of the national legislation passed in March 2010, is an individual mandate to obtain health insurance. Although previous researchers have studied the impact of expansions in health insurance coverage among the indigent, children, and the elderly, the Massachusetts reform gives us a novel opportunity to examine the impact of expansion to near-universal health insurance coverage among the entire state population. In this paper, we are the first to use hospital data to examine the impact of this legislation on insurance coverage, utilization patterns, and patient outcomes in Massachusetts. We use a difference-in-difference strategy that compares outcomes in Massachusetts after the reform to outcomes in Massachusetts before the reform and to outcomes in other states. We embed this strategy in an instrumental variable framework to examine the effect of insurance coverage on utilization patterns. Using the Current Population Survey, we find that the reform increased insurance coverage among the general Massachusetts population. Our main source of data is a nationally-representative sample of approximately 20% of hospitals in the United States. Among the population of hospital discharges in Massachusetts, the reform decreased uninsurance by 36% relative to its initial level. We also find that the reform affected utilization patterns by decreasing length of stay and the number of inpatient admissions originating from the emergency room. Using new measures of preventive care, we find some evidence that hospitalizations for preventable conditions were reduced. The reform affected nearly all age, gender, income, and race categories. We also examine costs on the hospital level and find that hospital cost growth did not increase after the reform in Massachusetts relative to other states.

10.3386/w16012.abstractZh: 2006年4月，马萨诸塞州通过了一项旨在实现近乎全民健康保险覆盖的立法。该立法的一个关键条款，以及2010年3月通过的全国性立法的一个关键条款，都是要求个人必须购买健康保险。虽然之前的研究已经探讨了健康保险覆盖范围的扩大对贫困人群、儿童和老年人产生的影响，但马萨诸塞州的改革为我们提供了一个新的机会，可以研究将健康保险覆盖范围扩大到全州人口的影响。在本文中，我们首次使用医院数据来研究这项立法对马萨诸塞州保险覆盖范围、使用模式以及患者结果的影响。我们采用了差异-差异策略，将改革后的马萨诸塞州与改革前的马萨诸塞州以及其他州的结果进行比较。我们将这一策略纳入工具变量框架中，以研究保险覆盖范围对使用模式的影响。通过《当前人口调查》的数据，我们发现改革增加了马萨诸塞州普通人口的健康保险覆盖率。我们的主要数据来源是大约20%的美国医院组成的全国代表性样本。在马萨诸塞州的出院患者中，改革使无保险人数相对于初始水平减少了36%。我们还发现，改革通过减少住院时间和急诊室引发的住院次数，影响了使用模式。通过新的预防护理指标，我们发现因可预防疾病而住院的情况有所减少。这项改革几乎影响了所有年龄、性别、收入和种族类别的人口。我们还研究了医院层面的成本，发现马萨诸塞州在改革后，医院成本的增长并未超过其他州。

abstract.text: There is a strong, positive and well-documented correlation between education and health outcomes. There is much less evidence on the extent to which this correlation reflects the causal effect of education on health - the parameter of interest for policy. In this paper we attempt to overcome the difficulties associated with estimating the causal effect of education on health. Our approach exploits two changes to British compulsory schooling laws that generated sharp differences in educational attainment among individuals born just months apart. Using regression discontinuity methods, we confirm that the cohorts just affected by these changes completed significantly more education than slightly older cohorts subject to the old laws. However, we find little evidence that this additional education improved health outcomes or changed health behaviors. We argue that it is hard to attribute these findings to the content of the additional education or the wider circumstances that the affected cohorts faced (e.g., universal health insurance). As such, our results suggest caution as to the likely health returns to educational interventions focused on increasing educational attainment among those at risk of dropping out of high school, a target of recent health policy efforts.

10.3386/w16013.abstractZh: 教育与健康结果之间存在强烈、积极的且已被充分证实的关联。然而，关于这种关联在多大程度上反映了教育对健康的影响——即政策所关注的变量——的证据却相对较少。在本文中，我们试图克服估算教育对健康因果效应的困难。我们的方法利用了两项英国义务教育法律的变化，这些变化导致同年出生的个体在教育成就上出现了显著差异。通过回归不连续方法，我们确认受这些变化影响的群体所接受的教育年限明显多于那些仍遵循旧法律制度的稍年长的群体。然而，我们发现几乎没有证据表明这种额外的教育改善了健康结果或改变了健康行为。我们认为，很难将这些发现归因于额外教育的内容或受影响群体所面临的更广泛环境（例如，全民健康保险制度）。因此，我们的研究结果提醒人们，在针对那些有辍学风险的人群提高教育水平的健康干预措施上，应持谨慎态度，因为这一目标是近期健康政策努力的重点。

abstract.text: Much has been written about the seemingly less formal, more agile biotechnology industry and its extensive interactions with academia and startups, as well as its distinct scientific, manufacturing and regulatory profile. Employing a data base encompassing all 96 biologics and 212 small molecules newly launched in the U.S. between 1998Q1 and 2008Q4, we compare their downstream clinical and commercial characteristics -- therapeutic class concentration, launch delays following approval, Orphan Drug and priority review status, supplemental indications, black box warning and safety record, and pricing and revenue growth during the product life cycle. We conclude that the market dynamics of biologics differ substantially from those of small molecules, although therapeutic class composition plays a major role.
