10.3386/w16014.abstractZh: 关于看似不那么正式、更加灵活的生物技术产业，以及它与学术界和初创企业的广泛互动，以及其独特的科学、制造和监管特性，已有大量研究。我们运用了一个包含1998年第一季度至2008年第四季度在美国新推出的96种生物制剂和212种小分子药物的数据库，比较了它们的下游临床和商业特征——治疗类别集中度、批准后的上市延迟、孤儿药和优先审评状态、补充适应症、黑盒警告和安全记录，以及产品生命周期中的定价和收入增长。我们的结论是，生物制剂的市场动态与小分子药物有很大不同，尽管治疗类别的构成起着重要作用。

abstract.text: In this handbook of labor economics chapter we examine the relationship between Human Resource Management (HRM) and productivity.HRM includes incentive pay (individual and group) as well as many non-pay aspects of the employment relationship such as matching (hiring and firing) and work organization (e.g.teams, autonomy).We place HRM more generally within the literature on management practices and productivity.We start with some facts on levels and trends of both HRM and productivity and the main economic theories of HRM.We look at some of the determinants of HRM -risk, competition, ownership and regulation.The largest section analyses the impact of HRM on productivity emphasizing issues of methodology, data and results (from micro-econometric studies).We conclude briefly with suggestions of avenues for future frontier work.

10.3386/w16019.abstractZh: 在本篇劳动经济学手册的章节中，我们探讨了人力资源管理（HRM）与生产力之间的关系。HRM包括激励薪酬（个人和团队层面）以及就业关系的许多非薪酬方面，如匹配机制（招聘和解雇）和工作组织方式（例如团队、自主权）。我们将HRM更广泛地置于管理实践与生产力研究的框架内。我们首先介绍了HRM和生产力水平及趋势的一些事实，以及HRM的主要经济理论。接着，我们探讨了影响HRM的一些因素——风险、竞争、所有权和监管。最大的部分分析了HRM对生产力的影响，重点讨论了方法论、数据及结果（来自微观计量经济学研究）方面的问题。最后，我们简要提出了未来研究的方向建议。

abstract.text: Caspi et al. (2002, 2003), Guo et al. (2008a), and Pescosolido et al. (2008) all claim to have demonstrated allele-by-environment interactions, but in all cases environmental influences are potentially endogenous to the unmeasured genetic characteristics of the subjects and their families. Thus, gene-gene interactions cannot be ruled out as an alternative explanation. Second, these studies have not deployed adjustments for multiple hypothesis testing--always an issue, but particularly so for GE studies with multiple alleles and outcomes. Using data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Adolescent Health (Add Health), we address these limitations of previous studies by taking advantage of a natural experiment that randomizes a particular environmental influence - fetal position, resulting in birth weight discordance within monozygotic twin pairs (validated with dizygotic twins as well). Whether or not we use corrections for multiple statistical tests, we find no support for the GE interactions (or for main effects of genes or birth weight) found in past research and, in fact, the only significant allele-birth weight interaction we reveal works in the opposite direction of Caspi et al.'s classic finding on 5-HTT and maltreatment.

10.3386/w16026.abstractZh: Caspi等人（2002年、2003年）、Guo等人（2008a年）以及Pescosolido等人（2008年）都声称已经证明了等位基因与环境之间的相互作用，但在所有情况下，环境因素的影响可能是受试者及其家族未测量到的遗传特征所导致的。因此，不能排除基因间相互作用作为另一种解释的可能性。其次，这些研究没有对多重假设检验进行校正——这始终是一个问题，尤其是在涉及多个等位基因和结果的研究中。利用《全国青少年健康纵向调查》的数据，我们通过利用一个自然实验来弥补以往研究的局限性，该实验随机化了特定的环境影响——胎儿体位，从而导致了单卵双胞胎之间的出生体重差异（在双卵双胞胎中也得到了验证）。无论我们是否使用多重统计检验的校正方法，我们都未能发现过去研究中发现的等位基因-出生体重相互作用的支持证据，事实上，我们发现的唯一显著的等位基因-出生体重相互作用方向与Caspi等人关于5-HTT和虐待的经典研究结果相反。

abstract.text: Medical care is characterized by enormous inefficiency. Costs are higher and outcomes worse than almost all analyses of the industry suggest should occur. In other industries characterized by inefficiency, efficient firms expand to take over the market, or new firms enter to eliminate inefficiencies. This has not happened in medical care, however. This paper explores the reasons for this failure of innovation. I identify two factors as being particularly important in organizational stagnation: public insurance programs that are oriented to volume of care and not value, and inadequate information about quality of care. Recent reforms have aspects that bear on these problems.

10.3386/w16030.abstractZh: 医疗行业的特点是效率极低。成本过高，治疗效果也远低于几乎所有对该行业的分析所预期。在其他效率低下行业中，效率高的企业会扩大规模以占据市场，或者新企业进入市场以消除低效现象。但在医疗行业，这种情况并未发生。本文探讨了这种创新失败的原因。我认为有两个因素在组织停滞中起着特别重要的作用：一是以服务量而非服务质量为导向的公共保险计划，二是关于医疗服务质量的信息不足。最近的一些改革措施与这些问题有关。

abstract.text: In this paper we examine the causal impact of competition on management quality. We analyze the hospital sector where geographic proximity is a key determinant of competition, and English public hospitals where political competition can be used to construct instrumental variables for market structure. Since almost all major English hospitals are government run, closing hospitals in areas where the governing party has a small majority is rare due to fear of electoral punishment. We find that management quality - measured using a new survey tool - is strongly correlated with financial and clinical outcomes such as survival rates from emergency heart attack admissions (AMI). More importantly, we find that higher competition (as indicated by a greater number of neighboring hospitals) is positively correlated with increased management quality, and this relationship strengthens when we instrument the number of local hospitals with local political competition. Adding another rival hospital increases the index of management quality by one third of a standard deviation and leads to a 10.7% reduction in heart-attack mortality rates.

10.3386/w16032.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们探讨了竞争对管理质量的影响。我们分析了医院行业，其中地理位置的接近性是竞争的关键因素；同时，我们也研究了英国公立医院，在这些医院中，政治竞争可以用来构建市场结构的工具变量。由于几乎所有英国的公立医院都是由政府运营的，因此在执政党占微弱多数的地区关闭医院是很罕见的，因为人们担心会面临选举上的惩罚。我们发现，通过新的调查工具衡量的管理质量与财务和临床结果（如急性心肌梗塞入院后的存活率）之间存在强烈的相关性。更重要的是，我们发现，更多的竞争（表现为邻近医院数量的增加）与更高的管理质量呈正相关，而当我们将当地医院数量作为工具变量时，这种关系更加明显。增加一家竞争对手的医院会使管理质量指数增加三分之一标准差，并导致心脏病死亡率降低10.7%。

abstract.text: General medical care in the United States has historically been provided by physicians who care for their patients in both ambulatory and hospital settings. Care is now increasingly divided between physicians specializing in hospital care (hospitalists) and ambulatory-based care primary care physicians. We develop and find strong empirical support for a theoretical model of the division of labor in general medicine that views the use of hospitalists as balancing the costs of coordinating care across physicians in the hospitalist model against physicians' costs switching between ambulatory and hospital settings in the traditional model. Our findings suggest opportunities to improve care.

10.3386/w16040.abstractZh: 在美国，一般的医疗护理历来由在门诊和医院环境中为患者提供治疗的医生负责。如今，这种护理分工越来越明显，一部分医生专注于医院护理（医院医师），另一部分则专注于门诊护理的初级保健医生。我们提出并找到了一个关于一般医学领域劳动分工的理论模型，该模型认为，医院医师的存在有助于平衡医院内不同医生之间协调护理的成本，同时也有助于降低医生在门诊和医院环境之间转换工作的成本。我们的研究结果指出了改善护理的潜在机会。

abstract.text: Previous investigators argued that increasing 5-year survival for cancer patients should not be taken as evidence of improved prevention, screening, or therapy, because they found little correlation between the change in 5-year survival for a specific tumor and the change in tumor-related mortality. However, they did not control for the change in incidence, which influences mortality and is correlated with 5-year survival. We reexamine the question of whether increasing 5-year survival rates constitute evidence of success against cancer, using data from both the U.S. and Australia. When incidence growth is controlled for, there is a highly significant correlation, in both countries, between the change in 5-year survival for a specific tumor and the change in tumor-related mortality. The increase in the relative survival rate is estimated to have reduced the unconditional mortality rate by about 15% in the U.S. between 1976 and 2002, and by about 15% in Australia between 1984 and 2001. While the change in the 5-year survival rate is not a perfect measure of progress against cancer, in part because it is potentially subject to lead-time bias, it does contain useful information; its critics may have been unduly harsh. Part of the long-run increase in 5-year cancer survival rates is due to improved prevention, screening, or therapy.

10.3386/w16051.abstractZh: 先前的研究者认为，癌症患者5年生存率的提高不应被视为预防、筛查或治疗的改进，因为他们发现特定肿瘤的5年生存率变化与肿瘤相关死亡率的变化之间几乎没有相关性。然而，他们没有考虑发病率的变化，而发病率的变化会影响死亡率，并且与5年生存率相关。我们使用美国和澳大利亚的数据重新评估了5年生存率提高是否意味着癌症防治取得了成功的问题。在控制了发病率增长后，两国都发现特定肿瘤的5年生存率变化与肿瘤相关死亡率的变化之间存在高度显著的相关性。据估计，1976年至2002年间，美国的相对生存率提高使无条件死亡率降低了约15%，而在1984年至2001年间，澳大利亚的类似情况也使死亡率降低了约15%。虽然5年生存率的变化并不是衡量癌症防治进展的完美指标，因为这一指标可能受到时间滞后偏差的影响，但它确实包含了有用的信息；其批评者可能过于严厉了。5年癌症生存率长期提高的部分原因是由于预防、筛查或治疗的改进。

abstract.text: Since 2003, Zambia has been engaged in a large-scale, centrally coordinated national anti-Malaria campaign which has become a model in sub-Saharan Africa. This paper aims at quantifying the individual and macro level benefits of this campaign, which involved mass distribution of insecticide treated mosquito nets, intermittent preventive treatment for pregnant women, indoor residual spraying, rapid diagnostic tests, and artemisinin-based combination therapy. We discuss the timing and regional coverage of the program, and critically review the available health and program rollout data. To estimate the health benefits associated with the program rollout, we use both population based morbidity measures from the Demographic and Health Surveys and health facility based mortality data as reported in the national Health Management Information System. While we find rather robust correlations between the rollout of bed nets and subsequent improvements in our health measures, the link between regional spraying and individual level health appears rather weak in the data.

10.3386/w16069.abstractZh: 自2003年以来，赞比亚开展了一项大规模、由中央政府协调的国家抗疟疾运动，这一运动已成为撒哈拉以南非洲地区的典范。本文旨在量化该运动的个体和宏观层面的效益，该运动包括大规模分发杀虫剂处理过的蚊帐、对孕妇进行间歇性预防性治疗、室内滞留喷洒、快速诊断测试以及以青蒿素为基础的联合疗法。我们讨论了该计划的时间安排和区域覆盖范围，并对现有的健康数据和计划实施数据进行了批判性分析。为了估算该计划实施带来的健康效益，我们采用了人口统计调查中的发病率数据以及国家健康管理系统中的医疗机构死亡数据。虽然我们发现蚊帐的普及与随后健康指标的改善之间存在较为稳健的相关性，但区域喷洒与个体健康水平之间的关联在数据中显得较为薄弱。

abstract.text: Exploiting changes in welfare policy across states and over time and comparing relevant population subgroups within an econometric difference-in-differences framework, we estimate the causal effects of welfare reform on adult women's illicit drug use from 1992 to 2002, the period during which welfare reform unfolded in the U.S. The analyses are based on all available and appropriate national datasets, each offering unique strengths and measuring a different drug-related outcome. We investigate self-reported illicit drug use (from the National Surveys on Drug Use and Health), drug-related prison admissions (from the National Corrections Reporting Program), drug-related arrests (from the Uniform Crime Reports), drug-related treatment admissions (from the Treatment Episode Data Set), and drug-related emergency room episodes (from the Drug Abuse Warning Network). We find robust and compelling evidence that welfare reform led to declines in illicit drug use and increases in drug treatment among women at risk for relying on welfare, and some evidence that the effects operate, at least in part, through both TANF drug sanctions and work incentives.

10.3386/w16072.abstractZh: 通过利用各州之间以及不同时期福利政策的变化，并在计量经济学差异-差异框架内比较相关的人口子群体，我们估计了1992年至2002年期间福利改革对成年女性非法药物使用的因果效应。这些分析基于所有可用且合适的国家数据集，每个数据集都提供了独特的优势，并衡量了不同的与药物相关的结果。我们研究了自我报告的非法药物使用（来自《全国药物使用与健康调查》）、与药物相关的监狱入狱人数（来自《国家矫正报告计划》）、与药物相关的逮捕事件（来自《统一犯罪报告》）、与药物相关的治疗入院情况（来自《治疗事件数据集》）以及与药物相关的急诊就诊情况（来自《药物滥用警告网络》）。我们发现，福利改革确实导致了依赖福利的女性的非法药物使用减少以及药物治疗的增加，并且有一些证据表明，这些效应至少部分是通过TANF药物制裁和工作激励措施实现的。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the impact of income on the long-term care utilization of elderly Americans using a natural experiment that led otherwise similar retirees to receive significantly different Social Security payments based on their year of birth. Using data from the 1993 and 1995 waves of the AHEAD, we estimate instrumental variables models and find that a positive permanent income shock lowers nursing home use but increases the utilization of paid home care services. We find some suggestive evidence that the effects are due to substitution of home care for nursing home utilization. The magnitude of these estimates suggests that moderate reductions in post-retirement income would significantly alter long-term utilization patterns among elderly individuals.

10.3386/w16076.abstractZh: 本文通过一项自然实验来估计收入对美国老年人长期护理利用的影响。该实验导致其他类似的退休人员根据出生年份获得显著不同的社会保障支付。利用1993年和1995年AHEAD数据，我们建立了工具变量模型，并发现正向的永久性收入冲击会降低养老院的使用率，但会增加付费家庭护理服务的利用。我们发现一些有说服力的证据表明，这些效应是由于家庭护理替代了养老院利用所致。这些估计结果的幅度表明，退休后收入的适度减少将显著改变老年人的长期利用模式。

abstract.text: Hospitals are currently under pressure to control the cost of medical care, while at the same time improving patient health outcomes. These twin concerns are at play in an important and contentious decision facing hospitals--choosing appropriate nurse staffing levels. Intuitively, one would expect nurse staffing ratios to be positively associated with patient outcomes. If so, this should be a key consideration in determining nurse staffing levels. A number of recent studies have examined this issue, however, there is concern about whether a causal relationship has been established. In this paper we exploit an arguably exogenous shock to nurse staffing levels. We look at the impact of California Assembly Bill 394, which mandated minimum levels of patients per nurse in the hospital setting. When the law was passed, some hospitals already had acceptable staffing levels, while others had nurse staffing ratios that did not meet mandated standards. Thus changes in hospital-level staffing ratios from the pre- to post-mandate periods are driven in part by the legislation. We find persuasive evidence that AB394 did have the intended effect of decreasing patient/nurse ratios in hospitals that previously did not meet mandated standards. However, our analysis suggests that patient outcomes did not disproportionately improve in these same hospitals. That is, we find no evidence of a causal impact of the law on patient safety.

10.3386/w16077.abstractZh: 目前，医院面临着控制医疗成本的同时提高患者健康状况的双重压力。在一项重要且具有争议性的决策中，医院需要权衡这两个问题——即选择合适的护士人员配置水平。从直觉上讲，人们认为护士人员配置比例与患者的治疗效果之间存在正相关关系。如果真是如此，这应该是确定护士人员配置水平时的一个关键考虑因素。尽管最近有一些研究探讨了这个问题，但人们仍然对是否建立了因果关系表示担忧。在本文中，我们利用了一个被认为是外生因素对护士人员配置水平的影响。我们研究了加州议会法案394号的影响，该法案规定了医院中每名护士必须照顾的患者数量的最低标准。在法案通过时，一些医院已经具备了合理的人员配置水平，而另一些医院的护士人员配置比例则未达到规定标准。因此，从法案实施前到实施后的医院人员配置水平的变化，部分是由该立法所驱动的。我们发现有充分证据表明，法案确实起到了降低那些之前不符合规定标准的医院中患者与护士比例的作用。然而，我们的分析表明，这些医院的患者治疗效果并没有得到显著的改善。也就是说，我们没有发现该法律对患者安全产生因果影响的证据。

abstract.text: Previous research has revealed much global convergence over the past several decades in life expectancy at birth and in infant mortality, which are closely linked. But trends in the variance of length of life, and in the variance of length of adult life in particular, are less well understood. I examine life-span inequality in a broad, balanced panel of 180 rich and poor countries observed in 1970 and 2000. Convergence in infant mortality has unambiguously reduced world inequality in total length of life starting from birth, but world inequality in length of adult life has remained stagnant. Underlying both of these trends is a growing share of total inequality that is attributable to between-country variation. Especially among developed countries, the absolute level of between-country inequality has risen over time. The sources of widening inequality in length of life between countries remain unclear, but signs point away from trends in income, leaving patterns of knowledge diffusion as a potential candidate.

10.3386/w16088.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，过去几十年中，出生时的预期寿命和婴儿死亡率这两个紧密相关的指标在全球范围内都呈现出趋同的趋势。然而，关于寿命长度的变化趋势，尤其是成年后的寿命长度变化，目前了解得还不够充分。本研究通过1970年和2000年收集的数据，对180个富裕和贫穷国家的生命跨度不平等进行了全面分析。婴儿死亡率的趋同无疑降低了从出生开始的总寿命长度上的全球不平等，但成年后的寿命长度上的全球不平等却依然停滞不前。这两种趋势背后，都存在着越来越多的不平等现象，这些不平等主要源于国家间的差异。特别是在发达国家中，国家间的不平等程度随时间而上升。关于国家间寿命长度不平等加剧的原因尚不清楚，但一些迹象表明，这种不平等与收入趋势无关，知识传播的模式可能是其中一个潜在原因。

abstract.text: Many developing countries use food-price subsidies or price controls to improve the nutrition of the poor. However, subsidizing goods on which households spend a high proportion of their budget can create large wealth effects. Consumers may then substitute towards foods with higher non-nutritional attributes (e.g., taste), but lower nutritional content per unit of currency, weakening or perhaps even reversing the intended impact of the subsidy. We analyze data from a randomized program of large price subsidies for poor households in two provinces of China and find no evidence that the subsidies improved nutrition. In fact, it may have had a negative impact for some households.

10.3386/w16102.abstractZh: 许多发展中国家通过食品价格补贴或价格管制来提高贫困人口的营养水平。然而，对家庭预算中支出比例较高的商品进行补贴可能会产生较大的财富效应。消费者可能会转向那些具有较高非营养属性（如口感）但单位货币所含营养含量较低的食品，从而削弱甚至逆转补贴的预期效果。我们分析了在中国两个省份实施的针对贫困家庭的随机价格补贴计划的数据，发现这些补贴并未改善营养状况。事实上，对某些家庭而言，补贴可能产生了负面影响。

abstract.text: Economists have devoted considerable resources to estimating local average treatment effects of expansions in Medicaid eligibility for children. In this paper we use random coefficients linear probability models and switching probit models to estimate a more complete range of effects of Medicaid expansion on Medicaid take-up and crowd-out of private insurance. We demonstrate how to estimate, for Medicaid expansions, the average effect among all of those eligible, the average effect for a randomly chosen person, the effect for a marginally eligible child, and the average effect for those affected by a nonmarginal counterfactual policy change. We then estimate the average effect of Medicaid expansions among all eligible children and the average effect for those affected by a nonmarginal counterfactual Medicaid expansion since these are likely to be the most useful for policy analysis. Estimated take-up rates among average eligible children are substantially larger than take-up rates for those made eligible by a counterfactual Medicaid expansion, moreover both of these effects vary widely across demographic groups. In terms of crowd-out, we find statistically significant, though small, effects for all eligible children, but not for those affected by a counterfactual policy change.

10.3386/w16112.abstractZh: 经济学家们投入了大量资源来估算儿童医疗补助资格扩展对当地平均治疗效果的影响。在本文中，我们使用随机系数线性概率模型和转换Probit模型来估算医疗补助扩展对医疗补助接受率和私人保险替代的影响。我们展示了如何估算医疗补助扩展对所有符合条件的人的平均影响、随机选择的人的平均影响、边缘符合条件的儿童的影响，以及受到非边缘反事实政策变化影响的人的平均影响。然后，我们估算了医疗补助扩展对所有符合条件的儿童的平均影响，以及受到非边缘反事实医疗补助扩展影响的人的平均影响，因为这些数据可能对政策分析最为有用。估算出的平均符合条件的儿童接受率远高于因反事实医疗补助扩展而获得资格的儿童的接受率，而且这两种影响在不同人口群体间存在很大差异。在保险替代方面，我们发现所有符合条件的儿童都有统计学上显著但较小的替代效应，而受到反事实政策变化影响的儿童则没有这种效应。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the impact of binge drinking on sexual activity among a nationally representative set of high school students during the 1990s and 2000s. The main innovations are explicitly controlling for time-invariant preferences regarding sexual behavior and alcohol use, and eliminating non-drinkers from the comparison group. I find that binge drinking significantly increases participation in sex, promiscuity, and the failure to use birth control, albeit by amounts considerably smaller than implied by merely conditioning on exogenous factors. For all outcomes, impacts rise substantially with binge drinking frequency. Results are similar using alternative comparison groups defined by excluding those who do not exhibit other risky behaviors, and by gender and race/ethnicity, but vary by grade level and over time in different ways for engaging in sex than protective behavior. Effects are much larger for the small fraction of students that has not been taught about AIDS/HIV infection in school.

10.3386/w16132.abstractZh: 本文估计了在1990年代和2000年代，酗酒对高中生性活动的影响。主要创新之处在于明确控制了关于性行为和酒精使用的时不变偏好，并排除了不饮酒者作为比较组。研究发现，酗酒显著增加了性行为的参与、滥交以及不使用避孕措施的行为，尽管这些影响的幅度远小于仅基于外部因素得出的结果。对于所有结果而言，酗酒频率的增加对性活动的影响显著增强。使用其他比较组的结果也类似，这些比较组排除了那些没有表现出其他危险行为的人，并且考虑了性别和种族/民族因素，但不同年级水平以及不同时间点上，性行为与保护性行为之间的影响有所不同。对于在学校未接受过艾滋病/HIV感染教育的学生来说，这种影响更为显著。

abstract.text: We study how the health and health insurance coverage of Mexican immigrants change with time in the US. Cross-sectional analyses suggest that approximately three decades of residency in the US is associated with a 9 to 11 percentage point (12% to 15%) decline in the probability of being uninsured for Mexican men and women. However, analysis using longitudinal data and fixed effects methods show that time in the US is unrelated to health insurance coverage. Both cross sectional and longitudinal analyses provide evidence of unhealthy assimilation--self-reported health declines slightly with time in the US.

10.3386/w16139.abstractZh: 我们研究了墨西哥移民在美国的健康状况和医疗保险覆盖情况随时间的变化。横断面分析表明，在美国居住大约三十年后，墨西哥男性和女性的无保险概率会下降9到11个百分点（从12%降至15%）。然而，使用纵向数据和固定效应方法的分析显示，在美国的时间长短与医疗保险覆盖情况无关。无论是横断面分析还是纵向分析，都表明存在不健康的同化现象——墨西哥移民在美国的时间越长，他们的健康状况略有下降。

abstract.text: This paper addresses three basic questions about an under-studied food subsidy program, the Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP): (1) Does CACFP reach targeted low-income children? (2) How do eligible families and child care providers who participate differ from those who do not participate? (3) What is the association between attending CACFP-participating child care and children's food intake, weight, and food security? We use the Early Childhood Longitudinal Study, Birth Cohort to examine these questions for a representative sample of young children and their providers. We find that program eligibility rules leave many poor children outside the CACFP program. Yet, among poor preschoolers in center-based care, participation in the program is correlated with positive outcomes such as increased consumption of milk and vegetables, and healthier weight (BMI). We discuss the implications of our findings, especially in relation to other food and child care subsidy programs.

10.3386/w16148.abstractZh: 本文探讨了关于一项研究不足的食品补贴计划——儿童与成人护理食品计划（CACFP）的三个基本问题：(1) CACFP是否惠及目标中的低收入儿童？(2) 参与该计划的符合条件的家庭和儿童保育提供者与非参与者有何不同？(3) 参与CACFP的儿童保育服务与儿童的食物摄入、体重以及食物安全之间存在何种关联？我们采用早期儿童纵向研究出生队列样本来研究这些问题，以了解年轻儿童及其保育提供者的情况。研究发现，该计划的资格规则导致许多贫困儿童未能纳入计划范围。然而，在中心式保育下的贫困学龄前儿童中，参与该计划与一些积极的结果相关，如牛奶和蔬菜的摄入量增加，以及更健康的体重（BMI）。我们讨论了这些发现的意义，尤其是在与其他食品及儿童保育补贴计划相关的背景下。

abstract.text: The combination of economic and biological factors is likely to result in overeating, in the current environment of cheap and readily available food. This propensity is shown using a "dual-decision" approach where choices reflect the interaction between two parts of the brain: a "deliberative" system, operating as in standard economic models, and an "affective" system that responds rapidly to stimuli without considering long-term consequences. This framework is characterized by excess food consumption and body weight, in the sense that individuals prefer both ex-ante and ex-post to eat and weigh less than they actually do, with dieting being common but often unsuccessful or only partially successful. As in the standard model, weight will be related to prices. However, another potentially important reason for rising obesity is that food producers have incentives to engineer products to stimulate the affective system so as to encourage overeating. Data from multiple waves of the National Health and Nutrition Examination Surveys are used to investigate predictions of the dual-decision model, with the evidence providing broad support for at least some irrationality in food consumption.

10.3386/w16149.abstractZh: 在食物廉价且易于获取的环境中，经济因素与生物因素的结合可能导致过度进食。这种倾向可以通过“双重决策”模型来体现，其中个体的选择反映了大脑两个部分的相互作用：一个“理性”系统，如同标准经济模型中的那样运作；另一个“情感”系统则对刺激迅速作出反应，而不考虑长期后果。这一框架的特点是过度食物摄入和体重增加，因为个体在事前和事后都倾向于进食，并且体重比实际体重要轻。节食虽然常见，但通常效果不佳或仅部分有效。与标准模型类似，体重将与价格相关。然而，肥胖率上升的另一个潜在重要原因可能是食品生产商有动机设计产品以刺激情感系统，从而鼓励过度进食。通过多次全国健康与营养调查的数据来验证双重决策模型的预测，这些证据为食物消费中的某些非理性行为提供了广泛支持。

abstract.text: We examine the impact of the expansion of public prescription drug insurance coverage from Medicare Part D on the elderly and find evidence of substantial crowd-out. Using detailed data from the 2002-7 waves of the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey (MEPS), we estimate that the extension of Part D benefits resulted in 80% crowd-out of both prescription drug insurance coverage and prescription drug expenditures of those 65 and older. Part D is associated with only modest reductions in out-of-pocket spending. This suggests that the welfare gain from protecting the elderly from out-of-pocket spending risk through Part D has been small.

10.3386/w16155.abstractZh: 我们研究了从医疗保险D部分扩展公共处方药保险对老年人的影响，发现存在显著的排斥现象。利用2002-2007年医疗支出调查的详细数据，我们估计D部分福利的扩展导致65岁及以上人群在处方药保险覆盖和处方药支出方面分别出现了80%的排斥现象。D部分仅对自付支出产生了适度的减少效果。这表明，通过D部分保护老年人免受自付支出风险的影响所带来的福利收益其实很小。

abstract.text: The effect of competition on the quality of health care remains a contested issue. Most empirical estimates rely on inference from non experimental data. In contrast, this paper exploits a pro-competitive policy reform to provide estimates of the impact of competition on hospital outcomes. The English government introduced a policy in 2006 to promote competition between hospitals. Patients were given choice of location for hospital care and provided information on the quality and timeliness of care. Prices, previously negotiated between buyer and seller, were set centrally under a DRG type system. Using this policy to implement a difference-in-differences research design we estimate the impact of the introduction of competition on not only clinical outcomes but also productivity and expenditure. Our data set is large, containing information on approximately 68,000 discharges per year per hospital from 162 hospitals. We find that the effect of competition is to save lives without raising costs. Patients discharged from hospitals located in markets where competition was more feasible were less likely to die, had shorter length of stay and were treated at the same cost.

10.3386/w16164.abstractZh: 竞争对医疗保健质量的影响仍然是一个有争议的问题。大多数实证估计都依赖于非实验数据的推断。相比之下，本文利用一项支持竞争的政策改革，来估算竞争对医院结果的影响。英国政府在2006年引入了一项政策，以促进医院之间的竞争。患者可以选择接受医院护理的地点，并获得了关于护理质量和及时性的信息。价格由买家和卖家协商确定，但在DRG类型系统中被集中设定。利用这一政策实施差异-差异研究设计，我们估算了引入竞争不仅对临床结果，而且对生产力和支出的影响。我们的数据集非常庞大，包含了162家医院每年约68,000例出院的信息。我们发现，竞争的效果是在不增加成本的情况下挽救生命。在竞争更为可行的市场中出院的患者，死亡风险更低，住院时间更短，且治疗费用相同。

abstract.text: There is conflicting evidence on the importance of out-of-pocket medical expenditures as a risk to financial security, particularly at older ages. We revisit this question, focusing on health care spending near the end of life using data from the Health and Retirement Study for the years 1998-2006. We address difficulties with missing values for various categories of expenditures, outliers, and variations across individuals in the length of the reporting period. Spending in the last year of life is estimated to be $11,618 on average, with the 90th percentile equal to $29,335, the 95th percentile $49,907, and the 99th equal to $94,310. These spending measures represent a substantial fraction of liquid wealth for decedents. Total out-of-pocket expenditures are strongly positively related to wealth and weakly related to income. We find evidence for a mechanism by which wealth could plausibly buy health: large expenditures on home modifications, helpers, home health care, and higher-quality nursing homes, which have been shown elsewhere to improve longevity.

10.3386/w16170.abstractZh: 关于自付医疗费用对财务安全的影响，存在不同的研究结果，尤其是在老年阶段。我们重新审视了这一问题，重点关注1998至2006年间健康与退休研究数据中的临终期医疗支出情况。我们发现，各类支出的数据缺失、异常值以及报告期间个体之间的差异都给分析带来了困难。在生命的最后一年，平均支出为11,618美元，其中第90百分位的支出达到29,335美元，第95百分位的支出为49,907美元，而第99百分位的支出则高达94,310美元。这些支出金额占逝者流动资产的重要比例。自付支出与财富之间存在强烈的正相关关系，但与收入的关系则较为微弱。我们的研究还发现，财富可能通过多种方式促进健康：例如对房屋改造、雇佣辅助人员、家庭护理以及选择质量更高的养老院等支出，这些做法在其他研究中已被证明能够延长寿命。

abstract.text: Uganda is widely viewed as a public health success for curtailing its HIV/AIDS epidemic in the early 1990s. We investigate the factors contributing to this decline. We first build a model of HIV transmission. Calibration of the model indicates that reduced pre-marital sexual activity among young women is the most important factor in the decline in HIV. We next explore what led young women to change their behavior. We estimate that approximately one-third the reduction in HIV in this cohort and almost 20 percent of the overall HIV decline was due to a gender-targeted education policy.

10.3386/w16171.abstractZh: 乌干达在20世纪90年代初成功控制了HIV/AIDS疫情，被广泛认为是公共卫生方面的成功案例。我们研究了导致这一下降的因素。首先，我们建立了一个关于HIV传播的模型。模型校准表明，年轻女性婚前性行为的减少是降低HIV感染率的最重要因素。接下来，我们探讨了促使年轻女性改变行为的原因。我们估计，这一群体中HIV感染率的下降约有三分之一，而整体HIV感染率的下降则接近20%，这主要归功于针对性别的教育政策。

abstract.text: We use data from The National Longitudinal Survey of Adolescent Health to estimate effects of adolescent girls' overweight on their propensity to engage in risky sexual behavior. We estimate single equation, two-stage, and sibling fixed-effects models and find that overweight or obese teenage girls are more likely than their recommended-weight peers to engage in certain types of risky sexual behavior but not others. The results from this study underscore the importance of using multifaceted and contemporary measures of risky sexual behavior and have implications for the health and well-being of adolescent girls.

10.3386/w16172.abstractZh: 我们使用《全国青少年健康纵向调查》的数据来估算青少年女孩的超重状况对其从事风险性性行为倾向的影响。我们通过单方程、两阶段模型以及兄弟姐妹固定效应模型进行估计，发现超重的或肥胖的青少年女孩比体重处于推荐范围内的同龄人更有可能从事某些类型的风险性性行为，但并不会从事其他类型的行为。这项研究的结果强调了使用多方面且现代化的方法来衡量风险性性行为的重要性，并对青少年女孩的健康与福祉具有启示意义。

abstract.text: In 2006 San Francisco adopted major health reform, becoming the first city to implement a pay-or-play employer health spending mandate. It also created Healthy San Francisco, a "public option" to promote affordable universal access to care. Using the 2008 Bay Area Employer Health Benefits Survey, we find that most employers (75%) had to increase health spending to comply with the law, yet most (64%) are supportive of the law. There is substantial employer demand for the public option, with 21% of firms using Healthy San Francisco for at least some employees, yet there is little evidence of firms dropping existing insurance offerings in the first year after implementation.

10.3386/w16179.abstractZh: 2006年，旧金山实施了重大的健康改革，成为第一个实施“支付或参与”雇主健康支出强制规定的城市。此外，该市还创建了“健康旧金山”这一“公共选项”，旨在促进全民可负担的医疗服务。根据2008年的湾区雇主健康福利调查，大多数雇主（75%）不得不增加健康支出以遵守法律规定，但仍有64%的雇主支持这一法律。雇主对公共选项有强烈需求，有21%的企业至少为部分员工使用“健康旧金山”计划。然而，在实施该法律后的第一年，几乎没有证据表明企业会放弃现有的保险服务。

abstract.text: The recent reform of the U.S. health care system has been described both as a boon and a death blow for the healthcare industry and for private insurers in particular. We exploit the surprise election of Republican Scott Brown to the U.S. Senate, which dealt a serious blow to the prospects for reform by depriving Democrats of their 60-vote "filibuster-proof" majority, to evaluate the market's assessment of Health Reform's impact on the health care industry. We find that Scott Brown's election was associated with an abnormal return of 2.2 percent for a typical dollar invested in health care stocks and an abnormal return of 6.3 percent for a typical dollar invested in managed care firms. A typical dollar invested in the pharmaceutical sector experienced abnormal returns of 2.9 percent, while investments in healthcare facilities (including hospitals) experienced abnormal losses of 3.4 percent. Analysis of firms participating in government programs show that firms involved with Medicare Advantage experienced gains while those involved with Medicaid Managed Care experienced losses due to the election.

10.3386/w16193.abstractZh: 美国最近对医疗体系的改革被描述为对医疗行业以及私人保险公司既是福音也是致命打击。我们利用共和党人斯科特·布朗意外当选美国参议院这一事件，这一事件通过剥夺民主党人拥有60票“阻挠议事”多数席位，对改革前景造成了严重打击，以此来评估市场对于医疗改革对医疗行业影响的看法。我们发现，斯科特·布朗当选后，医疗股票的典型美元投资获得了2.2%的异常收益，而管理型医疗公司的典型美元投资则获得了6.3%的异常收益。制药行业的典型美元投资则获得了2.9%的异常收益，而医疗设施（包括医院）的投资则出现了3.4%的异常亏损。对参与政府项目的公司的分析显示，涉及Medicare Advantage的公司因此次选举而获得收益，而涉及Medicaid管理型医疗的公司则因选举而遭受损失。

abstract.text: Do intellectual property (IP) rights on existing technologies hinder subsequent innovation? Using newly-collected data on the sequencing of the human genome by the public Human Genome Project and the private firm Celera, this paper estimates the impact of Celera's gene-level IP on subsequent scientific research and product development. Genes initially sequenced by Celera were held with IP for up to two years, but moved into the public domain once re-sequenced by the public effort. Across a range of empirical specifications, I find evidence that Celera's IP led to reductions in subsequent scientific research and product development on the order of 20 to 30 percent. Taken together, these results suggest that Celera's short-term IP had persistent negative effects on subsequent innovation relative to a counterfactual of Celera genes having always been in the public domain.

10.3386/w16213.abstractZh: 知识产权对现有技术的后续创新是否构成了阻碍？本文利用人类基因组计划由公共机构完成、私人公司Celera完成的基因组测序数据，估算了Celera在基因层面上的知识产权对后续科学研究和产品开发的影响。Celera最初测序的基因被赋予了长达两年的知识产权，但一旦被公共机构重新测序，这些基因便进入了公共领域。通过一系列实证分析，我发现Celera的知识产权导致后续科学研究和产品开发的效率下降了20%到30%。综合这些结果可以看出，与Celera的基因始终处于公共领域这一假设相比，Celera的短期知识产权对后续创新产生了持续的负面影响。

abstract.text: Since 1992, the Pennsylvania Health Care Cost Containment Council (PHC4) has published cardiac care report cards for coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery providers. We examine the impact of CABG report cards on a provider's aggregate volume and volume by patient severity and then employ a mixed logit model to investigate the matching between patients and providers. We find a reduction in volume of poor performing and unrated surgeons' volume but no effect on more highly rated surgeons or hospitals of any rating. We also find that the probability that patients, regardless of severity of illness, receive CABG surgery from low-performing surgeons is significantly lower.

10.3386/w16225.abstractZh: 自1992年以来，宾夕法尼亚州医疗保健成本控制委员会（PHC4）一直向冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）手术提供者发布心脏护理报告卡。我们研究了这些报告卡对提供者手术总量以及按患者病情严重程度划分的手术量的影响，并采用混合逻辑模型来研究患者与提供者之间的匹配关系。研究发现，表现不佳且未获得评级的医生的手术量有所减少，但这对评级较高的医生或任何评级的医院都没有影响。此外，我们还发现，无论患者的病情严重程度如何，患者接受低水平医生实施的CABG手术的概率显著较低。

abstract.text: This study examines the past year relationship between GPA and experiencing a combination of two primary depression symptoms, feeling sad and losing interest in usual activities for at least two consecutive weeks, among high school students during 2001-2009. The GPA loss associated with sadness, as defined above, falls from slightly less than a plus/minus mark to around 0.1 point when commonly co-occurring behaviors are held constant. Nonetheless, this effect is significantly larger than those of having considered or planned suicide and equivalent to having attempted suicide, which seemingly signify more severe depression. Moreover, sadness lowers the probability of earning A grades, and raises that of receiving grades of C or below, by over 15%. Coefficient sizes are similar when comparison groups are restricted to students engaging in correlated behaviors and in matching and instrumental variable models, suggesting that sadness causally reduces academic performance.

10.3386/w16239.abstractZh: 本研究考察了2001年至2009年间，高中学生中GPA与两种主要抑郁症状的结合情况之间的关系，这两种症状分别是感到悲伤以及至少连续两周对日常活动失去兴趣。当其他共同出现的行为保持不变时，与悲伤相关的GPA下降幅度从略低于一个加减分降至约0.1分。尽管如此，这种影响仍然比考虑或计划自杀的影响要大得多，且相当于曾经尝试过自杀，这似乎表明抑郁程度更为严重。此外，悲伤还会使获得A等级成绩的概率降低超过15%，同时使获得C等级或更差等级成绩的概率上升。当比较组被限制为表现出相关行为的学生，以及采用匹配和工具变量模型时，系数大小相似，这表明悲伤确实会导致学业成绩下降。

abstract.text: In recent years, child care subsidies have become an integral part of federal and state efforts to move economically disadvantaged parents from welfare to work. Although previous empirical studies consistently show that these employment-related subsidies raise work levels among this group, little is known about the impact of subsidy receipt on child well-being. In this paper, we identify the causal effect of child care subsidies on child development by exploiting geographic variation in the distance that families must travel from home in order to reach the nearest social service agency that administers the subsidy application process. Using data from the Kindergarten cohort of the Early Childhood Longitudinal Study, our instrumental variables estimates suggest that children receiving subsidized care in the year before kindergarten score lower on tests of cognitive ability and reveal more behavior problems throughout kindergarten. However, these negative effects largely disappear by the time children reach the end of third grade. Our results point to an unintended consequence of a child care subsidy regime that conditions eligibility on parental employment and deemphasizes child care quality.

10.3386/w16250.abstractZh: 近年来，儿童保育补贴已成为联邦和州政府推动经济弱势父母从福利制度转向就业的重要举措之一。尽管之前的实证研究一致表明，这些与就业相关的补贴能够提升这一群体的工作水平，但关于补贴领取对儿童福祉的影响却知之甚少。本文通过利用家庭从家中到最近的提供补贴服务的机构所需行进距离这一地理变量，来识别儿童保育补贴对儿童发展的因果效应。根据《早期儿童纵向研究》的幼儿园队列数据，我们的工具变量估计表明，在入幼儿园前一年接受补贴服务的儿童在认知能力测试中的得分较低，并且在整个幼儿园期间表现出更多的行为问题。然而，这些负面影响在儿童达到三年级结束时基本消失。我们的研究结果揭示了儿童保育补贴制度的一个意外后果：该制度以父母的就业状况为资格条件，而忽视了儿童保育服务的质量。

abstract.text: Public financing of private health insurance may generate external effects beyond the subsidized population, by influencing the size and bargaining power of health insurers. We test for this external effect in the context of Medicare Part D. We analyze how Part D-related insurer size increases impacted retail drug prices negotiated by insurers for their non-Part D commercial market. On average, Part D lowered retail prices for commercial insureds by 5.8% to 8.5%. The cost-savings to the commercial market amount to $3bn per year, which approximates the total annual savings experienced by Part D beneficiaries who previously lacked drug coverage.

10.3386/w16251.abstractZh: 私人健康保险的公共融资可能会产生超出受补贴人群之外的外部效应，从而影响健康保险公司的规模及议价能力。我们在Medicare Part D的框架下对这一外部效应进行了测试。我们分析了Part D相关保险公司的规模扩大如何影响保险公司在非Part D商业市场中的零售药品价格谈判。平均而言，Part D使商业保险客户的零售价格降低了5.8%至8.5%。这一举措为商业市场每年节省了30亿美元的成本，这一数字与之前没有药品覆盖的Part D受益人所节省的总金额相当。

abstract.text: Trends in BMI values are estimated by centiles of the US adult population by birth cohorts 1886-1986 stratified by ethnicity. The highest centile increased by some 18 to 22 units in the course of the century while the lowest ones increased by merely 1 to 3 units. Hence, the BMI distribution became increasingly right skewed as the distance between the centiles became increasingly larger. The rate of change of BMI centile curves varied considerably over time. The BMI of white men and women experienced upsurges after the two World Wars and downswings during the Great Depression and again after 1970. However, among blacks the pattern is different during the first half of the century with men's rate of increase in BMI values decreasing substantially and that of females remaining unchanged at a relatively high level until the Second World War. However, after the war the rate of change of BMI values of blacks resembled that of the whites with an accelerating phase followed by a slow down around the 1970s. In sum, the creeping nature of the obesity epidemic is evident, as the technological and lifestyle changes of the 20th century affected various segments of the population quite differently.

10.3386/w16252.abstractZh: 通过1886年至1986年出生的不同种族人群的美国成年人人群的百分位数，可以估算BMI值的趋势。最高百分位数在百年间增加了约18至22个单位，而最低百分位数仅增加了1至3个单位。因此，BMI分布逐渐呈现右偏态分布，百分位数之间的距离也越来越大。BMI百分位数曲线的变化速率随时间而变化。白人男性和女性的BMI在两次世界大战后都有所上升，在大萧条期间有所下降，而在1970年后又再次上升。然而，在黑人中，这一模式有所不同：男性BMI值的增加率在世纪前半期显著下降，而女性的BMI值则保持在较高水平，直到第二次世界大战。战后，黑人的BMI值变化率与白人相似，先出现加速阶段，然后在1970年代逐渐放缓。总之，肥胖症的蔓延具有渐进性，因为20世纪的技术和生活方式变化对不同人群的影响各不相同。

abstract.text: This paper explores price differences in the European Union (EU) pharmaceutical market, the EU's fifth largest industry. With the aim of enhancing quality of life along with industry competitiveness and R&D capability, many EU directives have been adopted to achieve a single EU-wide pharmaceutical market. Using annual 1994-2003 data on prices of molecules that treat cardiovascular disease, we examine whether drug price dispersion has indeed decreased across five EU countries. Hedonic regressions show that over time, cross-country price differences between Germany and three of the four other EU sample countries, France, Italy and Spain, have declined, with relative prices in all three as well as the fourth country, UK, rising during the period. We interpret this as evidence that the EU has come closer to achieving a single pharmaceutical market in response to increasing European Commission coordination efforts.

10.3386/w16261.abstractZh: 本文探讨了欧盟制药市场的价格差异，该行业是欧盟第五大产业。为了提升生活质量以及行业的竞争力和研发能力，欧盟采纳了许多指令，以实现统一的欧盟制药市场。利用1994年至2003年的年度数据，我们研究了治疗心血管疾病的药物价格差异是否确实在五个欧盟国家中有所减少。享乐回归分析显示，随着时间的推移，德国与另外四个欧盟样本国家——法国、意大利和西班牙之间的价格差异有所缩小，而这三个国家以及第四个国家英国的相对价格在此期间有所上升。我们认为，这证明了欧盟在欧盟委员会不断协调努力下，已更接近实现统一的制药市场。

abstract.text: We propose a latent variables approach within a present-value model to estimate the expected returns and expected dividend growth rates of the aggregate stock market. This approach aggregates information contained in the history of price-dividend ratios and dividend growth rates to predict future returns and dividend growth rates. We find that returns and dividend growth rates are predictable with R-squared values ranging from 8.2% to 8.9% for returns and 13.9% to 31.6% for dividend growth rates. Both expected returns and expected dividend growth rates have a persistent component, but expected returns are more persistent than expected dividend growth rates.

10.3386/w16263.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种在现值模型中的潜变量方法，用于估计整体股市的预期回报和预期股息增长率。该方法整合了价格与股息比率以及股息增长率的历史信息，以预测未来的回报和股息增长率。研究发现，回报和股息增长率是可以预测的，其R平方值分别介于8.2%至8.9%之间，而股息增长率的R平方值则介于13.9%至31.6%之间。预期回报和预期股息增长率都具有持续性特征，但预期回报的持续性更强。

abstract.text: Economists have puzzled over why eligible individuals fail to enroll in social safety net programs. "Chilling effects" arising from an icy policy climate are a popular explanation for low program take-up rates among immigrants, but such effects are inherently hard to measure. This paper investigates a concrete determinant of chilling, Federal immigration enforcement, and finds robust evidence that heightened enforcement reduces Medicaid participation among children of non-citizens. This is the case even when children are themselves citizens and face no eligibility barriers to Medicaid enrollment. Immigrants from countries with more undocumented U.S. residents, those living in cities with a high fraction of other immigrants, and those with healthy children are most sensitive to enforcement efforts. Up to seventy-five percent of the relative decline in non-citizen Medicaid participation around the time of welfare reform, which has been attributed to the chilling effects of the reform itself, is explained by a contemporaneous spike in immigration enforcement activity. The results imply that safety net participation is influenced not only by program design, but also by a broader set of seemingly unrelated policy choices.

10.3386/w16278.abstractZh: 经济学家一直对为什么符合条件的个人不愿参与社会保障计划感到困惑。人们普遍认为，政策环境过于冷淡是导致移民参与率较低的原因之一，但这种影响本身很难衡量。本文研究了导致政策环境冷淡的具体因素——联邦移民执法措施，并发现执法力度加强确实会降低非公民子女对医疗补助的参与率。即便这些子女本身是公民，且没有资格障碍，情况依然如此。来自美国无证居民比例较高的国家的移民、生活在其他移民比例较高的城市中的移民，以及拥有健康子女的移民，对执法措施最为敏感。在福利改革期间，非公民医疗补助参与率下降高达75%，这一下降被归因于改革本身带来的冷淡效应，而实际上，这一下降部分可以通过同期移民执法活动的增加来解释。研究结果表明，社会保障计划的参与率不仅受到项目设计的影响，还受到一系列看似无关的政策选择的影响。

abstract.text: The main purpose of this study is to provide empirical evidence on the effects of the cigarette excise tax structure on three outcomes: cigarette prices, government revenues, and cigarette consumption. We composed cross-sectional time-series data for 21 EU countries from year 1998 to 2007 from various data resources. We provide strong evidence that the price gap between premium and low-priced brands is larger in countries with a greater share of ad valorem tax. A 10-percent raise in the share of ad valorem tax in total excise tax leads to about a 4 to 5 percent increase in the price gap, with a smaller impact in more concentrated markets. Our estimates confirm that greater instability of government tax revenues from cigarette excise taxes can be attributed to greater reliance on the ad valorem tax and such instability increases with the growth of manufacturers' market power. We also find that greater reliance on a specific tax has greater impact on cigarette smoking, but the impact diminishes with the growth of manufacturers' market power.

10.3386/w16287.abstractZh: 本研究的主要目的是提供关于香烟消费税结构对三个结果影响的实证证据：香烟价格、政府收入以及香烟消费。我们从1998年至2007年间从各种数据资源中收集了21个欧盟国家的横截面时间序列数据。我们的研究结果表明，在采用从价税为主的国家的溢价品牌与低价品牌之间的价格差距更大。从价税在总消费税中的比例增加10%，会导致价格差距增加约4%至5%，而在市场较为集中的市场中，这种影响较小。我们的估计还表明，政府从香烟消费税中获得的收入的不稳定性与从价税的依赖性成正比，并且这种不稳定性随着制造商市场力量的增强而加剧。我们还发现，对特定税种的依赖对吸烟行为的影响更大，但这种影响随着制造商市场力量的增强而减弱。

abstract.text: Reinforcing earlier findings from other data, college senior fraternity/sorority members are more likely to consume alcohol frequently. Large reductions in estimates upon controlling for time spent partying, and to a lesser extent cigarette use and intramural sports involvement, suggest considerable unobserved heterogeneity in the relationship. Yet, effects remain substantive and are invariant to conditioning on numerous further measures of socializing, sports participation, academic performance and mental health. The conclusion holds when non-member comparison groups are restricted to drinkers who smoke, party and/or play intramurals, or matched to members based on drinking propensities, suggesting that fraternity/sorority membership raises alcohol use frequency.

10.3386/w16291.abstractZh: 其他数据进一步证实了先前的研究结果：大学高年级兄弟会/姐妹会成员更有可能频繁饮酒。在控制了聚会时间、吸烟频率和校内体育活动参与情况后，饮酒频率的估计值大幅下降，这表明这种关系存在显著的未观测到的异质性。然而，这些效应仍然显著，并且不受社交活动、体育参与、学业表现和心理健康等多种因素的调节。当将非会员对照组限制为吸烟、参加聚会或校内体育活动的饮酒者，或者根据饮酒倾向与会员进行匹配时，这一结论仍然成立，这表明兄弟会/姐妹会会员身份确实会增加饮酒频率。

abstract.text: The 1993 expansions of the Earned Income Tax Credit created the first meaningful separation in the benefit level for families based on the number of children, with families containing two or more children now receiving substantially more in benefits. If income is protective of health, we should see improvements over time in the health for mothers eligible for the EITC with two or more children compared to those with only one child. Using data from the Behavioral Risk Factors Surveillance Survey, we find in difference-in-difference models that for low-educated mothers of two or more children, the number of days with poor mental health and the fraction reporting excellent or very good health improved relative to the mothers with only one child. Using data from the National Health Examination and Nutrition Survey, we find evidence that the probability of having risky levels of biomarkers fell for these same low-educated women impacted more by the 1993 expansions, especially biomarkers that indicate inflammation.

10.3386/w16296.abstractZh: 1993年对劳动收入税收抵免政策的扩展，首次实现了基于子女数量来划分家庭福利水平的机制。现在，拥有两个或更多孩子的家庭获得的福利明显更高。如果收入能够保护健康，那么与只有一个孩子的家庭相比，拥有两个或更多孩子的母亲的健康状况应该会随着时间的推移而得到改善。根据行为风险因素监测调查的数据，我们发现，在差异-差异模型中，教育程度较低的、拥有两个或更多孩子的母亲，出现心理健康状况不佳的天数和报告健康状况极佳或非常好的比例，都相对于只有一个孩子的母亲有所改善。此外，根据全国健康检查和营养调查的数据，我们发现，这些同样受教育程度较低的女性，由于1993年的政策扩展而面临的风险性生物标志物水平有所降低，尤其是那些与炎症相关的生物标志物。

abstract.text: In this survey chapter on pricing and reimbursement in U.S. pharmaceutical markets, we first provide background information on important federal legislation, institutional details regarding distribution channel logistics, definitions of alternative price measures, related historical developments, and reasons why price discrimination is highly prevalent among branded pharmaceuticals. We then present a theoretical framework for the pricing of branded pharmaceuticals, without and then in the presence of prescription drug insurance, noting factors affecting the relative impacts of drug insurance on prices and on utilization. With this as background, we summarize major long-term trends in copayments and coinsurance rates for retail and mail order purchases, average percentage discounts off Average Whole Price paid by third party payers to pharmacy benefit managers as well as average dispensing fees, and generic penetration rates. We conclude with a summary of the evidence regarding the impact of the 2006 implementation of the Medicare Part D benefits on pharmaceutical prices and utilization, and comment on very recent developments concerning the entry of large retailers such as Wal-Mart into domains traditionally dominated by large retail chains and the "commoditization" of generic drugs.

10.3386/w16297.abstractZh: 在本篇关于美国制药市场定价和报销的调查章节中，我们首先提供了有关重要联邦法规的背景信息、分销渠道物流的详细机构信息、各种价格衡量标准的定义、相关历史发展情况，以及品牌药品中价格歧视普遍存在的原因。随后，我们提出了品牌药品定价的理论框架，分别讨论了在处方药保险存在和不存在的情况下的定价问题，并分析了影响药品保险对价格和用药行为相对影响的多种因素。在此基础上，我们总结了零售和邮购购买中共同支付和共同承担费用率的主要长期趋势，第三方支付方支付给药品福利管理机构的平均整体价格折扣百分比，以及药品分销费用的平均水平，还有仿制药的渗透率。最后，我们总结了2006年《医疗保险Part D》福利实施对药品价格和用药行为的影响，并对沃尔玛等大型零售商进入传统上由大型零售连锁企业主导的领域以及仿制药的“商品化”趋势等近期发展进行了评论。

abstract.text: We empirically analyze the welfare effects of cross-firm bundling in the pharmaceutical industry. Physicians often treat patients with "cocktail" regimens that combine two or more drugs. Firms cannot price discriminate because each drug is produced by a different firm and a physician creates the bundle in her office from the component drugs. We show that a less competitive equilibrium arises with cocktail products because firms can internalize partially the externality their pricing decisions impose on competitors. The incremental profits from creating a bundle are sometimes as large as the incremental profits from a merger of the same two firms.

10.3386/w16321.abstractZh: 我们实证分析了制药行业中企业捆绑销售的福利效应。医生通常会使用“组合用药方案”来治疗患者，这些方案包含两种或更多种药物。由于每种药物都由不同的企业生产，而医生在其诊所自行组合这些药物，因此企业无法进行价格歧视。我们发现，组合用药产品会导致一个竞争程度较低的均衡状态，因为企业能够部分内部化其定价决策对竞争对手产生的外部性影响。组合用药带来的增量利润有时甚至与同一两家企业合并所带来的增量利润相当。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effect of alcohol consumption on student achievement. To do so, we exploit the discontinuity in drinking at age 21 at a college in which the minimum legal drinking age is strictly enforced. We find that drinking causes significant reductions in academic performance, particularly for the highest-performing students. This suggests that the negative consequences of alcohol consumption extend beyond the narrow segment of the population at risk of more severe, low-frequency, outcomes.

10.3386/w16330.abstractZh: 本文探讨了酒精消费对学生学业成绩的影响。为此，我们选取了一所严格执行最低法定饮酒年龄规定的大学，研究21岁时饮酒行为的不连续性。研究发现，饮酒会导致学业成绩显著下降，尤其是对于那些表现最优秀的学生。这表明，酒精消费的负面影响不仅限于那些面临更严重、低频率负面后果的人群。

abstract.text: We study the design of randomized controlled experiments in environments where outcomes are significantly affected by unobserved effort decisions taken by the subjects(agents). While standard randomized controlled trials (RCTs) are internally consistent, the unobservability of effort provision compromises external validity. We approach trial design as a principal-agent problem and show that natural extensions of RCTs -which we call selective trials- can help improve the external validity of experiments. In particular, selective trials can disentangle the effects of treatment, effort, and the interaction of treatment and effort. Moreover, they can help experimenters identify when measured treatment effects are affected by erroneous beliefs and inappropriate effort provision.

10.3386/w16343.abstractZh: 我们研究了在受试者（代理人）做出的未观察到的努力决策显著影响结果的情况下，随机对照实验的设计。虽然标准的随机对照试验在内部上是一致的，但努力提供的不可观察性却损害了实验的外部有效性。我们将试验设计视为一个委托-代理问题，并表明随机对照试验的自然扩展形式——我们称之为选择性试验——可以帮助提高实验的外部有效性。特别是，选择性试验能够分离出治疗、努力以及治疗与努力相互作用的影响。此外，它们还能帮助实验者识别测量到的治疗效果何时受到错误信念和不适当努力提供的影响。

abstract.text: This paper describes and applies econometric strategies for estimating regression models of economic share data outcomes where the shares may take boundary values (zero and one) with nontrivial probability. The main focus of the paper is on the conditional mean structures of such data. The paper proposes an extension of the fractional regression methodology proposed by Papke and Wooldridge, 1996, 2008, in univariate cross-sectional and panel contexts. The paper discusses the stochastic aspects of share definition and measurement, and summarizes important features of the existing literature on econometric strategies for share model estimation. The paper then goes on to discuss the univariate fractional regression estimation strategies proposed by Papke and Wooldridge and to extend the fractional regression approach to estimation of and inference about regression models describing the multivariate share data. Some issues involving outcome aggregation/ disaggregation are considered, as is a full likelihood estimation approach based on Dirichlet-multinomial models. The paper demonstrates the workings of these various empirical strategies by estimating models of financial asset portfolio shares using data from the 2001, 2004, and 2007 U.S. Surveys of Consumer Finances.

10.3386/w16354.abstractZh: 本文描述了并应用了计量经济学策略来估计经济份额数据的回归模型，其中这些份额可能以非零概率取边界值（零和一）。本文的主要关注点在于此类数据的条件均值结构。本文对Papke和Wooldridge在1996年和2008年提出的分数回归方法进行了扩展，适用于单变量横截面数据和面板数据情境。文章讨论了份额定义和测量的随机性方面，并总结了现有文献中关于份额模型估计的计量经济学策略的重要特征。随后，文章进一步探讨了Papke和Wooldridge提出的单变量分数回归估计策略，并将分数回归方法扩展到用于估计和推断描述多变量份额数据的回归模型。文章还考虑了与结果聚合/分解相关的问题，以及基于狄利克雷-多项式模型的完整似然估计方法。通过使用2001年、2004年和2007年美国消费者金融调查的数据来估计金融资产组合份额模型，文章展示了这些不同实证策略的工作原理。

abstract.text: We use simple economic insights to develop a framework for distinguishing between prejudice and statistical discrimination using observational data. We focus our inquiry on the enormous literature in healthcare where treatment disparities by race and gender are not explained by access, preferences, or severity. But treatment disparities, by themselves, cannot distinguish between two competing views of provider behavior. Physicians may consciously or unconsciously withhold treatment from minority groups despite similar benefits (prejudice) or because race and gender are associated with lower benefit from treatment (statistical discrimination). We demonstrate that these two views can only be distinguished using data on patient outcomes: for patients with the same propensity to be treated, prejudice implies a higher return from treatment for treated minorities, while statistical discrimination implies that returns are equalized. Using data on heart attack treatments, we do not find empirical support for prejudice-based explanations. Despite receiving less treatment, women and blacks receive slightly lower benefits from treatment, perhaps due to higher stroke risk, delays in seeking care, and providers over-treating minorities due to equity and liability concerns.

10.3386/w16382.abstractZh: 我们运用简单的经济学原理，开发了一个框架，用于利用观察性数据区分偏见与统计性歧视。我们的研究重点集中在医疗保健领域的大量文献中，这些文献指出，种族和性别导致的治疗差异无法用可及性、偏好或治疗难度来解释。然而，治疗差异本身并不能区分关于医疗服务提供者行为的两种对立观点：医生可能会有意或无意地拒绝为少数群体提供治疗，尽管治疗对少数群体的益处相同（即存在偏见），或者因为种族和性别与较低的治疗收益相关（即存在统计性歧视）。我们证明，只有通过患者治疗结果的数据才能区分这两种观点：对于具有相同治疗倾向的患者，偏见意味着少数群体在接受治疗后获得的收益更高，而统计性歧视则意味着这些收益被平均化了。通过心脏病治疗的数据分析，我们没有发现基于偏见的解释具有实证支持。尽管女性和非裔美国人接受的治疗较少，但他们从治疗中获得的收益略低，这可能是由于中风风险较高、寻求医疗服务的延迟，以及由于公平和责任的考虑，医疗服务提供者过度治疗少数群体所致。

abstract.text: The potentially serious adverse impacts of behavior problems during adolescence on employment outcomes in adulthood provide a key economic rationale for early intervention programs. However, the extent to which lower educational attainment accounts for the total impact of adolescent behavior problems on later employment remains unclear As an initial step in exploring this issue, we specify and estimate a recursive bivariate probit model that 1) relates middle school behavior problems to high school graduation and 2) models later employment in young adulthood as a function of these behavior problems and of high school graduation. Our model thus allows for both a direct effect of behavior problems on later employment as well as an indirect effect that operates via graduation from high school. Our empirical results, based on analysis of data from the NELS, suggest that the direct effects of externalizing behavior problems on later employment are not significant but that these problems have important indirect effects operating through high school graduation.

10.3386/w16383.abstractZh: 青少年时期的行为问题对成年后就业结果可能产生的严重负面影响，为早期干预计划提供了重要的经济依据。然而，较低的教育水平在多大程度上解释了青少年行为问题对后期就业的整体影响，目前仍不清楚。作为探索这一问题的初步步骤，我们构建并估计了一个递归双变量Probit模型，该模型能够：1）将初中阶段的行为问题与高中毕业联系起来；2）将这些行为问题以及高中毕业作为变量，来模拟年轻成年期的就业情况。因此，我们的模型既考虑了行为问题对后期就业的直接影响，也考虑了通过高中毕业产生的间接影响。基于NELS数据的分析结果表明，外部化行为问题对后期就业的直接影响并不显著，但这些问题通过高中毕业产生了重要的间接影响。

abstract.text: In spite of the large expected costs of needing long-term care, only 10-12 percent of the elderly population has private insurance coverage. Medicaid, which provides means-tested public assistance and pays for almost half of long-term care costs, spends more than $100 billion annually on long-term care. In this paper, I exploit variation in the adoption and generosity of state tax subsidies for private long-term care insurance to determine whether tax subsidies increase private coverage and reduce Medicaid's costs for long-term care. The results indicate that the average tax subsidy raises coverage rates by 2.7 percentage points, or 28 percent. However, the response is concentrated among high income and asset-rich individuals, populations with low probabilities of relying on Medicaid. Simulations suggest each dollar of state tax expenditure produces approximately $0.84 in Medicaid savings, over half of which funnels to the federal government.

10.3386/w16406.abstractZh: 尽管长期护理所需的成本很高，但只有10-12%的老年人拥有私人保险。医疗补助计划提供基于经济状况的公共援助，并承担近一半的长期护理费用，每年在长期护理方面的支出超过1000亿美元。本文通过分析各州对私人长期护理保险的税收补贴政策和慷慨程度的变化，探讨税收补贴是否会增加私人保险覆盖，并降低医疗补助的长期护理成本。研究结果表明，平均税收补贴可使保险覆盖率提高2.7个百分点，即28%。然而，这种效应主要集中在高收入和高资产的人群中，这些人群依赖医疗补助的可能性较低。模拟结果显示，每投入一美元的州税收支出，可节省约0.84美元的医疗补助费用，其中超过一半的费用流向了联邦政府。

abstract.text: Excess body weight or body fat hinders performance of military duties. As a result, the U.S. military has weight-for-height and percent body fat standards for enlistment. This paper estimates the number and percent of military-age civilians who meet, and do not meet, the current active duty enlistment standards for weight and body fat for the four major armed services (Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps), using data from the full series of National Health and Nutrition Examination Surveys that spans 1959-2008. We find that the percent of civilian military-age men and women who satisfy current military enlistment standards for weight-for-height and percent body fat has fallen considerably. This is due to a large increase in the percentage who are both overweight and overfat, which roughly doubled for men and more than tripled for women between 1959-62 and 2007-08. As of 2007-08, 5.7 million men (11.70%) and 16.5 million women (34.65%) of military age exceed the U.S. Army's enlistment standards for weight-for-height and percent body fat. The implications of rising obesity for the U.S. military are especially acute given its recent difficulties in recruiting a sufficient number of new high quality service members in the midst of combat operations overseas.

10.3386/w16408.abstractZh: 过重的身体或体脂会妨碍军事职责的履行。因此，美国军队对新兵的选拔采用了体重与身高比例以及体脂百分比的标准。本文利用1959年至2008年连续进行的全国健康与营养调查数据，估算了符合和不符合当前现役新兵体重与体脂标准的适龄平民数量及比例，涉及陆军、海军、空军和海军陆战队四个主要军种。研究发现，符合当前体重与身高比例及体脂百分比标准的适龄男女比例显著下降。这一变化主要是由于超重和肥胖人群的比例大幅增加，从1959-62年到2007-08年间，男性超重和肥胖的比例大约翻了一番，女性则增加了三倍以上。截至2007-08年，有570万男性（占11.70%）和1650万女性（占34.65%）的适龄人员不符合美国陆军的体重与身高比例及体脂百分比标准。鉴于美国军队在海外作战行动中难以招募到足够数量的高素质军人，肥胖问题对美军的影响尤为严重。

abstract.text: The effect of shift structure on worker performance and productivity is an issue of increasing interest to firms and regulatory bodies. Using approximately 742,000 emergency medical incidents attended by 2,400 paramedics in the state of Mississippi, we evaluate the extent to which paramedics' performance towards the end of their shift is impacted by its length. We find evidence that their performance deteriorates towards the end of long shifts, and argue that fatigue is the mediating factor. These findings have implications for workforce organization, calling attention to regulation designed to limit extended work hours.

10.3386/w16418.abstractZh: 班次结构对员工绩效和生产力的影响越来越受到企业和监管机构的关注。本研究以密西西比州约742,000起紧急医疗事件为样本，涉及2,400名急救人员，评估了班次长度对急救人员班次结束时的绩效影响程度。研究发现，在长时间班次结束时，急救人员的绩效会下降，并认为疲劳是其中的中介因素。这些发现对劳动力组织具有启示意义，提醒人们需要制定限制延长工作时间的法规。

abstract.text: The theory on the demand for health suggests that schooling causes health because schooling increases the efficiency of health production. Alternatively, the allocative efficiency hypothesis argues that schooling alters the input mix chosen to produce health. This suggests that the more educated have more knowledge about the health production function and they have more health knowledge. This paper uses data from the 1997 and 2002 waves of the NLSY97 to conduct an investigation of the allocative efficiency hypothesis by analyzing whether education improves health knowledge. The survey design allows us to observe the increase in health knowledge of young adults after their level of schooling is increased by differential and plausibly exogenous amounts. Using nine different questions measuring health knowledge, we find weak evidence that an increase in education generates an improvement in health knowledge for those who ultimately attend college. For those with high school as the terminal degree, no relationship is found between education and health knowledge. These results imply that the allocative efficiency hypothesis may not be the primary reason for why schooling impacts health outcomes.

10.3386/w16422.abstractZh: 关于健康需求的理论表明，学校教育能够提升健康水平，因为学校教育提高了健康生产的效率。另一种观点是，教育分配效率假说认为，学校教育改变了用于健康生产的投入组合。这意味着受教育程度较高的人对健康生产函数的了解更为深入，他们的健康知识也更为丰富。本文利用1997年和2002年NLSY97调查数据，通过分析教育是否提升了健康知识，来探讨分配效率假说。调查设计使我们能够观察到，随着受教育程度的增加，年轻成年人的健康知识有所提升，且这种提升是差异化的、且可能是外生因素导致的。通过九个不同的健康知识测量问题，我们发现，对于最终完成大学教育的人来说，教育水平的提高对健康知识的提升作用并不明显。而对于那些以高中毕业为最高学历的人来说，教育水平与健康知识之间并没有明显的关系。这些结果表明，分配效率假说可能不是学校教育影响健康结果的主要原因。

abstract.text: The landmark Waxman-Hatch Act of 1984 represented a "grand compromise" legislation that sought to balance incentives for innovation by establishing finite periods of market exclusivity yet simultaneously providing access to lower cost generics expeditiously following patent expiration. Here we examine trends in the first quarter century since passage of the legislation, building on earlier work by Grabowski and Vernon [1992,1996] and Cook [1998]. The generic share of retail prescriptions in the U.S. has grown from 18.6% in 1984 to 74.5% in 2009, with a notable acceleration in recent years. This increase reflects increases in both the share of the total market potentially accessible by generics, and the generic efficiency rate - the latter frequently approaching 100%. Whereas in 1994, the generic price index fell from 100 to 80 in the 12 months following initial generic entry and by 24 months to 65, in 2009 the comparable generic price indexes are 68 and 27, respectively. Recent studies sponsored by the American Association of Retired Persons focus only on brand prices and ignore substitution to lower priced options following loss of patent protection. For the prescription drugs most commonly used by beneficiaries in Medicare Part D, the average price per prescription declined by 21.3% from 2006 to 2009, rather than increasing by 25-28% as reported by the AARP. Finally, we quantify changes over time in the average daily cost of pharmaceutical treatment in nine major therapy areas, encompassing the entire set of molecules within each therapy class, not simply the molecule whose patent has expired. Across all nine therapeutic areas, at 24 months post-generic entry, the weighted mean reduction in pharmaceutical treatment cost per patient is 35.1%.

10.3386/w16431.abstractZh: 1984年通过的《瓦克斯曼-哈奇法案》是一项“重大妥协”立法，旨在通过设定有限的市场独占期来平衡创新激励，同时允许在专利到期后迅速获得低成本仿制药。本文基于格拉博斯基和弗农[1992,1996]以及库克[1998]的早期研究，探讨了该立法通过以来的25年间的趋势。在美国，零售处方中仿制药的比例从1984年的18.6%上升到2009年的74.5%，近年来这一比例还有显著增长。这一增长反映了仿制药能够进入的市场份额以及仿制药的效率提升——后者的效率通常接近100%。1994年，仿制药进入市场后的12个月内，仿制药价格指数从100降至80，24个月后降至65；而到2009年，相应的仿制药价格指数分别为68和27。美国退休人员协会资助的最新研究仅关注品牌价格，而忽略了专利保护丧失后选择价格较低的仿制药的情况。对于Medicare Part D计划中常用的处方药，从2006年到2009年，每张处方的平均价格下降了21.3%，而非如美国退休人员协会所报告的那样增加了25-28%。最后，我们量化了九个主要治疗领域内药物治疗平均每日费用随时间的变化情况，涵盖了每个治疗类别中的所有分子，而不仅仅是专利已到期的分子。在所有九个治疗领域，仿制药进入市场后24个月，每位患者的药物治疗费用平均减少了35.1%。

abstract.text: We extend the semi-parametric estimation method for dynamic discrete choice models using Hotz and Miller's (1993) conditional choice probability (CCP) approach to the setting where individuals may have hyperbolic discounting time preferences and may be naive about their time inconsistency. We illustrate the proposed estimation method with an empirical application of adult women's decisions to undertake mammography to evaluate the importance of present bias and naivety in the under-utilization of this preventive health care. Our results show evidence for both present bias and naivety.

10.3386/w16438.abstractZh: 我们将Hotz和Miller在1993年提出的半参数估计方法应用于动态离散选择模型，该方法的核心理念是条件选择概率。我们扩展了这一方法，以适用于个体具有双曲线时间偏好且对时间不一致性缺乏认知的情况。我们通过成年女性接受乳腺X光检查的决策实例来说明所提出的估计方法，以评估当前偏见和时间认知不足在预防性医疗保健未得到充分利用中的重要性。我们的研究结果同时支持了当前偏见和时间认知不足这两个因素的作用。

abstract.text: While no longer common in the private sector, most public sector employers offer retiree health insurance (RHI) as a retirement benefit to their employees. While these plans are thought to be an important tool for employers to attract, retain, motivate, and ultimately retire workers, they represent a large and growing cost. This paper reviews what is currently known about RHI in the public sector, while highlighting many important unanswered research questions. The analysis is informed by detailed data from states on their liabilities associated with RHI, which were produced in accordance with the 2004 Government Accounting Standards Board Rule 45 (GASB 45). We consider the extent of the unfunded liabilities states face and explore what factors may explain the variation in liabilities across states. The importance and sustainability of RHI plans in the public sector ultimately depends on how workers view and value this post-retirement benefit, yet little is known about how RHI directly impacts the public sector labor market. We conclude with a discussion of the future of RHI plans in the public sector.

10.3386/w16450.abstractZh: 虽然私营部门已不再普遍采用，但大多数公共部门的雇主仍为其员工提供退休健康保险作为退休福利。这些计划被认为是雇主吸引、留住、激励员工并最终促使员工退休的重要工具，但同时也代表了巨大且不断增长的成本。本文回顾了目前关于公共部门退休健康保险的相关信息，同时指出了许多重要的未解研究问题。分析基于各州关于退休健康保险相关负债的详细数据，这些数据是根据2004年政府会计标准委员会规则45（GASB 45）生成的。我们探讨了各州面临的无资金负债规模，并探讨了可能导致各州负债差异的因素。公共部门退休健康保险计划的重要性和可持续性最终取决于员工如何看待和重视这一退休后的福利，然而关于退休健康保险如何直接影响公共部门劳动力市场的机制，目前了解甚少。最后，本文讨论了公共部门退休健康保险计划未来的发展方向。

abstract.text: This paper is the first to use the method of instrumental variables (IV) to estimate the impact of obesity on medical costs in order to address the endogeneity of weight and to reduce the bias from reporting error in weight. Models are estimated using data from the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey for 2000-2005. The IV model, which exploits genetic variation in weight as a natural experiment, yields estimates of the impact of obesity on medical costs that are considerably higher than the correlations reported in the previous literature. For example, obesity is associated with $676 higher annual medical care costs, but the IV results indicate that obesity raises annual medical costs by $2,826 (in 2005 dollars). The estimated annual cost of treating obesity in the U.S. adult non-institutionalized population is $168.4 billion or 16.5% of national spending on medical care. These results imply that the previous literature has underestimated the medical costs of obesity, resulting in underestimates of the cost effectiveness of anti-obesity interventions and the economic rationale for government intervention to reduce obesity-related externalities.

10.3386/w16467.abstractZh: 本文首次采用工具变量方法，来估计肥胖对医疗成本的影响，以解决体重的内生性问题，并减少体重报告误差带来的偏差。模型基于2000-2005年的医疗支出面板调查数据进行估计。工具变量模型利用体重的遗传变异作为自然实验，得出的肥胖对医疗成本影响的估计值远高于以往文献中的相关性结果。例如，肥胖与每年高出676美元的医疗成本相关，但工具变量模型显示，肥胖使年度医疗成本增加了2,826美元（以2005年美元计算）。在美国非机构化成年人群中，治疗肥胖的估计年度成本为1684亿美元，占全国医疗支出的16.5%。这些结果表明，以往文献低估了肥胖的医疗成本，从而导致对反肥胖干预措施的成本效益以及政府干预以减少肥胖相关外部性的经济理由的低估。

abstract.text: The choice to breastfeed rather than formula-feed an infant as well as the duration of doing so has been scrutinized in more recent times. Yet, key identification issues remain to be resolved, including the array of possible child development benefits, the optimal intensity of breastfeeding versus formula- feeding, and the possibility of confounding with other inputs that promote child health. This study uses the Early Childhood Longitudinal Survey - Birth Cohort to explore the causal effect of breastfeeding on development across the early years of childhood. We examine a range of health, physical, and cognitive outcomes and relate these to a set of breastfeeding and formula-feeding intensities. Adjusting for a very extensive set of potential confounding factors that also promote child development, our empirical method uses simultaneous equations models and propensity score measures to understand the link between breastfeeding and child outcomes. Our results indicate that breastfeeding and not formula-feeding at birth are associated with increased probabilities of being in excellent health at 9 months. Furthermore, they are protective against obesity and improve cognitive outcomes at 24 months and 54 months. Breastfeeding for 6 months or more increases motor scores at 9 months.

10.3386/w16496.abstractZh: 近年来，选择母乳喂养而非配方奶喂养婴儿以及母乳喂养的持续时间受到了广泛关注。然而，一些关键的问题仍未得到解决，包括母乳喂养可能带来的儿童发展益处、母乳喂养与配方奶喂养的最佳强度，以及这些因素与其他促进儿童健康的因素之间的相互作用。本研究利用《早期儿童纵向调查-出生队列》数据，探讨母乳喂养对儿童早期发展的影响。我们考察了多种健康、身体和认知方面的结果，并将这些结果与不同的母乳喂养和配方奶喂养强度进行了关联。通过调整一系列可能干扰儿童发展的因素，我们使用联立方程模型和倾向得分方法来分析母乳喂养与儿童结果之间的关系。研究结果表明，出生时选择母乳喂养而非配方奶喂养与9个月时处于良好健康状态的概率更高相关。此外，母乳喂养还能预防肥胖，并在24个月和54个月时改善认知表现。母乳喂养6个月或更长时间还能在9个月时提高运动能力评分。

abstract.text: A number of studies have found substantial correlations in risky behavior between siblings, raising the possibility that adolescents may directly influence the actions of their brothers or sisters. We assess the extent to which correlations in substance use and selling drugs are due to causal effects. Our identification strategy relies on panel data, the fact that the future does not cause the past, and the assumption that the direction of influence is from older siblings to younger siblings. Under this assumption along with other restrictions on dynamics, one can identify the causal effect from a regression of the behavior of the younger sibling on the past behavior and the future behavior of the older sibling. We also estimate a joint dynamic model of the behavior of older and younger siblings that allows for family specific effects, individual specific heterogeneity, and state dependence. We use the model to simulate the dynamic response of substance use to the behavior of the older sibling. Our results suggest that smoking, drinking, and marijuana use are affected by the example of older siblings, but most of the link between siblings arises from common influences.

10.3386/w16508.abstractZh: 多项研究发现，兄弟姐妹之间的风险行为存在显著相关性，这表明青少年可能会直接影响其兄弟姐妹的行为。我们评估了物质使用及贩卖毒品行为之间的相关性在多大程度上是由因果效应引起的。我们的识别策略依赖于面板数据、未来不会影响过去的事实，以及影响方向是从年长的兄弟姐妹传递给年幼的兄弟姐妹这一假设。在这些假设以及其他对动态关系的限制条件下，可以通过对年幼兄弟姐妹的行为与年长兄弟姐妹过去和未来的行为进行回归分析来识别因果效应。我们还建立了一个包含年长及年幼兄弟姐妹行为的联合动态模型，该模型能够考虑家庭特定的效应、个体特定的异质性以及状态依赖性。我们利用该模型模拟了年长兄弟姐妹的行为对物质使用行为的动态影响。我们的研究结果表明，吸烟、饮酒和大麻使用受到年长兄弟姐妹的示范影响，但兄弟姐妹之间的大部分联系源于共同的影响因素。

abstract.text: We develop a directed search model of relationship formation which can disentangle male and female preferences for types of partners and for different relationship terms using only a cross-section of observed matches. Individuals direct their search to a particular type of match on the basis of (i) the terms of the relationship, (ii) the type of partner, and (iii) the endogenously determined probability of matching. If men outnumber women, they tend to trade a low probability of a preferred match for a high probability of a less-preferred match; the analogous statement holds for women. Using data from National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent Health we estimate the equilibrium matching model with high school relationships. Variation in gender ratios is used to uncover male and female preferences. Estimates from the structural model match subjective data on whether sex would occur in one's ideal relationship. The equilibrium result shows that some women would ideally not have sex, but do so out of matching concerns; the reverse is true for men.

10.3386/w16517.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个有向搜索模型，用于研究关系形成的过程。该模型能够仅通过观察到的匹配数据，区分男性和女性对伴侣类型及关系条款的偏好。个体会根据（i）关系条款、（ii）伴侣类型以及（iii）由自身因素决定的匹配概率，来定向寻找特定类型的伴侣。如果男性数量多于女性，他们倾向于以较低的匹配概率换取较高的非理想匹配概率；对于女性来说，情况也类似。我们利用《全国青少年健康纵向研究》的数据，对高中时期的关系匹配进行了均衡分析。通过性别比例的差异，我们能够揭示男性和女性的偏好。结构模型的估计结果与关于理想关系中是否会发生性行为的主观数据相吻合。均衡结果显示，一些女性出于匹配考虑，虽然理想情况下不会发生性行为，但实际上还是发生了；对于男性来说，情况则相反。

abstract.text: The increase in obesity over the past thirty years has led researchers to investigate the role of social networks as a contributing factor. However, several challenges make it difficult to demonstrate a causal link between friends' physical fitness and own fitness using observational data. To overcome these problems, we exploit data from a unique setting in which individuals are randomly assigned to peer groups. We find statistically significant peer effects that are 40 to 70 percent as large as the own effect of prior fitness scores on current fitness outcomes. Evidence suggests that the effects are caused primarily by friends who were the least fit, thus supporting the provocative notion that poor physical fitness spreads on a person-to-person basis.

10.3386/w16518.abstractZh: 过去三十年中肥胖率的上升促使研究人员调查社交网络作为促成因素的作用。然而，由于多种挑战，使用观察性数据难以证明朋友的健康状况与自身健康状况之间的因果关系。为了克服这些问题，我们利用了一种独特的数据设置，其中个体被随机分配到不同的同伴群体。我们发现，同伴效应的统计显著性达到了40%到70%，这一效应与先前健康评分对当前健康结果的影响相当。证据表明，这些效应主要是由那些健康状况最差的朋友引起的，从而支持了“健康状况不佳会逐人传播”这一引人深思的观点。

abstract.text: Caloric intake and minimum calorie thresholds are widely used in developing countries to assess hunger and nutrition, and to construct poverty lines. However, it is generally recognized that the sufficiency of an individual's caloric intake cannot be determined, due to: a lack of consensus on the true thresholds; the fact that any such thresholds are individual-varying and unobservable; imperfect nutrient absorption; and the weak and non-monotonic empirical relationship between calories and wealth. We propose a revealed preference approach to measuring hunger and undernutrition that overcomes these challenges. Low caloric intake is associated with a large utility penalty (e.g., physical discomfort). The corresponding high marginal utility of calories causes a utility-maximizing consumer to primarily consume the cheapest available source of calories (a staple). Once they have surpassed subsistence, the marginal utility of calories declines significantly and they substitute towards foods with higher levels of non-nutritional attributes (e.g., taste). Thus, though any individual's requirements are unobserved, their choice to switch away from the staple reveals they are above that requirement. Accordingly, the percent of calories obtained from the staple can be used to indicate nutritional sufficiency. We also provide an application for China that shows the desirable empirical properties of this approach.

10.3386/w16555.abstractZh: 热量摄入和最低热量阈值在发展中国家被广泛用于评估饥饿和营养状况，以及确定贫困线。然而，人们普遍认识到，无法确定个体热量摄入的充足程度，原因包括：对真实阈值的共识缺乏；这些阈值因人而异且难以观测；营养吸收不完全；以及热量与财富之间的经验关系较弱且非单调。我们提出了一种揭示偏好的方法来衡量饥饿和营养不良问题，该方法能够克服这些挑战。低热量摄入会导致较大的效用损失（例如，身体不适）。而高热量摄入对应的高边际效用则促使消费者主要选择最便宜的热量来源（主食）。一旦超过生存需求，热量的边际效用会显著下降，消费者会转向具有更高非营养属性（例如，口感）的食物。因此，尽管任何个体的需求都是不可观测的，但他们选择不再依赖主食表明他们的需求已经得到满足。因此，从主食中获取的热量百分比可以用来指示营养充足程度。我们还为中国提供了一个应用案例，展示了这种方法的理想特性。

abstract.text: This paper develops a covariate-based approach to the external validity of instrumental variables (IV) estimates. Assuming that differences in observed complier characteristics are what make IV estimates differ from one another and from parameters like the effect of treatment on the treated, we show how to construct estimates for new subpopulations from a given set of covariate-specific LATEs. We also develop a reweighting procedure that uses the traditional overidentification test statistic to define a population for which a given pair of IV estimates has external validity. These ideas are illustrated through a comparison of twins and sex-composition IV estimates of the effects childbearing on labor supply.

10.3386/w16566.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种基于协变量的方法，用于评估工具变量估计值的外部有效性。假设观察到的遵守行为特征的差异是导致工具变量估计值彼此不同以及与诸如治疗对受治者影响的参数存在差异的原因，我们展示了如何根据一组特定协变量的LATEs来构建新子群体的估计值。我们还开发了一种重新加权程序，该程序使用传统的过度识别检验统计量来定义一个群体，使得给定的工具变量估计值在该群体中具有外部有效性。这些思想通过对比双胞胎和性别构成工具变量估计值来说明其对生育对劳动力供应影响的估计。

abstract.text: We measure and examine data error in health, education and income statistics used to construct the Human Development Index. We identify three sources of data error which are due to (i) data updating, (ii) formula revisions and (iii) thresholds to classify a country's development status. We propose a simple statistical framework to calculate country specific measures of data uncertainty and investigate how data error biases rank assignments. We find that up to 34% of countries are misclassified and, by replicating prior studies, we show that key estimated parameters vary by up to 100% due to data error.

10.3386/w16572.abstractZh: 我们测量并分析用于构建人类发展指数的健康、教育和收入统计数据中的误差。我们发现数据误差的来源主要有三个方面：(i) 数据更新；(ii) 公式的修订；(iii) 用于分类国家发展状态的阈值。我们提出了一个简单的统计框架，用于计算各国数据不确定性的具体指标，并研究数据误差如何影响排名的分配。研究发现，高达34%的国家被错误分类，通过复制先前的研究，我们发现由于数据误差，关键估计参数可能会出现高达100%的变化。

abstract.text: This paper studies racial/ethnic disparities in awareness of chronic diseases using biomarker data from the 2006 HRS. We estimate a 3-step sequential probit model which accounts for selection into: (1) participating in biomarker collection; (2) having illness (hypertension or diabetes); (3) being aware of illness. Contrary to studies reporting that African-Americans are more aware of having hypertension than non-Latino whites, we do not find this conclusion holds after self-selection and severity are considered. Likewise, African-Americans and Latinos are less aware of having diabetes compared to non-Latino whites. Disparities in unawareness are exacerbated when we limit the sample to untreated respondents.

10.3386/w16578.abstractZh: 本文利用2006年健康研究调查中的生物标志物数据，研究了种族/族裔在慢性疾病认知方面的差异。我们构建了一个三步序贯Probit模型，该模型考虑了以下三个因素的选择效应：(1)参与生物标志物收集；(2)患有疾病（高血压或糖尿病）；(3)知晓疾病情况。与一些研究认为非裔美国人比非拉丁裔白人更清楚自己是否患有高血压的观点不同，我们在考虑自我选择和疾病严重程度后并未发现这一结论成立。同样，与非拉丁裔白人相比，非裔美国人和拉丁裔对糖尿病的认知程度较低。当样本仅限于未接受治疗的受访者时，这种认知差异进一步加剧。

abstract.text: This paper estimates treatment size and status specific peer effects that are not detected by widely-used approaches to the estimation of spillovers. In a field experiment using university students, we find that subjects who have been incentivized to exercise increase gym usage more if they have more treated friends. However, control subjects are not influenced by their peers. Findings demonstrate that fraction treated has a large influence on outcomes in this environment, and spillovers vary greatly by treatment status. Results highlight subtle effects of randomization and document a low-cost method for improving the generalizability of controlled interventions in networked environments.

10.3386/w16581.abstractZh: 本文估计了那些被广泛使用的溢出效应估计方法未能检测到的、与处理对象身份相关的同伴效应。在一项针对大学生的实地实验中，我们发现，那些被激励去锻炼的受试者，如果拥有更多接受处理的朋友，那么他们使用健身房的频率会更高。然而，对照组受试者则不会受到同伴的影响。研究结果表明，在这种环境下，接受处理的群体对结果有着显著的影响，而溢出效应则因处理对象的身份不同而存在很大差异。研究结果揭示了随机化的微妙效应，并提供了一种低成本的方法，用于提高在网络环境中实施控制性干预措施的普适性。

abstract.text: While conducting empirical work, researchers sometimes observe changes in outcomes before adoption of a new treatment program. The conventional diagnosis is that treatment is endogenous. Observing changes in outcomes prior to treatment is also consistent, however, with anticipation effects. This paper provides a framework for comparing the different methods for estimating anticipation effects and proposes a new set of instrumental variables that can address the problem that subjects' expectations are unobservable. The paper uses this framework to analyze the effect of tort reform on physician supply and finds that accounting for anticipation effects doubles the estimated effect of tort reform.

10.3386/w16593.abstractZh: 在进行实证研究时，研究人员有时会观察到在采用新的治疗计划之前，结果发生的变化。传统的观点认为，这种治疗是内生的。然而，在治疗之前观察到结果的变化，也与预期效应相一致。本文提供了一个框架，用于比较估计预期效应的不同方法，并提出了一种新的工具变量集合，以解决受试者预期不可观测的问题。本文利用该框架分析了侵权法改革对医生供应的影响，发现考虑预期效应后，侵权法改革的估计效应翻倍。
