abstract.text: Poverty and altered planning horizons brought on by the HIV/AIDS epidemic can change individual discount rates, altering incentives to conserve natural resources. Using longitudinal data from household surveys in western Kenya, we estimate impacts of health status on labor productivity and discount rates. We find that household size and composition are predictors of whether the effect on productivity dominates the discount rate effect, or vice-versa. Since households with more and younger members are better able to reallocate labor to cope with productivity shocks, the discount rate impact dominates for these households and health improvements lead to greater levels of conservation. In smaller families with less substitutable labor, the productivity impact dominates and health improvements lead to greater environmental degradation.

10.3386/w16594.abstractZh: HIV/AIDS疫情导致的贫困和规划视角的改变可能会改变个人的折现率，从而影响对自然资源的保护意愿。我们利用肯尼亚西部家庭调查的纵向数据，评估健康状况对劳动生产力和折现率的影响。研究发现，家庭规模和构成是决定生产率的效应是否主导折现率效应，或者相反的关键因素。拥有更多年轻成员的较小家庭更能够重新分配劳动力以应对生产率的冲击，因此折现率效应在这些家庭中占主导地位，而健康状况的改善则会导致更高的资源保护水平。在劳动力可替代性较低的较小家庭中，生产率的效应占主导地位，健康状况的改善则会导致更大的环境退化。

abstract.text: We ask how patient knowledge of appropriate antibiotic usage affects both physicians prescribing behavior and the physician-patient relationship. We conduct an audit study in which a pair of simulated patients with identical flu-like complaints visits the same physician. Simulated patient A is instructed to ask a question that showcases his/her knowledge of appropriate antibiotic use, whereas patient B is instructed to say nothing beyond describing his/her symptoms. We find that a patient's knowledge of appropriate antibiotics use reduces both antibiotic prescription rates and drug expenditures. Such knowledge also increases physicians' information provision about possible side effects, but has a negative impact on the quality of the physician-patient interactions.

10.3386/w16602.abstractZh: 我们探讨了耐心掌握正确的抗生素使用知识如何影响医生开药行为以及医患关系。我们进行了一项审计研究，其中一对症状相似的模拟患者分别就诊于同一位医生。模拟患者A被要求提出一个能够体现其对抗生素使用知识掌握程度的问题，而模拟患者B则被要求仅描述自己的症状。研究发现，患者掌握正确的抗生素使用知识能够降低抗生素处方率和药物支出。此外，这种知识还能增加医生在告知可能的副作用方面的信息提供，但会对医患互动的质量产生负面影响。

abstract.text: Between 1973 and 2003, abortion providers in the United States were the targets of over 300 acts of extreme violence. Using unique data on attacks and on abortions, abortion providers, and births, we examine how anti-abortion violence has affected providers' decisions to perform abortions and women's decisions about whether and where to terminate a pregnancy. We find that clinic violence reduces abortion services in targeted areas. Once travel is taken into account, however, the overall effect of the violence is much smaller.

10.3386/w16603.abstractZh: 在1973年至2003年间，美国的堕胎服务提供者遭受了超过300起极端暴力行为的袭击。通过独特的攻击数据以及堕胎服务提供者与出生数据，我们研究了反堕胎暴力行为如何影响服务提供者对实施堕胎的决策，以及女性对是否以及何时终止妊娠的决策。我们发现，针对诊所的暴力行为会减少目标地区的堕胎服务。然而，一旦考虑到出行成本，暴力行为的总体影响要小得多。

abstract.text: Sedentary lifestyles, obesity, and obesity-related chronic diseases have become increasingly common among U.S. adults, posing a major health policy challenge. While individuals may be interested in exercising more to reduce these health risks, they often have difficultly forming long-term exercise habits. Behavioral economic devices like commitment contracts aid individuals make repeated actions in situations where there are upfront costs and the benefits, though substantial, are delayed. It is not known whether such contracts can help individuals to sustain increased exercise. We conducted a randomized controlled trial to test whether nudges and anchoring could be used to shift the types of exercise commitment contracts people entered into using a web-based contract creation tool. At the time of contract creation, users selected a contract length (duration); number of times a week to exercise (frequency); and a financial penalty for failing to live up to the contract in a given week (stake). We randomly set the default duration shown to users (8 weeks, 12 weeks, or 16 weeks). Outcomes include: contract acceptance; chosen duration, frequency, total exercise sessions; and chosen financial stake. We analyzed the data using multivariable regressions and also developed a theoretical model of active choice in the context of nudges, fitting the model to the data using non-linear optimization. 619 users, age 18-69, were included in the study, of whom 61% accepted/signed an exercise commitment contract. Users who were shown a longer default contract durations were significantly more likely to choose a contract of longer duration. There was no difference in the likelihood of accepting contracts or in the chosen exercise frequency or financial stakes. Our model of active choice suggested that almost 50% of users were highly susceptible to default values for contract duration, with the greatest effect for users interested in exercise contracts with durations nearer to the nudged defaults. This implication of the model was confirmed by quantile regressions (greatest effect of nudges for contract durations between the 40th and 80th percentiles). With changes in default values, individuals can be nudged into longer exercise commitment contracts that obligate them to greater numbers of exercise sessions.

10.3386/w16624.abstractZh: 久坐的生活方式、肥胖以及与肥胖相关的慢性疾病在美国成年人中越来越普遍，这构成了重大的健康政策挑战。虽然个人可能希望通过增加锻炼来降低这些健康风险，但他们往往难以形成长期的锻炼习惯。像承诺合同这样的行为经济工具可以帮助个人在存在前期成本且收益延迟的情况下进行重复行动。目前尚不清楚这类合同是否能够帮助个人持续增加锻炼。我们进行了一项随机对照试验，以测试提示和锚定策略是否可以用来改变人们使用基于网络的合同创建工具时所选择的锻炼承诺合同类型。在创建合同时，用户选择了合同期限、每周锻炼次数以及未能遵守合同时的财务惩罚。我们随机设置了默认的合同期限（8周、12周或16周）。研究结果包括：合同的接受情况、选定的合同期限、锻炼频率、总锻炼次数以及选定的财务惩罚。我们使用多变量回归分析数据，并开发了一个关于提示背景下主动选择的理论模型，通过非线性优化将模型拟合到数据上。研究纳入了619名年龄在18至69岁之间的用户，其中61%的用户接受了/签署了锻炼承诺合同。被展示更长时间限的默认合同的用户更有可能选择更长的合同期限。在接受合同的可能性、选定的锻炼频率或财务惩罚方面没有差异。我们的主动选择模型表明，几乎50%的用户对合同期限的默认值非常敏感，对于那些希望签订期限接近默认值的用户来说，这种影响最为显著。这一模型的结果通过分位数回归得到了验证——在合同期限的第40至80百分位数之间，默认值的调整对用户的激励作用最为明显。随着默认值的变化，个体可能会被引导签订更长期的承诺合同，从而被迫进行更多的锻炼。

abstract.text: Fires and burns are among the leading causes of unintentional death in the U.S. Most of these deaths occur in residences, and cigarettes are a primary cause. In this paper, I explore the relationship between smoking, cigarette policies, and fires. As fewer people smoke, there are less opportunities for fires, however, the magnitude of any reduction is in question as the people who quit may not necessarily start fires. Using a state-level panel, I find that reductions in smoking and increases in cigarette prices are associated with fewer fires. However, laws regulating indoor smoking are associated with increases in fires.

10.3386/w16625.abstractZh: 火灾和燃烧是美国非故意死亡的主要原因之一。这些死亡事件大多发生在住宅中，而香烟是主要诱因。本文探讨了吸烟、烟草政策与火灾之间的关系。随着吸烟人数的减少，火灾发生的机会也会减少，但这一减少的幅度存在疑问，因为戒烟者不一定会引发火灾。通过州级数据面板分析，我发现吸烟人数的减少和烟草价格的上涨与火灾数量的减少相关。然而，规范室内吸烟的法律则与火灾数量的增加有关。

abstract.text: As economic expansions raise employment and wages, associated shifts in income and time constraints would be expected to also impact individuals' health. This study utilizes information from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (1990-2007) to explore the relationship between the risk of unemployment and the consumption of various healthy and unhealthy foods. Estimates, based on fixed effects methodologies, indicate that a higher risk of unemployment is associated with reduced consumption of fruits and vegetables and increased consumption of "unhealthy" foods such as snacks and fast food. In addition to estimation of the average population effect, heterogeneous responses are also identified through detailed sample stratifications and by isolating the effect for those predicted to be at highest risk of unemployment based on their socio-economic characteristics. Among individuals predicted to be at highest risk of being unemployed, a one percentage point increase in the resident state's unemployment rate is associated with a 2-8% reduction in the consumption of fruits and vegetables. The impact is somewhat higher among married individuals and older adults. Supplementary analyses also explore specific mediating pathways, and point to reduced family income and adverse mental health as significant channels underlying the procyclical nature of healthy food consumption.

10.3386/w16638.abstractZh: 随着经济扩张带来就业和工资的提升，相应的收入变化和时间限制预计也会对个人的健康产生影响。本研究利用行为风险因素监测系统（1990-2007年）的数据，探讨失业风险与各种健康和不健康食品消费之间的关系。基于固定效应方法的估计表明，较高的失业风险与水果和蔬菜消费减少以及“不健康”食品如零食和快餐消费增加有关。除了对平均人群效应的估计外，还通过详细的样本分层以及针对那些根据社会经济特征被认为面临最高失业风险的人群进行独立分析，发现了异质性的反应。对于被认为面临最高失业风险的人群而言，所在州失业率每上升一个百分点，水果和蔬菜的消费量就会减少2-8%。在已婚个体和老年人中，这种影响更为显著。补充分析还探讨了特定的中介途径，指出家庭收入减少和心理健康状况不佳是健康食品消费顺周期性特征的重要渠道。

abstract.text: We discuss the identification and estimation of discrete games of complete information. Following Bresnahan and Reiss (1990, 1991), a discrete game is a generalization of a standard discrete choice model where utility depends on the actions of other players. Using recent algorithms to compute all of the Nash equilibria to a game, we propose simulation-based estimators for static, discrete games. We demonstrate that the model is identified under weak functional form assumptions using exclusion restrictions and an identification at infinity approach. Monte Carlo evidence demonstrates that the estimator can perform well in moderately sized samples. As an application, we study entry decisions by construction contractors to bid on highway projects in California. We find that an equilibrium is more likely to be observed if it maximizes joint profits, has a higher Nash product, uses mixed strategies, and is not Pareto dominated by another equilibrium.

10.3982/ecta5434.abstractZh: 我们讨论了完全信息下离散博弈的识别与估计问题。根据Bresnahan和Reiss（1990, 1991）的研究，离散博弈是标准离散选择模型的推广，其中效用取决于其他玩家的行为。利用最新的算法来计算博弈的所有纳什均衡，我们提出了基于模拟的静态离散博弈估计方法。我们证明，在弱函数形式假设下，通过排除限制和无穷远点识别方法，该模型可以被有效识别。蒙特卡洛检验表明，这种估计方法在中等规模的样本数据上表现良好。作为应用案例，我们研究了建筑承包商参与加州公路项目投标的决策行为。我们发现，如果一个均衡能够最大化联合利润、具有更高的纳什乘积、采用混合策略，并且不被另一个均衡帕累托支配，那么这个均衡就更有可能被观察到。

abstract.text: This paper studies partnerships that employ a mediator to improve their contractual ability. Intuitively, profitable deviations must be attributable, that is, there must be some group behavior such that an individual can be statistically identified as innocent, to provide incentives in partnerships. Mediated partnerships add value by effectively using different behavior to attribute different deviations. As a result, mediated partnerships are necessary to provide the right incentives in a wide range of economic environments.

10.3982/ecta6131.abstractZh: 本文研究了通过中介机构来提升契约能力的合作模式。直观上，盈利性的偏差必须能够被归因，也就是说，必须存在某种群体行为，使得个体能够在统计上被认定为无辜，从而为合作模式提供激励。通过中介机制，合作模式能够利用不同的行为来归因不同的偏差，从而创造价值。因此，在多种经济环境中，中介机制对于提供恰当的激励是不可或缺的。

abstract.text: We present a comprehensive framework for Bayesian estimation of structural nonlinear dynamic economic models on sparse grids. TheSmolyak operator underlying the sparse grids approach frees global approximation from the curse of dimensionality and we apply it to a Chebyshev approximation of the model solution. The operator also eliminates the curse from Gaussian quadrature and we use it for the integrals arising from rational expectations and in three new nonlinear state space filters. The filters substantially decrease the computational burden compared to the sequential importance resampling particle filter. The posterior of the structural parameters is estimated by a new Metropolis-Hastings algorithm with mixing parallel sequences. The parallel extension improves the global maximization property of the algorithm, simplifies the choice of the innovation variances, allows for unbiased convergence diagnostics and for a simple implementation of the estimation on parallel computers. Finally, we provide all algorithms in the open source software JBendge4 for the solution and estimation of a general class of models.

10.3982/ecta6297.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个用于稀疏网格上结构非线性动态经济模型贝叶斯估计的综合性框架。基于稀疏网格方法的Smolyak算子能够摆脱维数灾难的影响，我们将该算子应用于模型解的Chebyshev近似。该算子还能消除高斯求积法中的维数问题，我们将其用于理性预期模型中的积分计算，以及三种新的非线性状态空间滤波器中。与顺序重要性重采样粒子滤波器相比，这些滤波器显著降低了计算负担。结构参数的后验分布通过一种新的Metropolis-Hastings算法进行估计，该算法采用并行序列进行混合。这种并行扩展提升了算法的全局最大化性能，简化了创新方差的选择，使得收敛性诊断更加准确，并便于在并行计算机上实现简单的估计过程。最后，我们将所有算法集成到开源软件JBendge4中，用于一般类别模型的求解与估计。

abstract.text: This paper studies the identification and estimation of preferences and technologies in equilibrium hedonic models. In it, we identify nonparametric structural relationships with nonadditive heterogeneity. We determine what features of hedonic models can be identified from equilibrium observations in a single market under weak assumptions about the available information. We then consider use of additional information about structural functions and heterogeneity distributions. Separability conditions facilitate identification of consumer marginal utility and firm marginal product functions. We also consider how identification is facilitated using multimarket data.

10.3982/ecta6388.abstractZh: 本文研究了在均衡享乐主义模型中偏好和技术的识别与估计问题。我们识别了具有非加性异质性的非参数结构关系。在关于可用信息的弱假设下，我们确定了从单一市场的均衡观测中可以识别出的享乐主义模型的特征。随后，我们考虑了利用关于结构函数和异质性分布的额外信息的情况。分离性条件有助于识别消费者的边际效用和企业的边际产品函数。我们还研究了如何利用多市场数据来促进识别过程。

abstract.text: We show that in repeated interactions the avenues for effective provision of incentives depend crucially on the type of information players observe. We establish this conclusion for general repeated two-player games in which information arrives via a continuous-time stationary process that has a continuous multidimensional Brownian component and a Poisson component, and in which the players act frequently. The Poisson jumps can be used to effectively provide incentives both with transfers and value burning, while continuous Brownian information can be used to provide incentives only with transfers.

10.3982/ecta6420.abstractZh: 我们表明，在重复互动中，有效提供激励的途径在很大程度上取决于玩家所观察到信息的类型。我们对一般的重复双人游戏建立了这一结论，这些游戏中的信息通过一个连续时间的平稳过程传递，该过程包含连续的多维布朗成分和泊松成分，且玩家频繁采取行动。泊松跳跃可以用来有效提供转移激励和值燃烧激励，而连续的布朗信息则只能用于提供转移激励。

abstract.text: This paper formulates and estimates multistage production functions for child cognitive and noncognitive skills. Output is determined by parental environments and investments at different stages of childhood. We estimate the elasticity of substitution between investments in one period and stocks of skills in that period to assess the benefits of early investment in children compared to later remediation. We establish nonparametric identification of a general class of nonlinear factor models. A by-product of our approach is a framework for evaluating childhood interventions that does not rely on arbitrarily scaled test scores as outputs and recognizes the differential effects of skills in different tasks. Using the estimated technology, we determine optimal targeting of interventions to children with different parental and personal birth endowments. Substitutability decreases in later stages of the life cycle for the production of cognitive skills. It increases in later stages of the life cycle for the production of noncognitive skills. This finding has important implications for the design of policies that target the disadvantaged. For some configurations of disadvantage and outcomes, it is optimal to invest relatively more in the later stages of childhood.

10.3982/ecta6551.abstractZh: 本文提出了并估算了儿童认知与非认知技能的多阶段生产函数。产出取决于父母所处的环境以及儿童不同阶段的投入。我们通过估算某一时期投入与相应时期技能存量之间的替代弹性，来评估早期对儿童的投资与后期补救之间的收益差异。我们建立了一种非参数识别方法，用于识别一类非线性因子模型。我们方法的一个副产品是一个评估儿童干预的框架，该框架不依赖于任意缩放的测试分数作为输出，并且能够识别不同任务中技能的差异效应。利用估算出的技术参数，我们确定了针对不同父母和个人出生禀赋的儿童的最佳干预目标。在生命周期的后期阶段，认知技能的生产替代性会降低；而在非认知技能的生产方面，替代性则会增加。这一发现对于制定针对弱势群体的政策具有重要意义。对于某些弱势状况及其结果而言，在儿童生命的后期阶段进行更多投资是最优选择。

abstract.text: Unlike the prediction of a frictionless open economy model, long-term average savings and investment rates are highly correlated across countries—a puzzle first identified by Feldstein and Horioka (1980). We quantitatively investigate the impact of two types of financial frictions on this correlation. One is limited enforcement, where contracts are enforced by the threat of default penalties. The other is limited spanning, where the only asset available is noncontingent bonds. We find that the calibrated model with both frictions produces a savings–investment correlation and a volume of capital flows close to the data. To solve the puzzle, the limited enforcement friction needs low default penalties under which capital flows are much lower than those in the data, and the limited spanning friction needs to exogenously restrict capital flows to the observed level. When combined, the two frictions interact to endogenously restrict capital flows and thereby solve the Feldstein–Horioka puzzle.

10.3982/ecta6619.abstractZh: 与无摩擦开放经济模型的预测不同，长期平均储蓄率和投资率在不同国家之间具有高度相关性——这一现象最早由Feldstein和Horioka在1980年提出。我们定量研究了两种金融摩擦对这种相关性的影响。一种为有限执行机制，即合同通过违约罚款的威胁来强制执行；另一种为有限资产限制，即唯一可用的资产是非条件性债券。我们发现，同时存在这两种摩擦的模型能够产生接近实际数据的储蓄-投资相关性和资本流动量。为了解决这一谜题，有限执行机制的摩擦需要较低的违约罚款，此时资本流动量会远低于实际数据；而有限资产限制的摩擦则需要外部限制来将资本流动量维持在观察到的水平。当这两种摩擦结合在一起时，它们会内生性地限制资本流动，从而解决Feldstein-Horioka的谜题。

abstract.text: This paper provides a novel approach to ordering signals based on the property that more informative signals lead to greater variability of conditional expectations. We define two nested information criteria (supermodular precision and integral precision) by combining this approach with two variability orders (dispersive and convex orders). We relate precision criteria with orderings based on the value of information to a decision maker. We then use precision to study the incentives of an auctioneer to supply private information. Using integral precision, we obtain two results: (i) a more precise signal yields a more efficient allocation; (ii) the auctioneer provides less than the efficient level of information. Supermodular precision allows us to extend the previous analysis to the case in which supplying information is costly and to obtain an additional finding; (iii) there is a complementarity between information and competition, so that both the socially efficient and the auctioneer's optimal choice of precision increase with the number of bidders.

10.3982/ecta6640.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种基于新方法的信号排序方式，该方法以“信息越丰富，条件期望的变异性越大”这一特性为基础。我们通过结合两种变异性排序方式（离散排序和凸排序）来定义两个嵌套的信息标准（超模块精度和积分精度）。我们将这些精度标准与基于信息价值对决策者的排序方式联系起来。随后，我们利用精度标准来研究拍卖师提供私人信息的动机。通过积分精度分析，我们得到了两个结论：(i) 更精确的信号会带来更高效的分配结果；(ii) 拍卖师提供的信息量低于最优水平。超模块精度使我们能够将先前分析扩展到信息提供成本较高的情形，并得出一个额外发现：信息与竞争之间存在互补性，因此无论是社会最优解还是拍卖师在精度选择上的最优解，都会随着竞买者数量的增加而提升。

abstract.text: This paper provides computationally intensive, yet feasible methods for inference in a very general class of partially identified econometric models. Let P denote the distribution of the observed data. The class of models we consider is defined by a population objective function Q(θ, P) for θ∈Θ. The point of departure from the classical extremum estimation framework is that it is not assumed that Q(θ, P) has a unique minimizer in the parameter space Θ. The goal may be either to draw inferences about some unknown point in the set of minimizers of the population objective function or to draw inferences about the set of minimizers itself. In this paper, the object of interest is Θ0(P)=argminθ∈ΘQ(θ, P), and so we seek random sets that contain this set with at least some prespecified probability asymptotically. We also consider situations where the object of interest is the image of Θ0(P) under a known function. Random sets that satisfy the desired coverage property are constructed under weak assumptions. Conditions are provided under which the confidence regions are asymptotically valid not only pointwise in P, but also uniformly in P. We illustrate the use of our methods with an empirical study of the impact of top-coding outcomes on inferences about the parameters of a linear regression. Finally, a modest simulation study sheds some light on the finite-sample behavior of our procedure.

10.3982/ecta6706.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种计算量较大但可行的推断方法，适用于一类非常通用的部分识别计量经济模型。用P表示观测数据的分布。我们所考虑的模型类由总体目标函数Q(θ, P)定义，其中θ∈Θ。与经典极值估计框架的不同之处在于，并不假设Q(θ, P)在参数空间Θ中有唯一的最小值点。目标可能是对总体目标函数的最小化集合中的某个未知点进行推断，也可能是对最小化集合本身进行推断。在本文中，我们关注的对象是Θ0(P)=argminθ∈ΘQ(θ, P)，因此我们寻找能够以至少某个预先指定的概率渐进地包含该集合的随机集合。我们还考虑了当关注的对象是Θ0(P)在已知函数下的像时的情况。在弱假设下，可以构造满足所需覆盖性质的随机集合。我们提供了条件，使得置信区域不仅在P上逐点有效，而且在P上均匀有效。我们通过一项关于顶级编码结果对线性回归参数推断影响的实证研究，说明了我们方法的应用。最后，一项适度的模拟研究揭示了我们程序在有限样本下的行为。

abstract.text: Harsanyi's impartial observer must consider two types of lotteries: imaginary identity lotteries (“accidents of birth”) that she faces as herself and the real outcome lotteries (“life chances”) to be faced by the individuals she imagines becoming. If we maintain a distinction between identity and outcome lotteries, then Harsanyi-like axioms yield generalized utilitarianism, and allow us to accommodate concerns about different individuals' risk attitudes and concerns about fairness. Requiring an impartial observer to be indifferent as to which individual should face similar risks restricts her social welfare function, but still allows her to accommodate fairness. Requiring an impartial observer to be indifferent between identity and outcome lotteries, however, forces her to ignore both fairness and different risk attitudes, and yields a new axiomatization of Harsanyi's utilitarianism.

10.3982/ecta6712.abstractZh: 哈萨尼的公正观察者必须考虑两种类型的彩票：一种是她作为个体所面临的虚构身份彩票（“出生时的偶然性”），另一种是她想象中将成为个体时所面临的真实结果彩票（“人生机遇”）。如果我们区分身份彩票和结果彩票，那么类似哈萨尼的公理就能产生广义的功利主义，并允许我们考虑到不同个体的风险态度以及公平性问题。要求公正观察者对哪些个体应面临相似的风险持中立态度，会限制她的社会福利函数，但仍然允许她兼顾公平性问题。然而，要求公正观察者对身份彩票和结果彩票保持中立态度，则迫使她忽略公平性和不同风险态度，从而产生了哈萨尼功利主义的新公理化表述。

abstract.text: This paper extends the static analysis of oligopoly structure into an infinite-horizon setting with sunk costs and demand uncertainty. The observation that exit rates decline with firm age motivates the assumption of last-in first-out dynamics: An entrant expects to produce no longer than any incumbent. This selects an essentially unique Markov-perfect equilibrium. With mild restrictions on the demand shocks, sequences of thresholds describe firms' equilibrium entry and survival decisions. Bresnahan and Reiss' (1993) empirical analysis of oligopolists' entry and exit assumes that such thresholds govern the evolution of the number of competitors. Our analysis provides an infinite-horizon game-theoretic foundation for that structure.

10.3982/ecta6863.abstractZh: 本文将寡头结构的静态分析扩展至包含沉没成本和需求不确定性的无限时域情境。由于退出率随企业年龄的增加而下降，因此假设采用后进先出的动态机制：新进入者预期其生存时间不会超过现有企业。这一假设会选择一个本质上独特的马尔可夫完美均衡。在需求冲击的适度限制下，一系列阈值描述了企业进入市场及生存的决策过程。Bresnahan和Reiss在1993年对寡头企业进入与退出的实证分析假设这些阈值决定了竞争对手数量的变化。我们的分析为这种结构提供了无限时域的博弈论基础。

abstract.text: Learning-by-doing and organizational forgetting are empirically important in a variety of industrial settings. This paper provides a general model of dynamic competition that accounts for these fundamentals and shows how they shape industry structure and dynamics. We show that forgetting does not simply negate learning. Rather, they are distinct economic forces that interact in subtle ways to produce a great variety of pricing behaviors and industry dynamics. In particular, a model with learning and forgetting can give rise to aggressive pricing behavior, varying degrees of long-run industry concentration ranging from moderate leadership to absolute dominance, and multiple equilibria.

10.3982/ecta6994.abstractZh: 在实践中学习和组织性遗忘在多种工业环境中具有重要的现实意义。本文提出了一个动态竞争的一般模型，该模型考虑了这些基本现象，并揭示了它们如何塑造行业结构和动态变化。我们指出，遗忘并不简单地否定学习，而是两种不同的经济力量以微妙的方式相互作用，从而产生多种多样的定价行为和行业动态。具体而言，一个包含学习和遗忘的模型能够引发激进的定价行为，形成不同程度的长期行业集中度，从中等领导地位到绝对主导地位，并出现多种均衡状态。

abstract.text: We consider a class of mechanism games in which there are multiple principals and three or more agents. For a mechanism game in this class, a sort of folk theorem holds: there is a threshold value for each of the principals such that an allocation is achieved at a pure-strategy sequential equilibrium of the game if and only if (i) it is incentive compatible and (ii) it attains an expected utility for each principal that is greater than or equal to the threshold value for the principal.

10.3982/ecta7005.abstractZh: 我们考虑了一类机制博弈，这类博弈中存在多个主体和三个或更多的代理人。对于这类机制博弈，存在一个所谓的“民间定理”：每个主体都有一个阈值，只有当分配方案满足以下条件时，才能达到博弈的纯策略序贯均衡：(i) 该分配方案具有激励兼容性；(ii) 每个主体的期望效用大于或等于该阈值。

abstract.text: The subjective likelihood of a contingency often depends on the manner in which it is described to the decision maker. To accommodate this dependence, we introduce a model of decision making under uncertainty that takes as primitive a family of preferences indexed by partitions of the state space. Each partition corresponds to a description of the state space. We characterize the following partition-dependent expected utility representation. The decision maker has a nonadditive set function ν over events. Given a partition of the state space, she computes expected utility with respect to her partition-dependent belief, which weights each cell in the partition by ν. Nonadditivity of ν allows the probability of an event to depend on the way in which the state space is described. We propose behavioral definitions for those events that are transparent to the decision maker and those that are completely overlooked, and connect these definitions to conditions on the representation.

10.3982/ecta7019.abstractZh: 一个偶然事件的主观可能性往往取决于其向决策者描述的方式。为了适应这种依赖性，我们引入了一个不确定性下的决策模型，该模型以状态空间的划分作为偏好族的原始基础。每个划分对应状态空间的一种描述。我们描述了以下依赖于划分的期望效用表示方式。决策者对事件有一个非加性集合函数ν。给定状态空间的划分，她根据依赖于划分的信念来计算期望效用，该信念通过ν对划分中的每个单元格进行加权。ν的非加性使得一个事件的概率可以取决于状态空间的描述方式。我们为那些对决策者来说透明的事件以及那些完全被忽视的事件提出了行为定义，并将这些定义与表示方式的条件联系起来。

abstract.text: This paper develops methods for evaluating marginal policy changes. We characterize how the effects of marginal policy changes depend on the direction of the policy change, and show that marginal policy effects are fundamentally easier to identify and to estimate than conventional treatment parameters. We develop the connection between marginal policy effects and the average effect of treatment for persons on the margin of indifference between participation in treatment and nonparticipation, and use this connection to analyze both parameters. We apply our analysis to estimate the effect of marginal changes in tuition on the return to going to college.

10.3982/ecta7089.abstractZh: 本文提出了评估边际政策变化的方法。我们描述了边际政策变化的效果如何取决于政策变化的方向，并表明边际政策效应比传统处理参数更容易识别和估计。我们建立了边际政策效应与处理的平均效应之间的联系，这种联系有助于分析这两个参数。我们将这一分析应用于估计学费边际变化对上大学回报的影响。

abstract.text: A unifying framework to test for causal effects in nonlinear models is proposed. We consider a generalized linear-index regression model with endogenous regressors and no parametric assumptions on the error disturbances. To test the significance of the effect of an endogenous regressor, we propose a statistic that is a kernel-weighted version of the rank correlation statistic (tau) of Kendall (1938). The semiparametric model encompasses previous cases considered in the literature (continuous endogenous regressors (Blundell and Powell (2003)) and a single binary endogenous regressor (Vytlacil and Yildiz (2007))), but the testing approach is the first to allow for (i) multiple discrete endogenous regressors, (ii) endogenous regressors that are neither discrete nor continuous (e.g., a censored variable), and (iii) an arbitrary “mix” of endogenous regressors (e.g., one binary regressor and one continuous regressor).

10.3982/ecta7133.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个统一的框架，用于检验非线性模型中的因果效应。我们考虑了一个广义线性指数回归模型，该模型包含内生回归变量，并且对误差扰动没有参数假设。为了检验内生回归变量效应的显著性，我们提出了一种统计量，该统计量是Kendall（1938年）提出的秩相关统计量（tau）的核加权版本。这个半参数模型涵盖了文献中之前考虑的情况（连续内生回归变量（Blundell和Powell，2003年）以及单一二元内生回归变量（Vytlacil和Yildiz，2007年）），但这一检验方法首次允许以下情况：(i) 多个离散内生回归变量；(ii) 既不是离散也不是连续的内生回归变量（例如，被截尾的变量）；以及(iii) 任意“混合”的内生回归变量（例如，一个二元回归变量和一个连续回归变量）。

abstract.text: It has long been recognized that there is considerable heterogeneity in individual risk taking behavior, but little is known about the distribution of risk taking types. We present a parsimonious characterization of risk taking behavior by estimating a finite mixture model for three different experimental data sets, two Swiss and one Chinese, over a large number of real gains and losses. We find two major types of individuals: In all three data sets, the choices of roughly 80% of the subjects exhibit significant deviations from linear probability weighting of varying strength, consistent with prospect theory. Twenty percent of the subjects weight probabilities near linearly and behave essentially as expected value maximizers. Moreover, individuals are cleanly assigned to one type with probabilities close to unity. The reliability and robustness of our classification suggest using a mix of preference theories in applied economic modeling.

10.3982/ecta7139.abstractZh: 长期以来，人们已经认识到个体风险承担行为存在相当大的异质性，但关于风险承担类型的分布却知之甚少。我们通过估计三个不同实验数据集的有限混合模型来简洁地描述风险承担行为，这些数据集包括两个瑞士数据集和一个中国数据集，涵盖了大量真实的收益和损失情况。我们发现个体主要分为两类：在所有三个数据集中，大约80%的受试者的选择表现出不同程度的线性概率加权偏差，这与前景理论的观点一致。20%的受试者以接近线性的方式加权概率，其行为本质上属于期望值最大化者。此外，个体可以清晰地被分配到某一类型中，其概率接近1。我们分类的可靠性和稳健性表明，在应用经济建模中可以使用多种偏好理论进行组合。

abstract.text: We construct a new index of media slant that measures whether a news outlet's language is more similar to a congressional Republican or Democrat. We apply the measure to study the market forces that determine political content in the news. We estimate a model of newspaper demand that incorporates slant explicitly, estimate the slant that would be chosen if newspapers independently maximized their own profits, and compare these ideal points with firms' actual choices. Our analysis confirms an economically significant demand for news slanted toward one's own political ideology. Firms respond strongly to consumer preferences, which account for roughly 20 percent of the variation in measured slant in our sample. By contrast, the identity of a newspaper's owner explains far less of the variation in slant, and we find little evidence that media conglomerates homogenize news to minimize fixed costs in the production of content.

10.3982/ecta7195.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个新的媒体倾向指数，用于衡量一家新闻媒体的语言是否更倾向于共和党或民主党的政治立场。我们运用这一指数来研究决定新闻政治内容的市场力量。我们建立了一个包含媒体倾向的报纸需求模型，估算出如果报纸独立追求自身利润时可能会选择的倾向，并将这些理想状态与企业的实际选择进行比较。我们的分析证实，存在一种经济上显著的需求，即新闻倾向于符合个人政治意识形态的倾向。企业对消费者偏好有强烈的反应，消费者偏好占我们样本中所测量的媒体倾向变化的约20%。相比之下，报纸所有者的身份对倾向变化的解释力要小得多，而且我们发现几乎没有证据表明媒体集团会为了最小化内容生产的固定成本而使新闻趋于一致。

abstract.text: We prove the generic existence of a recursive equilibrium for overlapping-generations economies with uncertainty. “Generic” here means in a residual set of utilities and endowments. The result holds provided there is a sufficient number of potentially different individuals within each cohort.

10.3982/ecta7219.abstractZh: 我们证明了在存在不确定性的重叠世代经济体系中，递归均衡的通用存在性。这里的“通用”指的是在剩余的效用和禀赋集合中的情况。只要每个队列中存在着足够数量的潜在不同的个体，这一结果就成立。

abstract.text: Much of the extensive empirical literature on insurance markets has focused on whether adverse selection can be detected. Once detected, however, there has been little attempt to quantify its welfare cost, or to assess whether and what potential government interventions may reduce these costs. To do so, we develop a model of annuity contract choice and estimate it using data from the U.K. annuity market. The model allows for private information about mortality risk as well as heterogeneity in preferences over different contract options. We focus on the choice of length of guarantee among individuals who are required to buy annuities. The results suggest that asymmetric information along the guarantee margin reduces welfare relative to a first best symmetric information benchmark by about £127 million per year, or about 2 percent of annuitized wealth. We also find that by requiring that individuals choose the longest guarantee period allowed, mandates could achieve the first-best allocation. However, we estimate that other mandated guarantee lengths would have detrimental effects on welfare. Since determining the optimal mandate is empirically difficult, our findings suggest that achieving welfare gains through mandatory social insurance may be harder in practice than simple theory may suggest.

10.3982/ecta7245.abstractZh: 关于保险市场的广泛实证文献大多集中在是否能够检测到逆向选择问题上。然而，一旦检测到逆向选择，很少有人尝试量化其福利成本，或者评估政府干预是否以及可以采取何种措施来降低这些成本。为此，我们建立了一个年金合同选择模型，并使用英国年金市场的数据对其进行估计。该模型考虑了关于死亡风险的私人信息，以及不同合同选项偏好上的异质性。我们重点关注那些需要购买年金的人在选择保证期限时的行为。研究结果表明，与最佳对称信息基准相比，保证期限的不对称信息会导致每年约1.27亿英镑的福利损失，约占年金财富的2%。我们还发现，通过要求个人选择最长的保证期限，可以实现最佳配置。然而，我们估计，其他规定的保证期限会对福利产生负面影响。由于确定最优的强制保险条款在实证上较为困难，我们的研究结果表明，通过强制性的社会保险来实现福利改善在实践中可能比理论预测要困难。

abstract.text: We consider truthful implementation of the socially efficient allocation in an independent private-value environment in which agents receive private information over time. We propose a suitable generalization of the pivot mechanism, based on the marginal contribution of each agent. In the dynamic pivot mechanism, the ex-post incentive and ex-post participation constraints are satisfied for all agents after all histories. In an environment with diverse preferences it is the unique mechanism satisfying ex-post incentive, ex-post participation and efficient exit conditions. We develop the dynamic pivot mechanism in detail for a repeated auction of a single object in which each bidder learns over time her true valuation of the object. We show that the dynamic pivot mechanism is equivalent to a modified second price auction.

10.3982/ecta7260.abstractZh: 我们考虑在独立且私有价值的环境中，如何实现对社会效率的公平分配，其中各主体会随时间接收私有信息。我们提出了一种基于每个主体边际贡献的枢轴机制的适当推广。在动态枢轴机制中，所有主体在所有历史记录之后都能满足事后激励和事后参与约束。在偏好多样化的环境中，这种机制是唯一能满足事后激励、事后参与以及效率退出条件的机制。我们详细阐述了在重复拍卖单一物品时的动态枢轴机制，其中每个竞标者会随时间了解自己对该物品的真实估值。我们证明，动态枢轴机制等同于一种修改后的第二价格拍卖机制。

abstract.text: We study a continuous-time principal–agent model in which a risk-neutral agent with limited liability must exert unobservable effort to reduce the likelihood of large but relatively infrequent losses. Firm size can be decreased at no cost or increased subject to adjustment costs. In the optimal contract, investment takes place only if a long enough period of time elapses with no losses occurring. Then, if good performance continues, the agent is paid. As soon as a loss occurs, payments to the agent are suspended, and so is investment if further losses occur. Accumulated bad performance leads to downsizing. We derive explicit formulae for the dynamics of firm size and its asymptotic growth rate, and we provide conditions under which firm size eventually goes to zero or grows without bounds.

10.3982/ecta7261.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个连续时间的主-代理模型，在这个模型中，一个承担有限责任的风险中性代理必须付出难以观察到的努力来降低发生大规模但相对罕见的损失的可能性。企业规模可以无需成本减少，也可以增加，但需支付调整成本。在最优契约下，只有当足够长的时间没有发生损失时，才会进行投资。如果表现良好，代理将获得报酬；一旦发生损失，代理的报酬就会暂停，如果继续发生损失，投资也会停止。累积的不良表现会导致企业规模缩小。我们推导出了企业规模动态及其渐近增长率的显式公式，并提出了企业规模最终趋于零或无限增长的条件。

abstract.text: Single equation instrumental variable models for discrete outcomes are shown to be set identifying, not point identifying, for the structural functions that deliver the values of the discrete outcome. Bounds on identified sets are derived for a general nonparametric model and sharp set identification is demonstrated in the binary outcome case. Point identification is typically not achieved by imposing parametric restrictions. The extent of an identified set varies with the strength and support of instruments, and typically shrinks as the support of a discrete outcome grows. The paper extends the analysis of structural quantile functions with endogenous arguments to cases in which there are discrete outcomes.

10.3982/ecta7315.abstractZh: 对于离散结果，单方程工具变量模型被证明是集合识别性的，而非点识别性的。对于提供离散结果值的结构函数，可以推导出识别集合的界限。对于一般的非参数模型，可以推导出识别集合的界限，并且在二元结果情况下可以证明集合识别是尖锐的。通过施加参数限制通常无法实现点识别。识别集合的范围随着工具变量的强度和支持程度而变化，通常随着离散结果支持的增强而缩小。本文将结构分位数函数的分析扩展到存在离散结果的情况。

abstract.text: This paper develops a framework to assess how fear of miscoordination affects the sustainability of cooperation. Building on theoretical insights from Carlsson and van Damme (1993), it explores the effect of small amounts of private information on a class of dynamic cooperation games with exit. Lack of common knowledge leads players to second guess each other's behavior and makes coordination difficult. This restricts the range of equilibria and highlights the role of miscoordination payoffs in determining whether cooperation is sustainable or not. The paper characterizes the range of perfect Bayesian equilibria as the players' information becomes arbitrarily precise. Unlike in one-shot two-by-two games, the global games information structure does not yield equilibrium uniqueness.

10.3982/ecta7324.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个框架，用于评估对协调失败的恐惧如何影响合作的可持续性。基于Carlsson和van Damme（1993年）的理论见解，本文探讨了少量私人信息对一类具有退出机制的动态合作博弈的影响。缺乏共同知识会导致参与者对彼此的行为产生怀疑，从而使得协调变得困难。这限制了均衡的范围，并凸显了协调失败收益在决定合作是否可持续方面的作用。本文将完美贝叶斯均衡的范围描述为参与者信息变得任意精确的情况。与一次性二维博弈不同，全局博弈的信息结构并不保证均衡的唯一性。

abstract.text: In weighted moment condition models, we show a subtle link between identification and estimability that limits the practical usefulness of estimators based on these models. In particular, if it is necessary for (point) identification that the weights take arbitrarily large values, then the parameter of interest, though point identified, cannot be estimated at the regular (parametric) rate and is said to be irregularly identified. This rate depends on relative tail conditions and can be as slow in some examples as n−1/4. This nonstandard rate of convergence can lead to numerical instability and/or large standard errors. We examine two weighted model examples: (i) the binary response model under mean restriction introduced by Lewbel (1997) and further generalized to cover endogeneity and selection, where the estimator in this class of models is weighted by the density of a special regressor, and (ii) the treatment effect model under exogenous selection (Rosenbaum and Rubin (1983)), where the resulting estimator of the average treatment effect is one that is weighted by a variant of the propensity score. Without strong relative support conditions, these models, similar to well known “identified at infinity” models, lead to estimators that converge at slower than parametric rate, since essentially, to ensure point identification, one requires some variables to take values on sets with arbitrarily small probabilities, or thin sets. For the two models above, we derive some rates of convergence and propose that one conducts inference using rate adaptive procedures that are analogous to Andrews and Schafgans (1998) for the sample selection model.

10.3982/ecta7372.abstractZh: 在加权矩条件模型中，我们揭示了识别性与可估计性之间的微妙联系，这限制了基于这些模型的估计量的实际用途。特别是，如果（点）识别要求权重可以取任意大的值，那么感兴趣的参数虽然可以被点识别，但不能以常规的（参数化）速率进行估计，这种情况被称为不规则识别。这种收敛速率取决于相对尾部条件，在某些例子中可能慢至n−1/4。这种非标准的收敛速率可能导致数值不稳定和/或较大的标准误差。我们研究了两个加权模型示例：(i) Lewbel（1997年）提出的在均值限制下的二元响应模型，该模型进一步推广以涵盖内生性和选择性问题，这类模型的估计量通过特殊回归量的密度加权；(ii) 在外部选择性下的处理效应模型（Rosenbaum和Rubin，1983年），其中平均处理效应的估计量通过倾向得分的变体加权。如果没有强相对支持条件，这些模型类似于众所周知的“在无穷远处被识别”的模型，会导致估计量以低于参数化速率的速率收敛，因为为了确保点识别，需要某些变量取值在概率极小的集合上，即稀疏集合上。对于上述两个模型，我们推导了一些收敛速率，并建议使用类似于Andrews和Schafgans（1998年）为样本选择模型提出的速率自适应程序进行推断。

abstract.text: The minimax argument represents game theory in its most elegant form: simple but with stark predictions. Although some of these predictions have been met with reasonable success in the field, experimental data have generally not provided results close to the theoretical predictions. In a striking study, Palacios-Huerta and Volij (2007) present evidence that potentially resolves this puzzle: both amateur and professional soccer players play nearly exact minimax strategies in laboratory experiments. In this paper, we establish important bounds on these results by examining the behavior of four distinct subject pools: college students, bridge professionals, world-class poker players, who have vast experience with high-stakes randomization in card games, and American professional soccer players. In contrast to Palacios-Huerta and Volij’s results, we find little evidence that real-world experience transfers to the lab in these games—indeed, similar to previous experimental results, all four subject pools provide choices that are generally not close to minimax predictions. We use two additional pieces of evidence to explore why professionals do not perform well in the lab: (1) complementary experimental treatments that pit professionals against preprogrammed computers, and (2) post-experiment questionnaires. The most likely explanation is

10.3982/ecta7405.abstractZh: 极小极大论证代表了博弈论最优雅的形式：简单但具有明确的预测。尽管其中一些预测在领域内取得了一定的成功，但实验数据通常未能提供与理论预测接近的结果。在一项引人注目的研究中，Palacios-Huerta和Volij（2007）提出了可能解决这一谜题的证据：业余和职业足球运动员在实验室实验中几乎都遵循极小极大策略。在本文中，我们通过考察四个不同群体的行为来对这些结果进行重要限制：大学生、桥牌专业人士、具有丰富高赌注随机化经验的世界级扑克玩家，以及美国职业足球运动员。与Palacios-Huerta和Volij的研究结果不同，我们发现现实世界经验在这些游戏中并未转移到实验室中——实际上，与之前的实验结果类似，所有四个群体提供的选择通常都不接近极小极大预测。我们使用另外两项证据来探讨为什么专业人士在实验室中的表现不佳：（1）将专业人士与预编程计算机进行对比的补充实验处理；（2）实验后的问卷调查。最可能的解释是……

abstract.text: The deferred acceptance algorithm is often used to allocate indivisible objects when monetary transfers are not allowed. We provide two characterizations of agent-proposing deferred acceptance allocation rules. Two new axioms, individually rational monotonicity and weak Maskin monotonicity, are essential to our analysis. An allocation rule is the agent-proposing deferred acceptance rule for some acceptant substitutable priority if and only if it satisfies non-wastefulness and individually rational monotonicity. An alternative characterization is in terms of non-wastefulness, population monotonicity and weak Maskin monotonicity. We also offer an axiomatization of the deferred acceptance rule generated by an exogenously specified priority structure. We apply our results to characterize efficient deferred acceptance rules. 1.

10.3982/ecta7443.abstractZh: 延迟接受算法常用于在不允许货币转移的情况下分配不可分割的对象。我们提出了两种描述代理人提出的延迟接受分配规则的特征。两个新的公理——个体理性单调性和弱Maskin单调性——对我们的分析至关重要。一个分配规则是代理人提出的延迟接受规则，用于某些可替代优先级的接受者，当且仅当它满足非浪费性和个体理性单调性时成立。另一种描述方式基于非浪费性、人口单调性和弱Maskin单调性。我们还提供了一种由外源指定优先级结构生成的延迟接受规则的公理化描述。我们将我们的结果应用于描述有效的延迟接受规则。

abstract.text: This paper considers model averaging as a way to construct optimal instruments for the two-stage least squares (2SLS), limited information maximum likelihood (LIML), and Fuller estimators in the presence of many instruments. We propose averaging across least squares predictions of the endogenous variables obtained from many different choices of instruments and then use the average predicted value of the endogenous variables in the estimation stage. The weights for averaging are chosen to minimize the asymptotic mean squared error of the model averaging version of the 2SLS, LIML, or Fuller estimator. This can be done by solving a standard quadratic programming problem.

10.3982/ecta7444.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在存在多个工具变量的情况下，如何通过模型平均法来构建最优工具变量，以用于两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）、有限信息最大似然法（LIML）以及富勒估计量。我们建议对从多种不同工具变量选择中得到的内生变量的最小二乘预测值进行平均处理，然后在估计阶段使用这些平均预测值。平均处理的权重选择旨在最小化模型平均版本的两阶段最小二乘法、有限信息最大似然法或富勒估计量的渐近均方误差。这可以通过解决一个标准的二次规划问题来实现。

abstract.text: Fudenberg and Levine (1993a) introduced the notion of self-confirming equilibrium, which is generally less restrictive than Nash equilibrium. Fudenberg and Levine also defined a concept of consistency, and claimed in their Theorem 4 that with consistency and other conditions on beliefs, a self-confirming equilibrium has a Nash equilibrium outcome. We provide a counterexample that disproves Theorem 4 and prove an alternative by replacing consistency with a more restrictive concept, which we call strong consistency. In games with observed deviators, self-confirming equilibria are strongly consistent self-confirming equilibria. Hence, our alternative theorem ensures that despite the counterexample, the corollary of Theorem 4 is still valid.

10.3982/ecta7496.abstractZh: Fudenberg和Levine在1993a年引入了自我确认均衡的概念，这一概念通常比纳什均衡更为宽松。Fudenberg和Levine还定义了一致性的概念，并在他们的定理4中声称，在一致性以及其他关于信念的条件下，自我确认均衡的结果与纳什均衡的结果是一致的。我们提供了一个反例，证明了定理4是错误的，并通过用更严格的一致性概念来替代一致性，从而提出了另一种替代定理。在存在观测到的偏差因素的游戏中，自我确认均衡就是强一致性自我确认均衡。因此，我们的替代定理确保了尽管存在反例，定理4的推论仍然成立。

abstract.text: The topic of this paper is inference in models in which parameters are defined by moment inequalities and/or equalities. The parameters may or may not be identified. This paper introduces a new class of confidence sets and tests based on generalized moment selection (GMS). GMS procedures are shown to have correct asymptotic size in a uniform sense and are shown not to be asymptotically conservative. The power of GMS tests is compared to that of subsampling, m out of n bootstrap, and “plug-in asymptotic” (PA) tests. The latter three procedures are the only general procedures in the literature that have been shown to have correct asymptotic size (in a uniform sense) for the moment inequality/equality model. GMS tests are shown to have asymptotic power that dominates that of subsampling, m out of n bootstrap, and PA tests. Subsampling and m out of n bootstrap tests are shown to have asymptotic power that dominates that of PA tests.

10.3982/ecta7502.abstractZh: 本文的主题是那些参数由矩不等式和/或等式定义的模型中的推断问题。这些参数可能被识别，也可能未被识别。本文介绍了一种基于广义矩选择的新类置信集和检验方法。研究表明，广义矩选择方法在均匀意义上具有正确的渐近大小，并且不表现出渐近保守性。将广义矩选择检验的功效与子样本法、m out of n自助法以及“插入渐近”检验的功效进行了比较。后三种方法是文献中唯一被证明在矩不等式/等式模型中具有正确渐近大小的方法。研究表明，广义矩选择检验的渐近功效优于子样本法、m out of n自助法和插入渐近检验。同时，子样本法和m out of n自助法的渐近功效也优于插入渐近检验。

abstract.text: A model for binary panel data is introduced which allows for state dependence and unobserved heterogeneity beyond the effect of available covariates. The model is of quadratic exponential type and its structure closely resembles that of the dynamic logit model. However, it has the advantage of being easily estimable via conditional likelihood with at least two observations (further to an initial observation) and even in the presence of time dummies among the regressors.

10.3982/ecta7531.abstractZh: 本文介绍了一种适用于二元面板数据的模型，该模型能够考虑状态依赖性和超出现有协变量影响的未观测异质性。该模型属于二次指数型，其结构与动态逻辑模型非常相似。然而，该模型的优势在于可以通过条件似然法轻松进行估计，即使至少有两个观测值（甚至更多），并且即使回归变量中存在时间虚拟变量时也能实现。

abstract.text: We study preferences over menus which can be represented as if the individual is uncertain of her tastes, but is able to engage in costly contemplation before selecting an alternative from a menu. Since contemplation is costly, our key axiom, aversion to contingent planning, reflects the individual's preference to learn the menu from which she will be choosing prior to engaging in contemplation about her tastes for the alternatives. Our representation models contemplation strategies as subjective signals over a subjective state space. The subjectivity of the state space and the information structure in our representation makes it difficult to identify them from the preference. To overcome this issue, we show that each signal can be modeled in reduced form as a measure over ex post utility functions without reference to a state space. We show that in this reduced-form representation, the set of measures and their costs are uniquely identified. Finally, we provide a measure of comparative contemplation costs and characterize the special case of our representation where contemplation is costless.

10.3982/ecta7801.abstractZh: 我们研究了关于菜单的偏好选择，这种偏好可以假设个体对其口味并不确定，但在从菜单中选择一个选项之前，能够进行昂贵的思考。由于思考是昂贵的，我们的核心公理——对偶然规划的厌恶——反映了个体在考虑不同选项的口味之前，希望先了解自己将要选择的菜单。我们的表示模型将思考策略视为一个主观状态空间上的主观信号。状态空间的主观性以及我们表示中的信息结构使得从偏好中识别这些信号变得困难。为了克服这个问题，我们展示了每个信号都可以以简化形式被建模为对事后效用函数的度量，而无需参考状态空间。我们证明，在这种简化形式的表示中，这些度量的集合及其成本是可以唯一确定的。最后，我们提供了一种比较思考成本的方法，并描述了我们的表示模型中思考成本为零的特殊情况。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a method to address the longstanding problem of lack of monotonicity in estimation of conditional and structural quantile functions, also known as the quantile crossing problem (Bassett and Koenker (1982)). The method consists in sorting or monotone rearranging the original estimated non-monotone curve into a monotone rearranged curve. We show that the rearranged curve is closer to the true quantile curve than the original curve in finite samples, establish a functional delta method for rearrangement-related operators, and derive functional limit theory for the entire rearranged curve and its functionals. We also establish validity of the bootstrap for estimating the limit law of the entire rearranged curve and its functionals. Our limit results are generic in that they apply to every estimator of a monotone function, provided that the estimator satisfies a functional central limit theorem and the function satisfies some smoothness conditions. Consequently, our results apply to estimation of other econometric functions with monotonicity restrictions, such as demand, production, distribution, and structural distribution functions. We illustrate the results with an application to estimation of structural distribution and quantile functions using data on Vietnam veteran status and earnings.

10.3982/ecta7880.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种方法来解决在估计条件分位数函数和结构分位数函数时长期存在的非单调性问题，这一问题也被称为分位数交叉问题（Bassett和Koenker，1982年）。该方法包括将原始的非单调估计曲线进行排序或单调重排，使其成为单调重排后的曲线。我们证明，在有限样本情况下，重排后的曲线比原始曲线更接近真实的分位数曲线。我们还建立了与重排相关的算子的功能型δ方法，并推导了整个重排曲线及其泛函的泛函极限理论。此外，我们还证明了使用自举法估计整个重排曲线及其泛函的极限分布的有效性。我们的极限结果具有通用性，因为它们适用于所有单调函数的估计器，前提是估计器满足功能型中心极限定理，且该函数满足某些平滑性条件。因此，我们的结果也适用于其他具有单调性限制的经济计量函数的估计，例如需求函数、生产函数、分布函数和结构分布函数。我们通过一个应用实例来说明这些结果，该实例是使用关于越南退伍军人状态和收入的数据来估计结构分布和分位数函数。

abstract.text: The coalitional Nash bargaining solution is defined to be the core allocation for which the product of players' payoffs is maximal. We consider a non-cooperative model with discounting in which one team may form and every player is randomly selected to make a proposal in every period. The grand team, consisting of all players, generates the largest surplus. But a smaller team may form. We show that as players get more patient if an efficient and stationary equilibrium exists, it must deliver payoffs that correspond to the coalitional Nash bargaining solution. We also characterize when an efficient and stationary equilibrium exists, which requires conditions that go beyond the nonemptiness of the core.

10.3982/ecta7883.abstractZh: 联合纳什 bargaining 解决方案被定义为一种核心分配方式，其特征是各参与者的收益乘积达到最大值。我们考虑一个带有折扣机制的非合作模型，在这个模型中，一个团队可以形成，并且每个玩家在每一个时期都会被随机选中来提出一个提议。由所有玩家组成的整体团队能够产生最大的收益。但是，也可能形成较小的团队。我们表明，如果存在一种高效且稳定的均衡，那么随着玩家变得更加耐心，这种均衡所提供的收益必然与联合纳什 bargaining 解决方案相对应。我们还描述了存在这种高效且稳定均衡的条件，这些条件超出了核心分配的非空性要求。

abstract.text: We consider a model of strategic trading with asymmetric information of an asset whose value follows a Brownian motion. An insider continuously observes a signal that tracks the evolution of the asset's fundamental value. The value of the asset is publicly revealed at a random time. The equilibrium has two regimes separated by an endogenously determined time T. In [0, T), the insider gradually transfers her information to the market. By time T, all her information has been transferred and the price agrees with the market value of the asset. In the interval [T, ∞), the insider trades large volumes and reveals her information immediately, so market prices track the market value perfectly. Despite this market efficiency, the insider is able to collect strictly positive rents after T.

10.3982/ecta7884.abstractZh: 我们考虑了一个具有不对称信息的战略交易模型，其中资产的价值遵循布朗运动。内部人士持续观察一个信号，该信号追踪资产基本价值的演变。资产的价值在随机时间公开披露。均衡状态分为两个阶段，这两个阶段之间由一个内生确定的时间T分隔。在[0, T)区间内，内部人士逐渐将信息转移给市场。到时间T时，她所有的信息都已转移，市场价格与资产的市场价值一致。在[T, ∞)区间内，内部人士进行大量交易并立即披露信息，因此市场价格完美地跟踪资产的市场价值。尽管市场如此高效，内部人士在T之后仍能获得严格正的收益。

abstract.text: Behavioral choice models generate inequalities which, when combined with additional assumptions, can be used as a basis for estimation. This paper considers two sets of such assumptions and uses them in two empirical examples. The second example examines the structure of payments resulting from the upstream interactions in a vertical market. I then mimic the empirical setting for this example in a numerical analysis which computes actual equilibria, examines how their characteristics vary with the market setting, and compares them to the empirical results. The final section uses the numerical results in a Monte Carlo analysis of the robustness of the two approaches to estimation to their underlying assumptions.

10.3982/ecta7944.abstractZh: 行为选择模型会产生一些不平等现象，这些不平等现象结合其他假设后，可以作为估计的基础。本文考虑了两组这样的假设，并在两个实证案例中应用了这些假设。第二个案例研究了垂直市场中上游互动所导致的支付结构。然后，本文在数值分析中模拟了这一案例的实证环境，计算实际均衡状态，分析这些均衡状态如何随市场环境的变化而变化，并将其与实证结果进行比较。最后一部分利用数值结果，通过蒙特卡洛分析来检验这两种估计方法对其基础假设的稳健性。

abstract.text: Econometrica publishes original articles in all branches of economics - theoretical and empirical, abstract and applied, providing wide-ranging coverage across the subject area. It promotes studies that aim at the unification of the theoretical-quantitative and the empirical-quantitative approach to economic problems and that are penetrated by constructive and rigorous thinking. It explores a unique range of topics each year - from the frontier of theoretical developments in many new and important areas, to research on current and applied economic problems, to methodologically innovative, theoretical and applied studies in econometrics.

10.3982/ecta7953.abstractZh: 《Econometrica》发表经济学各个领域的原创文章——包括理论研究和实证研究、抽象研究和应用研究，涵盖了该学科领域的广泛内容。它倡导旨在统一经济问题的理论定量方法和实证定量方法的研究，并强调建设性和严谨性的思维方式。每年，《Econometrica》都会探索一系列独特的主题——从许多新领域中的理论发展前沿，到当前和应用性经济问题的研究，再到方法创新性的理论和应用性计量学研究。

abstract.text: We present a model in which a principal delegates the choice of project to an agent with different preferences. The principal determines the set of projects from which the agent may choose. The principal can verify the characteristics of the project chosen by the agent, but does not know which other projects were available to the agent. We consider situations where the collection of available projects is exogenous to the agent but uncertain, where the agent must invest effort to discover a project, where the principal can pay the agent to choose a desirable project, and where the principal can adopt more complex schemes than simple permission sets.

10.3982/ecta7965.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个模型，其中委托人将项目选择权委托给一个具有不同偏好的代理人。委托人确定代理人可以选择的项目集合。委托人可以验证代理人所选项目的特性，但不知道代理人还有哪些其他项目可供选择。我们考虑了以下情况：可用项目的集合对代理人来说是外生的且不确定的；代理人必须投入努力来发现项目；委托人可以支付代理人以选择理想的项目；以及委托人可以采用比简单许可机制更复杂的方案。

abstract.text: Does expertise in strategic behavior obtained in the field transfer to the abstract setting of the laboratory? Palacios-Huerta and Volij (2008) argued that the behavior of professional soccer players in mixed-strategy games conforms closely to minimax play, while the behavior of students (who are presumably novices in strategic situations requiring unpredictability) does not. We reexamine their data, showing that the play of professionals is inconsistent with the minimax hypothesis in several respects: (i) professionals follow nonstationary mixtures, with action frequencies that are negatively correlated between the first and the second half of the experiment, (ii) professionals tend to switch between under- and overplaying an action relative to its equilibrium frequency, and (iii) the distribution of action frequencies across professionals is far from the distribution implied by minimax. In each respect, the behavior of students conforms more closely to the minimax hypothesis.

10.3982/ecta7970.abstractZh: 在战略行为领域的专业知识能否转移到实验室的抽象环境中？Palacios-Huerta和Volij（2008）指出，专业足球运动员在混合策略游戏中的行为更接近最小最大策略，而学生（在需要不可预测性的战略情境下，他们通常是新手）的行为则不符合这一假设。我们重新分析了他们的数据，发现专业运动员的行为在几个方面与最小最大假设不符：(i) 专业运动员遵循非平稳的混合策略，其行动频率在实验的前半段和后半段之间存在负相关；(ii) 专业运动员倾向于在均衡频率之下或之上进行行动；(iii) 专业运动员的行动频率分布与最小最大假设所暗示的分布相差甚远。在每一个方面，学生的行为都更符合最小最大假设。

abstract.text: This paper combines dynamic social choice and strategic experimentation to study the following question: How does a society, a committee, or, more generally, a group of individuals with potentially heterogeneous preferences, experiment with new opportunities? Each voter recognizes that, during experimentation, other voters also learn about their preferences. As a result, pivotal voters today are biased against experimentation because it reduces their likelihood of remaining pivotal. This phenomenon reduces equilibrium experimentation below the socially efficient level, and may even result in a negative option value of experimentation. However, one can restore efficiency by designing a voting rule that depends deterministically on time. Another main result is that even when payoffs of a reform are independently distributed across the population, good news about any individual's payoff increases other individuals' incentives to experiment with that reform, due to a positive voting externality.

10.3982/ecta8011.abstractZh: 本文结合动态社会选择与策略性实验，探讨以下问题：一个社会、一个委员会，或者更一般地说，一个具有潜在异质偏好的群体，是如何尝试新机会的？每位选民都意识到，在实验过程中，其他选民也会了解他们的偏好。因此，当前的关键选民往往对实验持反对态度，因为实验会降低他们保持关键性的可能性。这种现象使得均衡实验的水平低于社会效率水平，甚至可能导致实验的负面选择价值。然而，通过设计一个依赖于时间的投票规则，可以恢复效率。另一个主要结论是，即使改革的收益在人群中独立分布，关于任何个体收益的好消息也会增加其他个体尝试该改革的动机，这是由于积极的投票外部性所致。

abstract.text: We prove—in the standard independent private-values model—that the outcome, in terms of interim expected probabilities of trade and interim expected transfers, of any Bayesian mechanism can also be obtained with a dominant-strategy mechanism.

10.3982/ecta8025.abstractZh: 我们在标准的独立私有价值模型中证明了，任何贝叶斯机制的结果，从交易的中期预期概率和中期预期转移的角度来看，也可以用占优策略机制来获得。

abstract.text: This paper introduces a novel bootstrap procedure to perform inference in a wide class of partially identified econometric models. We consider econometric models defined by finitely many weak moment inequalities,2 which encompass many applications of economic interest. The objective of our inferential procedure is to cover the identified set with a prespecified probability.3 We compare our bootstrap procedure, a competing asymptotic approximation, and subsampling procedures in terms of the rate at which they achieve the desired coverage level, also known as the error in the coverage probability. Under certain conditions, we show that our bootstrap procedure and the asymptotic approximation have the same order of error in the coverage probability, which is smaller than that obtained by using subsampling. This implies that inference based on our bootstrap and asymptotic approximation should eventually be more precise than inference based on subsampling. A Monte Carlo study confirms this finding in a small sample simulation.

10.3982/ecta8056.abstractZh: 本文介绍了一种新颖的自举法，用于在广泛类别的部分识别计量经济模型中进行推断。我们考虑由有限多个弱矩不等式定义的计量经济模型，这些模型涵盖了许多具有经济意义的应用。我们的推断程序的目标是以预先指定的概率覆盖已识别的模型集合。我们比较了我们的自举法、一种竞争性的渐近近似法以及子样本法在达到所需覆盖水平的速度方面的表现，这也被称为覆盖概率的误差。在某些条件下，我们表明我们的自举法和渐近近似法在覆盖概率的误差方面具有相同的阶数，这比使用子样本法获得的误差要小。这意味着基于我们的自举法和渐近近似法的推断最终应该比基于子样本法的推断更为精确。一项蒙特卡洛研究在小型样本模拟中证实了这一发现。

abstract.text: We examine the labor market effects of incomplete information about the workers' own job-finding process. Search outcomes convey valuable information, and learning from search generates endogenous heterogeneity in workers' beliefs about their job-finding probability. We characterize this process and analyze its interactions with job creation and wage determination. Our theory sheds new light on how unemployment can affect workers' labor market outcomes and wage determination, providing a rational explanation for discouragement as the consequence of negative search outcomes. In particular, longer unemployment durations are likely to be followed by lower reemployment wages because a worker's beliefs about his job-finding process deteriorate with unemployment duration. Moreover, our analysis provides a set of useful results on dynamic programming with optimal learning.

10.3982/ecta8061.abstractZh: 我们研究了关于劳动者自身求职过程的信息不完整对劳动力市场的影响。求职结果传递了有价值的信息，而从搜索过程中获得的知识使得劳动者对其求职概率的信念产生内生性差异。我们描述了这一过程，并分析了其与就业创造和工资决定之间的相互作用。我们的理论为失业如何影响劳动者的劳动力市场结果和工资决定提供了新的视角，并为负面求职结果导致的沮丧情绪提供了合理的解释。特别是，较长的失业时间可能会导致重新就业时的工资降低，因为劳动者对其求职过程的信念会随着失业时间的延长而恶化。此外，我们的分析还提供了一系列关于动态规划与最优学习的有用结果。

abstract.text: The absence of state capacities to raise revenue and to support markets is a key factor in explaining the persistence of weak states. This paper reports on an ongoing project to investigate the incentive to invest in such capacities. The paper sets out a simple analytical structure in which state capacities are modeled as forward looking investments by government. The approach highlights some determinants of state building including the risk of external or internal conflict, the degree of political instability, and dependence on natural resources. Throughout, we link these state capacity investments to patterns of development and growth.

10.3982/ecta8073.abstractZh: 国家缺乏筹集收入和支撑市场的能力是解释国家持续弱小状态的一个关键因素。本文报道了一个正在进行的项目，旨在研究投资此类能力的动机。文章提出了一个简单的分析框架，将国家能力模型化为政府的前瞻性投资。该方法强调了一些影响国家建设的关键因素，包括外部或内部冲突的风险、政治不稳定程度以及对自然资源的依赖。在整个分析中，我们将这些国家能力投资与发展和增长模式联系起来。

abstract.text: We use a preference-over-menus framework to model a decision maker who is affected by multiple temptations. Our two main axioms on preference—exclusion and inclusion—identify when the agent would want to restrict his choice set and when he would want to expand his choice set. An agent who is tempted would want to restrict his choice set by excluding the normatively worst alternative of that choice set. Simultaneously, he would want to expand his choice set by including a normatively superior alternative. Our representation identifies the agent's normative preference and temptations, and suggests the agent is uncertain which of these temptations will affect him. We provide examples to illustrate how our model improves on those of Gul and Pesendorfer (2001) and Dekel, Lipman, and Rustichini (2009).

10.3982/ecta8090.abstractZh: 我们采用偏好优先框架来模拟受到多重诱惑影响的决策者。关于偏好的两个主要公理——排除与包含——分别定义了决策者何时希望限制其选择集，以及何时希望扩展其选择集。受到诱惑的决策者会倾向于通过排除选择集中规范上最糟糕的替代方案来限制选择集。同时，他也会倾向于通过包含规范上更优的替代方案来扩展选择集。我们的模型能够识别决策者的规范偏好与诱惑，并表明决策者不确定哪些诱惑会对其产生影响。我们通过实例说明了我们的模型如何改进了Gul和Pesendorfer（2001年）以及Dekel、Lipman和Rustichini（2009年）的模型。

abstract.text: We use a second-price common-value auction, called the maximal game, to experimentally study whether the winner's curse (WC) can be explained by models which retain best-response behavior but allow for inconsistent beliefs. We compare behavior in a regular version of the maximal game, where the WC can be explained by inconsistent beliefs, to behavior in versions where such explanations are less plausible. We find little evidence of differences in behavior. Overall, our study casts a serious doubt on theories that posit the WC is driven by beliefs.

10.3982/ecta8112.abstractZh: 我们采用一种称为“最大博弈”的二次价格共同价值拍卖机制，通过实验研究“赢家诅咒”现象是否可以通过保留最佳响应行为但允许不一致信念的模型来解释。我们将“最大博弈”的常规版本中的行为（其中“赢家诅咒”可以通过不一致信念来解释）与那些这种解释不太可能成立的版本中的行为进行了比较。我们发现行为上几乎没有差异。总体而言，我们的研究对那些认为“赢家诅咒”是由信念驱动的理论的真实性提出了严重质疑。

abstract.text: This study utilizes regression discontinuity to examine the long-run impacts of the mita, an extensive forced mining labor system in effect in Peru and Bolivia between 1573 and 1812. Results indicate that a mita effect lowers household consumption by around 25% and increases the prevalence of stunted growth in children by around 6 percentage points in subjected districts today. Using data from the Spanish Empire and Peruvian Republic to trace channels of institutional persistence, I show that the mita's influence has persisted through its impacts on land tenure and public goods provision. Mita districts historically had fewer large landowners and lower educational attainment. Today, they are less integrated into road networks and their residents are substantially more likely to be subsistence farmers.

10.3982/ecta8121.abstractZh: 本研究采用回归不连续方法，考察了1573至1812年间在秘鲁和玻利维亚实施的mita制度对长期影响的分析。研究结果表明，mita制度导致家庭消费减少约25%，并使受该制度影响的地区儿童生长迟缓的比例增加约6个百分点。通过西班牙帝国和秘鲁共和国的数据，我们揭示了mita制度通过影响土地所有权和公共产品供给而持续发挥作用。历史上，mita制度实施地区的土地所有者数量较少，教育水平也较低。如今，这些地区在道路网络中的参与度较低，居民更可能从事自给农业。

abstract.text: An emerging literature in time series econometrics concerns the modeling of potentially nonlinear temporal dependence in stationary Markov chains using copula functions. We obtain sufficient conditions for a geometric rate of mixing in models of this kind. Geometric β-mixing is established under a rather strong sufficient condition that rules out asymmetry and tail dependence in the copula function. Geometric ρ-mixing is obtained under a weaker condition that permits both asymmetry and tail dependence. We verify one or both of these conditions for a range of parametric copula functions that are popular in applied work.

10.3982/ecta8152.abstractZh: 在时间序列计量经济学领域，有一批新兴的研究关注于使用copula函数对平稳马尔可夫链中可能存在非线性时间依赖性进行建模。我们得出了这类模型中几何混合率成立的充分条件。在一种较为严格的充分条件下，可以建立几何β混合，该条件排除了copula函数中的不对称性和尾部依赖性。而在较弱的条件下，则可以建立几何ρ混合，这种条件允许不对称性和尾部依赖性同时存在。我们对一系列在应用研究中常用的参数化copula函数验证了上述条件之一或两者。

abstract.text: Experimental evidence suggests that individuals are more risk averse when they perceive risk that is gradually resolved over time. We address these findings by studying a decision maker (DM) who has recursive, non-expected utility preferences over compound lotteries. DM has preferences for one-shot resolution of uncertainty (PORU) if he always prefers any compound lottery to be resolved in a single stage. We establish an equivalence between dynamic PORU and static preferences that are identified with commonly observed behavior in Allais-type experiments. The implications of this equivalence on preferences over information systems are examined. We define the gradual resolution premium and demonstrate its magnifying effect when combined with the usual risk premium. In an intertemporal context, PORU captures "loss aversion with narrow framing."

10.3982/ecta8219.abstractZh: 实验证据表明，当个体感知到的风险是随着时间逐渐解决的时，他们更倾向于规避风险。我们通过研究一个具有递归性、非预期效用偏好的决策者来探讨这些发现。该决策者倾向于一次性解决不确定性问题（PORU），如果他总是希望任何复合彩票在单一阶段内得到解决。我们建立了动态PORU与静态偏好之间的等价性，这种等价性对应于Allais型实验中常见的行为。我们进一步探讨了这种等价性对信息系统偏好的影响。我们定义了渐进解决溢价，并展示了其与常规风险溢价结合时的放大效应。在跨时间背景下，PORU体现了“具有狭窄框架的损失厌恶”。

abstract.text: A decision maker (DM) is characterized by two binary relations. The first reflects choices that are rational in an “objective” sense: the DM can convince others that she is right in making them. The second relation models choices that are rational in a “subjective” sense: the DM cannot be convinced that she is wrong in making them. In the context of decision under uncertainty, we propose axioms that the two notions of rationality might satisfy. These axioms allow a joint representation by a single set of prior probabilities and a single utility index. It is “objectively rational” to choose f in the presence of g if and only if the expected utility of f is at least as high as that of g given each and every prior in the set. It is “subjectively rational” to choose f rather than g if and only if the minimal expected utility of f (with respect to all priors in the set) is at least as high as that of g. In other words, the objective and subjective rationality relations admit, respectively, a representation à la Bewley (2002) and à la Gilboa and Schmeidler (1989). Our results thus provide a bridge between these two classic models, as well as a novel foundation for the latter.

10.3982/ecta8223.abstractZh: 决策者具有两种二元关系。第一种关系反映了在“客观”意义上的理性选择：决策者能够说服他人相信她的选择是正确的。第二种关系则描述了在“主观”意义上的理性选择：决策者无法被说服认为她的选择是错误的。在不确定性下的决策背景下，我们提出了两个理性概念可能满足的公理。这些公理允许通过一组先验概率和单一的效用指标来共同表示决策。在给定所有先验概率的情况下，选择f而不仅仅选择g是“客观理性”的，当且仅当f的预期效用至少与g的效用相当。选择f而不是g是“主观理性”的，当且仅当f的最小预期效用（相对于集合中的所有先验概率）至少与g的效用相当。换句话说，客观和主观的理性关系分别允许采用Bewley（2002）和Gilboa与Schmeidler（1989）的方法进行表示。我们的研究结果因此为这两种经典模型之间架起了桥梁，并为后者提供了新的理论基础。

abstract.text: The random priority (random serial dictatorship) mechanism is a common method for assigning objects. The mechanism is easy to implement and strategy-proof. However, this mechanism is inefficient, because all agents may be made better off by another mechanism that increases their chances of obtaining more preferred objects. This form of inefficiency is eliminated by a mechanism called probabilistic serial, but this mechanism is not strategy-proof. Thus, which mechanism to employ in practical applications is an open question. We show that these mechanisms become equivalent when the market becomes large. More specifically, given a set of object types, the random assignments in these mechanisms converge to each other as the number of copies of each object type approaches infinity. Thus, the inefficiency of the random priority mechanism becomes small in large markets. Our result gives some rationale for the common use of the random priority mechanism in practical problems such as student placement in public schools.

10.3982/ecta8354.abstractZh: 随机优先机制是一种常用的对象分配方法。该机制易于实施且具备策略防御性。然而，这种机制效率较低，因为所有代理人都可能因另一种机制而获得更好的收益，从而增加他们获得更受青睐对象的几率。这种低效现象可以通过概率序列机制来消除，但这一机制并不具备策略防御性。因此，在实际应用中应采用哪种机制仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。我们证明，当市场规模扩大时，这些机制会变得等效。更具体地说，给定一组对象类型，随着每种对象类型的副本数量趋于无穷大，这些机制中的随机分配会趋于一致。因此，在大型市场中，随机优先机制的低效性会显著降低。我们的研究结果为在诸如公立学校学生分配等实际问题中普遍使用随机优先机制提供了一定的理论依据。

abstract.text: This paper provides a directed search model designed to explain the residual part of wage variation left over after the impact of education and other observable worker characteristics have been removed. Workers have private information about their characteristics at the time they apply for jobs. Firms value these characteristics differently and can observe them once workers apply. They hire the worker they most prefer. However, the characteristics are not contractible, so firms cannot condition their wages on them. This paper shows how to extend arguments from directed search to handle this, allowing for arbitrary distributions of worker and firm types. The model is used to provide a functional relationship that ties together the wage distribution and the wage–duration function. This relationship provides a testable implication of the model. This relationship suggests a common property of wage distributions that guarantees that workers who leave unemployment at the highest wages also have the shortest unemployment duration. This is in strict contrast to the usual (and somewhat implausible) directed search story in which high wages are always accompanied by higher probability of unemployment.

10.3982/ecta8379.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个有向搜索模型，旨在解释在去除教育和其他可观测的工人特征的影响后，工资变化的剩余部分。工人在申请工作时拥有关于自身特征的私人信息。企业对这些特征的价值评估不同，并且只能在工人申请时观察到这些特征。企业会雇佣他们最青睐的工人。然而，这些特征是不可契约的，因此企业无法根据这些特征来设定工资。本文展示了如何将有向搜索的论点扩展以处理这一问题，从而允许工人和企业类型的任意分布。该模型用于建立工资分布与工资-持续时间函数之间的功能关系。这种关系为模型的验证提供了依据。该关系表明，工资分布具有某种共同特性：以最高工资离职的工人，其失业持续时间也最短。这与通常的有向搜索理论（尽管有些不合逻辑）形成了鲜明对比，在通常的理论中，高工资总是伴随着更高的失业概率。

abstract.text: This paper considers a panel data model for predicting a binary outcome. The conditional probability of a positive response is obtained by evaluating a given distribution function (F) at a linear combination of the predictor variables. One of the predictor variables is unobserved. It is a random effect that varies across individuals but is constant over time. The semiparametric aspect is that the conditional distribution of the random effect, given the predictor variables, is unrestricted.

10.3982/ecta8419.abstractZh: 本文考虑了一个用于预测二元结果的面板数据模型。通过评估给定分布函数（F）在预测变量线性组合下的取值，可以得到正面响应的条件概率。其中一个预测变量是未观测到的，它是一个随机效应，在个体之间会发生变化，但在时间上保持不变。半参数性的特点在于，给定预测变量的情况下，随机效应的条件分布是不受限制的。

abstract.text: Simple exchange experiments have revealed that participants trade their endowment less frequently than standard demand theory would predict. List (2003a) found that the most experienced dealers acting in a well functioning market are not subject to this exchange asymmetry, suggesting that a significant amount of market experience is required to overcome it. To understand this market-experience effect, we introduce a distinction between two types of uncertainty—choice uncertainty and trade uncertainty—both of which could lead to exchange asymmetry. We conjecture that trade uncertainty is most important for exchange asymmetry. To test this conjecture, we design an experiment where the two treatments impact differently on trade uncertainty, while controlling for choice uncertainty. Supporting our conjecture, we find that “forcing” subjects to give away their endowment in a series of exchanges eliminates exchange asymmetry in a subsequent test. We discuss why markets might not provide sufficient incentives for learning to overcome exchange asymmetry.

10.3982/ecta8424.abstractZh: 简单的交换实验表明，参与者交易其资产的频率低于标准需求理论所预测的。List（2003a）发现，在运作良好的市场中，经验最丰富的交易员不会受到这种交换不对称性的影响，这表明需要大量的市场经验才能克服这种问题。为了理解这种市场经验效应，我们区分了两种类型的不确定性——选择不确定性和交易不确定性——这两种不确定性都可能导致交换不对称性。我们推测，交易不确定性对交换不对称性最为重要。为了验证这一推测，我们设计了一个实验，其中两种处理方式对交易不确定性产生不同的影响，同时控制了选择不确定性。支持我们的推测的是，我们发现通过“强制”受试者在一系列交换中放弃其资产，可以在后续的测试中消除交换不对称性。我们讨论了为什么市场可能无法提供足够的激励来促使人们学习如何克服交换不对称性。

abstract.text: We extend the notion of competitive search equilibrium to an environment with adverse selection. Uninformed principals post contracts to attract informed agents. Agents observe the contracts and apply for one, trading off the probability of matching with a principal against the terms of trade offered by the contract. We characterize equilibria as the solution to a constrained optimization problem and show that in equilibrium principals offers separating contracts to attract different types of agents. We then present a set of examples to illustrate the usefulness of our model.

10.3982/ecta8535.abstractZh: 我们将竞争搜索均衡的概念扩展到了存在逆向选择的环境。信息不充分的委托人发布合同以吸引信息充分的代理人。代理人观察合同并选择其中一份，以匹配委托人的概率与合同提供的交易条件进行权衡。我们将均衡描述为约束优化问题的解，并表明在均衡状态下，委托人会提供不同的合同以吸引不同类型的代理人。随后，我们通过一系列例子来说明我们模型的有效性。

abstract.text: This paper studies repeated games with imperfect public monitoring where the players are uncertain both about the payoff functions and about the relationship between the distribution of signals and the actions played. We introduce the concept of perfect public ex post equilibrium (PPXE), and show that it can be characterized with an extension of the techniques used to study perfect public equilibria. We develop identifiability conditions that are sufficient for a folk theorem; these conditions imply that there are PPXE in which the payoffs are approximately the same as if the monitoring structure and payoff functions were known. Finally, we define perfect type-contingently public ex post equilibria (PTXE), which allows players to condition their actions on their initial private information, and we provide its linear programming characterization.

10.3982/ecta8565.abstractZh: 本文研究了存在不完美公共监控的重复博弈，其中参与者对收益函数以及信号分配与行为之间的关系都持不确定态度。我们引入了完美公共事后均衡的概念，并证明可以用研究完美公共均衡的技术来对其进行描述。我们提出了可识别性条件，这些条件足以构成一个folk定理；这些条件意味着存在完美公共事后均衡，在这种均衡中，收益大致与监控结构和收益函数已知时的情况相同。最后，我们定义了完美类型条件性公共事后均衡，这种均衡允许参与者根据初始的私人信息来制定行为，并提供了其线性规划描述。

abstract.text: We study optimal taxation when consumers have temptation and self-control problems. Embedding the class of preferences developed by Gul and Pesendorfer into a standard macroeconomic setting, we first prove, in a two-period model, that the optimal policy is to subsidize savings when consumers are tempted by “excessive” impatience. The savings subsidy improves welfare because it makes succumbing to temptation less attractive. We then study an economy with a long but finite horizon which nests, as a special case, the Phelps–Pollak–Laibson multiple-selves model (thereby providing guidance on how to evaluate welfare in this model). We prove that when period utility is logarithmic, the optimal savings subsidies increase over time for any finite horizon. Moreover, as the horizon grows large, the optimal policy prescribes a constant subsidy, in contrast to the well known Chamley–Judd result.

10.3982/ecta8611.abstractZh: 我们研究了在消费者面临诱惑和自我控制问题时的最优税收问题。将Gul和Pesendorfer提出的偏好类嵌入到标准的宏观经济框架中，我们首先在一个两期模型中证明了，当消费者受到“过度”急躁的诱惑时，最优政策是提供储蓄补贴。储蓄补贴能够改善福利，因为它使得屈服于诱惑的吸引力降低。随后，我们研究了一个具有长但有限时间范围的 economy，该模型作为特例包含了Phelps–Pollak–Laibson多重自我模型（从而为评估该模型中的福利提供了指导）。我们证明了，当期效用是对数形式时，对于任何有限的时间范围，最优储蓄补贴都会随时间增加。此外，随着时间范围的扩大，最优政策规定的是恒定的补贴，这与众所周知的Chamley–Judd结果不同。

abstract.text: This paper develops a new framework for examining the determinants of wage distributions that emphasizes within-industry reallocation, labor market frictions, and differences in workforce composition across firms. More productive firms pay higher wages and exporting increases the wage paid by a firm with a given productivity. The opening of trade enhances wage inequality and can either raise or reduce unemployment. While wage inequality is higher in a trade equilibrium than in autarky, gradual trade liberalization first increases and later decreases inequality.

10.3982/ecta8640.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个新的框架，用于分析工资分布的决定因素，该框架强调行业内再分配、劳动力市场摩擦以及不同企业之间的劳动力构成差异。生产力更高的企业支付更高的工资，而出口行为会增加具有特定生产力的企业的工资水平。贸易的开放会加剧工资不平等，同时可能提高或降低失业率。虽然贸易均衡状态下的工资不平等程度高于自给自足状态，但逐步的贸易自由化会先增加不平等程度，随后又会有所下降。

abstract.text: Two Ellsberg-style thought experiments are described that reflect on the smooth ambiguity decision model developed by Klibanoff, Marinacci, and Mukerji (2005). The first experiment poses difficulties for the model's axiomatic foundations and, as a result, also for its interpretation, particularly for the claim that the model achieves a separation between ambiguity and the attitude toward ambiguity. Given the problematic nature of its foundations, the behavioral content of the model and how it differs from multiple priors, for example, are not clear. The second thought experiment casts some light on these questions.

10.3982/ecta8689.abstractZh: 文中描述了两个基于Ellsberg思想实验的探讨，这些实验反思了Klibanoff、Marinacci和Mukerji在2005年提出的平滑模糊性决策模型。第一个实验对该模型的基础公理提出了挑战，因此也影响了对其的解释，尤其是关于该模型能否实现模糊性与对模糊性的态度之间的分离这一观点的解释。鉴于其基础存在的缺陷，该模型的行为内容以及它与多重先验假设的差异等细节并不明确。第二个思想实验则对这些问题提供了一些启示。

abstract.text: Consider an environment with a finite number of alternatives, and agents with private values and quasilinear utility functions. A domain of valuation functions for an agent is a monotonicity domain if every finite-valued monotone randomized allocation rule defined on it is implementable in dominant strategies. We fully characterize the set of all monotonicity domains.

10.3982/ecta8882.abstractZh: 考虑一个具有有限数量替代方案的环境，以及具有私人价值且具有准线性效用函数的代理人。如果在该环境中定义的每一个有限值单调随机分配规则都能通过支配策略来实现，那么一个代理人的估值函数域就被称为单调域。我们完全描述了所有单调域的集合。

abstract.text: We offer an axiomatization of the serial cost-sharing method of Friedman and Moulin (1999). The key property in our axiom system is Group Demand Monotonicity, asking that when a group of agents raise their demands, not all of them should pay less.

10.3982/ecta9019.abstractZh: 我们提出了对Friedman和Moulin（1999）提出的序列成本分摊方法的公理化表述。我们公理体系中的关键属性是群体需求单调性，即当一组代理人的需求增加时，并非所有代理人的支付都应减少。
